title: Toru
description: Toru is a bullet-hell platformer where absolutely everything that falls into your hands becomes a weapon! Boxes, crystals, bombs and even the enemies themselves! Your success depends only on your skill!

title: Lěngxiě Zhèng Shǎizǐ
description: This is a text adventure game, different options have different endings. Be careful, don't be killed by the psychopathic heroines because of the wrong choice!

title: Skyratz
description: Take to the air as one of six unique heroes and soar through Avion City as you perform tricky maneuvers, hunt for weapons and armor, and battle in the skies to claim your spot on the pecking order!

title: Life of Food
description: Play through a campaign with multiple levels, or fight against or with your friends in the arena. Play as four different types of characters, plus a secret character unlocked by finishing the campaign. Each character has a unique set of skills and animations.

title: Move It Up
description: Move It Up V1.1 brings a unique rhythm game experience with random level generator and battle mode.

title: Guns Blazing
description: Descend your way through an abandoned laboratory, swarming with both mechanical and human enemies. Your mission? Wipe them all out. In this fast-paced, casual, sci-fi, FPS, your goal is to employ an arsenal of upgradable weapons to defeat your enemies and reach the bottom of this derelict facility.

title: Dwarves & Dungeons
description: The game is innovated on the traditional game of Match-3 Puzzler, combined with the elements of rougelike game, adding hard core content, bringing a new and unique experience.

title: Denari
description: Denari twists the hack and slasher genre with the power of telekinesis, allowing players to redirect enemy projectiles. The story follows a young warrior gifted with the power of a goddess to fight the invading Denari empire.

title: Eternity Protectors
description: They are coming. Ready your weapons. Get behind that wall. Shoot... and run! Includes 20 minutes session Hero Defense: Shoot, dodge, summon, run, defend, die, respawn, unlock new characters, replay. Have fun.

title: Security Guy vs. AI: The Dawn of AI
description: Security Guy vs. AI: The Dawn of AI is a short top-down shooter game with a mysterious story. Reveal the truth about what happened at your workplace and stop the Evil Artificial Intelligence from spreading out.

title: Liberte
description: Liberté is a deck-builder roguelite inspired by the French Revolution and body horror. Brave the war-torn streets as Rene - a regular Parisian entangled in a civil war caused by a cryptic invader from another dimension, Lady Bliss. Collect cards, nurture alliances, and try to stay alive!

title: Escape from Poalet
description: Escape from Poalet is a point & click 3D graphic adventure game for one player. Help our protagonist to escape from Poalet while discovering all its secrets.

title: Dark Spot
description: Dark Spot is a puzzle game with hand drawn graphics. Use the mouse to move the dark spot and try not to drop it. The goal of the game is to collect all the stars on the screen and go to the exit. At the moment there are 14 levels available with pleasant music and the difficulty increases with each level.

title: Zigglox
description: Team up with friends or get online and find bricks to build the highest and prettiest tower before the other team ! Beware though, some bricks are... specials!

title: Silly Polly Beast
description: This story is about a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven roguelike with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

title: VR Fighter Jets War
description: This is a VR immersive flight shooting game with exquisite and gorgeous graphics. The overall environment is mainly based on aerial combat. High-fidelity sound effects provide players with a different shooting experience.

title: Abelana's Atom Maker
description: Visualize atomic orbitals, navigate across energy levels, gain an intuitive understanding of the composition of atoms and their electron configurations by assembling all elements of the periodic table. An educational VR experience designed for use by enthusiasts and academics alike.

title: Fractal Alchemist
description: Fractal Alchemist is a tool for creating and exploring 3D Fractal Worlds. For this you do not need knowledge of mathematics and programming - the Alchemist will do everything for you.

title: Drema
description: Drema is first-person quest that guides you through a series of unique locations, each with a story to tell. A journey through consciousness, with puzzle and horror elements.

title: Sunset Shapes
description: Bring broken pieces together, to reveal shapes of everyday objects. Travel with a Daisy and a Maggot along side several scenarios and discover to where they are headed to.

title: Neon Dimension
description: Welcome to an old-school arcade game with a modern design, in which you will enjoy exciting visual effects and excellent physics. And the relaxing gameplay is so easy to learn that you'll understand the whole idea after a few tries!

title: Void Marauders
description: Lead a band of space pirates and loot and pillage your way across the stars in this turn based tactical game!

title: Slimekeep
description: In a world becoming corrupted by the evil Slime King, KILL or CAPTURE various slimes to grow stronger and save Slimetopia! Venture through procedurally generated levels in this fast-paced roguelike, if you're tough enough to not get slimed...

title: Booobjz
description: You have to solve puzzles and switch gravity.

title: Hundun
description: First-person shooter adventure game 3D shooting, platform jumping, adventure puzzle solving Have a great gun shooting experience

title: Giant Blobs From Mars
description: You are a Giant Blob From Mars who has come to Earth to devour it's rich resources. Consume land to gain energy and leave no land untouched! This casual strategy game allows a single player to escape into mindless game play for hours while listening to a soothing acoustic guitar soundtrack.

title: Puerto Viejo
description: Puerto Viejo is a delightful story set during the Spanish Golden Age. You play as Miguel, a young boy on a quest to follow his father’s steps. Explore the city and its surroundings while meeting a colorful cast of characters along the way.

title: Fall of the Mafia
description: Fall Of The Mafia is a 2D action mafia game.

title: Shu's Misfortune
description: Shu's Misfortune is a sample RPG made in RPG Maker MZ. As Shu, end your father's haute couture legacy by unraveling his empire of fashion.

title: Clerk Hot Tale
description: Clerk Hot Tale is a visual novel in which the player goes through all the circles of bureaucratic hell, accompanied by an adorable female official.

title: Loch Mess
description: A 1 to 2-player co-op puzzle game featuring Scottish cryptids

title: Dab on Darkness!
description: Dab On Darkness is a cozy, short, non-linear visual novel where you learn real world, practical tactics to deal with those nasty thoughts you would rather not have. Make the correct decision as your inner negativity manifests into a cute anime girl, lest you despair into the darkness...

title: Tail Trail
description: Follow the story of a Private investigator hired to find a missing person on a mysterious island.

title: Space Ninja Simulator
description: Its a Space Game Simulator but your also an Ninja. Oh, and you'll destroy thousands of asteroids with your ninja powers!

title: Digital Janitors
description: Digital Janitors is an action-packed desktop defense game where hackers have taken your employer’s network hostage, which means the player must go to each computer in the company, excise the virus, and beat the hacker threat.

title: Life is sad
description: The game simulates a person in a state of depression and allows you to play while your days go by. The content includes images and sounds that may remind you of sadness, or even the pain of loss. It's a game about life and choices.

title: Skull Head World
description: Defend Skull Head World. Shoot skulls at invading skulls. Collect skulls to protect your skull. Flush skulls to upgrade. Part single-stick bullet-hell shooter, part top-down physics brawler. Super addictive arcade fun.

title: Squirrel Divorce
description: Squirrel Divorce is a top down game where you control a squirrel and dodge the moles that crawl out of their holes, and also run away from annoying ex-wives and collect scattered luggage around the location. Each time one of the wives steals your truck and you have to catch up with a heavy truck.

title: Demian: The Ritual
description: There was a forest front of a girl who awake from a dream. The girl couldn’t remember anything and she didn’t know where to go. She wandered in forest to get out of there, and she met strange family. The family's destination was a house that spirits who had a grudge lived.

title: Mariachi Undead
description: Mariachi Undead is a hand drawn, rhythm, cover based shoot-em-up, action side scrolling platformer where you can even play with a guitar and controller at the same time.

title: Versus: The Deathscapes
description: When a new threat emerges on planet Versus, you and your allies are forced to explore the dreaded Deathscapes to survive.

title: SMIB: Mission Cure
description: SMIB is a small robot with a big problem. Humankind can’t smile anymore and sent SMIB to space to find the cure. It needs YOU to remotely program its routes in its biggest mission: an adventure through the most exotic planets in the Universe. Solve puzzles, find the cure, and get SMIB back to Earth!

title: Alchemania
description: Alchemania is a pixel arcade platformer with a side view. This is a reaction game - you need to press button at the correct time.

title: Silence in the Dark
description: This is 2D Horror, survival, puzzle solving, action noir inspired by classic Japanese horror games.

title: Two Brain Sides
description: Two Brain Sides is hard action platformer game where you need to control two geometric shapes at the same time, moving through the danger using the brain to pay attention in different obstacles. Everything happens at the same time.

title: Stone it!
description: Stone it! is a logic puzzle game where you roll the block to the target through winding paths, elevators, bridges. Think over your steps and use lasers to clear your way.

title: Egg Rabbit
description: This is a different platform jumping game.You can control the distance and height of jumping by yourself.

title: Into the Light
description: Damien will have to survive by managing his resources to stay in the light and avoid the appearance of another world with new rules and dangerous residents. Will you be up to the task?

title: Arc Wizards 3
description: The war of the wizards begins! This is an exciting action game with a 16-bit taste!

title: Cardiac Unrest
description: You're a Combat Exorcist tasked with ridding a school of its evil. Armed with your Holy Gun and a Ghostometer, you must locate and exorcise the shadowy spirit terrorizing this school before you get overtaken by its dark evil.

title: Fragments of a Mind
description: Help Cassandra uncover the truth behind her family's betrayal in this action packed adventure game full of intricate puzzles, vicous enemies and deadly traps.

title: Girl Agent
description: Girl Agent is a 3D cartoon shooting game . Set agent training and real-time combat in parallel. The secret plot is quietly brewing in the fog. A number of girl agents have gathered and are waiting for the players. Now join the wishlist and let's go!

title: Riding Shotgun
description: Riding Shotgun is an arcade car combat game. Players commandeer the Crimson Crucible -- driving and shooting across the Mojave mowing down hordes of relentless demons. Keep your wits about you to reach your destination; the City of Sin - Las Vegas.

title: Siren Head: The Siren's Forest
description: In this indie horror game, you must escape the Siren’s Forest! Use multiple means of transportation to aid your escape. Unearth what truly happened in the forest by interacting with certain objects that could provide you with the answers you need. But be careful… There’s something out there!

title: Mysterious Blocks
description: Mysterious Blocks is a puzzle game in which you will find many interesting and difficult levels.

title: BattleJuice Alchemist
description: BattleJuice Alchemist is a singleplayer RPG combining classic top-down combat with third person bullet time. Explore a dark procedural world, learn ritual magic, solve riddles, craft alchemical potions and combine them in deck-building-like fashion to fight the demons overrunning the lands.

title: Gerrymander Madness
description: Gerrymander Madness places gamers into a fictional North Carolina legislator's office and allows them to manipulate the districts of a state map to gain political advantage for a chosen party.

title: Dstnce.
description: Dstnce. is a platforming adventure game where you work your day job, clean up your room, look after your plant, and so much more as you try to get by one step at a time. This is your game, it is what you make of it.

title: Ninja Lexx
description: This is a game about an ordinary guy with a guitar, whose life changed after meeting with bandits.The game has a simple but interesting storyline and cinematics/graphics.

title: Ponk's Jam
description: How fast can you beat Ponk's Jam? Join Ponk on an adventure across the entire Ponk World, fighting small enemies and big bosses! Race to get the best time, the quicker the time means the bigger the winner. Beating the game under a certain time could crown you the best Ponker ever!

title: A Letter to You!
description: A psychological horror game where fear and paranoia merge into a terrifying story!

title: HighFleet
description: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

title: Mini Island: Summer
description: Mini Island: Summer is one small hold & gun, boss rush mini-game of casual difficulty! This beautiful place was built only for simple fun! Choose the character and difficulty level that best suits you and enjoy a short, simple but colorful boss rush mini-game!

title: Treasure Tile
description: Treasure Tile is a hack'n'slash action RPG that takes place in a world completely made up of tiles. You are a tile, you fight other tiles and you earn tile treasure!

title: Parabolus Two
description: Shoot your way across the galaxy in this thrilling adventure! It’s the sci-fi shooter which blends old school game mechanics with modern story driven cinematic experiences. Unlock the mystery of strange events all over the Milky Way and find out who (or what) is behind them.

title: Cannon Lab 13
description: Cannon lab 13 is a laboratory where experiments are carried out to study the behavior of an ultra-bouncing ball after a shot from a special cannon. The game is a puzzle of different levels, where the player has to use logical thinking to get into the hole without spending all attempts to shoot.

title: Minicraft Shooter
description: Minicraft Shooter is an epic time killer shooter with a top view in which you face an endless crowd of zombies, in the scenery of a cyberpunk metropolis, a modern city and a green forest. and all this in a cubic style!

title: Thief Simulator 2
description:
Thief Simulator 2 will transport you to a world full of valuables, expensive cars, and rustling banknotes. As long as you find a way to steal them.
Know that a thief's trade is not a piece of cake. In order to get some practice, you'll start with petty theft. This is how you'll gain the experience required to access more and more risky - and most importantly, more profitable - jobs.

title: NBA 2K22
description: NBA 2K22 puts the entire basketball universe in your hands. Play now in real NBA and WNBA environments against authentic teams and players. Build your own dream team in MyTeam with today’s stars and yesterday’s legends. Live out your own pro journey in MyCareer and experience your personal rise to the NBA. Flex your management skills as a powerful Executive in MyGM and MyLeague. Anyone, anywhere can hoop in NBA 2K22.

title: Choco Pixel 4
description: Choco Pixel 4 is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

title: Sweet Tooth 2
description: Sweet Tooth 2 is a physical puzzle game with a side view. In the second part, there are more new items to pass, the game has become more difficult!

title: Tales from Zilmurik
description: High fantasy turn-based roleplaying game. Immersive story developed over 15 years. A beautifully crafted world rooted in refinement and discipline. Challenging and diverse combat potential.

title: Hexio
description: Connect all the nodes into beautiful and abstract shapes in this exciting puzzle game. Enjoy a relaxing piano soundtrack in your delightful experience.

title: Theater of Carnage
description: Battle for glory in the arena, fighting challengers and climbing the ranks. Show your tactical prowess in this turn-based strategy game. Choose one of distinct factions and put together a team of champions with a set of unique skills. Outsmart and destroy your opponents.

title: The Damathos Clan
description: Travel across different islands, continents and worlds while in the journey to stop a deadly threat and fulfill your duty as a Damathos!

title: Adam the Storyteller
description: Help Adam to solve puzzles around him after being kidnapped by a mysterious land-grabbing floating island. A hand-drawn puzzle-adventure with funny characters, hundred levels and power-up puzzles with unique abilities that will help You to get through a puzzle maze.

title: Jungle House
description: Can you build house in jungle wilderness almost with your hands? Yes, you can! Become an architect in the primitive times for building amazing houses in jungle wilderness with primitive tools. Explore and make houses from secret underground house with pools to houses on high trees.

title: Tale of Ninja: Fall of the Miyoshi
description: Play as a ninja through the Sengoku period of Japan. There are many possible ways to assassinate the target and find your own nindou.

title: Where Is My Mom
description: Where Is My Mom is a side-scrolling game tells a story about the fate of a girl who was stolen.The chapters are divided into stories that differ in gameplay and mechanics: the main mechanics of the game are puzzles but there are also stealth mechanics and horror elements at play as well.

title: WeeRPG
description: Hack and slash your way through this loot-rich ARPG with up to four local friends. Outfit your classless character to look and play the way you want. Tactical gear combinations and combat skill will determine how deep you can go.

title: The Vagabond Emperor
description: The Vagabond Emperor is a 2D RPG where you begin as a simple vagabond who decides to become an emperor in the fictional Middle Ages during a spreading curse. It's up to you to decide what to do and where to go to achieve your goals.

title: Deadzoned
description: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!

title: Lost Bazaar
description: Merchant-princes gather from all corners of the world to sell their bric-a-brac for a tidy profit. An easy to learn, hard to master multiplayer card game where 2 to 4 players compete for the customers in the mythical Bazaar.

title: A Marble's Muse
description: Will you be able to find love and create art in Liliana, a colorful land full of marbles?

title: Video Editor Tycoon
description: Based on tycoon games, Video Editor Tycoon provides a way for you to manage a video publishing company, where your mission is to maintain a financial balance in the face of monthly payments and also a professional balance for employees who are not fired.

title: Ministry of Pandemic
description: Ministry of Pandemic is a strategy and simulation game that forces social and economic balance during the pandemic. Formulate your strategy for survival while keeping all aspects of society steady.

title: Gachi Dungeon Master
description: Take on the role of one of the five legendary gachimuchi icons and enter the arena. Each character is distinguished by their own grips and strikes. Someone falls with his ass right on the face of the opponent, and someone gracefully wringes the opponent's hands.

title: The Legend of The Black Wizard
description: The 'Wizard' (Player) is in an open world 2D Top-Down map. The thing is, not everyone likes him. There's bounties on him, and he needs to survive. He can find allies that can help him, or he can be unlucky and find people that will kill him.

title: Captain Coffer 2D
description: Captain Coffer 2D is an arcade platformer starring a real, immortal treasure of a hero. Hop away on your peglegs and blast doubloons across 16 handcrafted, puzzle-oriented stages. Make your escape before time runs out and save the universe whilst discovering distinct, fantasy-themed worlds!

title: Alien Cat 6
description: If you want to feel like an attentive owner of a restless cat, then this game will be to your taste!

title: Triple Dungeon
description: Control three adventurers simultaneously in this experimental split-screen dungeon crawling adventure!

title: Mars Accident
description: Mars Accident is a 2d shooter where the player dodges a falling and flying saucer. The only thing that raises it is the laser energy bunches that the hero releases and which destroy the aliens. The goal of the game is to fight off the alien attack and protect your spaceship from the attack.

title: Don Flatus: Poop Hunter
description: After years of sending probes to Uranus, all the debris is now orbiting the planet as a ring of junk. The interplanetary commission has now sent a crack cleanup crew to clean the ring around Uranus. The team arrive at the planet and find that Uranus has been invaded by an alien presence!

title: Cyber Hunter: Awakening
description: Cyber ​​Hunter: Awakening is a game about a reckless bounty hunter who went out to hunt criminals in his city.

title: Battle Sad Boy
description: Battle Sad Boy is a third-person character sword fighting game that talks about different topics in each chapter. Visually cartoonish in nature, the game features multiple ideas and is not limited to one style of play.

title: Directive Nine
description: Directive Nine is a VR FPS Roguelite in a sci fi setting. "How is the Galactic Federation ever going to expand with these pesky settlers in the Outer Reaches? Get out there and deal with it for us. You know what I mean. You know. It's... I'm talking about destroying them. Like, dead dead."

title: Blewie
description: Blewie was created and programmed by a 1 man team out of a sheer love of puzzle and platform games. Help Blewie escape the fun-house - with such an epic puzzle-solving adventure as the little ghost, will he catch a break?

title: Clash of Irons: Blitzkrieg
description: Clash of Irons: Blitzkrieg is a real-time tank RPG+SLG game. It recreates the classic tanks of World War II and restores the shocking war scenes with fantasy World War II plots. Command your futuristic tanks across history and rekindle your war spirit with the will of iron and blood.

title: Cave Quest 2
description: Fight back against the underworld by acquiring powerful talents and spells on your journey to save your friends in this exciting and clever Match 3 game!

title: Jack Sprout
description: Jack Sprout is an educational RPG based in the fantasy setting of Beaver Creek Meadow. Players will explore the region to collect resources and complete various tasks for the neighbors. These tasks will help teach Jack about his importance to the community.

title: Slow and Steady
description: Slow and Steady is a game where you make the slowest tortoise ever reach the finish line.

title: Quiet Thoughts
description: Quiet Thoughts is a challenging narrative-driven platformer, centered on Asha's journey as she discovers what lies beyond her forest home, and searches for an escape from her own feelings.

title: Bigfoot Forest
description: Bigfoot Forest is a first-person indie horror game. While traveling in your car, you run out of gas and find yourself far away from any civilized locations at night, with only woods and a small town nearby.

title: Wild Workshop
description: Wild Workshop is a country-life RPG. From now on, you will get yourself an uninhabited island! You can transform the island into your lovely space. Start a farm, keep animals, make DIYs, and even build a house. Gradually accomplish your dreamland and make money at the same time!

title: Zombie Survival Online
description: Zombie Survival Online is a top-down 2D shooting multiplayer game that you can enjoy in 10 to 16 minutes. Pick up items, combine them, and survive the longest among other players in a large city where zombies appear at night! As the days go by, the sort of zombies increases, and poisonous gas hits the city...

title: Rokka
description: Rokka is an atmospheric Winter War simulator where you achieve a "defensive victory" by shooting incoming enemy soldiers and tanks. The game features adult humor.

title: Spawn Kings
description: Spawn Kings is a turn-based monster collecting fantasy RPG in which you are given the freedom on how you wish to level and progress through the game whether it be through completing quest or battling wild monsters.

title: BouncyBoi in Puzzle Land
description: A colourful tile based puzzler, now with added bounce!

title: Russian Mailman Simulator
description: This is an epic first person simulation game where the player defends his mail truck, while delivering letters to the local Russian population. The player must upgrade his gear, survive radiation sickness, and fight wave after wave to fulfill his duty!

title: God Sword
description: God Sword is an online world designed to present the real world，There is life and death, love and hate...

title: Two Bit Hero
description: A classic retro metroidvania - retroidvania if you will - with (mostly) black and white graphics. Handcrafted, fast-paced action with multiple endings.

title: Perfect Heist 2
description: Perfect Heist 2 is a round-based online game, where robbers try to hide in plain sight while robbing a bank without being noticed by the cop team!

title: Escape to Sidious
description: After Earth's downfall, a new planet must now be colonized and defended against attackers. Explore new technologies and revive trade. Settlers, the future lies ahead. Follow me to a better world. May Iridium be with us!

title: Drive 21
description: Drive 21 is a simulation game. By earning money with job opportunities, by making logistics and bus driver, by buying and modifying your own vehicle with the money you earn, you can make your own vehicle and you can travel with your own vehicle with open world driving experience.

title: Pro Deer Hunting 2
description: Pro Deer Hunting 2 continues the great tradition of realistic deer hunting simulations! Major graphics enhancements, inclusion of the muzzle loading rifle and climbing tree stand are just a few of the new features. Keep the tradition alive and become the next Pro Deer Hunter 2!

title: Pog 2
description: Cute, minimal physical puzzle.

title: Brave Deeds of Rescue Team
description: Lead the emergency services, manage vehicles, coordinate various rescue workers and keep regular citizens safe.

title: Gravitators
description:
Gravitators is a Gravity Twin Stick Shooter game where you pilot ships and complete mission objectives to secure the future of humankind. Defend the Earth and travel through the galaxy to repel an alien invasion.

Inspired by classic games like Thrust, Gravitar, Asteroids, Solar Jetman and others, Gravitators unshelves this old genre and overhauls it into modern times, while keeping the genre's trademark features: maneuvering through tight spots while carrying heavy objects, fighting enemies and preserving fuel.

title: Robot Female Hero 3
description: Several years after the events of Robot Female Hero 2, a group of tyranical invaders had arrived to try and take of the Milky way. Standing in their way is the cast from the first game. Once again this is a classic top-down RPG that seeks to recreate the games that dominated the 90's!

title: Era of Defense
description: Era of Defense is a first person open world game, in which your character is stuck back in time with a powerless time machine, surrounded by prehistoric people and prehistoric dangers. You must collect crystals from various sources to power up your time machine and travel back to the present. Crystals are given as rewards for quests given to you by locals, in which you defend sacred temples from onslaughts of enemies. Gain experience points through battle, which you can exchange for ever better weaponry, such as more advanced axes, hammers and bows, which in turn allow you to fight more difficult enemies.

title: Ekstase
description: Amazing techno beats and beautiful visuals set the stage for a game that honors the long forgotten falling block puzzle genre. Ekstase is easy to pick up and sink many hours into. With both classic and new game modes, there is something here for both the casual and the hardcore puzzle game player.

title: Raging Ball
description: Raging Ball is a challenging climbing game in which you control a bouncing ball. Bounce your way through challenging maps and try to reach the top of the world without ragi- ehm falling! You can (probably) do it!

title: Moving Letters
description: Enjoy word find games? Try it and You’ll never experience a dull moment after you try this addicting word puzzle game. Play this game once and just you won’t be able to put it down.

title: Impulse, From Here!
description: Impulse, From Here! is a 2D action game featuring unique aerial controls that allow you to blow yourself up in explosions as you progress! The stages are highly challenging and offer multiple routes, so there's replay-ability! Look at the way the cute girl gets beaten up badly!

title: BunnyShot
description: Play as an Easter bunny, score points and save chickens using Easter eggs in BunnyShot!

title: Military Service
description: Military Service is a side-scrolling shooting game. The protagonist will be transformed into a rifle soldier in voluntary service, learning about firearms, grenades, and marching. Use guns and grenades to knock down enemies encountered in the mission! Based on defense education, strengthen the awareness of defense against the enemy, and maintain national security!

title: Cheap Game
description: Cheap Game is simply an endless runner with pixel graphics and lots of interesting mechanics that can be combined to obtain surprising effects. In this game you run and kill monsters.

title: Wiz
description: Wiz is a 2D pixel-art Metroidvania focused on exploration and skilled combat with great rewards. Enter the world of Wiz and try saving the land to restore light and balance for all living creatures.

title: God Cop Bad Cop
description:
In God Cop Bad Cop, you play as a god who watches over a city to find a killer.
Analyze the movements of the villagers, use your legendary sense of deduction, find the killer and strike him down!

title: Lion Quest Infinity
description: Jethro the Lion and friends steal a magic grandfather clock and embark on an unforgettable adventure. Are they here to save the universe, or is it simply a marketing ploy constructed as part of an elaborate book tour?

title: Use Your Outside Voice, Richie Tozier!
description: An interactive alternate ending for the 2019 movie It Chapter Two. Playing as Richie Tozier, you return to the house on Neibolt Street to relive the events of the movie and try to get everyone out alive.

title: The Signal State
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic future, The Signal State puts your logic skills to the test with complex puzzles inspired by modular synthesizers. Repair machines, rebuild an abandoned farm, and be part of a revolution that will change the fate of agriculture once and for all.

title: Tomes and Quests: A Word RPG
description: An upcoming fantasy role-playing game with a word game twist, Tomes and Quests is a whole new take on puzzlers. Three friends have become trapped in a book. The upside is they now have amazing new abilities that are powered by words! Solve word puzzles, battle evil, level up, and save the worlds.

title: Weatherworn: The Adventure of Pap & Pup
description: Weatherworn: The Adventure of Pap & Pup is an all-ages adventure following the young Pup and their astronaut grandfather Pap. The stranded pair investigate a dangerous world. A retro RPG with a modern pace about the seasons of life and loss.

title: MouseBot: Escape from CatLab
description: Guide MouseBot through mazes of fantastical mechanical mouse traps created by the cat scientists of CatLab. Dodge giant metal Kitty Krushers, leap over mouse-grinding Roller Graters, evade scary Mines and Lasers, and platform your way across pools of bot-melting Acid on an epic quest for cheese and freedom. Conquer 88 challenging platform-style levels as you delve deeper into the mysterious laboratories of CatLab and uncover the cats' nefarious plans. Collect epic piles of cheese, and transmogrify that cheese into new skins and accessories for your robotic mouse. MouseBot: Escape from CatLab is a zany and exciting platforming game that will test your reflexes, skills, timing, and love of cheese!

title: VR AstroSmash
description: VRAstroSmash is a seated, casual scifi arcade style shooting VR only game. Destroy asteroids, space junk, and UFO'S. Up to 4k textures and 150000 polys. Ship auto upgrades through the game progression, such as auto fire, ship repair, increased weapon cooling, and flight controls.

title: Steel Division 2: Nemesis #4 - Storming Toulon
description: Lead two new battlegroups to victory in Nemesis: Storming Toulon with Verteidigungsbereich Toulon and 1e Division Française Libre. description: In the platformer from the creators of RRRR fights with mutant plants on the way to find a solution to the dark past. Overcome many thoughtful challenges and puzzles.

title: Cat Colony Crisis
description: You are tasked with helping a colony ship full of space-faring cats deal with a mysterious disease outbreak! Will you act fast and stop the spread of this disease or will it spread unchecked and ravage your Cat Colony.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Home Sweet Home - Wedding Ceremony
description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Home Sweet Home is an exciting puzzle game and holiday feeling in 500 high-quality photos.

title: Mey Rescuer
description: It involves mechanics of eliminating enemies and solving puzzles with the weapon that also puts blocks, while going through floating islands in your adventure

title: Bubble With Djealy
description: Bubble With Djealy Its a bubble game Shoot the bubbles and by 3 bubbels or more they wil remove and you get points

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season III - Soldiers of Fortune
description:
The resurgence of nomads from the Steppes saw occupied lands reclaimed, ill-gotten treasures seized, and once-proud noblemen driven into exile. Escaping with what little gold they could carry, the disgraced lords travelled south to recruit an infamous band of sellswords, armed to the teeth with heavy weapons and gunpowder armaments, to exact vengeance and restore their glory.
These soldiers of fortune hail from Sicania, their pockets lined with gold and their notorious reputations preceding them. They count among their ranks deadly crossbowmen, fearless swordsmen, cutting-edge artillery, and cavalry killers fighting in the name of a legendary mercenary. They are coming, and their hammers of reckoning will fall upon this land as if it were an anvil.

title: Attack from Planet Smiley
description: Attack from Planet Smiley is a retro arcade game where the aim of the game is to survive. Survive a horde of angry smiley faces invading your world. The only way to stop them? Your lasers, nukes and mad skills.

title: Geometric Sniper: Blood in Paris
description: Katy, a French sniper, needs to protect her magnificent city! A 2D sniper game like you've never seen! In this spin-off of the Geometric Sniper the missions are more and more challenging, you will not have a second chance. Accuracy is everything!

title: Pingers
description: Pingers is an addictive 'one-more-round' score chaser which is perfect to play solo or with friends. Ping your way to victory and see just how far you can get!

title: Snowboard
description: Go snowboarding and earn points.

title: Sophstar
description: A vertical arcade shoot'em up with an inventive teleport system, lots of fast-blazing action and explosions, tons of boss fights, a risk/reward based score system and a proper challenge for both veteran and new players of the genre.

title: Spock in the Dama Kingdom
description: Discover the Dama Kingdom in Spock, a great fantasy adventure game !

title: Galia Senki: Yuuhen Annales
description: This is a strategy game taking place during the Gallic War.

title: Escape Knox Manor
description: Escape rooms are fun! But Escape Knox Manor asks the question what if you were actually kidnapped? And what if you had to escape a mansion? Find out now!

title: Lucifer: Paradise Lost
description: Finally the long awaited prequel to Jesus Christ RPG is out! Play as Lucifer, the devious dark angel, in this retro arcade styled four-directional shooter.

title: Empire of the Wicked
description: A magical challenging indie top-down RPG where you have to dismantle the Empire of the Wicked by leveling up, completing quests, training skills, slaying bosses and collecting items/equipment. Compete online with other players in the gladiator arena to claim exclusive rewards!

title: Buddy's Creative Quest!
description: Buddy's Creative Quest! is a short, cheat code based, atmospheric plat-former! Unlock over 50 cheat codes to alter the gameplay!

title: Steel & Bone
description: Explore the mysterious aristocrat's dungeon in this free and short but exciting dungeon crawler.

title: Bub Block
description: A fast-paced multiplayer party game with blocks, spinning blades, and ghosts. Oh my!

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - North American T-6 Texan
description: The North American T-6 Texan was an excellent design that served as a basic transitional combat trainer in all branches of U.S. service as well as in countries worldwide. U.S. Navy pilots utilised the type under the SNJ designation, the most common versions being the SNJ-4, SNJ-5 and SNJ-6.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Grumman F4F Wildcat & Martlet
description: Developed by Just Flight, the Wildcat and Martlet add-on for FSX: Steam Edition contains four different aircraft - the Grumman F4F-3 and F4F-4 Wildcats and also the Martlet I and Martlet IV, the British name given to the F4F-3 and F4F-4-based aircraft which were supplied to Britain from the earliest days of WWII.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Night Environment Italy
description: Night Environment: Italy for FSX: Steam Edition revolutionizes your night flying experience in Italy.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim Australia
description: Toposim Australia for FSX: Steam Edition provides LOD 11/19m Multi-LOD terrain mesh for Australia, improving the accuracy of the default terrain mesh and offering a marked improvement to the landscape profile.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Beechcraft Duchess 76
description: The Beechcraft Duchess 76 is a popular twin engine General Aviation training and touring aircraft around the world. This model for FSX: Steam Edition comes with an authentic avionics suite, a realistic set of liveries, and is based on detailed research on the actual real-world aircraft featured in the software.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - McDonnell F3H-2 Demon
description: McDonnell Aircraft's F3H Demon was the firm's first swept-wing jet fighter. The aircraft was conceived in 1949 as the XF3H-1, with the first flight taking place in 1951. Unfortunately, the original power plant proved unsatisfactory, though despite this the F3H-1N set an unofficial time-to-climb record in 1955 of 10,000 feet in 71...

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Cessna 152
description: The C152 is a two-seater, piston-engine aircraft equipped with a fixed tricycle landing gear, 110hp four-cylinder engine and fixed-pitch propeller – an ideal aircraft for touring and flight training.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Night Environment: Connecticut
description: Night Environment: Connecticut for FSX: Steam Edition revolutionizes your VFR night flying experience. Using a series of databases, this add-on implements authentic and immersive lighting to different road types and other areas.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Airbus A318/A319
description: Fly-by-wire fans rejoice! This add-on is a high fidelity and massively detailed rendition of the Airbus A318 and A319 for FSX: Steam Edition. Developed by Aerosoft, this add-on contains exquisite models as well as all of the systems that are used in day to day flights in the real world.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - McDonnell Douglas DC-8 Series 10 - 40
description: The McDonnell Douglas DC-8 Series 10 - 40 was one of the first commercial jet airliners to ever enter service. The four-engine narrow-body airliner featured advanced aerodynamic and structural designs resulting in a very reliable, comfortable, and efficient aircraft.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim US West Coast
description: Toposim US West Coast for FSX: Steam Edition provides LOD 12 / 10m Multi-LOD terrain mesh for the West Coast of the United States, improving the accuracy of the default terrain mesh and offering a marked improvement to the landscape profile.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim Mexico
description: Toposim Mexico for FSX: Steam Edition provides LOD12 / 10m Multi-LOD terrain mesh for the whole of Mexico, improving the accuracy of the default terrain mesh and offering a marked improvement to the landscape profile.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim Southern Africa
description: Toposim South Africa for FSX: Steam Edition provides LOD 11 / 19m Multi-LOD terrain mesh for the whole Southern African region, improving the accuracy of the default terrain mesh and offering a marked improvement to the landscape profile.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Night Environment: Spain
description: Night Environment: Spain for FSX: Steam Edition revolutionizes your night flying experience in Spain.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim East Africa
description: Toposim East Africa for FSX: Steam Edition provides LOD 11 / 19m Multi-LOD terrain mesh for the whole Eastern African region, improving the accuracy of the default terrain mesh and offering a marked improvement to the landscape profile.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - First Flight Airport (KFFA)
description: This terrific scenery covers an extensive, detailed area around KFFA and includes the towns of Kill Devil Hills, Kitty Hawk and numerous islands in the region

title: BigChick
description: Be the Chicken Moses! Let your chickens go!

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Cessna C172RG Cutlass
description: The C172RG Cutlass II is a modification of the venerable C172, with differences including a retractable landing gear, variable-pitch constant-speed propeller and more powerful 180HP engine. These modifications resulted in a 20-knot increase in cruise speed. A total of 1,177 of the variant were constructed between 1980 and 1984.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Stinson L-5 Sentinel
description: The Stinson L-5 is typical of the type of aircraft developed during WWII for duties such as liaison, artillery spotting, photo-reconnaissance, and casualty evacuation. Rugged and dependable, the design is a true 'workhorse', showing little to no concern for aesthetics and equipped with no unnecessary embellishments.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Cessna C337H Skymaster
description: The Cessna Model 337 ‘Skymaster’ is a six seat, twin engine, civil utility aircraft, built in a ‘push-pull’ configuration. It shares the typical nose mounted engine configuration of other single engine models in the Cessna range but has the second engine mounted in the rear of its pod style fuselage.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Airbus Series Vol.4
description: FeelThere’s Airbus Series Vol. 4 is a detailed depiction of the fascinating world of Fly-By-Wire technology - as well as the Airbus’ high-end systems. These powerful aircraft offer unrivaled flying pleasure.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Conington Airfield
description: Conington, otherwise known as Peterborough Business Airport (ICAO: EGSF) is a privately owned airfield located in the UK county of Cambridgeshire, six miles south of Peterborough and twenty miles north-west of Cambridge.

title: Primal Dungeon
description: Throw bones, big rocks or use your spirit wolf special attack to kill a variety of enemies in this 2D platformer full action game.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Farm Strips Vol 2: Central and Southern England
description: Return to grassroots flying in the UK with Farm Strips Volume 2: Central and Southern England. This scenery pack is a collection of 18 airstrips recreating the small airfields often used by microlights and ultralights across southeast England.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Cessna CT210M Centurion II
description: The 210M Centurion has been designed to push the limits of what can be achieved in these host simulators and delivers high quality detail to satisfy even the most demanding private pilot’s needs.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim Southeast Asia
description: Toposim Southeast Asia for FSX: Steam Edition provides LOD 11/19m Multi-LOD terrain mesh for Southeast Asia, improving the accuracy of the default terrain mesh and offering a marked improvement to the landscape profile.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Convair XB-46
description: Back in 1947, Consolidated Vultee's beautiful jet bomber was dropped in favor of Boeing's superior B-47 Stratojet.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Cessna C172N Skyhawk II
description: Said to be the most successful training aircraft ever produced, the Cessna 172 Skyhawk first entered production in 1958, since when more than 40,000 have been built. The ‘N’ model was introduced in 1977 and featured an upgraded engine, with additional options such as air conditioning and larger fuel tanks becoming available before the...

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition: Farm Strips Vol 3 - South West England & Wales
description: Return to grassroots flying in the UK with Farm Strips Volume 3: South West England & Wales. This scenery pack is a collection of 18 airstrips recreating the small airfields often used by microlights and ultralights across South West England and Wales.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Steamboat Springs (KSBS)
description: The City of Steamboat Springs is an internationally known winter ski resort destination. The Steamboat Springs tourism industry is highlighted by Steamboat Ski Resort, which is on Mount Werner in the Park Range just east of the town.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Airbus A320/A321
description: Fly-by-wire fans rejoice! This add-on is a high fidelity and massively detailed rendition of the Airbus A320 and A321 for FSX: Steam Edition. Developed by Aerosoft, this add-on contains exquisite models as well as all of the systems that are used in day to day flights in the real world.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - US Cities X: Las Vegas
description: Fly through the Grand Canyon and over the iconic Vegas strip in US Cities X: Las Vegas for FSX: Steam Edition. Located in the middle of the Nevada desert, Las Vegas is characterized by low buildings with a concentration of high-rise hotels and casinos along one central strip.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Ajaccio
description: This beautiful scenery is massive and covers the entire seaside area for the Bay of Ajaccio. Over 13,000 custom objects are included in this stunning scenery, plus a detailed version of the LFKJ airport.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - US Cities X: San Francisco
description: US Cities X: San Francisco is an excellent add-on for FSX:SE which should be explored, experienced and enjoyed. Many of the famous areas around the city are included, such as the Golden Gate Bridge and the bay area.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Night Environment: Sweden
description: Night Environment: Sweden for FSX: Steam Edition revolutionizes your night flying experience in Sweden.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - North American F-86F-1 Sabre
description: The F-86 Sabre was a natural replacement for the F-80 Shooting Star. First introduced in 1949 for the United States Air Force, the F-86 featured excellent performance for its day, outstanding handling characteristics, and high adaptability. The Sabre served in a number of NATO-aligned countries and was even produced in Canada.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Grumman Gulfhawk II
description: In the 1930s the Grumman Aircraft Company was looking for ways to promote its new line of fast biplane fighter-bombers, so in 1936 an F3F-1 was equipped with a 1,000-horsepower Wright Cyclone engine and specially modified for high-stress manoeuvring and aerobatics.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Boeing 767-200/300
description: The 767 may live in the shadow of the larger 747, but the sturdy and efficient 767 files on many of the same routes worldwide. This wide body aircraft sits between the narrow body 757 and the Jumbo 747, and is used for both short and long haul duties.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - F-105D Thunderchief
description: The Republic F-105 Thunderchief, first flown in 1955 and often known as "Thud" by its pilots, was a rugged and reliable multi-role fighter with an emphasis on low-altitude, high-speed penetration strikes with a single nuclear bomb.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Seychelles
description: The world-famous tropical paradise of the extensive Seychelles island group has now come to FSX: Steam Edition! Located in the Indian Ocean, north of Madagascar and approximately 600 nautical miles away from the African continent, the Seychelles consist mostly of coral islands with more mountainous terrain on the islands Mahé and Praslin...

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - US Cities X: Los Angeles
description: Los Angeles is a major hub for air travel in the United States. Not only are there several major airports in the area, but there is a large general aviation presence as well. Additionally, there are more helipads in Los Angeles than in any other city.

title: Ocolast
description:
Ocolast is a parody horror game based on Outlast and the gay pornographic movie 'Ursos Grandes, Peludos e Mansos', which has since been considered 'one of the most reverberated memes on Brazilian internet' for its notorious scenes and phrases.

The objective of the game is to investigate what is going on in the 'Big, Hairy and Meek Bear Private Reserve' and stop the perpetrator of all the OCO in that place.

title: Stormblades
description: Combat-heavy fantasy RPG with a focus on fast-paced sword-swinging combat

title: Cartridge Monsters
description: Cartridge Monsters is a Monster Catching RPG with over 6 hours of gameplay. 5 dungeons, 2 towns and a main story with side quests. Travel, battle and catch new monsters.

title: Euclyca
description: Euclyca is a modern day Hentai-Esque JRPG with fantasy elements. You take on the role of Ashe, an inspiring individual who is enlisting into the Euclyca Corps to become a Guardian and protect his/her homeland from the strange invaders who wreck havoc on the planet.

title: Triblock
description: A little bit of Tetris, a little bit of match 3.

title: Lodestar
description: Lodestar sends you and your squad of friends on your own space odyssey. Transverse multiple planets in a journey to get home without losing yourself or your ship to the perils of the unknown! Gather resources, farm asteroids, and survive... with your own oh-so welcoming AI sidekick!

title: Decently Bad Tower Defense
description: This is a bad short Tower Defense game made from scratch as a new game developer. This game does all the basic things you expect from a tower defense. We have 3 types of enemies and 3 types of tower to destroy them with. Strategic placement of the towers will make your victory certain.

title: Mourning Inc.
description: There is a place where it helps to process what we have lost in our life. There is a place where new special guests always arrive and leave. There is a place where it helps to let go of the past and you start to live future. This is Mourning Inc!

title: Bad Meme
description: Rotate like crazy to navigate an increasingly frantic stream of memes! Play as your favorite memes each with their own personal abilities.

title: Himeko Maid
description: Join Suzuka as she enters the first Himeko Maid contest! Choose your maid, complete the events, and become an expert in Night Service Training!

title: Angel Sex Pet
description: An innocent angel comes to Earth but runs out of energy before she can make the return trip home. Turns out a human's "love" is what Charlotte gets her energy from. Being a pent-up single guy living on their own, Takeshi has A LOT of love he can pump her full of!

title: Fox Spirit: A Two-Tailed Adventure
description: Dazzle humanity or destroy it as a magical, two-tailed fox! Weave illusions, shapeshift, or control minds. You'll set the world on fire, one way or another.

title: KnockDown
description: KnockDown is an entertaining fun for children of all ages. The aim is to hit tin cans with a ball and clear them away. In 160 funny and creative levels you can prove your dexterity, precision and timing. In addition a smart strategy can always be helpful.

title: Abiko the Miko
description: Japanese female shaman fight against "yokai"! This is a shooting action game!

title: Incremental Epic Hero
description: Incremental, Idle, RPG, Japanese Anime Game! Incremental Epic Hero is a free-to-play idle game with Japanese cute anime!

title: Cyber-Ante
description: You are being hacked by increasing amounts of hackers who use many different techniques to get in the system. All you need to do is use your abilities to hit all the switches that shut down the ports that the hackers are coming in on. But, watch out, there are many different ways they can successfully hack in.

title: Otome the Exorcist
description: When the city of Himori is struck by nests of terrifying Voracites, the only ones who can counter the scourge are individuals known as Exorcists.

title: AHH!!! MazeZing
description: A first person maze game.

title: Castle survival
description: Castle survival is a game where you need to destroy an enemy castle with your army.

title: DreamScript
description: DreamScript is an educational first person puzzle game. Reprogram your environment, complete tasks and explore the dreamy world of DreamScript.

title: Zombie Dungeon
description: This is a game that looks very simple, enjoy frustration, time and time again.Drag the character to the end, use unique weapons to overcome various difficulties in the process, that's all of this game!

title: Planeta
description: Planeta is a planet-building game where you can create and customize your planet as you wish! Main goal is to create conditions for humans to live and build a rocket ship and fly to the moon!

title: Critters for Sale: Snake
description: An intense psychedelic point-and-click/visual novel following the events that will transpire in 2033 in a club called Limelight. A club with ties to aliens, secret societies, alternate timelines, and a doomsday machine.

title: Lost Remnant: Roaches to Riches
description: A Point & Click Management game of Incomprehensible Entities, Survival and Discovery. Inspired by SCP and Cultist Simulator, with Cosmic Horror elements.

title: Funtime with Buffy
description: Things are not going so well since you've been left alone in the house. Your friendly plushie toy, Buffy, is not so friendly anymore. Otherwise he's haunting you all along.

title: Broken Thorns: West Gate
description: A symbolic story where you play as a stranger who just came from cursed land, searching for peace in this wretched world. You will wander through the dying world, finding yourself in different situations where evil forces will try to stop you by using your fears, doubts, and weaknesses.

title: Proven: A Math RPG
description: Proven: A Math RPG is a retro-style role-playing game (RPG) that teaches math while never forgetting that it is a game!

title: Choco Pixel 6
description: Choco Pixel 6 is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season IV - Blood of the Empire
description:
As noblemen, nomads and sellswords fight tooth and nail for dominion of this coveted land, a new shadow is cast. The ascendant Anadolou Empire marches north under the banner of Sultan Fatih Suleyman IV, a keen tactician who has named himself heir to the Conqueror's City and all the lands surrounding it. With numbers legion and battle prowess beyond measure, their sights are set on total dominion.

While some rely on brute force in warfare, the Anadolou Empire values patience, discipline, and more strategic measures to attain victory. As the Sultan's father once told him, to exploit a fatal flaw in the enemy's very foundations - a crack in their armour, a moment of indecision, a door left unlocked - is to utterly obliterate them. The old world will yield, or it will bleed.

title: Rotego
description: A puzzle platformer where you must tether to finish! Hold space while jumping to shoot out a tether, which will shift the gravity towards any surface it connects with.

title: Bears In Space
description: Unleash your inner bear in this over-the-top bullet-hell FPS! Embark on a zany retro-futuristic adventure and destroy oil-thirsty robots with an outrageous arsenal. Transform into a bear, wield unique powers, and embrace the absurd fast-paced action of Bears in Space!

title: Pornocrates
description: Pornocrates is the queen of absolute pleasure. Her obsession is to create obscene parties for guests from different parts of the world (eccentric sex-loving guests).

title: Lighthouse of Madness
description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you in this island. Explore the enigmatic lighthouse, solve challenging puzzles and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity when facing the darkness of your mind.

title: Boom! VR
description: Dance the night away on the Boom!VR festival. We prepared a unique VR festival site for you to go crazy on the dance floor or just hang out and enjoy the music.

title: Snake in the Cube
description: "Snake in the Cube" - original, retro game, based on old snake games, remastered in 3D.

title: Annie and the Shadow Palace
description: Annie's shadow has lost her body and is trapped in the shadow palace. Her shadow must balance light and dark to navigate the winding walls and endless tunnels to escape.

title: Wet Steps
description: Have a relationship with a charming priestess! An urban fantasy short and brisk visual novel with elements of slavic mythology.

title: NightmAR Protocol
description: Take control of Azael, a young magician who is now forced to survive against the Host's demons inside an artificially constructed reality. Experience a unique blend between a 3D dark fantasy environment and 2D hand-drawn horrors. Learn new spells and hone your reflexes to survive.

title: Insect: Bombardier beetle
description: Insect: Bombardier beetle - a game about beetle survival in the aggressive world of ants. Find and destroy all enemies yourself or use other insects and creatures to achieve the goal.

title: Archer boy
description: Archer boy is a game in which you need to defend a castle. Get coins for destroying opponents. Buy upgrades for coins. Beat your previous record.

title: Water Rain
description: On another planet in the future, you set up shop in order to try to rake in money, but you aren't the only one who has the same idea.

title: Peace, Death! 2
description: Peace, Death! 2 is a midcore turn-based logic game where you send clients to Hell, Heaven, or Purgatory and help members of the Reapers Union as they work towards their great cause!

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season V - Legacy of Fire
description:
Over 100 years ago, King John I Kainurgos enjoyed a reckless and chaotic ascent to power over the Kingdom of Empyros. The young king promised much to many to secure his throne and was faced the daunting task of restoring his kingdom to its former glory. He mustered an army of knights from across the land called the Symmachean Brotherhood, assembled the kingdom's greatest minds to create weapons of fire and destruction, and set out across the sea in search of land and treasure.

Together with the Symmchean Brotherhood, the Empyrean forces found the Anadolou region. Their campaign showed promise, but time, gold, and bloodlust can turn even the loyal and chivalrous against their allies. The Brotherhood made a power play, and the ensuing struggle forced the hopelessly outnumbered Empyreans to fight back with their fire weapons. The subsequent desolation of forests, farmlands, and townships stoked resentment and fire in the hearts of the citizens of Anadolou that would burn fiercely for years to come...

title: Dungeons & Guns
description: Dungeons & Guns is a pixel art visual, dungeon crawler style game, where the player aims to advance as far as possible through the enemy crowded dungeons, until reaching the final challenge. After this, new challenges will arise.

title: Tiny Strife
description: Tiny Strife is a roguelike turn-based combat game. Control up to three heroes as you advance through the debris of a planet destroyed by Shub'Guth and confront his minions.

title: PP Puncher
description: PP Puncher is a turn-based RPG, mostly text-based, about a guy going on a quest to save his waifus, by punching his opponents' PP. The game stacks new game mechanics to the fight system, as the player progresses into the game.

title: Magical Girl
description: Magical Girl is a time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. Hell is empty, the devils are here, and there's no place to run or hide. All you can do is survive as long as you can until death inevitably puts an end to your struggles.

title: Jewel of Kuru
description: Experience the enchanted land of Kuru, filled with secrets and incredible multilevel bosses to fight on your way to find the Jewel Of Kuru which lies in the secrets on this majestic open world. Set in fantasy land of Kuru, its focuses on amazing boss fights with hack n' Slash gameplay.

title: Sword of Shushan
description: Sword of Shushan is a strategic war chess game based on the holy land of Shushan and the war between ancient demons. The player will play the role of Han Yunchuan, a disciple of Shushan, who will call on the friars of Wufeng and the elite of Taihao royal family to fight against the ancient demons.

title: Card Killer
description: This is a highest death rate game of survival, combined with masculinity, survival, thriller, suspense reasoning and other elements. There are two main lines you can choose from the story - the male line and the female line. Meanwhile, you can also choose different talents as you like.

title: Polycalypse: Last Bit of Hope
description: Survive the zombie apocalypse by yourself or with your friends in this low poly post apocalyptic world. Survive, build your base and fight the zombies. But beware, you aren't the only one trying to survive. There are other survivors in proceduraly generated bases that will shoot you on sight!

title: Mad Mosh
description: Next level heavy metal music sim - Stage dive, pogo, head bang to your hearts content. Or Load up some classical tunes and mosh to that, we don't mind.

title: Sir War-A-Lot
description: A 2D action platformer where you explore and fight your way through various locations in your quest to kill the monsters who wronged you. Upgrade your skills and abilities along the way and take on the challenges that come your way as the bad tempered, sword throwing Sir-War-A-Lot.

title: Beast Nature
description: You have to fight your fears and solve a mystery of this area. We dont know what lives here aliens, ghosts, bigfoot or just some wild coyotes, when night comes something weird used to happen. Better find something more powerfull then your old shotgun...

title: The protectors of Deya
description: Embark on an adventure that will take you to discover the story of Silver and his friends, each with their own skills and characteristics. A turn-based strategic combat in pure RPG style.

title: Jungle Rumble
description: Jungle Rumble is a game about a brave soldier who tries to restore order in the deep wilds of the Amazon by destroying the army of the evil Skull!

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season VI - Scourge of Winter
description:
The worst winter in living memory holds the North in an icy grip. Under cover of this freezing darkness, a horde of bandits, renegades, and exiles known as the Desecrators has conquered Ostaria. Under the command of the terrifying Scourge of Winter, a mysterious figure who plagued the land in legends, these brigands thrive on greed and unending cruelty.

As the Desecrators sow terror across the North, the survivors of their brutal assault flee south to Ungverija, seeking to join forces with any heroes who will take a stand against terror. Thanes and freemen, knights and kings must all join together in a desperate alliance to deliver Ostaria from the evil of the Scourge of Winter, and drive back the Desecrators by winter's end.

title: Let's Journey
description: Let's Journey - idle clicker rpg in amazing fantasy world. Choose your hero, roll dice and embark on an epic adventure! During the journey you will defeat hundreds of monsters, find rare equipment and meet legendary dragons.

title: Choco Pixel 5
description: Choco Pixel 5 is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

title: Catie in MeowmeowLand
description: Catie in MeowmeowLand is a classical humorous point-and-click adventure game. Help little Catie get back home from the bizarre cat world of MeowmeowLand!

title: Little Drift
description: Little drift is a racing game. The goal of the game is to score the most points. There are 4 levels available. In the presence of 9 cars with tuning.

title: Disc Golf Valley VR
description: Disc Golf Valley is home to some of the most beautiful and challenging disc golf courses in the world. Now you can experience them in spectacular VR! Fill up your disc bag, sign up for tournaments and challenge every course in the Valley.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season VII - Wolves of Ragnarok
description: The war for the North is won and winter’s grip begins to thaw. However, amidst the din of blades in bloody battles, something sinister has taken residence in the forest east of Vajk’s Lake. Strange lights dance in the pines, lupine howls scar the midnight air, and a rising tally of souls have been lost to the shadows of the glade. Here, the demented worshippers of the wolf-god Fenrir have amassed an army and set upon the land with a fierce vengeance as they seek to enthrone their leader as king.

Follow the rise of a dynasty, of its heroes and warriors, through years of chaos and war to a time of order and prosperity. title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - US Cities X: Indianapolis
description: US Cities X: Indianapolis from Aerosoft covers the Indianapolis area in FSX:SE with extensive satellite coverage and includes all major buildings and thousands of accurately placed autogen buildings. description: Detroit is home to the busiest airport in the state of Michigan. Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (KDTW) is the second largest Delta Airlines hub in terms of daily flights. Detroit Metro and the many other smaller airports make this a complex and busy environment for pilots.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Boeing B-29 Superfortress
description: Produced under license. Boeing and B-29 Superfortress, their distinctive logos, product markings and trade dress are trademarks of The Boeing Company.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Toposim Central Asia

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - US Cities X: New Orleans
description: This US Cities X scenery from Aerosoft covers New Orleans, with more than 1,200 major buildings modelled and around 30,000 realistically placed autogen buildings.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Douglas B-66 Destroyer
