description: 《降妖神兵》是一款奇幻武侠生活模拟游戏，经营自己的根据地，在地牢中探索冒险，升级最强装备，击败邪恶妖王！

title: Endo
description: Endo is a whimsical adventure with a focus on physical interaction. Embark on a surreal adventure set in an abstract psychedelic landscape, accompanied by original art, music and sound.

title: Nix Umbra
description: Light is my Sword, Darkness shall perish

title: Legend of Azcarth
description: Venture into ancient ruins in pursuit of an ancient power in order to stop the ones who kidnapped you and save the world from further corruption. Out of your element and surrounded by danger, who knows what you might find hidden in Azcarth, be it magic, friends, or even part of your own history.

title: Two Against the Legion
description: Two against the Legion is a cooperative local multiplayer adventure puzzle game for two players on a single PC, in which you have to defeat rebellious robots and prevent a technological disaster.

title: Near Deadline
description: You've been playing Nintendo DS for too long and you realize there's only 5 days left to meet your animation deadline; use the paddles to bounce the Z's away long enough to stay awake and finish!

title: RollerBaller
description: RollerBaller is a racer against the clock. Stay on the path or suffer the consequences and get back to your last checkpoint! Rather infuriating title, it will boil your blood and should only be played by the most patient.

title: Zodiac DX
description: Retro side-scrolling adventure!

title: Secret of Dungeon
description: Secret of Dungeon is an Indie MMORPG strategy game based on PvP combat as well as Co-Op, with dungeons and Boss to be defeated in a group so you can have lots of fun and laughter. With several aspects of RPG like Trade between Players, Party System and Guild System.

title: Odenavirus Online
description: In this building that refuses to closes due to the pandemic, you are free to create your character, interact with other players, set up your room and complete missions to unravel the truth. Just be careful, and protect yourself from the virus!

title: Bright Days in Quarantine
description: In a world where you need to stay at home to curb a virus pandemic, get your act together by revisiting old hobbies and find joy in the small things in this intense shelter game. Otherwise, you go insane!

title: Callparin 2
description: Callparin Island is a sun-drenched island with lots of jungle, beautiful beaches and an extremely hot desert in the center of the island. Callparin 2 offers a varied open world in third-person perspective, where you can interact with pretty much anything. There are numerous shops where you can buy and sell items. It is up to the player how the money is made. In addition, there is a lively underwater world that can be explored.

title: Evaverse
description: Welcome to the EVAVERSE, the next generation of social immersion platforms, empowering players to connect in a brand new metaverse world with mini-games!

title: War of Freedom
description: It is an open world game played from a third perspective. It is a medieval story-based game in which we interact with people and take part, character development, hunt.

title: Apple Hopper
description: Apple Hopper Is a 2D akrad with a side view, the task is to jump on platforms as long as possible and not fall.

title: Impavidvm
description: Impavidvm is a physics based platformer with puzzle solving components where you have to overcome increasingly complex obstacles, testing your abilities and observation skills.

title: Swiss Alps Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Swiss Alps Jigsaw Puzzles - Do puzzle in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving game play will help you to relax after a hard-working day. Swiss Alps Jigsaw Puzzles is designed for adults and children.

title: Don't Give Up: Not Ready to Die
description: How would you react when facing a near-death experience? Despair? Perseverance? ... Maybe sorrow? Face your inner demons while trying to gather resources and keep your body alive in this run survival game as hard as life itself.

title: Beyond Dawn
description: In a world where time is the most precious commodity of them all. You must guide your team of D.A.W.N agents in the epic struggle against the band of rebels led by their charismatic leader Manes. It’s up to you, will world order prevail or slip into the chaos that awaits…Beyond Dawn?

title: Lab BreakOut
description: Lab BreakOut is a hardcore precision gravity-shifting platformer with minimal graphics.

title: Conspiracy Girls
description: Conspiracy Girls is a short visual novel about cute and funny girls who around exposing conspiracies, and get into all sorts of trouble doing so!

title: Good Guy Card
description: This game is a adv game.says that player go to university and try to find his best lover's story.

title: Baking Bustle
description: Bake up a storm on an epic cooking adventure that spans the world of food!

title: 3 Tactical Lines
description: This app is a tactical card game. Build a deck with 40 cards. Place the units in the three rows of front row, middle row, and back row. Defeating an enemy unit increases the draw penalty. The opponent draws the deck as much as the draw penalty. If your opponent loses the deck, you win.

title: Ogopogo
description: Embark on an adventure as the legendary Ogopogo, navigating through captivating maze-like landscapes. Unlock achievements along the way, celebrating your progress and mastery of the game.

title: Yogurt!
description: Yogurt! is an animated erotic clicker game where the goal is to collect as many girls as possible.

title: Infanticide
description: Infanticide is a horror walking simulator set in Japan.

title: Without Romance
description: Her fairy tale life laid out before her, Risa’s eyes are set on the future. With thoughts of her family spurring her on, will she earn a place beside Ren Yamato, Prince Charming himself? The turmoil in her heart knows life is rarely so straight forward.

title: Ninja Girl
description: A full-scale action game in which one Kunoichi fights against ninjas and necromancers during the Warring States period.

title: Pixel Cup Soccer: Ultimate Edition
description: Pixel Cup Soccer: Ultimate Edition is a casual retro style soccer game, a great evolution from the previous edition. It's dynamic, arcade, with a fast paced gameplay, with just the fun part of soccer! The game has pixel art graphics with the retro style of the games from the 90’s, evoking nostalgia!

title: Florida Simulator 1986
description: Play as Kevin the gator' hunter during the hot Florida summer of 86' in this super immersive simulation.

title: Berry Mayhem
description: Berry Mayhem is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses. There are 27 different levels available.

title: Shutter 2
description: Shutter 2 is a classic 3D survival horror game that combines combat, exploration, puzzles and photography. Choose between classic static CC cams or switch to the over-the-shoulder cam to navigate your surroundings and upgrade your RC to defend yourself against the ghosts of Kent Island.

title: Train Train Train
description: Train Train Train is a game about managing train networks in various smol cute 3d worlds. Lay down tracks, upgrade intersections and don't bonk the sheep. Do not be deceived, this game can be as tough as it is cute.

title: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story
description: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story is an erotic management dating-sim where you manage a love hotel and develop romantic relationships in the city of Tokyo.

title: Candle In Darkness
description: People by nature are afraid of darkness, see it as danger. Monsters are lurking. Are they just a fiction or more? Darkness challenges your survival...

title: Haunting At Cliffhouse
description: Untangle the story of the family that has occupied Cliffhouse for so many years. Search for clues, solve puzzles, talk to guests, get summoned to a chapel, discover a luscious Japanese garden and find your way through the rainforest. There is so much to discover about the family, the land and the lore.

title: Awakening the Light
description: This 2D top down RPG follows NoName #1892 as he fights his way through vast amounts of monsters, navigates dangerous dungeons, and searches for the most important thing in his life: answers, while blending the excitement of classic adventure games with the fun and impact of story driven RPGs.

title: Midnight Renegade
description: Defeat the chief of a corrupt task force, and bring peace back to London in this 2d action platformer.

title: Absolute Alchemical Potion
description: Behold: the great scientist-alchemist Celsia. Help the protagonist recover her power and brew the potion that’ll change the world, or find true and eternal love.

title: Dàtóu Zhūluójì
description: An indie game based on dinosaurs. Players need to search through the dungeon for dragon eggs, hatch dinosaurs, build their own equipment, and finally defeat all the bosses to win.

title: Clash Memory Game
description: An exciting game "Find a Pair", the game is not only entertaining, but also developing, helping to develop skills such as reaction, visual memory and accuracy. Search for pairs, open levels and look at pictures that the game will reward you for passing the level.

title: Horizon Odyssey
description: Born into a world of stone and stifling rules, Mathias must search out a better future for himself and others. But what reason could there be to limit the exploration to the world above? And are these rules out of love or fear? Join Mathias on a classic JRPG journey to better himself and the world.

title: Sefir: Mafia Story
description: Sefir: Mafia Story is a reflex and fast thinking based 2D top down shooter game.

title: Wet Nightmares
description: As another woman joins the list of the missing, deep within a forest, a man living in solitude is visited by a pretty stranger. Wet Nightmares is an Erotic Horror Visual Novel exploring the psyche of a haunted man and his depraved past.

title: MegaBattle
description: Build robots and enter the arena to battle! Robots have taken control of the galaxy and now humans must build bots to fight in the MegaBattle Arena. MegaBattle combines the best of the CCG with innovative mechanics such as unique mana mode, opponent reading attack and a fast card draw system.

title: Dear Brother
description: Audrey is a young woman returning to her childhood home. Upon arriving, however, she begins to notice strange happenings around the house. Is this a dream or reality? Whatever it is, it seems so oddly… familiar. Explore with Audrey as she tries to work out the mysteries of her missing memories.

title: Safari Zone
description: Safari Zone is a Creature Collection game with some roguelike elements. Use your tools to improve your cataloging skills each visit!

title: Tap Those Targets
description: Tap Those Targets is a casual "shooting gallery" game. Targets appear on the screen and you must click on them as fast as possible. Targets spawn faster and get smaller over time; some even move around! How many can you click?

title: Heart of Summer
description: "Heart of Summer" is a visual novel style high school dating sim. You spend one summer at a Japanese high school and try to get the girlfriend you've always wanted!

title: Hope's Journey: A Therapeutic Experience
description: An RPG made by a team of medical doctors and therapists designed to help players cope with emotional difficulties.

title: Summoner Apprentice
description: Delve into the mystical art of summoning alongside Feylin, the last of the Ancients. Begin your journey as her new apprentice and learn how to summon minions, outwit your enemies, collect relics to enhance your powers and overcome the dreadful obstacles set in your path.

title: The Gorcs' Forge
description: Amid the news of the returning Tronraneren dwarves and the imminence of a new war, take the role of Zrurk, leader of the Gorcs - experts in the art of forging - and manage the workforce, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to defeat the dwarf army!

title: Zball VI
description: "Z Ball VI" is a new part of the puzzle game series where the puzzles are tied to physics. The new part has new mirror objects gameplay mechanics!

title: Roly-Polo
description: You control a PillBugBear (or a pair of them if you chose Twins-Mode), and to win you have to score 15 points by throwing a purple ball thought ring goals. It's local-multiplayer against friends or CPU controlled players with 8 hand-made stages!

title: Sillyfun Valley
description: Francis's best friend and canine companion, Chewbarka, is missing! Join her on a hilarious animated adventure as she searches the quirky neighborhoods of Sillyfun Valley to find her dear doggie. Along the way she will meet eccentric inhabitants, solves puzzles, and even find romance!

title: Pejes vs. Zombies
description: Resist the attack of the Peje Zombies! survive on this multiplayer or single player wave shooter! a Mexican fiesta!

title: Undercat
description: Undercat is a 2D action platformer where you play as a rebellious dog who is tired of catkind’s tyranny. Catch cats and shake out all their coins and use them to buy items. Throw stuff at your enemies and be shot from a cannon. Solve puzzles and end the cat tyranny once and for all.

title: Pokitaire
description: A poker and spider solitaire hybrid where you reveal and remove cards by playing poker hands! Turning the classic puzzle game into a score chasing arcade puzzle game.

title: Calm Girls
description: This is a classic puzzle leisure game. There are many types of second-order girls.

title: Super Sami Roll
description: Sami’s on a mission to rescue his friend Vera and he needs your help! Join him in this exhilarating, colorful 3D platformer and fast roll, air-grapple, and jump to save her!

title: Noren
description: Noren is a simple key finder game. The map of the game consists of several different regions and some of these regions have special game mechanics except for finding keys

title: HopeLand
description: Hope Land is a land of dreams that every survivor wants to visit at least once. It is up to you to survive and reach your goal and how.

title: Rules of Gravity
description: Take over the tasks of an astronaut either alone or with a space friend. Explore space and repair the space station, because you don't know what else is coming.

title: Kebab House
description: Have you ever wanted to know what it feels like to run your own Kebab shop? Do your best to make kebab orders from customers while making enough money to keep your shop open. Upgrade your shop with new toppings and equipment to have more customers inside and online

title: Axiom Alternative
description: A short kinetic visual novel, independently written by Redewaan Duckett, giving an alternative take on the Welcome To... Chichester series

title: Choco Pixel 7
description: Choco Pixel 7 is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

title: Holt

title: Blobert
description: Blobert is a platforming gaming where you have to skillfully maneuver yourself around obstacles to escape the evil clutches of Troblob. Along the way you run into Fabby the Fairy who aids you on your quest for vengeance.

title: Lucid Steam
description: The engineer has to make his way out of his dreams and defeat the boss. As time passed, bizarre and powerful monsters will appear and cause pain to the engineer. Can the engineer escape his lucid dreams?

title: Pirate of Madagascar Island
description: Pirate of Madagascar Island is a third-person exploration game which may seem like adventure and open world game. In this game you are pirate in the Madagascar island and need to roam around and find the portal to jump to the next level.

title: Toilet Paper War
description: Toilet Paper War is an RPG game in which you have to fight against others in action packed battles and play through adventurous casual games. The game is inspired by current affairs in the world and wrapped in an amusing and successful gamestory.

title: Kingdom of Bees
description: "Kingdom of Bees" is a game where you try to create a kingdom of bees. Kingdom of Bees is a real-time strategy game where you control a hive of wild bees that are trying to survive in a world full of dangers.

title: Isonzo
description: Ferocious Alpine warfare will test your tactical skills in this authentic WW1 FPS. Battle among the scenic peaks, rugged valleys and idyllic towns of northern Italy. The Great War on the Italian Front is brought to life and elevated to unexpected heights!

title: Happy Halloween
description: Happy Halloween is a 2D platformer where you have to do various picturesque hardcore levels playing as a main character Jack.

title: Detective Solitaire Inspector Magic and the Man Without Face
description: Visit a magical world right now! 200 magical layouts - find all the evidence!

title: TurBot
description: TurBot is a fast paced race to the finish where you'll combine a wide selection of movement options and power ups to reach the goal faster than anyone else!

title: Ascended
description: Ascended, a game where you manipulate objects, time and light! Ascended is a sci-fi first/third person 3D puzzle platformer in which you must guide a light energy source through a series of sixteen exciting puzzle levels using the various abilities which you unlock along the way!

title: 4Line
description: 4Line is a real-time take on the classic 4 in a Row board game. Play in fast-paced 1-minute matches, trying to get 4 in a row before your opponent does. Collect gems on the board to speed up your gameplay and gain an edge on your opponent.

title: The Viking Way
description: Experience the Viking way of life. Sail, explore, trade, build a fleet, and lead your fearless army to raid and conquest. Write your own story of the golden Viking age. You have many choices, and a leader can always find his own.

title: A Story In Space
description: Take on the persona of an intergalactic bounty hunter to try to save yourself and the people of the mysterious warring planets of Hakarr and Pahnbuk!

title: Epic Battles of History
description: Experience a world where the greats of human history collide in epic battles across time. Pick your favourite hero and assemble a team for the ages to duel it out with your friends and unleash the power of your cards to see who among you is the strategic mastermind.

title: Tragedy of Loneliness
description: In this world, anyone can betray, the only thing that does not betray is loneliness. It is a Kinetic Novel and RPG type game.

title: Kiiroi Hana
description: Kiiroi Hana is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.

title: Pumping Simulator
description: Pumping Simulator As an active member of a gas station in a major city around the world, you can play with up to 4 friends in a multiplayer co-op mode or single player mode to help you understand what the pumpers are going through, and maybe will make you rich.

title: Project: Skyscape
description: Project: Skyscape is a sandbox of vehicle simulations you can enjoy in Co-Op with your friends! Developed for the PC and VR experience in tandem, maintaining parity.

title: Cross Blitz
description: Cross Blitz is an exciting turn-based RPG card battler set in a wondrous world teeming with vibrant characters and fierce battles. Explore Cross Dawn Isle and uncover its secrets as you level up, craft new cards, build the perfect deck and battle your way to victory!

title: Helicopter Simulator
description: Helicopter Simulator: Exceptional missions in a detailed environment, creating an atmosphere for an immersive and bluffing experience!

title: JumpJumpBall
description: Spin, jump, and challenge various obstacles in an action game.

title: Copy Editor: A RegEx Puzzle
description: Copy Editor is an intricate puzzle game that teaches you Regular Expressions (RegEx), commonly used in computer science and language theory. Build complex rules that process and revise famous texts for your wacky and demanding publisher!

title: X Air Combat
description: The player controls the plane to fight the enemy in the sky, and the perspective of the game is third person.

title: Pop and Well
description: Pop and Well is a game where you can play with your friends and save the world.

title: Colored Shapes
description: Use physics to solve puzzles. Control gravity to move the main character on a dangerous adventure.

title: Lynium
description: Lynium is a competitive 2D and 3D music video game You can play the different traditional or original game modes

title: Everafter Falls
description: Rediscover your life on Everafter Falls. Farm, fish, craft, and fight to restore the peace in an all new farming adventure. Features split-screen coop, a pet with useful skills, drones, resource-harvesting pixies, a card eating progression system, dungeons to explore and much more!

title: Cthulhu Pub
description: In Cthulhu Pub, you can build your own pub or restaurant. Create cute characters, creepy monsters and establish a small cute pub or make a large castle with a plant of options.

title: Hyposphere Z
description: Hyposphere Z is a retro cyberpunk 3D puzzle platformer where you control a sphere, collect coins, solve puzzles and overcome obstacles by jumping or dodging them.

title: One True Cuddle
description: A top-down platformer where you play as a rabbit that's kidnapped, to avoid all obstacles and find your way back to your owner. But... something else is happening...

title: Home Defender
description: Home Defender is an adventure game where you play as a young boy who is alone in his home at a winter night. Your goal is to protect your home from two burglars who are trying to get you.

title: Tales of War
description: A medieval pvp game where you have to capture all the flags to win.

title: Smerch Battle Arena
description: Clash in furious combat in the yellow circle of the arena! Here, everyone will face bloody battles in PvP game modes and co-op to the last survivor. Fight for the leading positions and get valuable prizes for victory. Conquer glory in the arena as a Gladiator.

title: Damned Hand
description: You're in the home of a psychopathic art lover. and that isn't happy about this situation.He'll scare you. You have to be careful!

title: Destroy the Dummies
description: Destroy the Dummies is a simple yet difficult, third person, action, arcade style, series of challenges, with an interesting dark plot twist mid-game. An homage to the games of the early days of 3D graphics.

title: Charge Blade Hero
description: A fast paced 2D hack and slash, adventure game. Attack, Dodge, and Charge Up to maintain your weapon's durability as you take on waves of enemies.

title: The Sych story
description: Live a couple of days in the life of an ordinary omezhka owl. This is a visual novel about each of us, and no one in particular. Make your choice and decide the fate of Slavka Sychov.

title: Roman Empire Wars
description: Become an Emperor and guide your Legions to victory. Battle foreign armies and crush your enemies in a tactical real-time strategy game and show the whole Europe glory of the Roman Empire.

title: Choice of Life: Samosbor
description: You're just a simple inhabitant of the endless Gigastructure. The best you'll get is seven shifts at a machine and a bowl of feed concentrate, and that for good service to the party.... Is that it? Or do you have a choice?

title: Flap Demon
description: A difficult precision platformer where your only form of movement is flapping.

title: Reanimation Scheme
description: An otome game and romance visual novel about necromancy, love, life and death. Step into the shoes of the necromancer, Raenelle. Meet a colorful cast of characters, fail to summon the spirits of the dead, unravel mysteries, and maybe fall in love.

title: Plasma Attack
description: Plasma Attack is a top-down side scrolling shooter game where the character is a flying spaceship equipped with a base laser.

title: Neon Shooter
description: Neon Shooter is a fast-paced dual stick style shooter that is full of neon colors, bright particle effects, and enemies to destroy. Be ready to jump in and destroy enemies, collect coins and power ups, and upgrade your traits to reach the highest score possible!

title: Warspace 2
description: Warspace 2 is an open world RPG space shooter where you can trade, craft, fight and explore procedurally generated universe!

title: Friendly Fire: Arena
description: Friendly Fire: Arena is a free-to-play 1v1 arena FPS that features parkour, combat and vertical mobility with intense gunplay. Enter the simulation as Sam or Vince and get ready to fight to the death, but don’t worry, no ones really harmed, after all… It's just Friendly Fire.

title: Daughter of Essence
description: The largest and most powerful empire wants you captured at all costs. Their enemies want to control you for their own benefit. The world itself seems to want you dead. You just want to be a normal girl.

title: Victoria's Body
description: Pure lewd transformation fetish combined perfectly with turn based combat and puzzle/exploration gameplay make Victoria's Body an experience unlike any other. How will your deepest desires change you?

title: Idiot
description: Utopian island. Calm and happy life. Food is synthesized from cartridges. The night comes at your will. And you don't care about life outside the island. You know exactly what is bad there - this is what the state said, and it is always right.

title: Second Person: Secret Laboratory
description: Experiments. What could be better? - Horror from the second person. Controlling a monster created in a secret laboratory, reach your target before it hides from you or attacks.

title: Alien Cat 5
description: Alien Cat 5 is a game that will capture your attention for a long time and will make you feel like a full-fledged pilot of a huge spaceship.

title: Amaze Gears 3
description: Amaze Gears 3 is a straightforward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with traps, timer and cool soundtrack.

title: ClickMonster
description: An incredibly colorful and dynamic clicker in which you will plunge into the world of unique monsters, visit amazing worlds and acquire new improvements over time.

title: 24 Solar Terms
description: 24 Solar Terms is a seek and find puzzle game with the theme of the traditional Chinese twenty-four solar terms. The game connects the climate and farming of various solar terms through farming proverbs, myths and fables. Help local farmers solve problems and experience the story of 24 solar terms.

title: Poly Party
description: Welcome to Poly Party! A combination of Action, Adventure, Strategy, RPG, and Racing. Play some boardgames, minigames, missions, and races in the game modes provided!

title: Melodramatica
description: A charming management game set in an old Victorian Threatre. You are put in charge of a troupe of actors, it's your job to make sure your actors and the stage are ready to put on a perfect show! Train your actors, resolve their conflicts, dress up your troupe and set the stage for the final play!

title: Brain Sanguo
description: Brain Sanguo is a strategy game with turn-based combat.You play as a seignior in a mythical world about Sanguo, develop your territory, employ warriors, build armies, and prepare for the uprising of Huangjin.

title: Silent Night: A Christmas Delivery
description: Ride Santa's sleigh on Christmas eve and deliver all the presents. Explore islands generated procedurally, make smart moves and find the best route to maximize your score... Or just chill out in this silent night.

title: Grimm Shuffle
description: A memory game with pictures in a Japanese cute & fairy theme style, rearranged from the actual board game "Grimm Shuffle". Easy gameplay with relaxed play time. Complete the tutorial & play in different difficulties.

title: Planet Surf: The Last Wave
description: It's space surf season, year 2183. And as usual, the planet is about to explode! You have only 3 minutes to surf its last wave, get enough energy crystals for your hyper-foil board to get you out in one piece. Will you be able to make it to the next planet?

title: Vesper: Ether Saga
description: The perfect union between video games and comics.

title: A Gay Love Story About Gay Love
description: A short story-based SRPG about two men who will eventually come to love each other. Now updated with added dialogue, new characters, different choices to make and multiple endings!

title: Cì Shā
description: 《刺沙》是一款还原传奇单职业特色的游戏。游戏中主角色战士，带领宠物征战玛法大陆。野外地图BOSS，副本BOSS，各种精英BOSS等你去挑战。野外战斗，激情PK，炫酷觉醒，各种玩法带你领略传奇不一样的体验！

title: Imugi
description: Imugi is a point and click isometric puzzle game. Players can utilize mechanics such as box pushing, water flooding, and lightning strikes to make it past the trials laid out by the spirits of the mountain. Make it past the trial and ascend from Imugi to Dragon.

title: Just Get In Through the Door
description: This is a first-person puzzle game. All you need to do here is to get in through the door. You need to interact with cubes, elevators, etc.

title: Mine Crazy: The Korean Grinder
description: This is the essence of Korean grinder MMO. In game, you'll mine rocks, earn money, and reinforce your pickaxe with that money.

title: Couch Installation Service
description: A puzzle game about couches arrangement

title: Completely Stretchy
description: Stretch, swing and stick your way through the Grombi Isles! Use your stretchy arm and sticky fingers to explore vibrant regions, meet eccentric characters, and embark on quirky adventures. Oh, and you’re blue?

title: A Boy's Journey
description: Influence obstacles and gain power-ups in this beautiful skill-based platformer. Aim for the best highscore and if you don't like that one level, just generate a new one! Freeze and destroy obstacles or create a whole new path. Or give yourself a speed boost and invulnerability.

title: Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder
description: Go on an enigmatic adventure in this 1-4 player VR game set in an alternative western world. Discoveries, dangers and digging await the Prospector.

title: Jumping Platform Minigame
description: Jumping Platform Minigame is a 2D platform game in which you have to collect diamonds and kill small mushrooms.

title: Destiny Island
description: Destiny Island is a very short computer game. You play a man who visits his memories. You can walk and talk to mannequins about 7 sins. Associate essence with anything comes to your mind.

title: Primeval
description: Primeval is a turn-based strategy game where you play the part of a deity trying to build your domain and compete with other deities for power and essence.

title: Flippen Run Mike
description: Earth is under attack and the "Nazdu" are devouring everyone they can get their hands on. Mike isn't the hero anyone asked for, but he's the one you got. He's hiding in a hole, in his basement, and wants to see this through and survive, so he can go get some fried chicken.

title: Puzzling Peaks EXE
description: A charming, possibly spooky, story-rich physics puzzle game. You'll need quick reflexes, brainpower, and unconditional trust in your quirky artificially intelligent guide to succeed.

title: Cyberpunch
description: Cyberpunch is a post apocalyptic beat em up game for 1-4 players.

title: Sunflower Code
description: "Sunflower Code", which uses more than 50 paintings by Van Gogh, is a first-person perspective mystery-solving horror. Cryptography based on the basics of modern cryptography hinders the progress of the main character. You may be able to experience Van Gogh's paintings and their worldview.

title: Break Space: Out of Bounds
description: Break Space: Out of Bounds is a game that will bring 80's nostalgia to today's modernity! Control a spaceship and prevent the Terran nation from being enslaved by the Marthians.

title: The End of Labyronia: Nerubis
description: Travel through time and the four seasons to avert the apocalypse in the last part of the popular Labyronia saga.

title: Russian Drunken Boxers
description: You are waiting for the fights of drunk Russian boxers. Russian people love to fight in front of bears with balalaika!

title: White Dandelion
description: White Dandelion is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.

title: Crush the Industry
description: Claw your way to the top of a big game studio in this roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic JRPGs!

title: Terminal Singularity
description: The black hole is approaching, the singularity is inevitable! It is too late to run now, your only way out is a miracle. Your salvation lies in the power of the Grid - claim it for yourself and use it to escape your dark and terrible fate.

title: Legend of Maratha Warriors
description: The best action game dedicated to our beloved Warrior King ‘Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj’. Immerse yourself in one of the fast paced horse riding casual action game, with stunning visuals and sound. Defeat the enemies and get pass through the traps set on the way to secure the fort.

title: Smash'em
description: There are far too many monsters in this world, so they must all be smashed. Use variety of weapons and power ups to kill them all!

title: Riders 2491
description: Riders 2491 is an action shoot'em up game that pays homage to the classics of 90's arcades with modern visuals.

title: Belongings
description: Belongings is a Point & Click adventure game. Dispose of the belongings of Jennifers late spouse Marion. Jennifer must contend with her own memories, and have to face hard truths she might not want to know. Do you wish to step into the bitter future, or stay in the sweet past?

title: Survive Avalon
description: Survive Avalon is a sci-fi open world survival game combined with FPS and horror elements. The protagonist's spaceship crashes on an unknown planet. You need to explore the planet, hunt for food, and collect resources. The life is dangerous on Avalon. Every minute is another challenge. Far from your home, you can only count on yourself. Are you ready?

title: Rapper Life Simulation
description: Are you ready to start your rap career? You can lead a real rapper life with studios, concerts, albums, gang wars. You must also be able to survive among hip hop gangs!

title: RC Airplane Challenge
description: Fly model airplanes in RC Airplane Challenge in this arcade styled flight sim. Fly by yourself offline or with up to 32 other players in online gameplay.

title: Fusion
description: Fusion is a casual puzzle game with elements of a visual novel. Take four basic elements and use them to create hundreds of new ones, as well as meet four interesting heroes...

title: The Perfect Shape
description: An action precision platformer to test your dexterity, wit and patience

title: The Dream Libra Had
description: The two girls who had a traffic accident, Libra and her girlfriend Amili, wander the supernatural world as a near-death experience.

title: Wanderfar
description: Immersive first-person roleplaying adventure with a focus on exploring a rich handcrafted fantasy open-world filled with interesting places to find, powerful items to collect, challenging enemies to defeat, ancient mysteries to solve and, ultimately, good friends to make along the way.

title: Hellgate VR
description: Hellgate VR is a new VR game in the Hellgate series. This is a story about the fight of mankind for survival in the war against the devil. For all mankind! We need you.

title: Increlution
description: Survive the ever increasing pressure of time for as long as you can! A minimalistic idle game about time management that takes inspiration from roguelite games, with a focus on meta-progression. Every generation will have better chances at survival, because previous lives influence its instincts

title: Fat Man Fights
description: Become a fat man in this super fun action-arcade game, centered around an innovative and entertaining pushing mechanic, where you compete in fast-paced, hilarious sumo wrestling games against quick-witted AI opponents for the chance to win more delicious food!

title: TKKG: Wer stoppt den Feuerteufel?
description:
Investigate with TKKG in a new, exciting case that you do not know from the radio plays or books!
Together with TKKG you search for traces, clues and suspects. Only if you repeatedly slip into the different roles of the detectives and cleverly combine them, you can solve the crime in an exciting finale.

title: Let Yourself Out, Eddie Kaspbrak!
description: An epilogue to Use Your Outside Voice, Richie Tozier! Eddie Kaspbrak has a series of conversations.

title: Shiba Mekuri
description: January 23, 2021. A small family member has joined our family. A two-month-old Shiba Inu puppy. We named her Hina. This is a puzzle game with lots of cute daily videos of Shiba Inu Hina.

title: The Last Stand Legacy Collection
description: Survive the zombie apocalypse and make humanity's last stand in this three-game legacy bundle, revamped for modern hardware. Explore, build, and survive for as long as you can in The Last Stand, The Last Stand 2, and The Last Stand: Union City.

title: Don't Cut Your Hand 2
description: Chef can't work without his hand. So, please cut food carefully.

title: Falnarion Tactics: Oathbreaker
description: Choose a side and fight a series of action-packed quests to dominate the world of Nerfelo in this SRPG.

title: BridgeFix 2=3-1
description: BridgeFix 2=3-1 is a beautiful, relaxing and rewarding puzzle game which adds new twists to the game Hashi-wo-kakero. The game is easy to learn, hard to master and offers you plenty of puzzles to solve.

title: He Needs His Medicine
description: You have been dispatched for a 911 call. From the moment you step inside the apartment, you realize something is really wrong with the place. You are gonna make Him the last dosage. He needs his medicine.

title: The Adventurer: Episode 2 - New Dreams
description: Imagine every time you fall asleep new adventure awaits you...

title: ZeroChance
description: We try to survive by killing the creatures we encounter in each level.

title: DeadPoly
description: DeadPoly is a polygon zombie survival looter shooter with base building and crafting. Your only goal is survival, everything else is optional.

title: Aventura Pisicului Pierdut
description: Aventura Pisicului Pierdut este un joc bazat pe alegerile tale in care trebuie sa incerci sa il ajuti pe protagonist sa isi gaseasca scumpul pisic. Oare vei reusi sa iti indeplinesti scopul , sau vei fi distras de alte tentatii ? Visual Novel 2D, Choices Matter,Multiple Endings.

title: Assassin's Creed III: Tyranny of King Washington - The Infamy
description: In the first episode of The Tyranny of King Washington, the American Revolution is over but the true battle is just beginning. In The Infamy, George Washington, blinded by a thirst for unlimited power, has declared himself king.

title: Crazy Gravity
description: Crazy Gravity is a challenging Platform / Puzzle game about a little Astronaut lost in space, where your main objective is to energize your rocket and go home. Good luck!

title: MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore: Squall Valley
description: You get it all with Squall Valley! Six tracks total races in our largest Open World ever! Two Supercross, two Nationals, two Waypoint races plus Free Ride!

title: DCS World: A-10C - Red Flag Campaign
description: The A-10C: 16-2 Red Flag Campaign is a depiction of flying the A-10C "Warthog" during a typical Red Flag exercise in the skies over Nevada. This campaign includes extensive briefing, map, and lineup card PDF files for each mission and was designed in consultation with the renowned author Steve Davies.

title: Cinders of Hades
description: Cinders of Hades is a relaxing, wave shooter arcade-style VR game that all ages will enjoy. It has some classic, arcade influences translated to VR that veteran arcade players will appreciate.

title: DCS World: A-10C - Advanced Aircraft Training Qualification Campaign
description: The A-10C Advanced Aircraft Training Qualification campaign puts you in the cockpit of an A-10C Warthog, and tests your ability to use the aircraft's weapon systems successfully.Based on real world qualification requirements you will fly 10 performance check rides to execute against pre-defined performance objectives.

title: DCS World: A-10C - The Enemy Within Campaign
description: The Enemy Within is a story - driven campaign that puts you in cockpit of an A-10C Warthog, sent as a part of small US detachment to Georgia in order to help contain a growing threat from a terrorist organization calling itself the "Caucasus Liberation Army" (CLA).

title: DCS World: A-10C - Stone Shield Campaign
description: A-10C: Stone Shield is a story-driven campaign that puts you in the cockpit of an A-10C Warthog as a USAF pilot assigned to the 445th Air Expeditionary Wing. In 2015 Abkhazia, South Ossetia and Russia have announced the start of the "Caucasus-2015" military exercise.

title: DCS World: A-10C - Tactical Training Qualification Campaign
description: The A-10C Tactical Training Qualification campaign puts you in the cockpit of an A-10C Warthog, and tests your ability to interact with JTACs, Airborne FACs, AC-130 Gunships and manage Close Air Support (CAS) assets.

title: DCS World: A-10C - Operation Piercing Fury Campaign
description: Operation Piercing Fury (OPF) is a story driven campaign consisting of you leading a forwarded deployed A-10C Warthog "Hawg" Flight in the Georgian Area of Operations (AO). You will be assigned to and commanded by the Joint Special Operations Command providing direct support to conventional and non-conventional coalition forces...

title: DCS World: A-10C - Basic Flight Training Campaign
description: The A-10C Basic Flight Training Qualification campaign puts you in the cockpit of an A-10C Warthog, and tests your ability to fly the aircraft successfully.

title: MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore: The Stewart Compound
description: Come ride James Stewart's private race compound! Includes five authentic JS7 tracks.

title: MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore: Copper Canyon Open World
description: Explore the huge Copper Canyon Open World through the Free ride mode and see if you can find any hidden surprises or be the first to the next gate with four brand new Waypoint races and one Nationals track!

title: Bishoujo Battle Mahjong Solitaire
description: Let the mobile military girls of “Rikku☆Jiasu” be your companions as classic tile-matching gets more exhilarating than ever! Find pairs of mahjong tiles to remove them from the board. Plan your moves strategically and stay ahead of the clock to claim victory. Every 3 rounds of play, you’ll unlock a new costume for the girls, and more will be revealed as you progress. Of course, the important part of any solitaire game is replayability. With more than 100 tile layouts and randomized patterns, Bishoujo Battle Mahjong Solitaire offers endless incentive to keep coming back for more, just in case the anime-style fan service isn’t reason enough. You can also view unlocked characters and costumes in the Dressing Room!

title: Poultry Parade
description: These chickens need your help to escape a dangerous facility. Sharp and pointy things are your worst enemy. Fear not, for a chicken can not only jump, but it can also FLAP!

title: American Camper Simulator
description: Refurbish an old camper. Give it a spin on a selected stretch along the Route 66. Show off your camper to other tourists during your camping holiday, to sell it at a profit. Expand the business and earn money; have crazy and sometimes dangerous adventures in the USA in your subsequent camper.

title: Inexplicable Deaths In Damipolis: Inner Thoughts
description: One tragic night, the power dome of Damipolis died during dinner under strange circumstances... What were they doing there? What really happened that night? And... who is the culprit? Solve the mystery in this first-person 3D graphic adventure, inspired by classic film noir.

title: Time Machine
description: An exciting adventure through space and time awaits for you in the newest hidden object game! Immerse yourself into a real investigation, full of intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies!

title: Synthetik 2
description: SYNTHETIK 2 is a bold continuation of SYNTHETIK: Legion Rising. Fight a world overrun by the relentless Machine Legion. Experience the next level in gun-play and upgrade yourself beyond measure to rival their Gods. Can you defeat the Heart of Armageddon?

title: Cafe Paris
description: Welcome to a game about coffee and conversation. This is a 3D narrative coffee shop sim located in the heart of Paris. You run a 24/7 open coffee shop between the foot of the Eiffel Tower & the banks of the Seine river. Serve coffee & food to your customers and learn about their stories.

title: Dung Beetle Strike
description: Inspired by the classic Goof Troop, solve puzzles, fight against chimeras and play with Dung Beetle brothers on this exotic island.

title: Work and Girls
description: This is the puzzle with a several levels of difficulty and beautiful artbook. All characters appearing in this game are over 18 years of age.

title: Batallas Galacticas
description: a company is hiring people to drive a spaceship across the solar system, time to do some work and make some money!

title: Hentai Cyberpunk
description: Fight against robotic enemies ! In a sexy and futuristic Wave Based Game !

title: Super People
description:
Super People, developed by Wonder People, is a next-generation battle royale FPS game for PC.

Super People features 12 different playable classes each with diverse abilities and unique skills. In the end, only one super solider or squad will remain standing.

title: Hanaby's Summer Festival
description: A 2D platforming adventure featuring fireworks.

title: Happy Guy
description: Haro is a doctor. He was fired after problems with a nurse. His life changed a lot after that. He meets more beautiful girls. Who will be the most important girl in his life?

title: Space Ship Infinity
description: Returning to the classic style of spaceship games in pixel art. Survive in space as many enemy ships and anything else that can destroy your ship, get all the advantages and improvements available to get your best score.

title: Veronica's Body
description: How will your deepest desires change you again? Veronica's Body is all about erotic transformation and corruption fetish combat that flawlessly blends RPG style combat and kink in order to tackle titillating bosses and solve sultry secrets.

title: Rainbow Fuego
description: A fun, colorful, casual arcade game for all ages! Two games in one! Enjoy a casual solo mode in which you keep the ball inside the circle while listening to relaxing chill hop music, or challenge the AI to a game of space hockey! Developed by Jon Harvey Games.

title: Barnard's Star
description: Snipe your friends, electrocute your enemies and rain down acidic slime in the Barnard’s Star system, 6 light years from Earth. A multiplayer, turn-based tactics battler with no micro-transactions and no random chance — ingenuity is the only way to victory!

title: First Racer
description: First Racer is a racing game with convenient arcade control, crashes, a list of leaders, nice graphics and much more.

title: Bugz!
description: Venture into the world Bugz to capture, research and compete with your team of Bugz!

title: My New Memories
description: Memories...One of the most important things in our lives. But what happens if you forget who you are? If you don't remember anything? Then you can only hope that the people that do know who you are help you out...This is your journey...On your way to finding new memories...

title: Slave Fighter X
description: SlaveFighterX is a 2D side scrolling lewd fantasy Beat´em up, where you fight old school arcade style against hordes of voluptuous enemies and unique bosses while ripping each other’s clothes apart!

title: Fore Score
description: Fore Score is a multiplayer miniature golf game with a twist! Build the hole as you play, alternating between placing hazards on the course, and putting, trying to score the lowest strokes while messing with your friends!

title: Pathfinders: Mini Words
description: Help Pathfinders discover the name of day-by-day objects in English. A unique mix of logic puzzle and word search. Great for English learners.

title: This Game is Trash
description: This Game is Trash. Yes, it's literal trash. You are a KEYBOARD and you ROLL on a UFO all the way to the END! WHAT MORE COULD YOU WANT?? But seriously, can you make it to the end? Because it took us like 1000 tries. We counted. So play the game and see if you can. Your life depends on it now.

title: Buried Under Rocks
description: Would you choose the lie over the truth? Buried Under Rocks is an action and puzzling game with two different endings.

title: Sky Goddess
description: "Sky Goddess" is a vertical scrolling flying shooting game with nostalgic movie images.

title: Ambidextrous Psychopath
description: Ambidextrous Psychopath is a difficult 2D platformer designed to challenge players to use both sides of their brain simultaneously to control two separate player objects. With a full custom OST and a robust 81 level campaign, Ambidextrous Psychopath offers hours of challenging gameplay.

title: Amazing Pyramids: Rebirth
description: Amazing Pyramids are back! Lead a group of scientists through addicting word adventures! Play now and solve intricate word puzzles to unravel the secrets of an ancient city! Use your wits and vocabulary to survive the blistering sun!

title: Rainy City: Pandemic
description: Explore Rainy City, meet its residents and save your sister!

title: The Adventures on Uranus
description: The Adventures on Uranus is a short interactive experience. The game provides a chance to explore the imaginary planet of Uranus for a few minutes.

title: The Hardest Game in the Universe
description: Why are you getting to know one of the most difficult games in the universe, Embark on this challenge with the new casual game, platform that aims to become one of the games most hated for its difficulty,

title: Kate Kite
description: Kate Kite is a running game, beautiful painting style, beautiful music,You will love it.

title: Ona: A Mystical Art Experience
description: Travel across the world in an interactive and meditative journey to resolve the quest of our humanity.

title: Blue Bird Land Ep. 1
description: Blue Bird Land is an AVG with horror and puzzle elements. There are six endings and four levels. In each level, the form of the game is unique and different from others. Let’s follow the alluring characters, addicted to the dangerous amusement park!

title: Muzegate
description: Muzegate is a virtual concert application with sensational techno and EDM music, vivid lightshows, DJ view and 3 original environments. Ideal for virtual reality, but PC support is also included.

title: Space Junk
description: Intense action, retro-styled visuals, a sizzling synth soundtrack and tons of cool Sci-Fi references, all rendered in vibrant, neon graphics. Get your trigger-finger ready, turn the lights down, the sound up, and blast your way through level after level of fast paced, Junk smashing action!

title: Spellthief Erinn
description: Spellthief Erinn is a 2D Puzzle Platformer where you take control of the enemies magic attacks and use them to your advantage. Solve the misteries, explore the enviroment and reach the chest with a hidden spell. Find, steal and collect them all!

title: Cave Explorers
description: You will delve into the underground world of the mysterious desert, build your own deck, fight monsters, and dig for treasure. Every adventure is randomly generated - build powerful card combinations, collect equipment, encounter unknown creatures, and fight your way out of the dangerous caves!

title: The Seven Keys: Escape Room
description: Escape Room The Seven Keys is a graphic mystery adventure where your logical reasoning will help you escape, in addition to solving different challenges.

title: Speedgunner Ultra
description: Speedgunner Ultra is a dynamic platformer in which you can transform your character into a combat aircraft by pressing a button. Use all sorts of tricks to speed up and try to complete the level faster than anyone else.

title: Rescue Operation
description: Is a first-person shooter game. The game will follow the scenario of the game, and destroy the enemies in its path

title: Dab's Not Dead
description: Buckle up for a hacking rhythm game about saving Cyberspace from a mysterious threat! Move to the beat, groove your way through security systems, and fight the Virus corrupting friendly Cyberfolk (also in local co-op!). Make your own levels using your own music or the official tunes!

title: Hexurb
description: Hexurb is a calm, peaceful city builder where you can relax after a hard day and just have a good time!

title: Kidgilantes
description: Rescue all animals from their enclosures without being caught by adults! But, you can’t do it alone. You and your friend will have to dress up as adults to get by in this zoo!

title: Fast Food Simulator
description: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to expand your business. Take orders, make burgers, and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

title: Drunk Soccer is the Best Soccer
description: Drunk Soccer is the Best Soccer– a third-person soccer simulator. The main feature of this game is that all the players on the pitch are drunk as skunks.

title: Starship Intruder
description: The interface IS the game. Using your keyboard in a command prompt-style, you will engage in combat with enemy spaceships, raid planets, collect warp cores, draw space cards to obtain advantages (and disadvantages) and much more.

title: The Case of Maneki
description:
The Case of Maneki is a Detective game about a Maneki Neko, or lucky cat, following his adopted guardian to find the truth that is hidden between a series of gruesome murders.

You play as Kichiro and Nobutoshi, the detective and the apprentice of the city. With murders being committed at every corner, it is up to you to solve this case that traces back to years ago.

title: Microcosmum 2
description: A relaxing strategy game featuring unconventional gameplay. Your objectives include development, evolution, border expansion and protection of your hive.

title: Disarmed
description: A satirical fantasy puzzle game about healthcare.

title: Kingdom of Wreck Business
description: The depths of the Atlantic hide more than 12,000 sunken ships out of which at least half haven’t been located yet. As a depth explorer you will earn money from extracting valuable cargo from wrecks, grow your company, buy exploration vessels and real estate.

title: Deep Therapy
description: Be a psychologist, explore patients minds and search for lost memories in their subconscious. Then make a diagnosis according to your experience and the memories you have collected.

title: Diery Heaven
description: A simple parkour game in calm!

title: Kingslayer: The First Assassin
description: A different Sokoban style game where you have limited grid-movement and attacks in each level. Feel like an assassin in this minimalist puzzle.

title: Labyrinth Legend
description: Labyrinth Legend is an action RPG with hack and slash elements. Explore the automatically-generated dungeons, collect powerful equipment, and battle against unknown, formidable enemies!

title: Killer Ricky
description: Play as Killer Ricky and avenge his family by killing all members of a bloodthirsty Mafia organization.

title: On Space
description: You are a pilot of a spaceship and your task is to destroy enemy spaceships and survive.

title: Namnokh
description: Namnokh is a Puzzle-Platformer where you take on the role of the nomadic Wanderer. After discovering an ancient sentient Box, you must use it's powers to bounce, change it's weight and pass through certain parts of the environment to traverse the ruins of Namnokh.

title: One4
description: Beat the AI, or your friend in this massively puzzling game in the cubes

title: Time of Piracy
description: Time of Piracy - is the simplest 2D platformer in which you have to do different levels playing as a courageous Pirate.

title: Laika
description: Laika is a third person perma-death runner game. A robot named Rico launched into the space. While Rico overcome various obstacles, his journey starts by encountering Laika's trace and ends by finding Laika!

title: Shieldwall Chronicles: Realm of Madness
description: Gather your party and venture into a corrupted land ruled by demons and dark magic. Explore freely in an open world and decide your fate in tactical, turn-based combat. Forge legendary heroes in the furnace of battle and make decisions that will have lasting ramifications for your campaign.

title: Pixelstar Hero
description: A sci-fi turn-based roguelike adventure.

title: RushOut
description: Rushout is an enthralling and hilarious 3D ragdoll platformer with simple gameplay set in fantastic flying landscapes. And the prize for the best result will spark real excitement in you! Beware of crazy chickens!

title: Wordle 4
description: Wordle 4 is a new format puzzle game from the Wordle series. 29 new categories scattered across the English alphabet from A to Z.

title: The Host
description: After a Post-Armageddon event the world has gone back to its roots living in simpler times, back to swords, kings, and war. Something is brewing in the kingdom could it be related to the first apocalyptic event?

title: Gachi Revenge
description: The adventure of our beloved hero, in which he has to overcome all the obstacles prepared by the Gachi gang. They stole the most valuable and now pay for it.

title: Eager For Den
description: Metroidvania Survival Co-op Game in which you have to explore to survive, earn abilities to survive, play well-design characters to survive, cooperate with your firends to survive and survive to survive.

title: Aero Battle
description: Aero Battle - indie simulator of air battles, executed in 2D hand-drawn graphics.

title: Just Shake It
description: Just shake it left and right If you make a mistake, rewind time.

title: Unicorns on Unicycles
description: Turn your horns into swords in this wacky and sweet physics-driven rainbowcore fighting game featuring jousting unicorns… on unicycles.

title: Doggone Hungry
description: Doggone Hungry is a delicious game about eating food, getting fat, and being a dog. Your favorite toy, Quackerjack, is always getting stolen, and superior dog logic has determined that you must get fat to save him!

title: Crisis Arcana
description: There you were, ecstatic that you had been chosen to serve as the grand wizard's newest apprentice. Next thing you knew he's legless and horrific monstrosities are now roaming the realms. It's your job now to go throughout these realms and defeating the horrors that lie in wait.

title: Green Marquis
description: Green Marquis can change gravity Use the geometry of the level to solve puzzles.

title: Planet Miner
description: Remove fog, look for and mine minerals, construct buildings, upgrade the rover and reach the portal.

title: All-Inn
description: An unusual inn simulator fit on a single screen.

title: The Alchemist Alekki
description: This is a game about running a potion shop and saving time! Alekki has been accused of creating a potion that caused areas of time to merge together. Help her uncover the truth by defeating powerful Echoes of time in different Time-Warped areas.

title: The Depths
description: You are a 45 year old man who wakes up in this new world trying to figure out its secrets as you explore this first person horror you will find your self sneaking pass threats hiding from the shadow beset and solving puzzles.

title: The Happy Little Virus
description: As a virus, attack the servers of charities on orders from your sinister creator that seem strange... maybe even unethical? Journey down into their computers and engage in frantic debris-strewn battles with the antiviruses in this comedy puzzle shooter.

title: Marble Ball Racing
description: Marble ball racing is a racing game. Player will control marble ball to race with other 24 AI marble ball in sci-fi stages theme.

title: Phogbound
description: The story about hungry creatures, who are living in the Fog.

title: Vojo
description: Vojo - is a casual game in which you move forward through a tunnel. You need to avoid obstacles that appear in your path, and collect white cubes for which you get points. How many points can you collect?

title: Thief's Shelter
description: Uncover what happened at Highburn Mansion — before it unravels your mind. Investigate, solve intricate puzzles, document elusive evidence, and question every shadow. Thief’s Shelter is a first-person psychological mystery where the deeper you dig, the more reality slips away.

title: Mysterica
description: Experience VR combat as if you were an anime character with special abilities!Draw a magic circle with your own hands! Swinging the sword sends a slashing wave into the air.PvP and PvE VR action game. Enjoy the speedy and tense combat.

title: Rogue Party 2
description: Explore dungeons, defeat bosses and earn epic rewards with up to three other friends (and occasionally hit them with potions) in this playful Rogue-Like adventure.

title: Ragdoll Knight
description: Ragdoll Knight - A platformer game with a physical world, where the player controls a drunken knight who stumbles over something, loses his balance from the blows of arriving birds and is about to break his head on a nearby stone.

title: Cannibal Coast
description: Will you get revenge on your crew, head back to civilisation. Or will you succumb to the wicked ways of the Cannibal Coast?

title: Bravers
description: Deep in the underground world of a planet devastated by Great Impact, Bravers invites you to become a captain of your custom ship. Captain who leads his crew through the fascinating journey full of danger, mysteries, friends and foes. Are you brave enough?

title: Heart of Siam
description: Classic 2D action retro platformer. Are you ready to collect all the diamonds and find the secret caves?Heart of Siam, after 14 years of development, now on Steam.

title: Hero Team
description: A side-scrolling multiplayer shooter. 1-4 local players can fight 4v4 battles online and offline, or speedrun practice missions.

title: Gigapocalypse
description: Become a customizable giant monster with manifold skills in Gigapocalypse, inspired by classical Kaijū movies such as “Godzilla” and “King Kong” and the game classic “Rampage”.

title: Gladii
description: The enemies of humanity lay siege from all directions. You must fight your way through hordes of demons, zombies, ogres, and more as you unlock new characters and battlefields! Play solo or team up with three additional players in this 1-4 player couch co-op arena battle game.

title: Sweety Little Witch
description: Sweety Little Witch is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Quick Race
description: Everything you need to do is very simple - just race and over take every other car on the track to win the race! Quick Race is a simple racing game where you can compete with AI or on a split screen with your friend.

title: Routine Racers
description: Crazy side-scrolling 3D game set in daily routines like escaping from work, buying at the supermarket, having a drink in a bar, stopping a fire or capturing some narcos. 10 Routine Levels and an extra Endless Mode with unique skills to master: dodge, jump, roll, engage, brake, turbo, build and push.

title: Box Cats Puzzle
description: This is a puzzle game. A lot of cute cats want to enter a box, you need to help them~！

title: Thearchy
description: A pixel art style simulation of a fantasy post-apocalyptic Earth.

title: CatMafia
description: CatMafia is an arena Shooter with slasher elements and a top view. Earn points by fighting off waves of vile wolves, jackals and mice, and buy new equipment and first aid kits to be ready to fight the fattest opponent in the end.

title: Hidiom
description: Hideom is a game whose focus is to look for English idioms that are hidden in a literal way inside the game. Each expression found rewards you with an achievement on Steam.

title: AQ First Contact
description:
Become a commander and join the forces in AQ: First Contact.

AQ is a fully cross platform mmo allowing you to fight alongside or against your friends in real time 3v3 battles. Or take the fight to pirate corporations, destroy the Red Sun and capture Night Raven bases, but watch out for Xeno invasions as you explore the galaxy!

Mine for resources, Salvage debris for new tech and research or just destroy everything and take what you want by force. Explore asteroid belts, gas clouds and nebulas to find resources and new activities.

Join a Corporation, declare war or forge alliances, bombard outposts and capture sectors. Build defense hangers and shield generators to defend, or just go for extra resources and build some asteroid mines.

title: Space Moth: Lunar Edition
description:
1CC Games’ first shoot ’em up returns with totally overhauled visuals, all-new enemies and attacks, a deeper scoring system, remixed soundtrack and fresh player powers. Space Moth: Lunar Edition is the ultimate version of the beloved cult classic

Vivid visuals: from reworked nocturnal backgrounds to new enemies and particle effects, graphics have been enhanced to give Lunar Edition a distinct style and flair of its own.
Bullet Heaven: enemy attacks have been upgraded using 1CC Games’ custom bullet pattern editor from Star Hunter DX, allowing for intricate kaleidoscopes of death to dodge through!
From Beginner to Pro: Lunar Edition adds a flexible new scoring system, built to both raise the skill ceiling so pros can aim for stratospheric high scores, while lowering the barrier to entry so beginners can jump right in.
Stellar Sounds: to suit the more intense gameplay in Lunar Edition, all of the game’s cuts have been remixed and reinvigorated to get your blood pumping!

title: Demon Slayer Akagi
description: Battle against mythos inspired characters from around the world in this Arcade styled breakout game!

title: Create Your Own Model Railway
description: Build your own virtual model railway and watch it come to life in stunning 3D. No other software makes it as easy to create your own highly detailed tracks, stations, tunnels, towns, roads, level crossings and scenery. Ideal for railway enthusiasts of all ages, the only limit is your imagination!

title: Curse of the Pharaoh: Tears of Sekhmet
Sea of Thieves: Season 2
description: Our second Sea of Thieves Season sweeps in with a wealth of new content: refreshed Trials and Deeds to boost your Renown, Emissary system improvements, Forts of Fortune to conquer, Commodities to be bought and sold via Merchant Alliance Trade Routes, new and returning time-limited Events, freebies to grab through Twitch Drops and Prime Gaming, and renewed Pirate Emporium stock including the Season Two Plunder Pass!

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: North Star
description: North Star is the twenty-first expansion for Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege. It adds one new Operator from the Star-Net Aviation.

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 3
description: In Season Three’s undoubted star attraction and the game’s biggest update in years, Sea of Thieves collides with Disney’s Pirates of the Caribbean for the ultimate pirate crossover in Sea of Thieves: A Pirate’s Life! Join forces with Captain Jack Sparrow and fend off his old enemy, the notorious Davy Jones, to save the Sea of Thieves from catastrophe in this breathtaking original story.

title: Spirit of Arx
description: Spirit of Arx is a harrowing roguelike dungeon-crawler where players possess the spirits of the deceased in order to escape a labyrinthine fortress of anguish and misery.

title: Shattered Minds: Encore
description: As a detective with a knack for strange cases, your Chief has assigned you to a new investigation. After a series of famous monuments vanish into thin air, you are sent to Paris to investigate a possible link between the disappearances and a calling card discovered at the scene. Play through challenging hidden object scenes and perplexing puzzles as you unravel this thrilling mystery. Can you solve the case before anything else disappears?

title: Taisho x Alice: Episode 2
description:
TAISHO x ALICE episode 2 is a fairytale visual novel in which you must save your Prince Charming! The game is fully voiced in Japanese (excluding the main character).

As you progress through the story, you will be asked to make choices at key points that will lead you to different endings. You will take on the role of the fairytale heroine in order to rehabilitate your chosen love interest and guide him to his "happily ever after"!

title: PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds: Season 11
description:
Drop back into the highlands of Paramo with updated terrain and new game modes available. While there, you can try out the latest weapon balance updates that include damage increases for the Mini-14, VSS, and SCAR-L.

You can also work on the 10 new Mastery Medals added to bling up your revamped PUBG ID. On larger maps, deploy the new Emergency Pickup to grab a quick transport over to the safe zone for you and your squad. 11.1 also features Killfeed updates, new ways to find and add friends, a new Match Log, and more.

title: PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds: Season 12
description:
Season 12 has landed on the Battlegrounds!

Drop-in and explore our biggest Miramar update since launch; with significant visual and design improvements, a new uniquely Miramar vehicle, and an armor-destroying sniper rifle, what’s not to love?

title: SafeZoneVR
description: SafeZoneVR is a VR interactive survival horror game. Players will scavenge the map trying to escape a fallen SafeZone once strong and bustling as the survivors flocked to it.

title: The Sims 4: Throwback Fit Kit
description: Outfit your Sims in retro-inspired athleisure looks with The Sims 4: Throwback Fit Kit. Take it back to nostalgic colors, bold patterns and trend-forward silhouettes with these all-new Create-a-Sim items. Updated everyday classics and workout wear elevate this unique collection - and your Sim's fashion.

title: Die After Sunset
description: Die After Sunset is a 3rd person action rogue-lite shooter with a unique mechanic featuring light and darkness. Battle for Earth and travel through time as you defeat hordes of enemies and complete random quests to create the best build possible. Can you solve the mystery behind the Murkor invasion?

title: Aurum Online
description: Game that is being made live in Twitch by JeroMono. An action-MMORPG with cartoon style.

title: Infidhells
description: Infidhells is a Roguelite Puzzle-Game based on various stuff and of course Tetris. You'll encounter many foes, bosses, hectic items and game changing mechanics. Anyway, it should be great (when it actually works).

title: Coridden
description: Become the beasts you defeat in this action-packed RPG! Equip and upgrade both your human and beast form and shapeshift between them anytime. Venture out solo or ride together in co-op on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed away inside a legendary city.

title: Robolife: Days with Aino
description: There's nothing better than living with a robot girl! Get your wrench on and show her your mechanic power! But beware, she might be more than just a regular robot...

title: The Truth About 9th Company
description: The Truth About 9th Company is the first Russian documentary computer game. The game simulates the historical battle for Hill 3234 which took place on 7–8 January 1988 in southern Afghanistan between Soviet paratroop units of the 345th Independent Guards Airborne Regiment and mujahideen.

title: Far Beyond the World
description:
"Wake up!" says the voice, and you open your eyes in a strange cabin in the woods with only a vague recollection of the life you've left behind. Despite appearances, you know that something isn't quite right.

Set on an adventure, trying to piece together the puzzle of your past, as well as forge a new life among the Wolves of Avalan as you try to steer clear of their tribal politics. Your heart will be your compass, but can you trust your feelings when they're so easily clouded? Love can be both a boon and a distraction. Choose your friends carefully and your enemies more careful still.

You had one life already… there might not be a third.

title: Final Fantasy
description: The original Final Fantasy comes to life with completely new graphics and audio! A remodeled 2D take on the first game in the world-renowned Final Fantasy series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics.

title: Final Fantasy II
description: The original Final Fantasy II comes to life with completely new graphics and audio! A remodeled 2D take on the second game in the world-renowned Final Fantasy series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics.

title: Final Fantasy III
description: The Steam port of Final Fantasy III 3D Remake features high-resolution graphics, improved lighting and full controller and keyboard support. It also includes Steam achievements and widescreen compatibility. Among all releases of the remake, this version offers the most technically polished and feature-rich experience.

title: Final Fantasy IV
description:
FINAL FANTASY IV was the first title to introduce the Active Time Battle (ATB) system, which has become synonymous with the series. It also saw the introduction of the Augment system, which enabled the transfer of abilities from other characters and gave players an edge in battles.

The remaster of Final Fantasy IV (2007) features a new Hard mode, autosaves, rebalancing, a new UI, and higher resolution visuals

title: 100 Hidden Cats
description: 100 Hidden Cats is a hidden object game in the city setting with black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style.

title: Replanted
description: Richard, an ordinary farmer in an ordinary island village, murders his wife. He must hide her from the authorities, and keep up the facades.

title: Asteroids: Far Away From Home
description: The game is about surviving in space and trying to get to home planet all while destroying asteroids and other threats. You gain upgrade points, power ups, arcade points while playing and ship boosts when you reach home planets. You can upgrade your ship from the main menu.

title: SunnySide
description: Find harmony in the Japanese countryside as you help Sparky uncover lost memories in this modern take on the farming and life simulator. Build a thriving homestead, cultivate new relationships, and chase your own happiness in SunnySide.

title: Haunt Chaser
description: Haunt Chaser is a horror game. Can be played as Single-player and 4v1 where one player takes control of a paranormal entity and Chasers needs to use all the hunting equipment in order to banish the evil and save the poor souls from torment while uncovering deeply disturbing secrets. Also can be played as 4 player co-op adventure game.

title: Redtape
description: Climb the corporate ladder in this roguelite deckbuilder. Recruit Employees, stack rule-bending abilities and bonuses, and purchase Items to boost your plays. Score massive point combos to game the system harder than the C-suite games you.

title: Beyond the Storm
description: Beyond the Storm is a love-letter to the iconic shmup Tyrian, bringing back the same experience from the past while adding improved visuals, new stories and a lot of more content!

title: A Message and an Advice
description: You are Khurshid, and you are going to die soon, so leave a video message behind, just so a certain someone will have some answers.

title: Vascolet: La Fórmula Secreta
description: The secret Formula is the new Alejandro Vascolet's adventure inside the fantastic world of evil sorcerer Malmark. You must help Alejandro recover the book of the Secret Formula in a journey through five different levels.

title: BoF1LL: A Withering World
description: Together two companions will explore and restore their shrouded landscapes. Playable solo and in Couch Co-op!

title: The Rebellion
description: Fuel a people’s uprising through fast turn-based tactical battles and hard choices; lead your heroes, stretch scarce resources, heed the crowd’s needs, plan each move with care, break the tyrant’s grip, and let hope rise again!

title: XA: Contra Los Cuatreros Galácticos
description: An advergame published in 2010 by Batovi Games Studio based on the Megaman series of games and created to advertise Calcar's products. Enjoy!

title: Super Vampire Ninja Zero
description: This is a fighting game where you take control of Mina, a martial arts expert who has some demon and zombie's butts to kick!

title: G-Darius HD
description: Take flight in the iconic Silver Hawk and immerse yourself in thrilling gameplay with both modern HD-visuals or authentic retro-arcade graphics. Experience the conflicts between the Amnelia Kingdom and the merciless Thiima Empire that took place before the battle between the people of Darius and Belsar. During this conflict, the series’ iconic Silver Hawks were created to make use of the game’s unique capture ball system that allows you to forge your own strategy and gain an edge over the enemy! G-DARIUS HD is the port of “G-DARIUS” in high resolution – developed by the masters of remastering at M2. The game can also be played in low resolution like in the original arcade version. From the epic boss battles to the memorable soundtrack, G-DARIUS stood out when it first got released in the arcades and up to these days, critics and fans are praising this game as a prime example of how to bring a 2D game series properly to 3D.

title: Funny Truck
description: Throw annoying people out of your truck. Collect points.

title: Gearshifters: Collector's Edition
description:
Steer, drift, spin, smash and gun through waves of enemy vehicles. Go to war against extreme machine bosses. Build up and tune your tactical loadout of car mods, defences and weaponry for each treacherous transport mission. Drive. Destroy. Get Paid. Upgrade!

The Collector's Edition includes:
- Game: Gearshifters
- Clothing Patch
- Soundtrack
- 4 x Art Cards

title: The Hero We Need
description: The Hero We Need is a tower defense with real-time strategy elements with a focus on narrative where players have the power to create their own custom towers by crafting and combining runes.

title: Jewel Match: Twilight 3 - Collector's Edition
description: Send shivers down your spine... with this creepy-crawly Match-3 quest that will chill you to the bone and make your flesh crawl. Discover eerie scenes and restore abandoned buildings, but beware of marauding creatures in this dark land.

title: XDefiant
