description: Ubisoft's worlds collide in a free-to-play, first-person arena shooter where you compete to be the best in fast-paced online matches!

title: Yuki: Space Ranger
description:
Yuki is an epic adventure where you become a space ranger, in VR and MR!

You’ll face perils in deep space and your only companions throughout this journey are POD, your sidekick, and your own skill while playing. Dodge and defeat countless waves of projectiles and enemies while you get better and better with power-ups and charms to help you out.

title: Arbor
description: Become an pioneer, overcome crises and colonize the island.

title: Petz 4
description: Petz consists of Dogz 4 and Catz 4. Dogz and Catz are virtual petz that live on your computer. Players can adopt, raise, care for and breed their own Catz and Dogz. This title introduced companion Bunnies and Pigs, as well as travel playscenes.

title: Context Insensitive
description: A game about configuring your keybindings.

title: Security Booth
description:
Security Booth is a VHS PSX Horror Game.

Based in 1996, you are working for a company known as Nova Nexus, you play as a security guard.
Your job role is to make sure that only the right authorized personnel are getting into the facility.

title: Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout - Season 5
description: Get ready to stumble in the jungle! Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout Season 5 is fully-equipped with an adventurous theme featuring giant swinging logs, a mysterious Lost Temple and...mechanical Rhinos?!

title: I Don't Know Which Name I Should Give This Game
Quake 4: Lightning Fast Mod Doom Edition
description: Quake 4 Lightning Fast Mod is a Doom mod for both single and multiplayer modes based on Quake 4

title: Office Point Rescue
description: Terrorists have invaded and taken hostages in the Emeraldalo Corporation's headquaters. Agent Foldon is assigned to infiltrate the building, dispatch the terrorists and rescue any surviving hostages.

title: Metavaxx
description:
Develop the ultimate vaccine in Metavaxx, the world's first minesweeper shooter!

Train your own new vaccine in body samples, either by shooting down the virus agents hidden in infected cells, or by isolating those cells, only clearing the healthy cells around them. You win when there are only healthy cells OR only infected cells remaining. Your vaccine's progress depends on how many remaining cells of either type you managed to preserve.

title: Florescer
description: Florescer is a story driven game delevoped with the help of a Brazilian NGO called Florescer, an organization that houses transsexual and transvestite women. The game is meant to invoke reflection and to generate empathy torwards trans people, inserting the player in the role of a teenage transgender girl and depicting the hardships and prejudices present in her daily life.

title: Chainsaw Dance
description:
Uh oh! It seems you are on a date with the Chainsaw Man!
He dismembers everything, and besides, you hardly understand what he is saying. Will you survive this date?

title: Knife to Meet You
description: A knife throwing game with total throw-control (spinning, power, direction), real physics simulation, object destruction (slicing, piercing, pinning), competitive leaderboards and replay system.

title: Among Dots
description: Maze 2D Pixel Game. To survive, Sora Amber must go through the mazes, running around the labyrinths and gathering energy dots to repair the important rooms of the abandon spaceship. Find super items that boost her strength, make her invisible and help her beat the enemies. Let's go! Sora chan !!

title: Doortal
description: Doortal is a puzzle game that bends reality. What is on the other side of a door depends on what shape you put in. Can you collect all the shapes? Can you visit all the dimensions? How fast can you do it?

title: Betsy's Hospital
description: A small, surreal exploration game based on a memory of a children's hospital.

title: Pottergame
description: Relive the magic of harry potter with this epic game.

title: Sadness of Valor
description: Commander aboard the Global Support Orbital Station (GSOS-3) capable of intervening rapidly on a part of the planet, ensuring the sustainability of humanity. Nothing ever goes as planned. Face the chaotic desert left by the planet and discover the mysteries of its history. In this RTS, alternate between management and combat with friends or soon on a machmaking!

title: Istanbul, Texas
description:
Istanbul, Texas is a music centric tale of destruction, regret and repair.

A man returns to his burnt down and emptied record store, drunk and alone. Drift through the record stacks left behind in Donny's Discount Dungeon, switching your soundtrack as you stumble through breathless thoughts of past and present.

title: The Sims 4: Limited Edition
description:
Unleash your imagination and create a unique world of Sims that's an expression of you! Explore and customize every detail from Sims to homes, and much more with The Sims 4. Life, and Sims, are yours to control. Customize your unique Sims, design their homes & take them on wild adventures through celebdom, romance, holidays and more.

The Sims 4: Limited Edition includes a copy of The Sims 4 and Life of the Party digital content, which features the Flaming Tiki Bar and sleek, stylized outfits for your Sims.

title: The Sims 4: Premium Edition
description:
Unleash your imagination and create a unique world of Sims that's an expression of you! Explore and customize every detail from Sims to homes, and much more with The Sims 4. Life, and Sims, are yours to control. Customize your unique Sims, design their homes & take them on wild adventures through celebdom, romance, holidays and more.

The Sims 4: Premium Edition includes a copy of The Sims 4, Life of the Party digital content, Up All Night digital content and the Creator's Guide hardcover book.

title: The Sims 4: Collector's Edition
description:
Unleash your imagination and create a unique world of Sims that's an expression of you! Explore and customize every detail from Sims to homes, and much more with The Sims 4. Customize your unique Sims, design their homes & take them on wild adventures through celebdom, romance, holidays and more.

The Sims 4: Collector’s Edition includes a copy of The Sims 4, Life of the Party digital content, Up All Night digital content, Awesome Animal Hats digital content, The Creator's Guide hardcover book, and an exclusive interactive USB Plumbob by SteelSeries.

title: Curtain
description:
CURTAIN is an interactive first-person narrative about Kaci & Ally, two queer women in a Glasgow punk band, which gives you a first hand experience of their destructive relationship.

Players embody Ally coming home to their apartment after a successful gig as Kaci, your partner, watches and comments on every thought and action, creating an overwhelming, stifling atmosphere

It takes about half an hour to finish, the game will exit itself.

title: Legends of Kingdom Rush
description:
An RPG game with roguelike elements developed in the medieval fantasy world of Kingdom Rush.

The Kingdom and the rest of the known world are now under the control of the dreadful Dark Army. However, a new threat bigger than the Dark Lord himself unites the heroes of the realm pushing the notions of good and evil aside.

Fight on a turn-based grid moving around the combat area. Switch and match your heroes and companions until you find your ideal team for each battle!

Find treasures, solve riddles, explore ruins, and so on. The world will react differently according to your decisions, so be careful!

title: Misc.
description:
It’s been following you for ages
Year after year
Apartment after apartment
But now it’s time
There is no turning back
You need to sort the "Misc." box.

title: The Isle is Full of Noises
description:
A storm is upon you. Your boat is small... and your destination shrouded. Follow the moon and greet your fellow travellers with care.

Your destiny awaits beyond the westbound lights... in the island's cavernous depths. Be not afeard... the isle is full of noises.

The Isle is Full of Noises is a '#flatgame'. There's intentionally no interaction or even collisions, except for moving the pieces around the screen. It's focused on presenting a game as the most raw and immediate combination of movement, art and sound. The Flat Game manifesto says that all you need to make a game and to present an idea is a couple hours, a laptop, and some markers.

title: Throne: Kingdom at War
description: Throne: Kingdom at War is a medieval-themed Plarium strategy game that has already gained a foothold on the mobile market and now is available as a browser game. Millions of players are vying for the Throne of Amaria, but only the bravest will earn the crown. To lead your Kingdom to prosperity, you shall have to become not only a skilled warrior in battle, but also a wise leader!

title: Frostory
description: A story driven pixel art action adventure game.

title: Dungeon Zer0
description:
Dungeon ZER0 is an epic dungeon game, based on the legendary The Legend Of Zelda games made by Nintendo.

In this game you embody Peter, a medium that has been all his life searching for the magatama, a mystic amulet that will provide him with the cherished endless life. In his journey, he will get into a scary dungeon full of monsters, mysteries, dangers and puzzles. Fight strong goblins, dodge sharp starsaws and survive for the sake of finding eternity.

In order to defend himself of the dangers of the dungeon, Peter will use his sword and his skill in order to defeat the mighty goblins. He also needs to use the Yearts to recover the lost health or the dungeon keys for opening doors. And make sure you don’t step on the spikes at the floor… cause it will hurt so much!

title: Bananas in Pyjamas: It's Fun Time
description: Sing-a-long with B1, B2, the Teddies and Rat in a Hat... and much, much more! Take B1 and B2 on a wonderful adventure through the fun-filled world of Cuddles Avenue. Visit the beach, Rat in a Hat's shop, the park and the Bananas' house for hours of interactive fun and games. Bananas in Pyjamas: It's Fun Time uses the same unique blend of fun and learning that has made the television series a hit with children around the world.

title: Bananas in Pyjamas: It's Party Time
description: Bananas in Pyjamas, a worldwide phenomenon, and favorite for millions of children over the globe, has now come to the PC with this excellent new CD-ROM for young children. Join B1 and B2 on a wonderful adventure through the wacky world of Cuddles Avenue for hours of interactive fun and games. Bananas in Pyjamas help children develop a variety of skills, such as memory building, sequencing and problem solving. The program also enhances social skills such as sharing and co-operation, as well as encouraging children to join in with musical activities by playing instruments, singing and dancing.

title: eFootball
description: eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami. Released in September 2021, it marks a significant shift in the Pro Evolution Soccer (PES) series. Konami rebranded the franchise to eFootball and transitioned to a free-to-play model and a new engine, Unreal Engine.

title: DownFall BattleGrounds
description: Downfall BattleGrounds, the upcoming Free-To-Play online survival game from NeoLife Studio. Players will have the opportunity to collect weapons to survive, team up with friends or go solo and even build their own bases! Get ready for an intense, action-packed adventure unlike any other!

title: The Legend of Neverland
description: The Legend of Neverland is an MMORPG set in a universe called Cabala. Something strange is happening in this utopia, and it's up to you to protect the innocent civilians who are being attacked by evil forces. After designing your character's appearance, you can start exploring this open world with more surprises than meets the eye.

title: Fire and Darkness
description: Fire and Darkness is a cancelled three-dimensional real-time strategy video game developed by Singularity Software. The game consists of a player controlling one of two factions, and their main mission is to defeat the enemy faction to secure the planet's resources. Although the project was incomplete, it became the first game to win the Seumas McNally Grand Prize at the Independent Games Festival of 1999.

title: Daiku no Medium
description:
A ship by the name of 'Lilith' has been navigating through space for two years with a single goal – reaching Eden, the heart of the Universe. The ship's team, consisting of Captain Lazarus, First Mate Anna and Second Mate Joseph, is constantly fighting through hundreds and hundreds of enemy 'Phantom 4s' that has been chasing them throughout the whole trip.

But the final frontier stands before them: Eden is almost within hand's reach...

title: Occupation 2.5
description:
First/Third Person Shooter.
Save the world from extraterrestrial invasion.

title: 2089: Space Divided
description: 2089: Space Divided is a classic science fiction real-time strategy game in which you collect resources, build up your base, raise troops and destroy your opponents with tactical finesse.

title: Grid Legends
description: What does it take to become a racing legend? Welcome to Grid Legends: a high-stakes driving experience that combines thrilling unpredictable motorsport, incredible race variety, and an immersive driving story that puts you at the heart of the action.

title: Apex Legends: Emergence
description:
Meet a new legend: With microdrones and an artist's eye, Seer spots opportunities that other Legends might miss, and seizes them in the most beautiful way he can.

Season 10 also comes with new weapons, ranked arenas and new scenery.

title: Knockout City: Season 2 - Fight at the Movies
description:
Fight at the Movies stars a new map, the Holowood Drive-In, where the playing field changes in real-time as you brawl through scenes from movies across every genre. What’s a movie without snacks, though? Grab yourself a concession-stand classic with the all-new Soda Ball. Time your throws to cover your rivals’ screens with sticky soda!

Season 2 also brings a new season of League Play (with its own shiny rewards), tons of new cosmetics, new Playlists, and more. Arrive to matches in style in a shiny new stretch limo Crew Vehicle, unlockable in all-new weekly Crew Contracts.

title: Knockout City: Season 1 - Welcome to Knockout City
description: Now grab a ball, round up a crew, hit the streets, and make a name for yourself!

title: Runic Relay: The Trials
description: Runic Relay: The Trials is a First Person Platforming game with a focus on Speedrunning. Play as an apprentice wizard who has entered in a competition called “The Trials.” Each trial takes place in a magically constructed dungeon, and consists of a short challenge that you must complete using the tools given to you. These tools include multiple spells, which you can use in tandem with one another to complete tasks that one spell alone might not be able to.

title: Agatha Christie: Hercule Poirot - The First Cases
description: Discover an untold crime story from the mysterious youth of the famous detective Hercule Poirot.

title: Random Racing
description: A collection of driving mini-games with unique exaggerated physics. Full cross-platform multiplayer enabled. Invite friends and compete in interesting game modes such as Sumo, Darts, Bomb-Tag and more.

title: Carrot Slime 2
description:
Welcome to Carrot Slime 2!
Get to the golden carrot in the fastest time possible whilst picking up beetroots and normal carrots along the way!

title: Sur
description: Sur is a survival horror game inspired by survival horror classics. Help Vanessa guide her wheelchair to explore the Uroko hospital and escape from creatures that chase her in her biggest nightmare. Whether hiding or shooting firearms. Survive!

title: Tealerland
description: In this FNAF inspired game you will use T-Lure to contain animatronics while the power goes out or animatronics bang at your door. Climb down a ladder into your office with dangers on the way.

title: Throne of Fate
description: Throne of Fate is a hardcore dynamic RPG roguelike, where you have to clear the land from the creatures that have invaded them. A variety of locations, a variety of weapons, different items, and invincible bosses are waiting for you in Throne of Fate!

title: Animators Hell
description: A UCN style game that includes the oc's of popular SFM YouTubers. Fend off against the animators in your own personalized hell until 6 am.

title: Heist Simulator
description: Lights, Camera, HEIST! Grab your perfect team then hack, unlock, solve and disguise your way to stealing England's finest tat and treasures. Once you're a master thief, take our tools into your own hands and create your perfect heist!

title: Chihiro Himukai Always Walks Away
description: Chihiro Himukai Always Walks Away is a sweet visual novel about two people finding each other after slipping apart.

title: Crypto Is Dead
description: Crypto Is Dead could be described as a "Papers, Please"-like. It's a mix of simulation and puzzle game in which you will have to make your bank grow during 30 days. To do so, you will have to check some bills and find out if they are genuine or fake. During your month of work, you will accumulate money, pay taxes and keep up with the central bank by updating your tools.

title: Nightriderz
description: Nightriderz is a reborn project of Need for Speed:World that has been closed in 2015.

title: Osakabe
description: Osakabe is a first-person horror experience set in a haunted Japanese Castle. You'll need to struggle, run and hide to escape from Osakabe's fierce grasp. You'll explore your surroundings to find out about Osakabe's past and use your limited tools to turn the tides in your favor. You may also find familiar faces along the way that guide your path, but only if Osakabe doesn't find you first...

title: Astoria Legends: Red Moon
description:
Each year on the eve of the Red Moon, the Astrals call forth their Envoys and summons to the world the Tower of God. The arrival of the Tower of God also heralds the oncoming Judgement and brings fear and death upon those caught within its domain. Follow the Envoy of Fire, Astor Roen, as he descends upon Marcalaan and sets the city in chaos... for as long as he keeps his pacts to the gods alive, his home will be safe.

Astoria Legends: Red Moon is a 2D Character action game set to launch on the Nintendo Switch in 2022.

title: Alien Quest: Eve
description: Alien Quest: EVE is a side-scrolling platform game. It's inspired by Super Metroid and Metroid Fusion but also has RPG status system. When your character levels up, you get the Stat Points that be used to power up your character like Diablo.

title: Lisa: The Timeless
description: Lisa: The Timeless is a fan game based on the world established by Austin Jorgensen’s title, Lisa: The Painful, as a story set outside of the main plot of the original Lisa trilogy.

title: Darkness and Light
description: Darkness and Light is a single player 2D platformer game about The Soul on its path to the final destination. Explore flying through avenue, mountain range, city lights, and darkness. Experience downfalls and changes, endings and new beginnings, crying and laughter. Solve puzzles and mazes, gather knowledge, fill with love, collect all the keys that open magical doors, and enlighten the soul to ascend.

title: Baron of Blood
description: Platformer for the PC-DOS released by DeltaSoft in 1999.

title: Cuccchi
description: Cuccchi is a game where you explore beautiful dioramas and go through dangerous and trippy labyrinths, in a journey inside the paintings of Enzo Cucchi.

title: Pedro's Adventures in Spanish
description:
'Pedro's Adventures in Spanish' is a language learning adventure game. All of the dialogue, narration and interface is in simple Spanish accompanied by graphics, animation and context so that you can learn without the need for translations.

This is not a classroom, there are no quizzes or word matching exercises. The purpose of this game is to provide a fun environment for you to practice and learn through context and immersion.

-Classic Point & Click 2D Pixel Art game
-Dozens of unique characters fully voice acted by native Spanish speakers
-Auto-saved progress and no death mechanic encourages experimentation without risk
-Over 1800 lines of in-game Spanish dialogue
-Approximately 15-20 hours of game play (depending on experience level)

title: No Break
description:
What if you lose the brakes from your car, how will you stop it?

How to stop it in the appropriate position without any damage or to say the least damage?

In the No Brake game, you will simulate your assumptions and prove that you can stop the car without brakes and without any damage

can you do it

title: Attack of the Petscii Robots
description:
Sometime in the future, robots attempt to take over human settlements on various planets. Your goal is to infiltrate these settlements and destroy all of the robots.

To do this, you’ll need to locate weapons and other tools...

title: Quake: Episode 5 - Dimension of the Past
description: An semi-official 5th episode for Quake's 20th Anniversary developed by MachineGames of Wolfenstein New Order/New Colossus fame.

title: Timore
description: Horror game, made with Unity 4 engine. It is a game where you search for keys and open doors, run away from "enemies", but sometimes you could choose the wrong way and you just got to face your fate.

title: City-Racing
description: Race through vibrant urban environments against elite drivers in this high-octane street racing game. Navigate waypoint courses, use nitro boosts strategically, and compete across multiple tracks. Master your driving skills to overcome the ultimate challenge: an intense police helicopter chase.

title: Strawberry Jam
description:
Strawberry Jam is a platforming text adventure about the life of an ordinary strawberry. There is no difficult platforming, as the focus is on the story.

The player controls a Strawberry named Jam. They can select their gender before starting the game. The player can talk with other characters and find out little tidbits about others while obtaining tasks for what to do next.

title: Phobia 1.5
description: Phobia 1.5 is a story based first person survival horror game. It's the second game in the series; with Phobia: The fear of the Darkness being first, and upcoming Phobia: Fear of the Unknown being the third.

title: Dream.exe: A Markiplier Fan Game
description:
This is the final release of the long awaited Markiplier fan-game Dream.exe. But this is so much more than a fan-game, it's an experience. You play as Markiplier when he discovers a cool, new fad that recently hit the Internet: Dream.exe.

From start to finish, this game will take you on a fun, yet emotional journey through the world of Dream.exe. Find out what Dream.exe is in this articulately-crafted game designed and created in just 3 weeks by two young developers, both of whom have never made a game before this one.

So strap on your Blue Suits, and get ready for the most emotional journey of your life.

title: With the Addition of Markiplier
description: A Markiplier's fan game

title: Bukkaku
description: The indie game is of experimental genre with mostly horror elements. Bit of survival with sci-fi and RPG elements. A story between life and death in a stylized game origami world. Bukkaku created by Lukas Reznicek aka RZE.

title: Swing & Miss
description: Swing & Miss is an adult visual novel, or eroge. It is a mostly linear story centered around themes such as swinging, netorare (or netorase), moral degeneration, and female domination. It contains a lengthy story and beautiful artwork to illustrate the characters and (erotic) event scenes.

title: JumpStart Numbers
description: A JumpStart game released by Knowledge Adventure in 1998. It is a part of the JumpStart Learning Games series. It focuses on teaching math skills for ages 5-8.

title: Dragon Quest X: Tensei no Eiyuu-tachi Online
description:
The fifth major expansion for Dragon Quest X, known as Version 6.

To play with Dragon Quest X Heroes of the Heavenly Stars Online, the player must have Dragon Quest X Awakening of the Five Tribes, The Sleeping Hero and the Guided Allies, Lore of the Ancient Dragon, The 5000 Year Voyage to a Faraway Hometown, and Thorn Lady and the God of Destruction. Also, the owners of "Dragon Quest X All in One Package version 1-5" can play it.

title: Tonko 2
description: A platformer game for Windows 95. The resolution has doubled from the previsous game and the sountrack is now MIDI based.

title: Tonko 3
description: The third entry in the Tonko series. Introduces puzzles to the game instead of the pure platformer of previous entries.

title: Airlines Deluxe
description: Airlines Deluxe is a game made by Thomas "Safariminer" Althot in 2021 with the Unity game engine. The game is a 3D platformer set in the sky, the goal being to hop from platform to platform until you reach the finish line.

title: Negligee: Spring Clean
description: The girls of the Lingerie shop are back and they are in for their toughest day of the year, a mega sale event! How will the girls handle things, you get to decide not only how the sale goes but who you will control in this adult yuri/lesbian themed multi-routed visual novel game.

title: Flesh of the Killer
description: In a dark freeport on the edge of the city the artworks are stored; it's a members-only institution and a secret to everybody. That's why BB and her friends want to document as much as possible before they get kicked out. But why does the vault have no security guards? Just what has been evolving underground in the forbidden Museum Of Moral Art? And if inanimate objects could have morals, would we understand them?

title: Dip the Frog
description: Follow the story of a joyful little frog who goes on an adventure in this super-tight platformer.

title: Summer of '58
description: In the summer of 2008. The main character, at the request of followers, goes to Russia to explore the abandoned camp "Yunost". Locals say that this place is inhabited by restless souls. This will need to be checked.

title: Speculum Mortis: Regret
description: Speculum Mortis (Latin for "mirror of death") is a horror-themed first-person point-and-click adventure done mostly in greyscale. Speculum Mortis: Regret is a remaster that fixed several bugs (including at least one game-ending bug) and added some content to the original game.

title: Chess with Lasers
description: Lasers, portals, mirrors... what could be more awesome? Destroy the enemy's king with your laser by moving and rotating mirrors and by strategically using the special abilities some pieces possess. Play against friends (local and online) or against the AI and create levels!

title: Rocket League: Season 3
description: Start your engines! Rocket League Season 3 is fueled up and live! Drive into the most high-octane season yet, with a new Rocket Pass, challenges, and content from Nascar and Formula 1.

title: Medoka Magik Grls Extended
description: A story about a young girl fighting a great evil hiding in the shadows.

title: Pretty Neko
description: Relax class puzzle game to keep you in a good mood.

title: Shout Seven
description:
Set in Ye Olde England, with stunning visuals and simple gameplay, this is an all new, addictive, medieval romp that takes alignment challenges to the next level, with a brand new way to move.

-You can start anywhere on the board
-You can only go where your opponents let you
-You can push your opponents off the board

For two, three, and even four players, Shout Seven is a whole new take on the classic struggle of wits. You are rewarded for your cunning but punished for the slightest mistake. You can advance from Knight to Monarch or be demoted to Peasant. Even without a single stone in play, you still have the chance to declare victory over your defeated foes.

So read of the discovery of this fabled royal game in the hallowed grounds of Avalon and let us put it back on its noble pedestal!

Yes, there are ads, but the chancellor has a war to fund against the barbarian hordes.

title: Mom
description: Mom says I can't get out of my room after 12:00 AM. But I always hear the door opening and closing after that hour. Why isn't mom sleeping?

title: The Ramp
description: You crave for flow? You just want to shred through a halfpipe without all the boring stuff? Say no more, The Ramp is your jam!

title: Teraphobia
description:
Teraphobia is the fear of monsters itself. It's gotten so bad at this point that you always feel the stress. It's like someone is watching you constantly...
Teraphobia is a psychological co-op horror game where you stop a group of monsters that have awoken from the underworld.

title: Thief 2X: Shadows of the Metal Age
description:
An unofficial expansion pack to Thief II: The Metal Age with features similar to those in retail Looking Glass games: complex level design, a lengthy campaign (consisting of thirteen long missions), pre-rendered introduction and ending sequences, original music, new voice acting, original artwork, and animated mission briefings.

Thirteen full-length missions take the action through city streets and rooftops, ancient tombs, hotels, museums, cathedrals and more in a gripping tale of vengeance and deception. Hundreds of new models, textures and sounds: 3000 lines of new dialogue. Four cutscenes and twelve new briefings in the original Thief style. Ten new weapons and tools provide the means to evade, outwit, and out-fight your opponents, as well as bringing unprecedented levels of emergent gameplay to the Thief series.

title: Final Fantasy: Pixel Remaster Collection
description: The Final Fantasy: Pixel Remaster series will comprise FINAL FANTASY I through FINAL FANTASY VI, with each game releasing individually. For long-term fans that will be hugely exciting news - a chance to revisit some of their most beloved RPGs of all time in a way that perfectly captures the spirit of those original game.

title: Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons
description: Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons is the third expansion for the award-winning and critically acclaimed MMORPG Guild Wars 2. The dragon cycle that has sustained and blighted Tyria for ages is collapsing. Mortal hearts and choices will define this moment in history—and echo in the future forever.

title: Tonko 4
description: The final entry in the Tonko series. A 3D platformer for the PC.

title: Oatmeal
description: Oatmeal. This game is about oatmeal. In this game, you have a spoon, and 1 minute to eat as much oatmeal as you can. It's not as easy as you think.

title: Entity Researchers
description: Entity Researchers is a dungeon crawling RPG with manic battles and randomized items and maps.

title: BlackThorne Keep: Chronicles
description: Thommas BlackThorne is the last heir of the BlackThorne, a once noble family of the northernmost edges of the empire. When his family lands are given to a new noble, Thommas needs to travel south to find his older brother that decided to dedicate his life to the church - and deliver the news of the Fate of the BlackThorne.

title: Black
description: Small episode with three Wizard and one Base level as well as a start map. Also has a few new textures and different endings depending on skill level.

title: HookCat
description: A short topdown puzzle-solving game about a detective cat with a grappling hook

title: Elemental War 2
description:
Elemental War 2 offers you the popular tower defense feeling combined with innovative game mechanics: as soon as you defeat an elemental – a particularly strong enemy that will demand everything from you – you’ll receive its element stone, which you can use to build new defense towers. As you keep collecting elements, you’ll always have new levels and tower combinations at your disposal.

Only if you skillfully combine the different towers and make use of their advantages will you be able to stand up to the monster hordes. Through in-game side quests, you’ll also unlock items that further enhance the abilities of your towers or decisively weaken your opponents at just the right time!

Elemental War 2 offers you dozens of hours of gameplay to develop strategies, complete all the quests and discover all the secrets of the game world. The lovingly hand-built maps offer you varied games and always new challenges!

title: Hideout: Face your fears
description: In this third person stealth game set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by an artificial intelligence, you will take on the role of May in her quest to save her brother. Avoid the robots, explore the town and find its secrets!

title: The Whitetail Incident
description: A short horror game where you have to survive cultist, with a shotgun in hand can you make it to the end?

title: Frigid
description: Hunt, build, craft and survive an apocalyptic arctic environment and unravel the mystery of a strange virus that is infecting the local wildlife. Inspired by The Thing!

title: Winds & Leaves
description:
Learn to read the signs of the various climates, awaken old landmarks, and grow your own forests in this PlayStation VR flora builder.

Stranded in a barren landscape, you are the only being capable of mastering the ancient art of growing vegetation.

Journey across the Steppe to discover landmarks left behind from a previous time. Uncover their secrets in order to unlock new equipment and gather ancient dormant seed varieties. Find the perfect conditions to plant them in and you'll witness magnificent trees grow to maturity and transform the landscape.

title: Freddy in Space 2
description:
Freddy is back... in space! Every good horror series inevitably goes to space, but how many of them go back for a second round?

When Freddy leaves the lunar base on a deep-space mission, the central computer system is hijacked by the newly installed high-tech computer assistant: L.ogarithmic O.nline LAN-compatible Z.ero-error H.ydraulic A.uxiliary X.ylophone(?), otherwise known as L.O.L.Z.H.A.X.

LolzHax has brainwashed the other resident space warriors, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, and that weird gangly space puppet, and has locked Freddy's son outside the station with limited air remaining. Can Freddy rescue his friends, defeat LolzHax, and save his son in time?

This game was originally designed for the December 3rd, 2019 fundraiser for St. Jude hosted by Game Theory. The live-stream is over now and was a big success. Thank you to everyone who watched and contributed!

title: Roxy Raccoon
description: Roxy Raccoon is a cute, fun-filled 3D platformer for all ages and a throw back to collectathons of the past. Starring an adventurous young cub, leap, climb, sneak and roll through four unique worlds and compete in minigames in order to end the bratty witch's evil plans.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
description: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel lets players old and new enjoy the hugely popular Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG in digital form. Players across the globe can compete in intense collectible card Duels, both thrilling to play and watch. Alongside those iconic cards will be a huge range of other monsters, spells, traps, and more, drawn from Yu-Gi-Oh's two-decade-long legacy.

title: Luminesce
description: In luminesce you fly through a neon world blasting everything you see, there are many different enemy types in this awesome Shmup!

title: Grey Instinct
description: In this cyberpunk 2D point-and-click adventure game, play as Grey, an amateur detective. Unravel the mystery by searching for clues, solving puzzles, talking to the mask-wearing residents of New Corium, and, if you have time, maybe go on a date!

title: Speedrun the Game
description: Speedrun the Game is a stereotypical “save the princess” kind of game, but with a twist. You do go to the castle, defeat the bad guys, and save the princess, but the whole point of the game is to play it over and over to get a faster time, achievements, hats, mini games, etc. Every time you play the game, there’s something different about it than the last time you played!

title: Primal Hearts
description: After moving into a new town hoping for a new life, Kazuma finds himself the swing vote between two deadlocked factions representing tradition and innovation. Nicknamed “Triple Seven,” can he still live easy and find romance under his new status as a much-contested lucky guy?

title: Primal Hearts 2
description: As new rivalries and old divisions threaten to split Ainoshima apart once again, only a new “Triple Seven” can restore peace once more! Torn between the machinations of the Liberal Arts and Sports factions, can our hero heal everyone's hearts—and steal just one?

title: Lockdown Lewd Up!
description: Lewd up your lockdown! (18+)

title: Sovereign Tea
description: Command the Tea Princesses to victory over the Coffee Empire in this adorable Strategy RPG! Brew your minions, position your armies, and tactically press forward to achieve victory.

title: Science Simulator
description: Science Simulator the science educational video game. explore, discover, learn.

title: One Shot in the Dark, Now I'm Dead.
description: They killed the world generations ago. Find out the truth and ascend to the Wire.

title: Genfanad
description: An Indie MMORPG inspired by classic MMOs and smashing tropes together.

title: Blacksmith Legends
description: Blacksmith Legends is a RPG simulation strategy game where you inherit a small workshop and build your way up. Your job is to craft/modify your recipe's, manage your workshop/employees, become hero or villain with, compete against other blacksmith's in the Kingdom. Impress or dethrone your King!

title: Kubo 3
description:
Kubo 3 is new homebrew NES game from SJ Games (a 7 year old from France and little help from his Dad).

The game is available in ROM version to download or can be ordered in complete NES CARTRIDGE edition in box with the manual.

title: The Cyclist: Tactics
description: A pro cycling turn-based tactics and strategy game. Create your own rider and manage your team throughout career mode, or compete in customizable single races and tours. Manage your resources wisely and outsmart the competition to ride to the top.

title: Chain Break
description:
Developed almost entirely by one of 1985 Alternativo's most active members, Manu Segura, Chain Break is a highly addictive endless runner arcade game that will make us break a sweat to overcome each and every one of its increasingly difficult levels.
The project began at the end of March 2017, born as a parallel task to the realization of another of the main games of 1985 Alternativo.

title: Magical Sound Car
description: The Magical Sound Car is a little car that can run, jump... and plays music while is moving! The kids made courses for the toy and challenge you to beat all them. Simple reach the kids to beat the level and go to the next!

title: Gift Shop Factory
description: A CHALLENGE FOR YOU!! Although this is an endless game, at the end of your shift, the boss will comment on your perfomance. Will it be bad... or it will be good? There's different comments she can give you, but will be able to make she thinks your job was "very impressive"? This is the best comment you can get from her, so try your best to impress her!

title: Symbiotic Love
description: Symbiotic Love is a coming-of-age Yuri Visual Novel set in an All Girls' High School. What has fate in store for love so perfect, so symbiotic, that they could only live, and perish together?

title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2: Butcher's Banquet
description: A free major expansion which introduces an entirely new, unexplored region - The Temple - complete with all-new objectives and some of your most deadly contracts.

title: The Church of Cheesus Crisp: An All You Can Pray Buffet
description: You are Fr. Salad, the pastor of The Church of Cheesus Crisp. You've been given the holy book to tell each parishioner a parable, a life lesson you might say. Complete each mini-game to give each Food Person a blessing, or let sin prevail. Get the high score and get them warm, fuzzy, good good feels.

title: The Adventurer
description:
Run, jump, collect stars, solve puzzles and fight your way through an epic adventure.

Omar is a young boy who lives with his father in a small land. Few months ago, Omar saw a strange creature inside the deep forest. Ever since, Omar is afraid to go into the forest and he gets nightmare of that creature everyday. Omar's father wanted him to face his fear. Omar promised to his father that one day he would go into the forest alone.

title: Prison of the Magi: Ch. 0
description: Escape the void, trust nothing—a 1-player adventure game with cosmic horror vibes.

title: Sideliner
description: A minimalist puzzle game where you use your current path to create new ones.

title: From View
description:
Explore more than 30 simple but beautiful diorama-like rooms in this relaxing adventure / puzzle / hidden object game hybrid.

Collect items, solve simple puzzles, and piece together the clues to unlock and rekindle the five shrines.

There are no threats to overcome, no opponents to defeat, and no clock to rush against. You will find some quiet puzzles and beautiful, simple scenery.

title: Rent's Due: The Game
description: Rent's Due: The Game is a third-person platformer game where you take control of protagonist Tesha Robinson. Tesha is in need of some money and in order to get it, she must complete different levels with various obstacles that provide a huge challenge.

title: Mochi A Girl
description: Easy controls! Exhilarating and springy wire action!

title: Ultra Mission
description: Embark on a dangerous investigation in Ultra Mission, the latest arcade-inspired shooter from Gumbo Machine. As an agent of the Stellar Exchange Commission, you must traverse the labyrinthine maze that is Otto Labs. Each of Ultra Mission's 20 levels is littered with powerful automatons and questionable experiments.

title: TeleNovela
description: Embrace your inner Latino and write the greatest love story that will run for about six months on prime time before being replaced by an even greater love story!

title: The Illusion
description: The Illusion Is a Puzzle Game Where You Have To Pass Through A Different Set Of Tests For Your Brain, Memory, senses and interactivity with the environment While You Are Trapped In mysterious mansion surrounded With Unknown Dark Forces

title: An Odd Tale
description: An Odd Tale is an indie adventure-RPG filled with mystery and laughs. After discovering a lost government file about a secretive project, you venture out across the Odd Kingdom to find answers in a hilarious adventure.

title: Plumber 2
description: The Plumber 2 is a popular logical game, whose goal is to connect two water points in a short time to drain the water. This game has 30 levels with a gradually increasing degree of complexity, and the game is ideally suited for mobile devices.

title: Geisterland
description: Geisterland is a dark adventure game that takes place in a fantastic universe and talks about societal problems in a creative way. It talks about empathy and fairness... and if we might let them go to survive. Will you give up your principles to survive?

title: Gachimuchi Life Simulator
description: Experience the whole journey of becoming a Gachimuchi fighter. Deep RPG system, open world. Become the best in the Gacimuchi league!

title: Knights & Guns
description: Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences. A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm. Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

title: Dream House Days DX
description: The house of your dreams is a dream no more! You play both architect and landlord in this fanciful new sim, and it's up to you to furnish your ideal abode with anything from arcade games to saunas to convenience stores. Certain combinations can power up your rooms...and their rent. Put an HDTV and game console together to make a game room, or a grand piano and painting together to make a fine arts room! Rise up the rankings of real estate fame and you might reel in some celebrity tenants, ranging from hit singers to soccer stars! But there's more than just business at stake. Tenants will look to you for guidance on everything from romance to career choices. With your help, they just might tie the knot or land that dream job! Build a dream home where dreams come true! Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

title: Theofil
description: Theofil is an action arcade game in which you'll guide a hooded hero wearing an ancient robe. Your weapon is a magical wooden staff that brave Theofil uses to destroy his enemies. His abilities will help you fight against dangerous enemies.

title: 1942 Wing Baron
description: Jump on board of the famous red biplane and destroy everything you come across! If you enjoy classic aviation arcade games in which your screen fills up with chaos and destruction you’ll love 1942 Wing Baron. Progress through 15 levels with different landscapes and lots of enemies who will make your life a misery: planes, ships, tanks, helicopters, etc. Pick up arms, avoid enemy bursts of machine-gun fire and confront the most dangerous final bosses!

title: Hentai Sexy
description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

title: Photo-Life: Rina's Journey
description: Travel with Rina during a year as a photographer! 75 Pictures to unlock in Story & Extra modes. Procedurally generated mini-game.

title: Battlegrounds: First Blast
description: A military styled action tower-defense game filled with nukes, missiles and tanks. Improve your building, canons and tanks. Purchase stronger ammunition and survive the next wave. Highly replayable, tough and addictive. The fun never ends

title: Dice Girls: Lying Dice
description: And three different character of the United States play together big dice dice this very interesting game. Big dice is also called braggart dice, is a very popular bar dice game in China. If you win, the pretty girls can take off one piece of clothing.

title: World Pirate Wars
description: World Pirate Wars is an open world pirate survival game. Defeat enemy hordes in horde mode or fight against npcs and players on the open world (open world coming soon).

title: Kitsune Killer
description: Kitsune Killer is a 2d slasher game in which the player needs to quickly and accurately cut his enemies, thereby accumulating the hearts of his enemies in order to be able to go further and defeat them all, becoming the main one among the ninja killers.

title: Missing Bullet
description: This is a first person action game,The player needs to survive as long as possible, the player has bow and arrow, shield, knife as weapons.,,Players are free to explore the surrounding area.Survive as long as possible!

title: Hyper Dungeon Crawler
description: Hyper Dungeon Crawler is a turn-based roguelike RPG with crafting. Collect materials and craft your unique tools, weapons, magic spells and other supplements and fight your way through a series of procedurally generated scenes.

title: Smithy Wars
description: Discover Recipes. Try out tactics. Customize a fireball. Smithy Wars is a fighting game with a heavy focus on crafting and customizing spells. Fights are made by the AI based on the tactics, spells and items provided to your fighters.

title: Ships at War
description: A physics-based strategy game with player-made warships and submarines. Build the most effective warships and use them to sink the enemy during battles. Conquer the ocean by deploying your ships in strategic locations on the sea in round-based scenarios.

title: Puzzle Soccer
description: it's not enough to be the fastest nor the most skillful player, sometimes you must to be the smartest one! Use your memory power and strategic ability to move your players in the correct order to score the goal.

title: Coloring Game 4
description: This is the last part of the Coloring Game’s franchise (coloring by numbers). The game’s fans are going to enjoy the improved functionality and a multitude of new images.

title: Cube-e
description: Cube-e - platformer on accuracy with a change in gravity, performed in 2D graphics.

title: Adriatic Pizza
description: Adriatic Pizza is a peaceful pizzayolo 3D simulator. In a world inspired by Porco Rosso, explore islands, deliver pizzas, meet wonderful characters and watch out for your Seaplane fuel !

title: Unlikely Heroes
description: The evil Lich King, lord of the Undead, is rising once more. It weighs upon your shoulders to do what no one before could, defeat it once and for all, and rid humanity of this ultimate evil!

title: Age of Darkness: Final Stand
description: Age of Darkness: Final Stand is a dark fantasy survival RTS where you must illuminate, build and defend humanity’s last bastion against hordes of Nightmares. Set in the remnants of a kingdom consumed by a deadly fog, you decide. Will you hide in the light? Or take back your world.

title: Religion Inc.
description: Religion Inc. is a strategy simulator where you create a religion. Will you find a way to unite the whole world under one faith? Create your own unique religion using different combinations of religious aspects! Test if it can withstand the challenges of the times, the pressure of obstacles, and bring humanity together.

title: Anomalous
description: A pixelated low fidelity 90s throwback hyper-fast action shooter. Survive and fight through a city overrun with manufactured monstrosities, biomass horrors, and a military authority trying to purge everything living. Featuring a heavy metal soundtrack

title: Silverwing
description: Silverwing is an action flight game where you build an array of powerful spaceships to combat enemies across space and a diverse array of planet landscapes. Play through a fully voiced 20+ mission campaign with multiple endings based on your mission choices.

title: Island of the Lost
description: A relaxing first-person exploration game. Journey through eight unique environments as you collect treasures, unlock secrets and search for a way off the island.

title: Zap! Retro Arcade Collection
description:
ZAP! is a compilation of eight single player space shooters in the fixed screen genre. The games have all been previously released by Alawar Entertainment, Inc .

The games in this compilation are:
Alien Outbreak 2: Invasion
Back to Earth
Back to Earth 2
Crusaders of Space
Crusaders of Space 2
Crusaders of Space: Open Range
El Airplane
Pulsarius

The following game is not in the same genre and is included as a bonus game
Cubozoid

title: Cupid's Palace
description: Cupid(You) are in the chaotic depths of Hades. You seek help from the GODS of Olympus, to help unite with your beloved Psyche at the Cupid's Palace.

title: StrateZ
description: StrateZ is a casual post-apocalyptic RTS game where you fight to survive as one of three separate factions be it Survivor, Zombie or Marauder.

title: Pathmaker
description: Pathmaker is a single-player puzzle game with the goal to get all of your carts from one side to the other. Cross tracks, avoid obstacles, and make sure the carts don't collide with each other. 130 levels range from simple to very challenging. Exercise your logic skills!

title: Floating Islands of Nucifera
description: Floating Islands of Nucifera is an open world shopkeeping game set in an abandoned world in the sky. Adventure across the fantasy world of Nucifera in your airship, summon powerful creatures to your side to aid in dangerous turn-based combat, and loot treasures to help pay off your family's debt!

title: Super Brain Cube
description: Super Brain Cube! Your color cube puzzle clicker in space with great soundtrack.

title: Samurai Vandalism
description: Mukuro is a member of the shogunate's personal enforcer group Hozuki. Her view of the world will be challenged, and she must decide whether to remain loyal, or to try and forge her own path in a war-torn world.

title: Beyond the Waterfalls
description: Beyond the Waterfalls pits players against each other in a world trapped between waterfalls which players go from one environment to the next leading to one fire fight to the next in fast paced combat. Pick your favorite class and outwit your opponents.

title: Big Neon Tower vs. Tiny Square
description: Ride the vaporwaves as you outrun nefarious neon nuisances in this 90s inspired precision platformer. No sprint, no double-jump, and no floaty controls! Just quick deaths and generous respawn points. Can you reach the top of the tower and rescue your Pineapple?

title: Grim Tales: The Heir - Collector's Edition
description: You've got one dangerous family.

title: Eternal Destiny: The Salem Witches - Those Who Devour Fear
description: Second DLC for Eternal Destiny, with a new story and dungeons for the newly released cards.

title: Tom's Adventure
description: A little but very fun and challenging platform game.

title: Love n War: Warlord by Chance
description: Warlord by Chance is a tactical RPG. Your destiny is to become a warlord. Build your economy, recruit gorgeous heroic girls, upgrade units, and immerse in stimulating love tales. Stand, Fight and Create your own dynasty, my lord.

title: Zoo War
description: Zoo War is a 3v3 Multiplayer Online Battle Arena that will give you a fascinatingly deep experience of tank shooting games!

title: My House My Rules
description: My House My Rules is a horror with elements of humor, the main character is no longer a helpless whipping doll! You will be armed with the most powerful weapon - a word!

title: Sumple
description: Take a seat back and explore a vast and beautiful world. Find out why it became so empty. And get inspired by all the stories that helped others in the past. But also don't let your guard down because revenge is the reason you were summoned here.

title: Frog Story
description: The story of a frog trapped in an eternal maze, help a frog with knowledge of karate to go through this maze and get free

title: Medieval Apocalypse
description: The main goal in Medieval apocalypse is not only to survive as in previous survival games where you had to watch over the hunger, thirst, fatigue but the player will have to watch out for infection caused by zombies to not become one of them.

title: Celestine
description: Celestine, by the makers of Final Battle, features an enthralling story with many twists and turns, and a gameplay to satisfy the itch of RPG players. It is a must-have for fans of the old Final Fantasy, Dragon Quest and Breath of Fire.

title: DuDu Kingdom
description: The lovely dudu lives alone in the deep forest, needs to collect fruit and honey to go home every day, can you help him?

title: Tower of Mice
description: Tower of Mice is a Action RPG with randomized content. Choose your battles or be forced to hide from enemies. Level up and acquire new both skills and perks hidden in the forest. Explore a demonic realm that consists of puzzles and fierce encounters. Reach The Tower and uncover the truth.

title: Zombie Spectre
description: A debut title by 528 games, Zombie Spectre is an epic action packed third person zombie shooter. Take on swarms of zombies and huge zombie boss battles in this epic zombie shooting game. In this zombie survival game you will meet waves of zombies.

title: BrightSeeker
description: Journey through the world where magic and technology are intertwined, defeat dangerous enemies, discover hidden secrets and vanquish challenging bosses.

title: Way Far Home
description: Join the Hardcore adventure with little Fox. Travel through lands and sky, discover the secret of the Jungle. Overcome the suffering of exhaustion, painfulness, lost in fear. Find true love.

title: Duamo
description: Duamo is a deceptively simple minimalistic vibrant neon puzzle game where you have to fit shapes into a square.

title: Dead Herring VR
description: Dead Herring is a VR-Experience in which you solve a murder case.

title: Looping World
description: Looping World is an independent survival simulation game in which you have to play a conscious world, survive in a dangerous void, and at the same time survive to create more species.

title: Role Player: Full Immersion
description: Role Player is an Interactive movie game, you have to choose options and decide the fate of the main character. Our hero loves to play RPG games on the topic of technological disasters and post-Apocalypse, but he wants more entourage and adrenaline! Let's see how he`ll like it

title: Jei VR
description: Members of the Cyberion underground are trying to destroy World Dynamics inc by organizing sabotage, undermining infrastructure and freeing people from debt camps-factories. Jei is a girl who is destined to end the dictatorship.

title: Dark Magic
description: You grew up in an ordinary family with an ordinary life, except for the fact, you're the only man alive in the world!

title: Welcome to Dreamville
description: Welcome to Dreamville - this is a small adventure in a quiet town called Dreamville. You will face a very simple goal, but with each failure the game will become more difficult.

title: Tell Some Story: Foz
description: Action-adventure + Third person shooter. The year is 2042, the near future, the gloomy world of cyberpunk will offer you the role of detective Foz. Random circumstances drag the hero into a showdown between gangs and corporations, where he has to make a choice on whose side he is.

title: Get Out! Snakes!
description: Inspired by the success of the 90s, Get out! Snakes! Make the famous Snake from old cell phones your enemy, save your friends green apples in 5 different worlds, or lute against a friend in the multiplayer arena! Ah! And don't take your eyes off the snake, after all, you're also hunting now!

title: Chǔ Hàn Nǚzǐ
description: Ancient China, the era of the Chu-Han War. This is a historical novel adventure that depicts the "what ifs" of the two leaders of the Chu-Han War, Han Yu and Liu Bang. ---Your choice will be the guidepost of this story.

title: Adventures in Morality: An Interactive Case Study
description: Take a 3D interactive test to calculate your sympathy-type. According to CYBIL, the A.I. who built Adventures in Morality, differences in sympathy-types is the cause and solution to all human conflict. Hear CYBIL's story and discover your sympathy-type in Adventures in Morality.

title: The Last of Anime
description: The Last of Anime is a cool open-world shooter. Your task is to clean up the destroyed city. A pistol, submachine gun and sniper rifle will help you defeat your enemies.

title: Atlas Falling
description: Atlas Falling is an action RPG with roguelike elements in which the game world is forged as you battle to discover the truth. Experience endless gameplay from randomized skills, levels, and multiple upgrade paths.

title: Empower
description: Enter a physics based PC VR multiplayer Sci Fi arena sandbox that supports ranged and close combat. Switch dynamically between PC and VR mode and compete against other players and complex AI with fully physics-based weapons in a partially Zero G arena with different modes.

title: Pianistic
description: Become a pianist with KEYBOARD and MOUSE! Play the masterpieces of classic, jazz and other piano pieces.

title: Whiskers & Tail
description: Two cute mice are taking the laboratory by storm. Test your reflexes, memory and problem-solving skills by taking on a wide variety of puzzle-based tasks.

title: Cannabis Farmer Strain Master
description: Cannabis Farmer Strain Master is a Unique and Timeless experience to test your skills to be come the ultimate Strain Master.

title: Beyond Horizon
description: Battle across the galaxy, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the mystery of Kuma's missing sister in this fast-paced top-down space shooter.

title: You Are Alone
description: Take back her husband from the mafia and destroy the invention A story about revenge The game is a third person perspective, action, mission system, shooting game, different types of enemies, and different missions at each level The game is 3 level

title: Nyaf
description: A funky, crazy Hidden Object Game that just feels good. Come have a good time into a warm and unique universe, with great art and music, bonus-games and layers of secrets. Select between 8 levels of difficulties, switch helps on and off, play as you wish!

title: Moi Mei 2
description: "Moi Mei 2" tells the story of a brave girl, doomed to a feat, through a visually stunning puzzle platformer.

title: Cross Maid
description: 互相认错性别的两人，机缘巧合之下开始同居生活 产生羁绊到互相依恋再到自我怀疑，温馨欢乐的短片小故事

title: Vectromirror 0
description: Become the Test Subject and attempt to complete a challenging experiment to awaken emotional responses in your Artificial Intelligence. Jump, wall-run, and parkour your way through the free-to-play prequel to the upcoming game.

title: LineVox
description: LineVox is a casual cyberpunk game suitable for both one and several players, where you have to control the ship avoiding obstacles in order to win.

title: Fire & Maneuver
description: From the team that brought you The Armchair Historian comes a new strategy game set in the Victorian Era. As muskets become rifles and infantry are replaced by Gatling guns, you must adapt to a rapidly changing battlefield. This is a new age, not of courage and chivalry, but of Blood and Iron.

title: FPS Tactics
description: Control a group of special agents, find a monster on the map and place the agents so that they can defeat the monster

title: Hack Jump
description: Hack Jump is a 2D Platformer with nice Story.

title: Nauticalypse
description: Explore the mysterius sea and defeat mythologic creatures to get gold and treasures. Build different weapons to defend and improve your ship.

title: Viking Heroes 2
description: Join a family of heroic Vikings on an epic journey through a magical land as they come to the aid of the helpless and seek to stop a dark and destructive force. Defeat ferocious dinosaurs, explore the dazzling realm of dreams and plan ahead as you amass resources and race to beat the clock!

title: Restart Zero
description: Restart Zero is an action shooter in cyberpunk style. Experience a fast-paced adventure single or local coop multiplayer.

title: Grappling Ball
description: Grappling Ball is a single player platformer where you control a ball with a grapple gun and use it to go up against 10 levels which increase in difficulty

title: Night Attack: Touge
description: Dive into the golden era of Japanese street racing. Choose from a list of iconic cars and perfect your driving skills in beautiful mountain roads. Challenge your friends and rivals in downhill or uphill battles. At night, the streets are yours.

title: Hanefield Asylum
description: Horror themed Asylum game, with FPS and a story line, Fight your way through the Asylum using a light and a gun to discover your identity and find your way out!

title: Esports Godfather
description: "ESport Godfather" is a card game that simulates MOBA e-sports games. In the game, you will become a coach. From scratch, you will form a team that belongs to you. By analyzing versions, training players, and developing strategies, the team becomes stronger and better known through competition.

title: FLChess 2
description: Chess game in 3D environment, where advanced artifical inteligence with 6 levels of strength can make you work hard for win.

title: One Rainy Night
description: One Rainy Night is a puzzle platform game in which you investigate the mysterious disappearance of the inhabitants of Sleepy Falls.

title: En-Train
description: It's a real-time shooter game played in a disastrous world. Get on the train now!

title: Gachi Run: Running of the Slaves
description: Furious 3D runner about a pumped-up Gachi. Run as far as possible! Collect Sweets! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

title: Time Tails
description: Visit the American Revolution with two time traveling cats from the 80's! Help Ari and Zoe fix glitches in time to help save the American revolution! This short point and click adventure helps players learn the basics of 3D coordinate systems used in game development software like Unity.

title: Magic Manny
description: Magic Manny - In this Magical RPG, Manny Awakens to discover He is another Time and Place. He must Develop his Magic Skills and Level up. Help him to Fend off hordes of undead skeletons and evil drones. Each section of the game offers a chance to learn more magic abilities.

title: Mythrealm
description: Explore a fallen land of mystery and lore. Battle against dark and ancient monsters. Traverse deadly pitfalls, and advance your character in this fantasy 3rd person action RPG. Uncover the chaos that is darkening the land and fight for the magic that empowers the Mythrealm.

title: Chernobyl Inferno
description: Go in search of your brother, who got lost in the catacombs of Chernobyl, among aggressive inhabitants mutilated by radiation.

title: Moonshot: The Great Espionage
description: Moonshot is a stealth puzzle platformer that puts you in the role of a spy of a fictional country in the 'moon race' era. In competition with the USA and the Soviet Union, you will have to use espionage and sabotage to make sure that your nation will be the first on the moon.

title: P0
description: Enjoy your last 7 days in the hospital, a peaceful and settled place where you can't really kill anyone. Explore with your feeble combat ability and find a way out. End with the truth of P0.

title: Anime Squad
description: Anime Squad is an Online First-Person Shooter game set between two rival teams, Pink Force and Purple Ghost. In Anime Squad, you can choose the Pink Forc and Purple Ghost sides, see and experience how devastating this sweet battle can be.

title: Slikoban
description: Slikoban is Sokoban game. Move the cubes to their correct locations and solve the levels.

title: Heart of Dungeon
description: You are an adventurer. You are on a journey to King's Landing and are now escorting a merchant's wagon. Your companion, a competitor, has told you of a dungeon in the area. You may head there, or you may not. The choice is yours.

title: Dream of Hakugyokurou
description: In the Lotus Land, endless rain began to fall, and fewer acquaintances could be seen on the streets. However, strange events remained unresolved for a long time. At this moment, Yuyuko disappeared......

title: Engine Evolution 2021
description: Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses similar principles as World of Tanks - with each PvP race, against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your motorbike, or unlock the next motorbike.

title: Vegteria
description: Enjoy managing your own vegetables shop . Plant, harvest, buy and sell goods, transport, drive, upgrade, customize your shop to be the best shop owner in the village.

title: Agent X
description: Agent X is a short FPS game. The police officers named Turk give 5 task to complete! Let's see if Agent X can withstand against bad girls!

title: Stern
description: Anarchy and lawlessness flourish in the city, and at the same time, due to the explosion of a chemical plant, all residents inhabiting the city are turning into unknown creatures and creatures that crave human flesh. No more rules and laws!

title: Stand of Arms
description: This is a hard-core first-person shooter game with armed conflict as the background. Players can operate more than a dozen weapons, fight on the front line where the situation is changing rapidly, and experience a unique strategy game of guns and bullets.

title: RE:Jump Boy
description: Jump one by one small steps, take a rainbow bath in the last toilet, and you will enter the next level

title: Karting4Fun
description: Have some fun with friends on one computer or online! Enter a race full of adrenaline and fast turns. Hitting and pushing are allowed! There are tracks in the open air or the halls.

title: Monster Wilds
description: Play as Doppel, the adorable shapeshifting blob, and battle your way through the Monster Wilds to become the ultimate Monster! Fight all kinds of unique enemies and explore a number of strikingly designed levels.

title: A Dog Named Mato
description: A dog named Mato is a puzzle game with an unusual mechanics of rotating the entire level in different directions.

title: Chess Valley
description: Play chess in a way you've never played. Face a board like a labyrinth and try to cross it with the king to join his army.

title: Who's Lila?
description: A reverse-detective point-and-click adventure where, instead of choosing dialogue options, you control the character's face manually.

title: Tank Fight
description: Tank Fight is an online multiplayer fighting game where you upgrade your tank and compete with others until someone wins. You can mess around with friends or join public lobbies.

title: Donutis Simulator
description: You can prepare delicious and richly decorated donuts in your donut shop by purchasing the ingredients written in the recipe. During the game, you buy new furniture in your store and provide the best comfort to your customers. Don't forget to pay the bills! Jump in your car and enjoy the fun.

title: Lumione
description: Lumione is a platformer game set in a deep-sea universe. Join the protagonist Glimmer on a journey in search of the Light as you put your wit to the test in solving challenging puzzle-like levels. Learn from your failures and restore the Light of Hope to the seabed.

title: Ball Partner
description: turn-based marbles battle game。Go to all corners of the game to find various monsters, become partners with them, train them, challenge the competition and win the championship together.

title: Galactic Pick Up Artist
description: A dating-sim that augments your real life dating skills! Become the commander of a small science vessel, and meet the girls aboard your ship, all while training real life social skills. Can it get any better? Oh yes, it can. There’s Nudity (obviously).

title: Blackhole Simulator
description: Enter the life of a small black hole at the center of the smallest galaxy. What you seek is to become the legendary super black hole.

title: Little Adventure
description: Little Adventure is a 2D platformer adventure game with beautiful graphics. You have to play as an assistant to the blacksmith named Ben and, together with the blacksmith, go to the castle to the king to give the legendary sword! Immerse yourself in a fantasy world full of danger and adventure!

title: Planta
description: Planta is a third-person open-world survival game with a procedurally generated terrain. It means the map is endless and expands while exploration! Planta throws you into an unrepeatable adventure in which you focus on gathering resources, building your base, exploring the world and... surviving!

title: Top Billiards
description: A billiard game for one players

title: Mr.Bottle and His Dream
description: Mr. Bottle lives in a small wine cellar. Perhaps unwilling to be ordinary, or perhaps his heart longing something, he decides to depart and seek a dream of his own. It's a retro cross-board physics indie game with a single player storyline and a multiplayer racing mode.

title: Puzzles with Cats
description: Puzzles with Cats is a classic puzzle that invites you to put together a picture from a huge amount of details!

title: Cat Way Domino
description: Find a new way to play Domino, helping a cat going trough different paths, finding the best domino pieces combination to keep the cat alive, in a relaxing ambience

title: Once Upon a Jester
description:
Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!

They embark on a grand adventure across a fantasy kingdom, meeting tons of wacky characters, performing improvised shows and singing their hearts out. Along the way, they unintentionally discover the freedom and joy of musical theatre. Will the pair change their wicked ways or do whatever it takes to get rich?

title: Honour Runs
description: Compete in the Honour Runs. A visceral, retro inspired, twin stick, score challenge contest.

title: Doodle God Universe
description: Doodle God is an addicting puzzle & world building game where players use logic and ingenuity to create the entire universe. Starting with the basic elements of earth, wind, fire and air players can build a world filled with locomotives, Dragons, skyscrapers, Aliens and more.

title: Defender of Kuiper Belt
description: Fight against alien invaders with your powerful spaceship. This is a bullet hell game which puts your dodging skills to a true test.

title: Dark Frame
description: Simple platformer in a dark setting

title: Stuck Together
description: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner. Failure is always one slip away.

title: Chacal
description: Run, hit, and dodge bullets with Chacal! From the southern reaches to the capital of Argentina, achieve the best Score, and defeat the evil President Francisco to free the nation from his subjugation!

title: Three of Cards
description: Three Cards is a movie-like noir card action game. The magician has a horrible relationship with insurance company A. Help the magician to take revenge on the key characters who have plunged him into hell, and shed light on his path. Because the process will be very dark and terrible.

title: FarRock Dodgeball
description: FarRock Dodgeball is a dodgeball game where you play as kids from NYC that travel around the city for a dodgeball tournament. Includes a story mode with RPG elements, Arcade mode and VS mode up to 4 players.

title: Retro Machina: Nucleonics
description: Retro Machina is a single-player action and exploration game set in a retro-futuristic universe. Experience the journey of a little robot as they solve intricate puzzles and begin unraveling the mysteries of a world long forgotten.

title: Hodl Simulator
description: Ape investors have to know when to hodl them, and know when the fodl them. But with the dark potassium pool manipulation of Monkeydel investments, this is becoming harder and harder each day. This corrupt corporation makes their living by crashing honest banana companies the only solution to HODL!

title: Maelstrom: A Yaoi Visual Novel
description: Disgraced soldier Demetri is exiled to Secren, a dangerous world devoid of women. Earthlings are smaller and weaker than the violent men of Secren. Demetri's only hope for survival is to bond with a strong mate who can love and protect him. The heterosexual Italian-American is reluctant.

title: The Fire
description: The Fire is a difficult 3D platformer in a world that grows around you.

title: Doomed Lands
description: Doomed Lands is a survival game where the protagonist must collect, build, mine, face enemies, bosses and survive a doomed land.

title: Adventure Bit
description: Jump, run, steal, fight, catch, and solve puzzles in this minimal-style adventure inspired by the golden age of the Japanese computer MSX!

title: Tafl Champions: Ancient Chess
description: Play Tafl Champions, an ancient form of chess dating all the way back to the Vikings! Capture the defender's king while they guide him to escape the battlefield and to freedom. Challenge your enemies, customise your shield, play on multiple platforms and become the ultimate Tafl Champion!

title: Abyss of Death
description: Abyss of Death is an action game set in Vietnam War. As a lost soldier destroy buildings, smash bunches of enemies and get out of this hell on your own or with a friend.

title: BRDG
description: BRDG is a puzzle game about pushing blocks and making bridges.

title: The Old West Savior
description: In this game you play as the sheriff in a beautiful pixel art world, save the town and all the old west from the bandits and become The Old West Savior!

title: Beta Escape
description: Escape room inspired game. Solve puzzles, alone or with your friend, just like in your favorite escape room!

title: Socialism Simulator
description: The civil war is over. To the rapturous cheers of the crowd, you and four of your companions take control of the country. The young socialist state proudly raises its flags, its eyes fixed on a distant, bright future.

title: A Snake in a Maze
description: A Snake in A Maze is a Sokoban and Snake inspired puzzle game. You play a venturous snake that travels around the world hunting for treasures.

title: GrappleShot
description: GrappleShot is a fast-paced movement FPS about using a grappling gun used to swing around the map and gain lots of speed. Depending on the class you pick, you can have an assault rifle, shotgun, or sniper rifle, each with its own strengths and weaknesses.

title: Do you have Akira points?
description:
My childhood friend suddenly came to stay at my room.
Wait, are you a woman!?

I'm at least humane enough to let you stay here for a while if you have nowhere to sleep.
Huh? You're giving me "AKIRA Point" as a token of gratitude?
OK, so what type of bonus will I get when I earn the point enough?

---- Yeah, I like the bonus.

title: StarBall
description: 2-on-2 basketball in zero gravity. Pass, shoot, block, and save in an arena where no direction is up or down! Hone your skills against the AI championship league in career mode, then compete online solo or with a teammate. Starball is the sport of tomorrow.

title: My Time Alive
description: In 2023, industry leading pharmaceutical company "HT Pharmaceuticals" found the complete cure for COVID-19, and they released the vaccine to the public. 9 months later, not much is left of mankind. Complete supply missions and conduct research studies to help find the cure to the infection.

title: Artifact Foundry
description: Artifact Foundry, a special edition of Artifact, the DOTA2 card game, with streamlined gameplay, new cards, new single-player content, and an improved new player experience.

title: The Remainder: The Complete Edition
description: The Remainder is a dark fantasy story made of psychological puzzles, romance, and the unexpected. The Complete Edition contains acts 1 to 4!

title: Train Simulator: LMS Stanier Mogul Steam Loco Add-On
description: Featuring a 2-6-0 wheel configuration and design elements from the GWR, Stanier's Mogul Class was a fleet of 40 strong and a key player for the railway's passenger and freight services, and thanks to the efforts of Bossman Games, it can be experienced authentically in Train Simulator.

title: Tiger Tank 59 I: Rainstorm MP066
