OLD TOWER is programmed with KickAsm after a six years break. It's FREE or pay what your want.

Download contains PRG+TAP file.

Have Fun!

title: Grand Theft Auto: Rio de Janeiro
description:
GTA: Rio de Janeiro is a mod of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. There are many different versions of the mod, by different people, but all of them try to change the aesthetics of the game (cars, ads, music and others) to new ones based on Rio de Janeiro, a Brazilian city known for being a tourism destination (and also for elevated crime rates). Some version of the mod also change the layout of the city for a new one resembling the Brazilian city.
This mod and it's variants were very popular in Brazil, where it was sold in parallel shops as a pirate game.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Brasil
description: Grand Theft Auto: Brasil is a mod of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas which changes everything in the game to match with the Brazilian theme. The city is changed to the city of Santos (which is located in the State of São Paulo).

title: Klondike: The Lost Expedition
description: Klondike: The Lost Expedition is an online farming simulation game with a strong economic component.

title: Eternal Cave Escape
description: Eternal Cave Escape is a precision-platformer that challenges players to climb their way out of a cave using a pickaxe. Mistakes in this cave cost the player time rather than lives, as all progress can be lost through falling. Will you rise out of this seemingly endless cave, or will you be stuck here forever?

title: ScrewUp
description: ScrewUp is a survival game where the player has to survive on a deserted island that nobody knows it’s name. There are many things that wait to be explored.

title: The Wratch's Den
description:
Dig out a proper dungeon, grow your little villainous society, set up defences against heroes, and survive long enough to retrieve the Orbs of Infinite Power.

The Wratch has been defeated, they have gone into hiding with the pitiful remains of their army. Now it's up to you to dig out a proper base for The Wratch. You'll have to defend them against the heartless heroes come for easy prestige, and retrieve the 3 legendary Orbs of Infinite Power in order to come back out of the Den and crush human society once and for all.

title: Is It Wrong to Try to Shoot 'em Up Girls in a Dungeon?
description: This mini-game was once a DLC add-on for the game "Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combate" but it is now available as a stand-alone release on PC (Steam) and Nintendo Switch. You play as Aiz Wallenstein and can choose from five other characters to accompany you. The game has no extra modes but does feature four difficulty options.

title: Moonwave Overdrive
description: Explore the neon-lit streets of Eyre City while on the job at the Moonwave Cruiser Company. Accept contracts and fight for survival as an underworld courier in this Retro-futuristic 80s-inspired Australian Megapolis.

title: Check x Mate
description: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

title: Dystopicon
description:
In Dystopicon the players will live in a dystopian society in which they receive money in exchange to watch TV. With that money they pay services to cover their basic needs. Throughout the game they will discover the details of this dystopia in which the government monitors your movements but gives you freedom of choice.

The story will be told through gameplay, texts and comics. Take your time to explore the different objects and the mechanics in your first day.

title: Titan Tactics
description: Created in one month for the 32-bit Jam, plus an extra 3 weeks for the Spring Cleaning Jam! A follow up to Pocket Tactics, Titan Tactics is inspired by the awesome tactic games of the 90s. Fight with your allies and uncover the mysteries of the kingdoms of Tyrmyr and Skathi!

title: PiColumns
description: PiColumns is a port of the classic puzzle game Columns to Pico-8.

title: Repurpose
description: You and several others have passed away. You have three options: either take the trials to earn your place in Heaven, live it up in Hell, or remain lost in Limbo for the rest of eternity. Repurpose is an LGBT+ positive dating sim about death, love, and finding your purpose.

title: Fallumns
description:
For Ludum Dare 48 Jam

I've always felt the Match-3 genre had the most depth! Wouldn't you agree?

Z and X rotate, Esc or ENTER pause. press Ctrl+Y to change controls.

title: Come Back Home Please
description: Trapped in an innocent 2D world trying to figure out what's going on by your own decisions! Prepare for one of the hardest and most frustrating game you've ever experienced. Play "Come Back Home Please" and unveil the dark truth.

title: Moons of Ardan
description: Moons of Ardan is a captivating city-building game set in space that allows players to rebuild and expand their civilization across the moons in a living planetary system.

title: Gefragt Gejagt
description: In Gefragt Gejagt, players have the opportunity to test their knowledge. Team up with friends to compete about the title of the smartest person. Be the hunter or become the hunted.

title: Obsideo
description: Obsideo is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror, where you and your team of priests explore different locations experiencing paranormal events in an attempt to figure out what ghost they're dealing with and exorcise it from the property.

title: Rolling Adventure
description:
Drive with precision, jump and speed up your way on this exiting conveyor-belt platformer. Explore with care and close attention, the handcrafted puzzles filled with the hardest challenges.

Rolling adventure is a *VERY HARD* highly-addictive hard-core tight platformer with a unique twist, you drive over a conveyor belt with a beautiful procedurally generated environment.

title: Overheat
description: Ascend the White Columns and dismantle the corrupted Bureau as a synthetic human in a fast-paced, brutal action beat 'em up adventure. Wield the power of Hybrith, a mysterious bio-matter that weaves the host into a walking arsenal. Burn through your foes through a vast selection of weapon styles.

title: Fantastic Fortune
description: Fantastic Fortune is a romance simulation game.

title: Fantastic Fortune 2
description: Fantastic Fortune 2 is a romance simulation game. In this otome game the protagonist is one of the three female characters: Aoi (16-year old priestess summoned from another world), Marine (15), or Aqua (13-year old with a memory loss). The story takes place in a fantasy setting and it unfolds during a seven month training period where you try to become a "Daughter of Star".

title: The Saddle Club: Willowbrook Stables
description:
The most exciting Saddle Club adventure yet might also be the most difficult and this time you won't have the rest of the Saddle Club to help you.
If you solve all the clues, you'll uncover secrets that have remained hidden on Coventry Island for decades. You will have to be careful, though, as others are trying to solve the mystery, too–people who will stop at nothing to do so. If someone beats you, Willowbrook Stables will be lost forever.

title: Instant Farmer
description: A country life, growing a vegetable garden in your own ranch. In this tiny fantasy countryside experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing. Just keep in mind: water brings life. Swap the blocks of earth, stone, water, and others, like water channels and lawn sprinklers, so that all the arable soil receives the necessary water. Solve the challenge and feel the pleasure of watching the plants instantly grow and bear fruit. There is no time limit or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack and animal sounds. Figuring out the patterns of blocks will make it easier to solve the puzzles. As you progress solving the challenges, see your farm expand and evolve in the background with new types of vegetables. With clean skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among birds and listening to the sounds of nature.

title: Rush Rally Origins
description: Rush Rally Origins combines the classic top down racing action from the original Rush Rally with the highly praised graphics and physics from Rush Rally 3. Take on 36 new and unique stages across the world, each with the ability to change the time of day and weather. Drive over many challenging surface types including snow, gravel, dirt, mud and tarmac!

title: Super Hiking League DX
description: Who's the best 2D platformer in the world? Find out in the League! Join Nelson in the Super Hiking League! An evil wizard is making the mountains disappear in a plan to make the world perfectly flat! As a member of the Super Hiking League you will not let this happen. Compete in climbing matches against other Hikers to collect all magic gems and stop his plans! Super Hiking League provides tight jump-rope-bend-swing-win gameplay with beautiful 8-bit+ graphics and a top notch authentic 8-bit soundtrack!

title: Sudoku Classic
description: It's a game, but you can play it as if you were writing with a pen on a piece of paper. You can customize the assist function to your liking.

title: Custom Machinery
description: Custom Machinery is a block based building game in which you can build vehicles and other machines, configure their parts and use them.

title: Ubirajara
description: Come discover a world full of Brazilian cultural personalities, with several exclusive powers to be used strategically, play win and try to be the best by entering the world rank!

title: Rescuer
description: Ryan is a former military man who receives a job offer as a private security guard, when he arrives in Rutianland, Ryan realizes that there is something wrong, everyone is the same, as if they were robots.

title: Larry the Unlucky: Part 1
description: Follow Larry's life to find the source of his lack of luck. Discover his intriguing story and solve puzzles to understand how his life plays out.

title: Life Can Be Amazing
description: “Life Can Be Amazing” is an uplifting Yuri Romantic Comedy Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Play as this seasoned chef as she seeks to rediscover her culinary talent and inspiration by taking a trip down to the Caribbean.

title: Razenroth 2
description: Razenroth 2 is a dark action game with RPG and roguelike elements. Enter a randomly generated world of nightmares and fight with an army of dangerous monsters.

title: Marble Parkour 2: Roll and Roll
description: Sequel to marble parkour. Roll more and avoid new traps and play different minigames

title: Fear Protocol: Shadow Paradigm
description: It's another nice dark day in Escondido, California and special agent Jack Banger goes from out of the frying pan and into the fire. The disgusting biomonster creatures are continuing to terrorize the city and there's only so much time before the plague spreads across the nation.

title: Orbital Defence Command
description: A third person arcade shooter set in orbit above earth. Craft and find puzzle blocks to liberate captured alien continents. Defend yourself and your blocks from constant alien attacks and avoid a variety of obstacles and disasters. Watch out for the enemy bosses when you liberate a continent!

title: Pop This Pop-It
description: Pop this Pop-It is a 2d pop-it, relaxing game where you pop bubbles, get bonuses and accumulate successful roles.

title: DarkFighter
description: Chaos wakes up from the darkness and erodes Hades of hell. Hades opens the door of hell, and the devil and chaos of hell come to the world. Chaos erodes the earth, and the gods who can fight against chaos are missing. Only the sun goddess and the God of love protect human beings against Hades.

title: Armada
description: Play as a slimebabe on her quest to face her nemesis, Armada.

title: Trashyard
description: Trashyard is a multiplayer third-person shooter in which, on eight different maps, fierce battles are fought for themselves, choosing a character with unique abilities. Choose yourself who you are - a police officer with a super fart, a cursing Russian robot, or a sexy anime girl.

title: Star Shift Origins
description: Star Shift Origins tells the story of the first Crew of the Dauntless. Trapped in an alternate reality and on the run, the crew desperately searches for answers while being hunted by the relentless Earth Systems Alliance (ESA).

title: Undying Symphony
description: «Undying Symphony» tells a story about challenges that Leningrad people faced during the Siege and shows us one of the most tragic episodes of Leningrad history

title: Cube Space
description: Cube Space is a minimalist arcade Shoot `em Up game set in space. You control a spaceship and your task is to score as many points as possible by destroying enemies and obstacles in your path.

title: God of the Arena Dungeon
description: Destroy arena vermin, level up, choose your class path, get loot, and slay other players. Destroy the bosses of the arena without being slain, and perhaps your ascent into arena God-hood will be recorded into legend!

title: Liber
description: We all dreamed of adventures full of mysteries and mysticism, dreamed of finding ourselves in unusual situations and emerging from them as a hero. Solve riddles, fight enemies, fight adversity and help the main character Alex unravel the hidden meanings of Liber.

title: Missing Love
description: In the early 2000s Somewhere in America, There is a serial killer who calls himself the Love Killer who likes to murder any couple indiscriminately For five years, you'll play Elijah Sanders, a private investigator whose partner is Lieutenant Anthony Williams. victim woman named Kate Hernandez.

title: They're Coming
description: They're Coming is a single-player survival horror game designed to immerse thrill seekers into the Asylum which is haunted by the undead.

title: Conundrum
description: This game plunges you into a mysterious and challenging arms warehouse.

title: Thief Shop
description: Steal from your friends in order to become the richest merchant in the market. Play online and offline in 4-player versus mayhem!

title: Find Objects
description: Are you ready to test your eyes with Find Objects, Your seek and find skills will be challenged like never before. Develops your secret seeker skill to find object. This is a puzzle game similar to Hidden Object games, in which you have to find the objects while the clock is ticking.

title: Our Personal Space
description: A visual novel where your choices determine the future of your relationship and the success of your colony. Choose how to treat your husband and how to spend your free time in this frontier sci-fi story.

title: Island of Girls Dreams
description: Island of Girls Dreams is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls. The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Descent: Legends of the Dark
description: To play the Descent: Legends of the Dark board game, one player must download the free Descent: Legends of the Dark app on a compatible device. This companion app determines the setup of each quest, tracks your party’s inventory, skills, progress, and resolves combat while telling a narrative story.

title: Infinity Tempest
description: You must help the three heroes to flee from their pursuers in an endless race for the survival of humanity.

title: Blood Spear
description:
Blood Spear is a student game which won the first prize of the jury at ISART Digital Montréal in 2021.

Blood Spear is a unique ranged action-adventure game in which you play as a demonic spear. Emerging from a deep slumber, you are thirsty for blood. Throw with precision to impale and defeat powerful foes inside grandiose environments where a long-coveted power lies.

title: Simple Fish Adventure
description: Simple Fish Adventure is a challenging physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer. Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Lihue
description: Lihue is a narrative adventure that takes place in the dream of a 26-year-old trans girl. Through her memories you will know her deepest desires and fears. Explore the landscapes of her mind to discover the reasons that led her to undertake this journey into the dream world.

title: SuperSecret
description: SuperSecret is a tiny 3rd-person adventure where you run around, meet a couple of weirdos, solve a puzzle, and do cool stuff. You like cool stuff, don't you? I think maybe you like cool stuff.

title: Unholy Alliance: Tower Defense
description:
Enemies from this world and the dark world fight together in an “Unholy Alliance” to destroy your Extractors. Get ready to stand your ground and defeat enemy hordes using a vast arsenal of towers and special powers at your command.

Fight on forests and wastelands, customizing your defensive strategy with different tower, special power, and Extractor upgrades and specializations! Bring your enemies death from above, send them moving backwards using Wind, place Mines in their way, block their way with a Decoy, or even Freeze them.

title: Church of Stratum
description: Church of Stratum is a First-person Horror-like exploration game about investigating the now abandoned bunker of a religious cult. Solve puzzles and interact with the world using physics.

title: Infinite Lagrange
description: Infinite Lagrange puts you at the head of a galactic fleet and lets you travel through uncharted space. You’ll use stargates to hop from area to area, coming across lost cities and alien fleets from friends and foes alike. You’ll start off with three to five ships, but once you construct a spaceport and upgrade your tech, you’ll be able to expand your fleet considerably. You can also design a plethora of different ships for your varying needs, from constructing frigates for cargo to forging battlecruisers to defend yourself.

title: Untangle
description: Untangle is developed by UnityGameEngine, it is a first-person, single-player, school-violent-themed survival horror game. Though it's not a game based on a true story, it is built on an intention to raise awareness of school violence at the same time when you're playing a game.

title: Arena 54: Visual Novel Action Adventure
description: Arena 54 - Visual Novel Action Adventure is a story-driven RPG that brings the universe together in an epic war for the Crystal. Save the planet Earth simply by making the right choices. Choose wisely, or the Crystal will be lost in Doom Hammer’s hands.

title: G-Mode Archives 15: Chura-jima Kurashi
description:
Where there is sky and sea, there is a story. Experience the "slow life" of your dreams on a southern island!

It is a game where you can simulate life on the fictional island "Churajima" reminiscent of a remote island in Okinawa.

"I want to be wrapped in the pleasant sound of waves and look at the wide sky on the sandy beach ..."
Such a longing "slow life" is waiting for you.

Interact with village residents and tourists, sea fishing, shamisen, hub extermination, Okinawan cuisine, etc.
You are free to enjoy the activities unique to the southern island and do anything.
You can walk around the island and have various experiences.

Why don't you relax in "Chura Island" with the main character who moved because he was tired of living in the city?

title: VR Dance Star
description: This is a leisure and entertainment game with dance and diy as the theme.

title: Reflections of Life: Meridiem - Collector's Edition
description: Fate hangs in the balance!

title: On the Earth Shift
description: An alien game about earth, good vibes, and binary decisions.

title: Untitled Video Game
description: 'Video game' parody game filled with funny cliches, stereotype characters and nonsense that we're used to seeing in games.

title: Meridian 157: Chapter 2
description: Trapped deep underground on a lost and forgotten island, David’s priority shifts from finding answers about the mystery surrounding him, to surviving the crisis he now finds himself trapped in. It’s now up to you to find an escape from the 157th meridian, but be warned, as escape may not be so easy

title: Meridian 157: Chapter 3
description: You have ventured this far, now there is no turning back. Uncover the island’s dark history by travelling through crumbling caverns and mysterious laboratories, but be warned, some may not be too welcoming of your presence…

title: Game of Love
description: Alice thought high school would just be an easy ride. But when she suddenly becomes very popular, the drama begins. Threats first. It always starts with threats... but what comes next?

title: Tekken 7: Zafina
description: Zafina, a deadly assassin from ancient times, joins the fray! Track down and defeat those whose veins course with devil's blood in order to stop the revival of Azazel!

title: Tekken 7: Leroy Smith
description: The Wing Chun master Leroy Smith joins the fray! Toy with your opponent using a mix of offensive and defensive moves, then overwhelm them with a quick flurry of attacks!

title: Tekken 7: Fahkumram
description: An add-on for Tekken 7 that grants use of the character "Fahkumram". The nation-wide hero from Thailand, Fahkumram joins the fray with his powerful Muay Thai style fighting! Break through your opponent's guard with his overpowering reach combined with a violent array of attacks!

title: Tekken 7: Frame Data Display
description: View frame data using one of two different modes: "Simple Display" and "Detailed Display." The feature is available in Practice Mode, Warm-Up Mode (while waiting to join an online match), within online player matches, and while spectating tournaments.

title: Tekken 7: Cave of Enlightenment
description: A mysterious buddhist temple set deep within a cave. This stage is chocked full of unique gimicks consisting of balcony breaks, floor breaks, and more!

title: Tekken 7: Lidia Sobieska
description: The Polish prime minister Lidia Sobieska joins the fray! Fight to protect her people using her karate techniques! Osu!

title: Armello: The Dragon Clan
description: Join the insidious band of scaled heroes in their journey to reclaim their birthright, Armello's throne. The Dragon Clan, Armello's second Clan DLC, features four new playable Heroes, a brand new Dragon-exclusive Quest system, a complete Dragon Clan Novella, Dragon Dice, six new Signets, and a new Amulet!

title: Armello: The Bandit Clan
description: Fight for glory as the infamous Bandit Clan in Armello's first Clan DLC! The Bandit Clan DLC features four new playable Heroes, over 50 unique Bandit quests, Bandit Dice, a new Bandit Clan Ring, and a bunch more goodies!

title: Party Crasher Simulator
description: Join the wildest party of the year! If crashing parties is your greatest passion, then this game is definitely for you. Step into the shoes of a young man who has no mercy for party people and become famous as the King of Party Crashing!

title: Wildlife Park 2: Domestic Animals
description: Domestic Animal-Package: New cute pets, which you can mind, will play inside your zoo. Highlind and norwich terrier, old german sheep dog, european domestic animal and carthusian looking forward for a new home!

title: Realms of Antiquity: The Shattered Crown
description: A retro-CRPG for the TI-99/4a home computer, also playable in modern Windows.

title: Caveman
description: caveman is a side view runner, you play as a caveman running away from a dangerous predator.

title: Star Realms: Heroes
description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 6th chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Command Decks
description: This expansion allows you to play as a legendary commander in the Star Realms universe! Each of these 7 decks replaces a player's normal starting deck, and modifies the player's starting Authority and hand size. This expansion also adds Chapter 22 to the ongoing single-player campaign.

title: Star Realms: Fleets and Fortresses
description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 8th Chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: United - Heroes
description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 14th chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Frontiers
description: This standalone expansion contains 45 new cards. Use these cards in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 17th and 18th chapters of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Cosmic Gambit
description: The expansion contains 19 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 11th and 12th chapters of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Bases and Battleships
description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 5th Chapter of the campaign.

description: This expansion contains 8 new multi-faction cards. Use these cards in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 19th chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Frontiers Promos
description: Star Realms - Frontiers Promos adds 17 new ship and base cards to your Trade Deck. Use these cards in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 21st chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Frontiers Events
description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 20th chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: Colony Wars
description: This standalone expansion contains 120 new cards (43 unique). Use these cards in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 9th and 10th chapter of the campaign.

description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 15th Chapter of the campaign.

description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 13th Chapter of the campaign.

title: Star Realms: United - Missions
description: This expansion contains 12 cards that you can use in online play, versus the AI or a friend, or in the 16th chapter of the campaign.

title: Escape From Monster
description: You woke up in a dark room in an unknown place, can't remembering how you ended up here. You have an empty pockets, and the sounds from SOMETHING are heard outside the door. Try to solve the secrets of the Dark House and ESCAPE from the unknown MONSTER.

title: Freezer Pops
description: Freezer Pops is a bara visual novel where you play as a game developer in Brazil trying to pay the house rent. Walk around the neighborhood and the beach, Meet datable guys, Get Ready for COMPETITION! Can you beat an old lady who has a freeze pops family empire? Which of the boys will help you?!

title: Nominal
description: Take command of a highly detailed, alternate-history, 1960's spacecraft facing a series of fatal failures. Your friends, Mission Control, have the ship manual. You must work together to bring the ship back to a NOMINAL state before the mission, and possibly your life, is lost!

title: Stalked
description: It's a late night and you're returning home from work , you will face your worst nightmares ,Weird things happening and getting chased by a stalker.Will you escape your home and find out what's happening or just die ?

title: Ninja Stealth 4
description: Ninja Stealth IV is a new challenge for you. Be stealth, evade from lasers, cameras, motion detectors and security guards. Collect all computers to beat the game.

title: Show do Milhão 2006
description:
WILL YOU ACCEPT THE CHALLENGE?

All the emotions of the television program Show do Milhão from SBT, with Silvio Santos are in this game, now with more than 20.000 questions. In this new 2006 edition you can play with up to 8 players on the same computer, or if you prefer you can play online, against real opponents over the internet, increasing your sense of competition, and trying to reach the highest scores in the Show do Milhão Hall of Fame.

title: Tanklike
description: Tanklike is a cooperative 2D shooter for 1 - 4 players. Improve your stats, upgrade your arsenal, and ricochet your way to victory!

title: XSection
description: Put your perception of shape to the test! Can you identify which of the objects presented to you creates the outline on screen? Get ready for an all new brain exercise!

title: Dusk of the wasteland age

This already war-torn country has recently been befallen by a mighty set of catastrophes. Your unlikely protagonist, a member of the weak Ruby tribe, turned out to be one of a few survivors of the last cataclysm, a giant avalanche. Your initial personal mission quickly turns into the ultimate search for truth - a search that requires you to climb the fabled grand summit.

Your journey begins when you wake up in a mysterious cave. Struck by the blow of a giant avalanche you and your fellow miners have been washed away into the darkness. You must climb out of this crevasse and head to Pinetown - the once great village at the very foot of the Mountain. There might be your only chance to gather the strength, the gear and the knowledge to begin your ascent of the unknown. Your destination - the Summit - is clear, but the way there is as treacherous as it is fabulous.

Along your way you will stumble upon characters of all tribes, foreigners and natives to the mountain. You will find climbing equipment that will be essential for your progression - an icepick, a rope and grappling hook, a parachute and many more. You will also encounter great obstacles, mysteries and enemies which will make your journey even more epic.

This game combines the joy of exploring a large interconnected world with fluid and unique platforming and engaging puzzles.

description: First person view. Stat-heavy RPG. Original title.

description: Do you think Queen's Gambit is a TV series, comrade? WRONG! It is a Chess opening! If you don't even know that, you have a lot to learn! A good chess player should know the chess openings and, more important, how to avoid their traps! Enroll NOW and find out how!

title: Chessmates

description: Activate SUPERPOWERS – in this sports game you can add fireballs, vanishing balls, superspeed, blocks, and many others to your arsenal – play now and discover them for yourself! Develop your player's SKILLS – raise your stats across categories such as serve power and strength, stamina, or attack! You will have a bundle of additional outfits to choose from as well as bags with super contents to open – as long as you win matches! Make your opponents tremble at the sight of your player! Volleyball will never be the same – play Volleyball Challenge and be part of the sports revolution!

title: Adventure Field 4
description: Several years after Atoa defeated his evil self, Eras, and Marok took their place as leaders of the Sarook Kingdom. Atoa defeated the evil that was born from within him but a greater danger is now looming upon Sarook kingdom... The direct sequel to Adventure Field 3... Adventure Field 4 is a 20 hour, semi open-world, turn-based JRPG. Battle monsters, complete quests and save Sarook Kingdom! In this game you will have to fight your way through dungeons and powerful enemies to try gathering souls gems. Between the fighting and the exploration, you can cook and grow some vegetables, discover hidden mysteries hidden within the night and day system, try to find what people need to finish side quests and find many collectibles and secrets along the way! In Adventure Field 4, you can forget the old way of getting gold and items. You will need to find a variety of chests to open at your local chest opener! Having some difficulty with particular enemies in combat? Ask your royal team mate, Eserod! He will tell you about monsters strengths and weakness! You will need his help for sure... Dark hours are coming again to Sarook Kingdom... The Kingdom can feel the burning souls of the calamity... The Kingdom will fall again... But not if you can save it!...

Casa dos Artistas is a simulation game based on the reality show by the same name, developed by Green Land Games and published by Cia. do Software in collaboration with SBT.
Choose your character, define your personal traits such as character, stamina, enthusiasm, hygiene, libido, and charisma, and enter the competition! You must win over the participants and the public, trying to stay in the House until the grand finale. To do so, date, flirt, fight, talk, act, sing, dance, do everything to please everyone, use all your imagination to win the grand final prize.

title: Vampiromania: O Game

Vampiromania is a game that mixes action and role-playing, where the player controls 3 characters individually - Teodor, Petru and Ecaterina - who possess different characteristics. Teodor is a strong man who fights with his hands and protects the group with his shield. Petru, the boy, uses his sling to attack the enemies and Ecaterina is a fast woman with good kicking abilities.

The objective of the group is to find the terrible Vlad Tepes and to destroy him. Three types of different enemy creatures exist during the game: vampires, buzz and ghosts.

Doki Doki Gravity Dive is a Score Attack Shoot 'em Up with tiny solar systems as your playground which are populated with tiny worlds and a singularity at their center.

Enemies relentlessly invade and it is up to you to keep them at bay. At least for as long as you can!

Each celestial body has its own gravitational pull and to stand even the slightest chance to survive the never ending onslaught, you have to adapt to changes in gravity quickly and throw concepts like up and down out the window!

So hop, fly, dodge, shoot and (hopefully) have fun!

Bitgun is a top-down shooter with a lot of blood and zombies. Burn zombies with a flamethrower, shoot them in the face with a sniper rifle, or go berserk with a shotgun!

Make sure you bring enough guns because they will break quickly while you go on missions and kill hordes of zombies. You will be dodging zombies that are crawling out of the ground and jumping at you. If you die while fighting your way towards the zombie boss you will lose all your gear.

Are your NERF skills up to the challenge to become the ultimate NERF Legend?

Extreme Games Meet NERF set in out-of-this world locations such as Fortress Siege, Jungle Trouble, ragnarok, and Spaceport Blastoff.

15 Authentic NERF Blasters across the Mega, Ultra and Elite lines. Plus upgradable perks and skins to customize your blaster.

19 Single player levels with tournament courses.

4 vs 4, 8 player free for all with online multiplayer modes.

Collect dart powerups such as magnetic push and pull, seeker darts and freeze to change the tide of battles.

description: Yummy mahjong is a game for fans of the mahjong connect genre. Collect identical pairs of goodies to clear the playing field and go to the next level.

It starts out a small collection of Estates and Coppers, but you hope that by the end of the game it will be brimming with Gold, Provinces, and the inhabitants of your kingdom.

Your goal is to clear tiles and get the gold chests hidden underground. Assemble crystals of the same color into chains - the more you collect, the bigger the explosion! Test your puzzle skills today!

It's a solo campaign, but you'll never be alone - beware of the demons, they are everywhere and they want to see you dead. You’ll have the chance to visit many unique locations, fight powerful monsters, avoid traps, and fight bosses! Investigate the source of the radio signal in an old castle on Neo Valkyria, discover the secrets of a suspicious-looking laboratory, explore Alien World with its intriguing wildlife and try not to die in flames while on a mission in Lava Cave. There are all sorts of beverages for you to acquire and every single one of them has its own unique power. Protect yourself, slow your enemies, become incredibly powerful and even visit other dimensions, but be careful... the drinks may be toxic! Some of them can make you feel a little fuzzy. Do you often feel nostalgic? Check out the "old-school" mode, which will take you on a journey through the pixelated version of the game! Get a taste of the good, old days! Spend hours tearing up any demon who stands in your way! Watch the blood spurt everywhere and leave the pile of corpses in your wake!

Pre-Fortress 2 is a TF2 sourcemod that caters to the gameplay of earlier Team Fortress installments while maintaining the aesthetics from TF2's alternative designs from 2006.

Grenades, armor, and cut content are all back to create a nostalgic Team Fortress experience! Visit the reimagined world of classic maps such as Crossover and more!

HUNDREDS OF WELL DESIGNED LEVELS

Use lights, lenses and mirrors to solve a variety of easy to hard levels. lumen. is family friendly and suitable for players of all ages and created by Lykke Studios who also brought you Apple Arcade hits like the puzzle 'tint.'

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER

The game is easy to pick up and play at any time for either short or long sessions on any Apple device with cross functionality game saves.

BEAUTIFUL GRAPHICS, MUSIC & SOUND EFFECTS

title: Nihilo
description:
Estes was just fourteen years old and dealing with the loss of his father when The Calamity occurred. Objects of unknown origin had struck near Ignarosa, the capital of Autenon, with the force so great the dust blotted the sky out and led to three months of freezing and unrelenting snow. People died of cold and starvation, and only a few isolated enclaves lived to see the Months of Blizzard end as suddenly as they started. During this time, many plants and animals were also decimated or driven to extinction. In their place, new and dangerous creatures to fill the void, many with a mysterious link to The Calamity itself...

Ten years later, Estes and his friend Nikolai are sent out from their home town of Jupa to make contact with survivors further north, and learn what they know of Calamity. Estes also hopes to see Makal, his formerly beautiful birthplace, while Nikolai is searching for the man who betrayed his father. Dodgems or Bumper Cars will always be remembered as one of the longest running and most successful attractions in the amusement industry. No other ride can compete with Dodgems when it comes to family fun and entertainment. Bumper-to-bumper traffic never been this fun – or bumpy! Grab all your friends and family for fantastic fun on our classic Dodgems simulator game. Step into the dodgem arena, take control of your own dodgem car, and race around as you try to avoid the chaos! Jump into one of 16 cars, put your foot on the accelerator, and try to eliminate your rivals! But watch out for the guy behind you; he has a wild look in his eye!

title: Minecraft Dungeons: Ultimate Edition
description: Experience the complete story of Minecraft Dungeons from the beginning to the End! Minecraft Dungeons: Ultimate Edition includes the base game and all six DLCs.

title: Wreckfest: Complete Edition
description: Wreckfest: Complete Edition is an expanded version of the original Wreckfest game developed by Bugbear Entertainment. This edition includes the base game along with Season Pass and Season Pass 2, which were released after the launch. These DLCs add a significant amount of content, including 32 new cars, 20 new roof decorations, and customisation packs

title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The year is now 2029, and the golden era of augmentations is over. Mechanically augmented humans have been deemed outcasts and segregated from the rest of society. Crime and acts of terror serve as a thin veil to cover up an overarching conspiracy aimed at controlling the future of mankind…

This edition includes the game itself, along with all of the items listed below:
- Season Pass
- Extra in-game Mission
- Covert Agent Pack

title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War - Outlaw Tribe Nemesis
description:
The Outlaw Tribe Nemesis Expansion includes:

• Thousands of NEW Nemesis System enemies, followers & stories
• NEW Orc Weapons, fatalities and brutalities
• NEW Fortress, Outpost and Wilderness gameplay
• NEW Legendary Gear Set for the Bright Lord

title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War - Desolation of Mordor
description:
The Desolation of Mordor Story Expansion includes:

• NEW Story campaign
• NEW Side missions featuring Torvin
• NEW Human Mercenaries and Bodyguards
• NEW Region of Mordor - The Desert of Lithlad
• NEW Beasts: Were-wyrms

title: Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Edition
description:
The Stranger Things Edition of Dead by Daylight includes all the content of the Special Edition, three original chapters (Curtain Call, Shattered Bloodline, Darkness Among Us), and the Stranger Things chapter. This edition gives you access to a roster of 11 Killers and 14 Survivors.

This edition of the game was delisted on November 17th 2021, along with the related DLC. The DLC's map, The Underground Complex, was removed from the game and additional costumes related to Stranger Things were removed from the in-game store.

title: Monster Hunter: World - Iceborne: Master Edition Digital Deluxe
description:
This is the Digital Deluxe Edition of "Monster Hunter World: Iceborne Master Edition," a set containing both the main game and the massive "Iceborne" expansion.

New quests, monsters, weapons, armor, story, and the unlocking of an all-new "master rank" await to take your hunting to the next level!

title: Hellpoint: Blue Sun
description: Travel to the Blue Sun parallel dimension to experience a new layer of story that reveals the one true cause of the Merge cataclysm. A ton of new armors and characters, a new “contract” system, dual wield weapons, three new sprawling locations to explore and die in

title: Injustice 2: Raiden
description: Download and play as Raiden - The elder God of Thunder has sworn to defend the Earthrealm from any and all threats. Raiden knows that if this universe falls, his own universe will become Brainiac's next target.

title: PGA Tour 2K21: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Golden Touch Pack featuring a gold-plated driver and gold-plated putter, as well as the 2K/adidas CodeChaos MyPlayer Pack featuring the adidas CodeChaos BOA Golf Shoes, and custom adidas / 2K CodeChaos Polo, Pants and Hat, designed by adidas, exclusively for PGA Tour 2K21. Players will also receive an additional 2300 currency to unlock additional MyPlayer gear to hit the links in style!

title: Injustice 2: TMNT
description: Deep below the surface, in the sewers of New York City, four turtle brothers were mutated by radioactive ooze and began training in the art of ninjutsu. While in a fight with the fearsome Krang—our heroes in a half-shell were jettisoned on a one way trip across the Multiverse.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Deluxe Edition
description:
Includes the game and Ultimate Pack, which contains the Berserker Gear Pack, Berserker Settlement Pack, and more!

Become Eivor, a legendary Viking warrior raised on tales of battle and glory. Explore a dynamic open world set against the brutal backdrop of England's Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your clan's settlement, and build your political power on a quest for glory.

title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War - Slaughter Tribe Nemesis
description:
The Slaughter Tribe Nemesis Expansion includes:

• Thousands of NEW Nemesis System enemies, followers & stories
• NEW Orc weapons, fatalities and brutalities
• NEW Fortress, Outpost and Wilderness gameplay
• NEW Legendary Gear Set set for the Bright Lord

title: Generation Zero: Alpine Unrest
description: You've discovered an unexplored island off the east coast which holds more answers, deadlier machines, new weapons, and perhaps something even more valuable - other survivors. It's time to visit Himfjäll, this former ski resort that now hold the only hideout for those trying to stave off the enemies attacks.

title: Minecraft Dungeons: Echoing Void
description: You’ve followed the story of the Arch-Illager and found the shards from the Orb of Dominance, and now it’s time to get to the End. Reach the conclusion of the Minecraft Dungeons story with the newest DLC – Echoing Void!

title: Sonic Mania: Encore
description: Experience an all-new Encore Mode, two new playable characters Mighty and Ray, and four player Competition Mode.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance - DLC Collection
description: This DLC Collection contains all released DLCs for award-winning open world RPG Kingdom Come: Deliverance, namely: Treasures of the Past, From the Ashes, The Amorous Adventures of Bold Sir Hans Capon, Band of Bastards and A Woman's Lot.

title: Untrue New World
description: Evolutionary breeding loop VRRPG 「This is merely a story in which you are deceived by justice, the world, and me.」

title: Career of the President
description: Economic simulator based on late 1980's game President

title: Waifu Breaker
description: Break hot waifus with your ball! Collect hearts and stay alive to reveal your waifu slowly. Bring light to your basement and uncover 11 lewd beauties!

title: Planetary Defense
description: Planetary Defense - defend the Earth from attack!

title: Alveole
description: Alveole is a minimalistic puzzle where the player must understand how to run and why does he do it?

title: Arker: The Legend of Ohm
description: Explore the land of Ohm, recruit your hero and battle in exciting strategic online battles against other players.

title: Xel
description: Xel is an epic 3D sci-fi fantasy action-adventure. Explore the mysterious world of Xel and help protagonist Reid to uncover her enigmatic past. Make new friends and foes along the way and collect exciting gadgets to master challenging dungeons and solve time bending puzzles.

title: Dredge
description:
Dredge is a fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your vessel and dredge the depths for long-buried relics. Explore the stories of the strange locals and discover why some things are best left forgotten.
Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth.

title: Pixasso
description: Pixasso is a relaxing game for lovers of the coloring of tiny pixel art. Color more than 50 pictures and have fun!

title: Axial Disc 1
description: A modern turn-based deckbuilding JRPG involving party synergy for attacks that features unique pixel art and chiptune music!

title: Paradox
description:
One player hunts, four players run and fight back with superpowers.
Use unique abilities, complete objectives, and escape through ancient Egypt, Victorian London, and more, to complete the the story.

title: Hunter Hearts
description: Have you ever had that feeling of looking back in the past? Well, Hunter Hearts is about the past of the protagonist, before the tragedy happend. Find out in this visual novel what he's been going through.

title: The Matchless KungFu
description: The Matchless Kungfu is an open world sandbox RPG game based on a WuXia background. You can play any martial arts role you imagine in this wild world. Travel through the great wilderness, or be the leader of the group. The most important thing is, build your own story and live the experience!

title: Retribution: Universal Requiem
description: A Free-to-Play game based around space, PvP, PvE, Battle Royale, with vast customisation and flexibility. We plan to add extra features such as racing game modes as the game evolves...

title: The Far Kingdoms: Magic Mosaics
description: "The Far Kingdoms: Magic Mosaics" takes you on a challenging mosaic puzzle journey where you gather magic elements. These magic elements are refills for 4 mystical runes. These runes are the pillar of protection from the invasion of the evil dark magician that threatens the kingdom.

title: Secret of Harrow Manor 2
description: Return to the town of Harrow Manor, this time the monsters are much more deadly. The keys and weapons are well hidden, see if you can make it out alive!

title: Last Village
description: Arriving on a hunt in a small village, you become a witness to attack of alien forces on the ground, armed with a shotgun, you decide to repulse the alien intruders.

title: Life on a Pizza
description: You are no longer the eater; you are the eaten. Play as toppings trying to survive on a pizza from the hungry Jaw biting its way to you and the ants pushing you to your delicious death. Customize the pizza, pick a mode and your topping, then hop in this hysterical party or solo game.

title: Cubiya
description: Cubiya is a 3D puzzle game, where you are asked to think around the box. You play as a small astronaut who is trying to rebuild a world. Run around chunks of the planet to find and build beacons, and reconnect the broken world. Explore different chunks of the world solving puzzles along the way.

title: Football Tournament
description: Football has united all the countries of the world on the football field, and numerous football tournaments are held every year. This time there is a place for your team in the standings, choose it and play football.

title: Vaccine Delivery Simulator
description: Vaccine Delivery Simulator is a fun casual game. Your task is to have time to deliver the vaccine to those in need. For most of the game, you will throw the vaccine, so your accuracy is important!

title: Antithesis
description: A top-down action arcade game where you control one spaceship with each hand at the same time, but they both have opposite goals: avoid or destroy.

title: Our Beautiful Earth 2
description: Find hidden objects, animals and different items in the most beautiful places of the world. Explore a variety of wonderful scenes and experience different customs and cultures, also see many different kinds of animals.

title: Tyrant's Blessing
description: Tyrant's Blessing is a tactical turn-based game where your ability to plan, adapt, and strategize is more important than min-maxing your units or finding the sharpest sword in the hoard. Select battles every day, make challenging choices, and cleverly use the strengths of these rag-tag insurgents to defeat the undead hordes and maybe - just maybe - bring real life back to Tyberia.

title: Hex of the Lich
description: Hex of the Lich is a spellcrafting turn-based roguelike. Forge spells from hexes and find new ones along the way. Gain powerful artifacts that enhance your abilities. Clear dungeons filled with bouncing blobs, eldritch horrors, and otherworldly aliens. Can you break the Hex of the Lich?

title: Voxel Printer
description: Make your own voxel art masterpiece in this colorful game.

title: Ultimate Racing 2D 2
description: The ultimate top-down racing game is back! Ultimate Racing 2D 2 includes new cars, new tracks, track/car editor, time-trial mode, damage, multi-class racing and more.

title: The Purification
description: As the last surviver you find yourself in a zombie infected wolrd. Survive by finding weapons and objects to escape the horror.

title: Bloomee
description: Delve into a virtual space free from the stresses of work, school and general day-to-day struggles. At times when it seems like we can't keep up with how fast the world is moving, take a load off and witness the worlds of Bloomee and satiate your desire to escape your current reality.

title: Narvas
description: Take control of Mace in this local co-op side scrolling platform shooter as you travel from assignment to assignment taking on enemy bots and dangerous bosses on different planets.

title: Sokobond Express
description: A beautifully minimalist puzzle game combining chemical bonds and puzzling pathfinding.

title: Shiny Summer
description: Shiny Summer is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Ronister Adventure
description: Horrible creatures ravaged the entire autumn, taking their sacred fruits to other lands. Now Ronister goes out on an adventure around the world, facing various enemies and obstacles. On his journey he'll find vehicles and will get unique abilities to save our planet from the terrible Evil Bat.

title: Vector Race
description: Vector Race is a racing game set in a surreal setting. A colorful track with electronic music. Reach the end of the race with the fastest time. Compete with your friends who will be on the leaderboard.

title: Outerverse
description:
Build automated machines and weapons across the universe to beat massive bosses and advance your technology while experiencing cosmic events in this quest driven automation crafting adventure game.
Includes a manual scenario for crafting instead of machines for those not a fan of logic/automation!

title: Hexdoku
description: Player must fill the grid with different shapes. Each line and area must not contain same shape, just like classic Sudoku game!

title: Nevergrind Online
description: Nevergrind Online is a real-time cooperative multiplayer online RPG where you and a group of adventurers join forces to protect the Kingdom of Edenburg from the sinister forces of darkness. Up to six players can form a party and venture forth to help restore peace and order to the Kingdom.

title: Summit in Space
description: "Summit in Space" is a short precision platformer in a pixel retro style. Play as the Brave Adventurer, and reach the Space Summit in time!

title: Surprise Party!
description: Save the world as a Balloon(!?) in this story driven horror/stealth puzzle game!

title: Lilly's Rescue
description: Lilly's Rescue is a 3D platform liner game, Solve the puzzles by moving the platforms, improve your skills throughout the game and find your kitten and bring him home.

title: The Heart of Darkness
description: Explore the Realm of Darkness, a mysterious dungeon in the underground kingdom of Haillard. You must find the spirit of the Saint of Darkness, and unravel the truth of this strange world in this dark, turn-based RPG.

title: Last Shape Standing
description: Last Shape Standing is at its core a survival game where each player needs to survive through a multitude of chaotic and fun randomly selected challenges, be it bullet hell, PVP, a zombie apocalypse or even dangerous quizzes!

title: Car Jump
description: Reach the finish line with a jumping car, mastering treacherous levels in this platform game.

title: The Hunger: Games Ensemble
description: A Collection Of Hilarious VR Games!

title: Super Shield Dash
description: Super Shield Dash is an arcade game where you smash enemies with your shield, while time moves as you move. No powerups, no fancy weapons. Just you simply dashing around, throwing shield to destroy enemies. So plant your feet, grit your teeth and eat those horses.

title: The Rescue Squad
description: The Rescue Squad is a 2d side-scroller game in which the player controls a spaceship and rescues lost astronauts from an infinite number of planets, dodging the soil and debris of unknown planets.

title: Fission
description: Play as a shape hero. Enter combat worlds found along the main world. You will need to get stronger in this unusual RPG to defeat the enemies, bosses and eventually the Round Lord.

title: Heir Obscure
description: Escape the clutches of a decadent cult of aristocrats and the demon that haunts their retreat. Stay quiet, stick to the shadows, uncover the dark secrets of the sadistic Empire and of the mysterious Plightswoman who claims to want to help you. A story-rich horror game with immersive stealth.

title: Provider
description: Speak to the lost souls, caught between planes and lacking closure. Brave the dangerous Excluded Zones. Return victorious, with a story to tell. Provide closure and uncover the larger mystery that lurks.

title: Droptch
description: Stranded upon an island and surrounded by an ancient sea, you awaken...

title: Occultism Interrogation: The Ritual of Little Nightmares
description: Can you prove your INNOCENCE? Overcomes the Devil's interrogation. A terror game where you experience the stress of making decisions. An esoteric game full of mysteries, intrigue and horror. Will you escape from the sinister and evil sect?

title: Dark Forest: Lost Story VR
description: In this horror game we will tell you truthful stories about demons and ghosts.

title: Dead-End Detective: The Sixpence Strangler
description: Become a detective in this comedic/thrilling visual novel set in the 1950s as you try to track down a serial strangler that stalks the streets of London.

title: Paladin's Lance
description: Paladin's Lance lets you ride fierce dragons into glorious combat against powerful foes. The game features squad tactics and a compelling fantasy story. Take up your lance and shield, turn the tide of war through epic battles, and save Valoria from the return of an evil god.

title: Maidens of the Ocean Solitaire
description: Maidens of the Ocean Solitaire is a watery tale you won’t soon forget! It’s the time of year when every mermaid in the ocean attends the fabulous aquatic party. Help the lovely merfolk prepare by escorting them to the event.

title: Secure the Skies
description: Music-based aerial combat.

title: Dude Simulator 4
description: Dude Simulator 4 – a first-person open-world sandbox game with a plot. Some new adventures are awaiting the dude. The main character of the game gets to know that he has a brother living in a different city, so he sets out to find him.

title: Not Their Will
description: Not Their Will is a 3D Top-down shooter in which you are an alien that uses the weapons of the enemies against them.

title: Condors vs. Ocelots
description: Condors and Ocelots have been at war for generations. Customize your army to reign supreme in this Tactics RPG focused on customizable armies!

title: Requiescat
description: Requiescat is a sci-fi RPG.

title: Slime Climb
description: A challenging precision platformer that will test your determination. Climb an unforgiving mountain filled with tricky platforms and treacherous gaps as you yearn for Tasty Snacks at the summit. Every fall hurts, but victory tastes sweet.

title: Ambush
description: Ambush is a party game up to 2-8 players in local multiplayer. Stay hidden in a crowd, spot players among the AIs, and slice them up with your freshly sharpened katana. Strategy and violence will be part of the game.

title: Fox in the Woods
description: A crafting base survival casual game play. Two playable game modes! Hand drawn vector images and animations. Support a small local game design team!

title: Dark Pathways
description: You wake up in your cell, but this time the door is open and strange creatures will chase you across amazing worlds. You have to look for objects and tools scattered in the labyrinth that can be used to finally stop this threat. Only then you can come back to the peace of your cell.

title: LogiCally
description: Test your skills in this challenging game of logic, observation and mental calculation. Solve problems of increasing difficulty and exceed your limits. How far can you get?

title: Dominium Mundi
description: Dominium Mundi is a lightweight 4X strategy game set in the medieval period where 4 players compete to create the most influential empire. Expand your empire over the map, convert more people to your religion, and control more trade routes.

title: On Closer Inspection
description: Experience the Australian War Memorial’s collection in VR! View and explore a Mark IV tank from WW1; a Hudson Bomber and an Avro Lancaster from WW2; the Adelaide Class Frigate; and the Bushmaster. Featuring video, audio, photos, and facts to bring to life the history of these important items.

title: City Wars: Tokyo Reign
description: City Wars: Tokyo Reign takes the customization and strategy of a traditional CCG and introduces a dynamic battlefield where tactile mechanics and turn-based battling combine. Choose a Faction, build a Combat Case and take to the streets.

title: Cultic
description: You died? So what? Tuck your guts back in and gear up to fight your way through the ranks of a mysterious and twisted cult. You, your guns, and your dynamite will have to shoot, slide, blast, duck, dodge, and maybe throw a gib or two to survive in this old-school-inspired shooter.

title: Invincible Cleopatra: Caesar's Dreams
description: Help Cleopatra find the amulet of dreams and stop the war

title: Anarchy: Wolf's Law
description: The constant struggle for control of the territory between living people, but in singleplayer mode. A dynamic shooter with elements of RPG and economic thinking.

title: On Key Up: A Game for Keyboards
description: Get to know your keyboard with this unique, physics-based puzzle game!

title: Super Astrovade
description: Super Astrovade is a shoot-em up with no shooting. A bullet hell without bullets. Evade enemies and absorb stardust to unleash a powerful supernova bomb that destroys everything around you. Evade, absorb, destroy, survive.

title: Who Killed Mr. White?
description: A turn-based murder mystery.

title: Ball Challenge
description: With a retro pixel art graphics, Ball Challenge is a hard game that requires a lot of skill and agility from the player to go through all it's challenges. Dodge monsters, spikes and traps, collect the necessary diamonds and try to reach the end of each level.

title: Conflict Area
description: Conflict Area is both a singleplayer and multiplayer game made by 2 developers.

title: Skillsworn
description: Skillsworn is a real time, party-based isometric adventure game. Take on the role of a fresh adventurer and embark on a journey through the wilds of the world. Defeat a variety of dangerous foes and prove that you are not just another bored peasant seeking a thrill.

title: Enchanted Kingdom: Frost Curse - Collector's Edition
description: The King is dead! As his son, it’s up to you to rule the Empire. But any plans for a coronation are quickly thwarted when a frigid foe attacks your realm! A long-lost relative is after your crown, and their dark magic threatens to take the land into an age of cold darkness. Do you have what it takes to defeat them and save your home in time? Find out in this exhilarating Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

title: Sphere Game Epic
description: Sphere Game Epic is the newest in the Sphere Game series, with new mechanics and visuals, bringing more challenges to be overcome.

title: Galaxy Drift
description: Galaxy Drift is a high speed isometric racer inspired by classics like F-Zero, Rock n' Roll Racing and RC Pro-Am. Reach astronomical speeds, def the laws of physics as you warp past planets, stars and black holes in an adrenaline fueled race across the galaxy!

title: Potato's Dream
description: A clicker game where you make a potato's dream come true. Will you help it obtain its dream or will it slowly rot away in a bag in a dark kitchen?

title: Cinemoji
description: Do you watch many movies? Test your deduction skills and your cinema knowledge trying to guess the name of the film represented by the emojis. Don't be shy to ask for help, you probably won't discover all the answers by yourself!

title: Noyah: Corrupted Memories
description: Noyah: Corrupted Memories is a roguelike deckbuilder, in pixel art, with random battle generation, day and night cycle, climate events, advanced rune system, that allows you to create endless possibilities with a single card.

title: Gunmancer
description: Gunmancer is a science fantasy roguelike top-down shooter. Summon guns as you shoot your way through mysterious randomly generated dungeons full of ancient forbidden magic of guns and dangerous monsters.

title: Jiguland
description: Jiguland is an open world roguelike rpg taking place in a twisted setting of medieval modern life. Use clever tactics and creative strategy to survive this unforgiving place.

title: Dear Mom: My Letter to You
description: Follow the emotional story of Ayame Kawasaki, who disappears from the public eye following her mother's suicide. One year later, she's ready to start her life again. Build and develop meaningful connections with those you cherish in this slice-of-life/social simulation game.

title: Dream Mirror
description: Dream Mirror transports you to Immersive environments and magical worlds where you can Interact with environment and solve puzzles to pass the level.

title: Murder Hornets
description: Kill wasp or wasp kill you

title: Space Box Battle Arena
description: Design and build your unique free-form spaceship and fight your enemies for victory in the Space Box! Machine guns, lasers, flamethrowers, harpoons, energy shields, black hole generators, and much more equipment to choose your game style! The exciting PvP sandbox battle arena awaits!

title: JMPR
description: JMPR is a handcrafted unforgiving 2d platformer, or “Meatlike,” made for diehard fans.

title: Valley of Shadow
description: An autobiographical puzzle game. Solve puzzles using classic spells (Light, Force Missile, Fireball) while you explore a dark world full of secrets.

title: Endro
description: The endros need your help to survive in this world of endless monsters that keeps appearing. Make the endro species last for eternity and help them defeat the evil.

title: Flowcubes
description: Have you ever been led to a dead end by your phone and thought you can do it better? With FLOWCUBES you are in control of the path. Lead the people to their destination and make sure they make it there. Place and combine flow fields to generate a world with a perfect path from A to B.

title: Pearls of the Oceans
description: Together for the Planet! Evade and outsmart the many dangers of the oceans, collect the Pearls to save the World. Stay on your toes through 100 handcrafted levels and challenge yourself to climb the leaderboard and prevent the war to begin.

title: Cyberpunk Detective
description: This is a cyberpunk crime fiction game, that will allow you to visit the City and unfold its secrets. You will play as a private detective, one of the dying species, that still seeks for the truth, justice and money. Mostly money.

title: Between Time: Escape Room
description: You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you have to travel through time, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles to get priceless treasures. Will you be able to make it back alive?

title: Saphyro
description: Saphyro - is a casual game where your task is to collect white cubes, for which you get points. The difficulty is that you need to dodge the colored platforms that randomly appear on the playing field and the cube, which you control constantly in motion. And how many points can you collect?

title: Afterlife Beans
description: You are a bean that is about to go to the after life but someone won't let you to do that! find out who it is in this game! collect coins, shoot enemies and terrible puns are awaiting you, so what are you waiting for? join the bean in afterlife beans.

title: Born Into Fear
description: Born Into Fear is a first-person horror game set in an evacuated neighborhood. You'll have to solve puzzles and avoid enemies to destroy the evil Buffer.

title: 50 Waves Hero
description: It's a defense game that blocks 50 waves. But Hero has just woken up from the seal and is powerless. So you have to protect your castle while growing up your warrior.

title: Raven's Hike
description: No jumping, no walking. Raven's Hike is a unique 2d platformer in which all movement is based on her Grappling Hook

title: Revenger
description: A fast-paced, tough as nails first-person shooter evocative of the direct-to-video action flicks of the 1980's, Revenger is a short, but memorable experience about one man's hunt to rescue his daughter, and kill everyone responsible for her kidnapping.

title: Arcaduis
description: Arcaduis is an Atari 2600 Retro games simulation game in a retro cartoon atmosphere.

title: Speed Mazing
description: Exciting "racing" party game for up to 4 players. Quick gameplay loop, hundreds of maps and eye-catching visuals. Also included is a challenging time attack mode for single player.

title: Centauri Dominion
description: Centauri Dominion is a top down space shooter set in the Centauri sector where a new colony is being established. There are others arriving seeking to dominate the sector for themselves and will not take no for an answer.

title: Gun Duel
description: Gun Duel is a 2D fast-paced shooter where the player can choose one of three characters. Each character has different abilities that can adapt to a player's playstyle. Gun Duel is the perfect combination between 2D, pixel art, and fast-paced shooters!

title: The Hauntings
description: The Hauntings is a 1-4 player online co-op investigation and exorcism game. Using a wide range of paranormal investigation equipment your group must try and successfully discover the source of the haunting and proceed to remove the threat from the area!

title: Fight For Eden
description: Fight For Eden is a fantasy action-RPG VR game where you will follow the story of a young orc enrolled to fight against the half elves' oppression.

title: Azlan: Rise of the Burlpups
description: New to VR or Tower Defense? Learn to Plan, attack & defend in this immersive VR strategy game. Get ready for massive tower defense battles in VR as AZLAN defends Zalolo Land from total ruin. With a vast arsenal of upgradable cannons, arrows, and crystal towers at your command, can your skill & craft save Zalolo from Rise of the...

title: Kula
description: Beat your own record and help Kula to jump away from the evil triangles in this easy and fun game for kids.

title: Volcano Princess
description: After the war between humans and demons, you found a baby on the battlefield and became a father. You will Plan time and courses for her, bring her into contact with various roles, and raise her up. The daughter's future and the ending of the volcano country depends on each of your choices.

title: SudoKats
description: Cats are very demanding and peculiar animals. Use your sudoku skill to help them feel one of a kind.

title: The Journey of AutUmn
description: The Journey of AutUmn - A classic point-and-click adventure game with completely hand-painted graphics. The player controls an android that crashes during its mission through a variety of lovingly designed environments and solves classic inventory puzzles.

title: Flower in the Snow: Resurrection
description: What is going to be acted before you is——Blossom in the shackles, but deep down in your bone, suspension and romantic.

title: All Dream Long A Flower Storm
description: Award-winning point-and-click game FREE to download and play! Relax into a dreamscape full of fairytales, legends, and peculiar scenery. With the help of friendly demon Baku, solve riddles and puzzles to reach the true end and wake up... if you want to wake up, that is.

title: Corona Frustration Elimination
description: Corona plunged the world into chaos in 2020. That sparked anger and frustration. Here you can let your frustration run free and Corona really express your opinion!

title: Coronavirus: Nano Force
description: A fast-paced arcade shooter where you pilot a nano-ship in the fight against the Coronavirus. Grab powerups to upgrade your weapons and eliminate the virus infection.

title: Covid-19: Corona Clicker
description: Develop a vaccine for Covid-19 and save the world from pandemic! Covid-19 - Corona Clicker is a game for PC. Get higher virus resistance and take strategic measures for the country, such as airport closures or healthcare support.

title: Schoolmates: The Mystery of the Magical Bracelet
description: Long ago, a dark order of mages decided to wreak havoc upon the land but was kept at bay by another group known as the Selena order. Help the three young apprentices, Flex, Eva and Blondie to defeat a powerful mage in this incredible hidden object and point & click adventure!

title: Among School Girls
description: Among School Girls is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: High School of Memories
description: Meet Haru Takahashi, a first-year high school student from America with natural blonde hair! As he goes to school at Kaisouroku High School, he's bound to meet lots of wonderful classmates and experience all the excitement of living in Japan, the land of his dreams!

title: Aske
description: A first person shooter that sets you far away, near death.

title: Pandemic Heart
description: Pandemic Heart is a relaxing visual novel game with multiple endings that set about a wild story of love in the Pandemic or the Outbreak.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Heart of Russia
description:
Explore the heart of Russia, Moscow, and beyond. Feel the spirit of Russian history driving through centuries-old cities. Get lost in the sea of trees and open plains.

As a direct result to Russia's invasion of Ukraine, SCS Software announced its decision to not go through with the release of Heart of Russia DLC.

title: The Song of Survivors
description: The Song of Survivors is a free-to-play massively-cooperative bullet-hell style MMORPG. If you die, a new hero reborn who carries your legacy onto your next adventure!!

title: Boxing Babes: Sexy Fight Hentai Anime Girls
description: BOXING BABES: Sexy Fight Hentai Anime GirlsThe Action Echii Hentai Boxing Game its released on PC! Box, Customize, Flirt and Fight.

title: Fight the Landlord
description: A game of competition and card collection.Use your skills and items to win the game!The game has single-player mode and online mode.

title: Light Fighter
description: Light Fighter is an arcade survival game and scoring.

title: The Moon Relax
description: The Moon Relax is a realistic exploration and survival game set in a large open world on the Moon.

title: Hunting Moon vol.2
description: When I received a life-size puppet, I thought it was a prank, but the puppet moved suddenly...

title: The Forever Moon
description: The Forever Moon is a puzzle adventure and visual novel doujin game of Touhou Project. It is a love story about Kaguya Houraisan and Fujiwara no Mokou, and a story of Eientei, Bamboo forest of lost and Hakurei Shrine.

title: Furry Shades of Gay
description: Love Stories is a game about love, queer relationships, hot gay sex and slapstick humor. Five furry stories full of wit, tough decisions, and sweaty, raunchy humping.Features branching narrative, multiple different scenarios and animated sex scenes!

title: Furry Love 2
description: Amazing Furry Beauties. Good Atmosphere, Great Music, Levels with Full HD Furry Artworks. Furry Love 2 is waiting for you! Music, 40 artworks, great for relaxing. Solve puzzles and other game modes, see beautiful furries! Join us!

title: Sweet Love
description: Sweet love is a minimalist platformer with a committed message.

title: Love Tavern
description: After your death due to a car accident, you have been summoned by the goddess to take care of a tavern in an Isekai world. Your job is to hire different girls from various tribes and races to help out the business there, as well as build up room by room of the tavern to expand the business.

title: Lovely Planet Remix
description: A collection of original and unique first person shooter games with 150+ levels across 14+ playlists. Climb the leaderboards, watch recorded replays and hunt down secrets in this fresh new Lovely Planet experience.

title: Love Stories: Sex and the Furry Titty
description: Love Stories: Sex and the Furry Titty goes to town on the city! There are foxy ladies out and about, hung plumbers visiting some wet and wild kitties, gloryholes waiting for the connoisseurs, and much more! Five all-new, original stories, each one ending up in hot sweaty sex!

title: Love Meeting
description: This is a casual draw line game. The girls in the game have different stories. You can chat with girls. The secret hidden in the girl is waiting for you to discover.

title: LGBT Color by Number for Adults
description: Get LGBT Color by Number for Adults coloring book, ‘cause LOVE IS LOVE!

title: Injustice 2: Brainiac
description: Play as Brainiac before earning him in-game through completing story mode.

title: Tiny Metal: Will of the Shogun
description: Will of the Shogun DLC continues the TINY METAL: FULL METAL RUMBLE story in the form of Act 8, the next chapter of the main core TINY METAL: FMR campaign. In addition to a brand new Act comes Legendary Battles which adds more maps and a "legendary" challenge for old and new commanders to take on!

title: Wurdweb
description: Grab words from a list and cross them with words on the board. Puzzle your way towards a Finish Tile, put down enough words, or put down as many words as you can!

title: Paranoia!
description:
"The friendship of two girls is tossed around by cruel fate."

There were two girls. They were always together.
No matter the time of the day, no matter what happens.
They are always together, because they are friends.

This story begins when they become junior high students.

title: Hugo: Bukkazoom
description: Hugo: Bukkazoom! is a 3D racing game based starring Hugo the TV Troll, a popular cartoon character on Danish television. In this game Hugo is shrunk to the size of little green creatures called greenflies. He must race a kart through marshes, deserts and various landscapes. The circuits have checkpoints, upgrades and a scoring system open to different possible strategies. Both single-player and multiplayer games for up to two players are supported.

title: PowerSlave: Exhumed
description: PowerSlave: Exhumed is a Kex engine enhanced port of the PlayStation and SEGA Saturn versions of Powerslave (Exhumed). Its improvements include high resolution and modern gamepad support. The content of the original games remains unchanged.

title: Splinterlands
description: Splinterlands is a unique digital trading card game that allows players to truly own their cards and other in-game assets. Thanks to web 3.0 technology powered by the HIVE blockchain, each card in Splinterlands is a non-fungible token owned by a player. That means that players can do anything they want with their cards, including battling for rewards, holding as collectibles, trading on the peer-to-peer market, combining to level up, or even burning to obtain Dark Energy Crystals, the official in-game cryptocurrency of Splinterlands.

title: Old Salt
description:
A Naval Strategy Experience With No Reinforcements On The Way

2-4 player online Strategy game with multiple factions.

title: Alice Trapped Beyond Wonderland
description: Discover and solve the extraordinary mysteries from the magical kingdoms beyond the incredible Wonderland, Find where the evil red queen banished your friends, gather clues about their whereabouts, and solve multiple puzzles to rescue them once and for all to get them back to their home in Wonderland.

title: Retro Commander
description: Retro Commander is a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy wargame.

title: Tokyo 24-Ku
description: In this visual novel, our protagonist, Akihiro Sonogi, is a promising young member of the House of Representatives aiming to be top of the faction. After a suspected terrorist bombing in Tokyo's Shibuya district, he was elected to tackle the case.
