Now you can enjoy casino action right in the comfort of your own home. eGames CASINO is packed with 7 exciting games including BlackJack, Roulette, Video Poker, Slots and Keno.

The super realistic 3D table layouts, casino background noises and dealer voice cues along with the awesome graphics and fantastic animation are sure to make you feel like you're in the middle of Vegas winning the big money prizes!

Includes: Western Slots, U.S. Slots, Galaxy Poker, Castle Poker, Roulette, Keno & BlackJack

- Cool sounds & animated graphics!
- Scores are tracked so you can take your winnings to other games!

Platforms: Windows 95/98

title: Lake of Shadows
description: A 2D pixel art side-scrolling resource management with some action, looting, and a bit of exploration that mainly focuses on a small area. Defend yourself against the terror of the night inside your settlement by employing some villagers and give them equipment to further strengthen your defenses.

title: Butterfly Soup 2
description: Set a few months after the events of the original story, the game switches between the perspectives of Diya, Noelle, Akarsha, and Min-seo as they navigate high school life in the San Francisco Bay Area.

title: Super Cat Wars
description: A fan-made mod for Super Mario War, modifying it to feature the colorful cast and environments of the Super Cat Tales series of indie mobile games by Neutronized. This game features a Story Mode, expanded tileset sheets for level editing, new music packs and sounds, several crossovers, and quality-of-life additions to the game engine.

title: Aoi Shiro
description:
The Seijou Girls’ Academy Kendo Club is traveling to Shoushinji for a Summer training camp. Near there is an island, Urashima, where legend has it a demon extermination took place long ago.

They arrive around the time of a festival which honors a god that is worshipped by the people of Urashima; it celebrates the onitaiji and ensure another year of health for the people. Around the time of the festival, the weather around Urashima worsens and storms will come.

A few days into their training, Osanai Shouko finds a girl washed up on the shores near the location of the training camp. She cannot speak and doesn’t seem to know much about herself...

title: Bat Egg
description: Bat Egg is a small, cute avoid-the-obstacles game, with several game modes and unlockable skins.

title: Pizza Shop Manager
description: Pizza Shop Manager is a unique combination of strategy and simulation game with some economic elements. Do your best to fulfil pizza orders from customers while making enough money to keep your shop open in this fun cooking game. You take the role of Pizzeria Manager. Manage every aspect of your pizzeria and make it become the best eatery in town!!

title: Savior of the Abyss
description: Savior of the Abyss is an RPG Maker-style horror adventure game about solving riddles using clues from exploring the surroundings. The goal of the game is to guide the main character, Stella, to the surface of an underground facility. In order not to face sudden death, you must always pay attention and be suspicious of the things around you.

title: Give Me Strength
description:
Give Me Strength is an interactive thought by James Poole.

I struggle to make things and this is a game about me struggling to make things and other thoughts.

title: Wraith Ops
description: Wraith Ops is a fast-paced FPS shooter focusing on satisfying gunplay and back-to-basics playstyle. Its main goal is to bring together objective-based gameplay with a focus on teamwork, fast movement, snappy combat and more realistic/tactical features loved by many. Learning from its peers, we believe that realistic features and gameplay elements can work not only by putting obstacles in your way but by helping you overcome them, enhance the experience and improve your immersion.

title: Quartet
description: A series of unlikely train robberies. A mysterious deck of cards. A fleet of deadly airships. An accidental mage. Choose from four stories, in any order, and see how they eventually intertwine in this turn-based RPG.

title: Transfusion
description:
Transfusion plunges you into a world originally created in 1997 by Monolith Productions. Created with the BUILD game engine (Duke Nukem, Shadow Warrior), Blood was a tour de force of horror that has yet to be matched, in which you battled minions of evil in a lightning-paced, blood splattered quest for glory.

Thrill to new, enhanced special effects not seen in the original as you guide Caleb along his gory quest through a 3-dimensional world of horror. But the fun is just beginning then…

When Tchernobog’s Cabal has fallen, there’s millions of challengers vying for your throne out there in cyberspace. Be sure to hone your skills against the enhanced FrikBots before defending your title in online bloodbaths. No need for Caleb to do all the work either - you can battle online as any identity you choose by selecting from the character library or by downloading new identities from the internet.

title: Campfire Tales
description: This 8bit game is a port from a mystery source...This casual, linier, interactive story game centers around a campfire with old friends telling... tales.

title: Big Cat from Hell
description: Big Cat from Hell is a kinetic novel about a boy and a demon.

title: Mickey Storm and the Cursed Mask
description:
Spy up and save your parents in this action-packed platformer!

Welcome to the world’s greatest waterpark! In this resort full of wild adventures and thrilling waterslides only you, and your sister, can stop the evil Dr. Fisher! Using the powers of a mysterious mask this vicious villain has enchanted the entire park to finally trap your parents. Why? Because they are none other than the world famous Storm spies!

Jump, slide and rush through a series of challenging 2.5D water slides to take down Dr. Fisher and save your parents! But, don’t expect a walk in the park. Because of the curse, all slides are totally OUT OF CONTROL! Each area is filled with dangers, obstacles and enemies waiting for you in each corner, so brace yourself before you’re wiped out. Luckily you’re not in this alone as you’ll be accompanied by your special spy vlogging drone B.U.D.D.Y.

title: Anno 1800: The High Life
description:
The 3rd DLC of the Anno 1800 Season 3 Pass.

Take your city to grand new heights with modular skyscrapers, shopping arcades, and the epic Skyline Tower monument.

title: Magical Girl Pretty Samy Part 1: In the Earth
description: Based on Magical Girl Pretty Sammy anime TV series which focuses on magical girl Sasami from the Tenchi Muyo! universe.

title: Magical Girl Pretty Samy Part 2: In the Julyhelm
description: A visual novel based on the Magical Girl Pretty Sammy series.

title: Puzzletronics
description: In this game you will have the experience of moving pieces to form an electronic circuit, while listening to a calm and relaxing soundtrack. This game is not an electronic circuit simulator but it will be a lot of fun to use electronics in this game.

title: Hammer 2 Reloaded
description: Enjoy intense action in this third-person shooter action game. Your job is to clean city of crime in mutiple missions, each one with its own goal. The game features a fully Open World Environment. Improve your arsenal in the dedicated shop with cash you gained from previous missions.

title: Melty Blood: Type Lumina - Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition Set Details
① MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA
② MELTY BLOOD ARCHIVES Enjoy both the MELTY BLOOD Guide Book packed with amazing artwork and details about the setting and history of the game, and the MELTY BLOOD SOUND COLLECTION with background music from the franchise all together in digital format.

title: White Girl
description: #Four players real-time battle royal! This game is a battle royal game which in-game time goes by in real-time. The main game mode is randomly matching world battle mode, but you can also play friend match mode if you want to play with friends casually. #Update the AI girl and fight against other players! By gaining cards called "piece of memory", you can update your girls and/or attack opponents' girls. As the girls get updated, their bodies gain various color. The colors are expressed in three values, which are "R", "G" and "B". The values themselves become the girl's status and her appearance. #Color affection makes brand new strategy! "R", "G" and "B" affect each other. Since this game is real-time four players game, you always need to check two things. How other players are making their girls and how you should make your girl to compete with them. This feature will give you a brand new strategical battle! #This game is recommended to these gamers!

title: Pippu: Bauble Quest
description: Pippu is a heroic little creature from the world of the Beandrops. One day her planet is visited by hostile aliens called the Obkins, who travel from place to place stealing precious treasures to power their dangerous and wacky machinery. Run, climb and swim your way through 14 worlds to bash the baddies and save your planet. Features: Colorful, vibrant worlds with lots of nooks and crannies to explore. A kooky cast of weird and wonderful characters to meet. Collect all 56 Baubles to restore your world to its full glory. Fun for all the family, young and old, beginner or seasoned gamer.

title: From Earth to Heaven
description: In this game, you follow the protagonist who initially fell from heaven back into the sky. The game is a unique combination of a first-person platformer and a light-hearted exploration game with an almost philosophical story-telling. It is highly stylized and surprises with breathtaking environments, a surreal world full of beauty and grace, and a couple of small environmental puzzles that blend perfectly into the peaceful yet stunning environments. Will you be able to make it back into heaven? Find it out.

title: Magical Girls Second Magic
description: " Magical Girls Second Magic" features cute girl characters ranging from magical girls to girls with furry cat ears.This is a unique block-busting game in which you destroy all the blocks placed on the stage to evolve the illustrations of cute girl characters.

title: Spectacular Sparky
description: Spectacular Sparky is an action-packed platform/shooter with wacky characters, explosive weapons and boss battles to treasure. Sparky is an adorably insane intergalactic bounty hunter who can dash through obstacles, fire his weapons in any direction and even extend his jumps by flapping his long bunny-like ears. Each time he brings down a boss, his connected confidante Shig (half shark, half pig) is ready to point him in the direction of yet another space fugitive. In the grand tradition of irreverent 1990s video-game heroes, Spectacular Sparky is as sassy as he is fearless. His voice-acted wisecracks and sarcastic jabs tend to get under the skin of his enemies in a most amusing fashion. And his universe is awash with spikes, lava, buzzsaws, super-saturated colors, slick parallax scrolling and mega-driven music, the way every game ought to be.

title: Shark Pinball
description:
Get ready for Shark Pinball, a pinball machine where you'll try to score points avoiding Sharks, octopus and many other perils, show everybody that you're not affraid of the sea monsters on this table.

Discover all the missions and secrets, in this unique two leveled pinball arcade machine. Complete all the missions and become number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard.

title: Surviving Mars: Below and Beyond
description: Key Features Back to the Bases - Expand your colony into caves and lava tubes under the surface. Mine Your Own Business - Go below the surface and beyond the red planet to mine new resources. Branching Paths - The Recon and Expansion research trees unlock additional features for exploration.

title: Jack Axe: The Trial
description: Be Jack! Throw your axe! Test yourself against The Trial to prove yourself worthy in this speedrunning competition!

title: Pro Strategy Football 2022
description: Manage, Coach, or enjoy watching live sims! Create custom schedules! Configure playoffs formats, create manual brackets, or standalone tournaments! Enjoy revamped animation, custom sounds and music, and more! Season play with up to 130 teams! Career play with many custom league configurations!

title: Make a Path for the Chicken
description: After falling into a hole, this Chicken finds herself on a journey to find her chicks. Solve puzzles and make a safer path for the chicken to complete this journey.

title: Secrets of the Lost Tomb
description: Explore a new world of twists and turns where you will be at the edge of your seat. Secrets of the Lost Tomb is an Egyptian-themed role-playing game with puzzles, first and third-person perspectives, and adventure. Players can enjoy a challenging yet engaging campaign and also party up with friends.

title: Uncrashed: FPV Drone Simulator
description: Amateur or experienced FPV pilot, learn or improve your skills on Uncrashed,the new ultra realistic FPV simulator. Simulate your own FPV drone with settings based on real values and you will have the same feeling as a real flight without the risk of breaking your drone !

title: Light the World
description: Light the World is a simulation puzzle game. The year is 2125 and the world is on the brink of destruction as a result of rampant unchecked pollution. Clouds of pollution blanket the sky and prevent most sunlight from reaching the earth's surface.

title: Station 17
description: Venture into the echoing halls of Station 17. But Beware, not is all as it seems.

title: Deep Madness

title: Misericorde: Volume One
description:
The year is 1482.

The age of exploration and enlightenment is on the distant horizon and the Renaissance is in full swing across Europe; but in England, the War of the Roses is in its final throes. Change is coming, but in one little convent in the north of the kingdom, everyone has seemed blissfully unaware.

Everyone except Sister Catherine, a beloved nun and firebrand thinker who has just been murdered. In an isolated monastery with an already mysterious reputation, any one of the Sisters could be the killer—and Mother Superior is as stumped as anyone else. That's where you come in.

As an Anchoress, you took an oath to never leave your cell; to devote yourself entirely to God and provide spiritual support to all who came to your door. But as the only Sister who couldn't possibly have committed the crime, you have a new mission: solve the case, before the bishop shutters the convent and the killer goes unpunished.

The Superior hasn't told everyone why you've suddenly joined the regular congregation, but something tells you most of these women know exactly what's going on. Who can you trust? Who is being honest, and who has their guard up—and why? Is the convent really haunted? Who killed Sister Catherine? And worst of all... are you next?

title: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Square Snake
description: Standard snake-eating game, chasing and eating small balls, the snake's body will grow longer and longer, be careful not to hit obstacles, do not bite their tail or body. Eat 50 small balls to get through. The DLC include full 10 missions

title: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Bomber the Ruby Magic
description: You found some prehistoric magic towers in the cave. Red gemstones emit red light balls that move in the air. You move forward carefully, don't touch these light balls, you'll get hurt. Once you've found the treasure, go to the next map quickly.

title: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Bomber the Falling Stone
description: The cave looked like it was about to collapse, and the stones above my head began to fall. You will be hurt by being stoned, please be careful to move forward. Remember to destroy the enemy to get the keys, blow open the walls to get the treasure chest.

title: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Pinball Killer
description: You've been put into a huge billiard table by extraterrestary. They give you a gun that fires white billiards, which you must use to shoot down billiards of all other colors. But these billiards are so huge that they can easily crush you. The DLC include full 10 missions

title: Poker Chase
description: Texas hold 'em poker, with common gacha game thematics.

title: Moon Whistle
description:
Moon Whistle is a Japanese language freeware role-playing video game created with RPG Tsukūru 95. Mainly made by Kōichirō Takaki, also known as Kannazuki Sasuke, this game involves an adventure of a five-year-old kindergartner in a pseudo-Japanese city of the 1980s and 1990s.
In 2011 an updated version was released called Moon Whistle XP.

title: My Home Town
description: A tiny accident occur in modern Japanese town.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 2: Jack-O'
description: This allows the character Jack-O' to be used in-game.

title: The 13th Month
description: The famous fairy tale "Sleeping Beauty" is completely reimagined and redesigned as Visual Novel… With a demonic imagination and originality.

title: Metroid Planets
description:
Metroid Planets is a Fan Remake of the 1986 Nintendo Entertainment System game Metroid created by vacantshade.

It updates Samus' movement and adds a saving system, among other features. The game is called Metroid Planets because of its multiple maps. Planet Zebeth is a remake of the original Metroid. Planet Novus is a whole new map with new bosses and new areas. Selecting Planet Enigma will bring you to a room creator and a map generator that uses those rooms to create a world. (If you go to the Discord linked in the game menu, you can download a room pack and upload your own rooms.) The game also has online multiplayer.

title: Loot Train
description: Loot Train is a procedurally generated game where you take control of a hooded thief, that has a will bent on robbery, in a train full of valuables. Progress through train cars to defeat colorful enemies, and weird bosses summoned by the Guild of Righteous Protectors, to stop your genocide!

title: Diner Bros Inc
description: Join the Bros once again as they defend their precious restaurant! Co-operate or compete against your friends in this frantic party game for up to 4 players. Beat quick sequences of crazy minigames, fight a mysterious villain, and collect gems. Quickly! Before time runs out!

title: 2weistein: The Curse of the Red Dragon 2
description: The unique and fantastic idea behind the series of 2weistein games is to train math in a real 3D action adventure. Embedded in the tantalizing story the player has to solve math quests or puzzles to get ahead in the game. It was developed by game specialists in cooperation with teachers and psychologists and won several prices and awards.

title: BattleBalls
description: Battle Balls is a physics-based arena brawler where you design your own spinning warriors and send it into chaotic fights. Choose your weapon, adjust spin speed, damage, and health, then watch as your creations bounc, slash, and smash their way through the arena.

title: Taco: Princess from the Moon
description: Taco: Princess from the Moon (Nekotako) is a homebrew platformer for the SNES.

title: Castle: Daybreak
description: Embark on an adventure as you unlock new abilities and take on challenging enemies! Explore the open world and survive the night!

title: Battle Brigade
description: Experience the intensity of head-to-head battle with Battle Brigade! Choose from 8 iconic characters, then battle against them with a robust variety of match options.

title: Space X Collector
description: This platform game may be one of the most challenging games you've ever seen in your life.

title: Bot.vinnik Chess: Early USSR Championships
description: All this current chess hype is producing too many know-it-alls. It's time to teach you kids real chess from my fellow masters. Enroll now and you might learn a thing or two.

title: Dungeon Conqueror
description: Dungeon Conqueror is a roguelite where you need to beat each dungeon to advance in the game. buy weapons and armor, evolve your character, complete missions and defeat bosses to achieve the conqueror mode given by each boss.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance - Limited Edition
description: A humble, young blacksmith loses everything to war. As he tries to fulfill the dying wish of his father, Fate drags him into the thick of a conspiracy to save a kidnapped king and stop a bloody conflict. You will wander the world, fighting as a knight, lurking in the shadows as a rogue, or using the bard’s charm to persuade people to your cause.

title: Fire Commander: First Response
description: Lead a team of firefighters against the force of nature! Play the free prologue to Fire Commander, a real time tactical game about the real heroes.

title: Dwarves: Build and survive
description: You have to play as one of the surviving dwarves, take an axe and a hammer in your hands, and start building a new settlement, look for food, and defend against enemies.

title: Pro Pain Labs
description: Pro Pain Labs is a 2D platformer set within a facility designed to test the durability of robots. Hop, skip, and jump your way through levels littered with dangerous hazards to avoid.

title: The Dive
description: Linear underwater horror game about a search dive that quickly turns into fight for survival after an encounter with hellish creature.

title: Twilight Wars: Declassified
description: Twilight Wars is a dungeon crawler in a cyberpunk setting, where teams of secret agents fight for the interests of corporations. Revive a secret organization, recruit and equip a team of specialists - and neutralize those who stand in your way!

title: Hot Wheels: Jetz
description:
A miniature crisis is happening and only you can stop it. Who or what could be trying to take over your home? Jump into your tiny, toy-size plane and fly missions of bravery to solve the mystery and save the day. Perfect your piloting skills as you dodge enemy fire, or command your fighter's missile guidance system to lock-on and crush your opponent. Perform cool aerial stunts as you speed through Jetz's realistic 3-D house. Fly at supersonic speeds using the turbo boost, then stun the enemy by hitting the air brake and stopping on a flying dime.

Hot Wheels Jetz delivers big fun, colorful environments, and a hangar of zippy, toy-size planes. Choose from seven different aircraft, all based on original Hot Wheels Jetz designs. Buzz through eight challenging household environments from the living room to the bedroom and out into the garage. Monitor your hits, missiles, and more with onscreen displays. You'll be asked to accept 10 missions, along with one bonus mission that must be completed to spare your home from certain doom.

title: Record of Battle 3D Maiden Wars
description: This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Eiji Egenesta. Fight your way through horde of robots in this puzzle/RPG.

title: Time Loader: First Memories
description: Time Loader: First Memories is a story-driven puzzle-platformer with tiny robots, alternate realities, nostalgic music, and primitive tech from the 90s!

title: Beat Rush
description: Dodge the spikes and traps!

title: Monster Girl Dungeon
description: You wake up in a mysterious forest filled with monsterrr... girls? What's more, you tried remembering what came before you were in bed, but it just feels like something is blocking your memory somehow. ... perhaps these monster girls have something to do with it?​

title: Modern Combat
description: An ambitious total-conversion modification for Relic's award-winning Company of Heroes, Modern Combat transports players into the midst of a high-tech war between the modern-day People's Liberation Army and United States Armed Forces.

title: Selatria
description: Follow the story of Mage and Melanie as their home, Availia, is threatened by an invading imperial army. These two soon find themselves on the run, recruiting friends in unlikely places to protect their home… and eventually the world.

title: Tremen
description: Fight the hordes of mutants that enslaved humanity through a concrete brutalist hell in this FPS with modern graphics and old school gameplay.

title: Brick Building
description: It´s ideal for collaborative works with students and teachers of universities and colleges, because it’s disruptive and transversal tool for many subjects.

title: Blair Witch: Limited Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:

- Blair Witch
- Luxury Box
- Original Soundtrack on CD (15 tracks)
- Artbook (All colored 52 pages)
- DLC Ticket

title: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom - King's Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom Game Software
- Exclusive making-of Blu-ray disc
- Joe Hisaishi-composed theme vinyl record
- Evolution of a King diorama figure
- 20 cm tall rotating scenes music box that plays the game’s main theme
- Exclusive 148-pages artbook featuring concept art from Yoshiyuki Momose and Level-5
- An exclusive SteelBook case
- Season Pass

title: A Total War Saga: Troy - Amazons
description: Harness the power of the Amazon warriors in the first DLC for A Total War Saga: TROY. Enjoy two new factions; new epic heroes Hippolyta and Penthesilea; new female-only unit rosters; three new faction mechanics; two new epic mission chains, and more!With a Horde army at your side, roam the world and capture new settlements.

title: A Total War Saga: Troy - Ajax & Diomedes
description: Forge your legacy on the Aegean battlefields with the new DLC for A Total War Saga: TROY! Jump into the fray as two of the most iconic heroes of the age, Ajax & Diomedes, with their unique armies, mighty Paragon units, and new methods to conquer Troy.

title: Tank Golfing
description: Have you ever played golf with a tank? Now you can. Tank golfing is a new twist on this classic sport. You try to shoot golf balls with your tank, sounds simple, but requires skill. Laid back, but not easy.

title: Tekken 7: Collector's Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:

- Tekken 7
- 12" x 18" Kazuya & Heihachi Figure
- TEKKEN 7 Original Game Soundtrack
- Steel Book

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Commander Edition
description: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Commander Edition includes a base game, an Art Book, Digital OST, Digital Map, and 4 in-game items: Magnificent Plume Hat, Ratcatcher's Goggles, Dashing Cavalier's Gloves, Righteous Exorcist's Bracers.

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Mythic Edition
description: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Mythic Edition includes a base game, an Art Book, Digital OST, Digital Map, 4 in-game items: Magnificent Plume Hat, Ratcatcher's Goggles, Dashing Cavalier's Gloves, Righteous Exorcist's Bracers and a Season Pass.

title: Office Strike War: Multiplayer Battle Royale
description: Office Strike is a multiplayer Battle Royale game where you can play with up to 24 players against each other in a battle for survival!

title: Ultimate Physical Wrestling
description: A professional wrestling game that can be played with that "ring-shaped controller"! Four wrestlers stand in front of you! Use your own body to make your move!

title: Immortals: Fenyx Rising - Shadowmaster Edition
description: Includes copy of the Immortals Fenyx Rising game and the Hades the Shadowmaster Character Pack.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 2
description: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 2 is the direct sequel to Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX! This new game takes the original speedy and stylish 2D action gameplay to the next level as Copen rips through enemies with his new "Break-Shift" form. His new destructive capabilities makes the high-speed action more satisfying than ever! Experience a new apex of cutting-edge 2D action with Luminous Avenger iX 2!

title: Alt Oxygen
description: Alt Oxygen is a survival game based on an economical design. Beside to survive there is a story to understand what happened and where are you exactly in the universe.

title: Magicka: Free Jolnirs Workshop
description: After some tiring, yet enjoyable, days of commandeering an unwilling workforce, Jólnir - the Crimson King - decided to take the day off. While lounging in his recliner by the fireplace, he fell into the world of dreams. After a rather unpleasant awakening he found himself in a very dangerous place - at the blunt end of a very large club.

title: Farm Day 2021
description: Decorate your town with a lot of beautiful decorations to make your fun farm city unique.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Monte Carlo (Rally Location)
description: With often varying conditions at each starting point (typically comprising of dry tarmac, wet tarmac, snow, and ice, sometimes all in a single stage of the rally), The Monte Carlo Rally will challenge every aspect of your driving ability, and push your driving skills to the limit.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Wales (Rally Location)
description: Situated in the hilly regions of Wales, this rally pushes drivers to the limit as they navigate the often wet and slippery forest sections and high speed sections in between. Receiving little traffic aside from forestry maintenance, the road surface is made up of heavier gravel on a hard-packed road base creating an unforgiving rally.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Lydden Hill, UK (Rallycross Track)
description: Lydden Hill, situated in Kent, England is the birthplace of Rallycross hosting the first ever Rallycross event in 1967, with Vic Elford taking the honours in a Porsche 911. Lydden Hill now traditionally hosts 2 rounds of the British Rallycross Championship along with the UK round of the GRC Rallycross Europe.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Yas Marina Circuit, Abu Dhabi (Rallycross Track)
description: This highly technical and challenging rallycross track sits in the first sector of the Hermann Tilke designed Yas Marina Circuit. The combination of viewing grandstands, wrapped around tight bends and an ultra-fast Joker section provides drivers with thrilling overtaking opportunities.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Bikernieki, Latvia (Rallycross Track)
description: Latvia Rallycross. Recreate the electric atmosphere of the Latvia FIA World RX Championship weekend on the 1.3km track at Bikernieki National Sports Base. The 60% asphalt, high grip, track is located on the outskirts of the Latvian capital Rīga.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Greece (Rally Location)
description: Always presenting itself as one of the most gruelling rally locations on any race calendar, stages in Greece feature dusty roads and hidden rocks, capable of severely damaging cars that cut corners or run too wide in the wrong places. The dusty conditions mean visibility can become an issue for drivers further down the running order.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Killarney International Raceway, South Africa (Rallycross Track)
description: The Killarney circuit is located in Cape Town and was added to the WRX calendar in 2017. The inaugural race was won by Johan Kristoffersson for PSRX, after the notably action packed Semi Finals and Finals.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Germany (Rally Location)
description: Germany presents a tarmac challenge like no other. Race through the flowing, technical tarmac stages of Baumholder, a returning region from the original DiRT Rally. Germany Rally will be accessible through My Team, Custom Championships and Time Trial.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Finland (Rally Location)
description: This is one of the fastest and most renowned rally locations in the world, featuring colossal jumps and blisteringly high average speeds. The thick gravel and the undulating nature of this course mean that car control and balance are especially significant when navigating the Finnish stages.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Estering, Germany (Rallycross Track)
description: Estering hosted its first rallycross event in 1972, and is characterised by its thick gravel sections, difficult Joker Lap and high speed straight, one of the few places where rallycross cars can reach their top speed. Estering draws a large crowd each year, and is acknowledged to be a true fan favourite.

title: DiRT Rally 2.0: Sweden (Rally Location)
description: Take on the twisting snow banks of Värmland in Sweden Rally. A returning favourite from the original DiRT Rally, prepare to race down winding icy roads of Värmland, knowing that even the smallest mistake could end your stage. Sweden Rally will be accessible through My Team, Custom Championships and Time Trial.

title: Gentle Club
description: Gentle Club is a fighting simulator inspired by Hollywood movies, distinguished by the choreographed stunts the players perform while fighting in dynamic and destructible environments.

title: Older
description: Older is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Takashi and is centered around the collection of effects and exploration of a dream world. The game allows saving through the menu, but is primarily done through a typewriter in Takashi's room. Uniquely, the dream world is accessed through a projector.

title: Tec
description: Tec is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. In this game, instead of the bed, Funetsuki opens her dresser/cabinet to enter the dream world. She can save using the computer in her room and has two endings.

title: Obox
description: Obox is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game starts in Ofudatsuki's room, which cannot be exited from. The goal is to explore and collect Gadgets (effects).

title: S//D
description: S//D is a traditional Yume Nikki Fangame. Unlike most Yume Nikki fangames, the Nexus can be accessed immediately by exiting the bedroom. Some NPCs give a fake effect which will trap the player in an enclosed area once it is used and certain chasers and events may cause the player to lose one or all of their effects. The lost effects need to be obtained again from where they're initially found if this happens.

title: The Architect's Game
description: The Architect's Game is a series of online party and deception gamemodes for 4 to 10 players in which you either play the rules or try to check how deep the rabbit's hole goes.

title: Sick Mind
description: Sick Mind is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It plays a bit differently than most Yume Nikki Fangames, in that the Nexus can be entered straight away by exiting the bedroom. The player can save anywhere from the menu or by using the desk in the main character's bedroom. The player can progress through the game by collecting effects and exploring new areas. Additionally, there are a couple of readable books on the bookshelf in the bedroom.

title: Musuu
description: Musuu is a traditional Yume Niki fangame. It stars Rei, a boy refusing to leave his room. Inside the bedroom, you can either save at the desk, turn a space heater on or off, or sleep in the bed to enter the dream world. Uniquely, effects are referred to as Numbers, and allow the main character to match the appearance of the NPC the effect's collected from.

title: Rose Knight and Thorn Witch
description:
Rose Knight and Thorn Witch is a fairy tale yuri visual novel series.

In Chapter One, The Girl who Wanted to Become a Knight, Derin Larkspur longs to leave the Thistle Village behind and journey to the Academy where she will train as a knight. When she hears rumors about a witch living in the woods nearby, she vows to drive the witch away to prove herself as a candidate for the Academy.

But is it a witch in the woods or something else entirely?

title: Yume Nichiroku
description: Yume Nichiroku is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, focusing on exploration and finding effects within the Hirosae's dreamworld, which is ultimately the main goal of the game. A minigame can be played by interacting with the handheld console.

title: Logistical: The Netherlands
description:
Logistical expands into Europe starting with the Netherlands.

Netherlands like what you have been doing down under and would like to use your services. We are overloaded with a national icon and need it distributed badly.
Before you get too carried away you will be required to upgrade a few roads if you want your trucks driving all over the place.

title: Logistical: Germany
description: Over 2600 New towns to Complete. A Large Chemical Spill in the Stuttgart region has created chaos. A full quarantine of ALL products in and out of the Stuttgart region has been put into place. Over 100 towns are within the affected zone. We can get you into the area so you can fix the towns within the zone, and you can move your empty trucks in and out. Small industries have been setup for each type of product within the zone.

title: Logistical 2: France
description: Figure out and schedule cargo deliveries across the country of France to solve the logistical problems. Includes cities like Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Toulouse and many, many more. Over 3000 towns and many logistical puzzles to solve.

title: Logistical 2: Sweden
description: Logistical 2: Sweden has over 2,000 towns and 1,000 businesses to complete.

title: Logistical: New Zealand
description: Logistical has expanded to New Zealand with over 100 new towns to complete. Logistical is a strategy puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the country. The whole game is a huge puzzle while each town is its own little piece of puzzling. Plenty of towns are easy enough.

title: Logistical: Canada
description: Logistical grows in North America with the addition of Canada. Over 800 New towns to Complete. Canada is huge. 2nd biggest country on this planet. Bigger than Australia but many parts not as accessible. That being said, it will take a lot of travel to play this country.

title: Logistical: USA - Hawaii
description: Logistical expands into North America with the islands of Hawaii Over 100 new towns to complete. Hawaii like what you have been doing down under and would like to use your services. Hawaii is built across a series of four major islands as well as others in between. You will need to start adopting new logistical strategies to do this one.

title: Logistical: USA - California
description: Logistical expands through the USA starting with California Over 1000 new towns to complete. California like what you have been doing down under and would like to use your services. California has a wide range of environments from forest, through farmland, huge cities, coastline, oil fields to desert mining.

title: Caucasus: Nanatsuki no Nie
description: There is a small village. One day, two university students visit the village to do research about a local legend handed down from generation to generation. However, they are struck by snowstorm and saved by Benio. They are invited to her mansion and a strange wedding ceremony is held there... If a bride can spend one night in a coffin safely, their marriage will be completed. However, it is all destroyed by someone unknown...

title: Logistical 2: Washington
description: Logistical 2: USA - Washington is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state or country. Hundreds of towns and over 10,000 businesses to complete across Washington, USA. Cities like Seattle, Spokane, Vancouver, Tacoma and many, many more.

title: Logistical: Egypt
description: Logistical expands into Africa with the addition of Egypt. Over 130 New towns to Complete. The annual flooding of the Nile has occurred (Wafaa El-Nil). There is a two weeks holiday for all... except you.

title: Logistical 2
description: LOGistICAL 2 is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state or country. Thousands of towns and thousands of businesses to complete across the world. Many free sub-modules to get you started.

title: Nagomibako Innocent Grey Fandisc
description: Innocent Grey fandisc featuring short stories and mini-games based on Innocent Grey works such as Cartagra and PP-pianisimo-.

title: Home Game
description: Home Game is about the hermit at home. Explore town, find ways into buildings, die horribly, fail utterly, cash cans for change, regret your decisions in life. The game features magic spells, a cat, rude people, demons and death. You can pass through solid objects. You can help end this world. You may grow flowers in your garden, as well as feed birds. It has rain SFX.

title: Alive Arrow
description: Alive Arrow is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The goal is to explore and collect effects in Fin's dreamworld, which you can enter interacting with the TV.

title: Home Game 2
description:
Home Game 2 is about the hermit selling his home.
Explore town, hop fences to enter yards, acquire cursed swords, ruin your mood by mis-using magic spells, die over and over and over again. Never find your way.
This hectic masocore features scrolls, portals, demons and death.
Drink coffee across 8 levels and try to survive your stalker.
Achieve a perfect homesense score.
Can you reach the truest ending?

title: Yume no Tsubasa
description: Yume no Tsubasa is an adventure game, developed and published by KID, which was released in Japan in 2000.

title: Phantom Hysteria
description:
Phantom Hysteria is a 1-4 player, online co-op ghost hunting game. Take on ghost-hunting contracts with your taped-together equipment as one of four playable P.I.N.E characters. Hone your skills for your designated class, utilize an array of equipment to decipher your clues, and use that to identify your contracted apparition.

Choosing from a variety of thrilling maps; you and your team will be required to investigate your phantom, untether them, and neutralize the phantom from this plane. That is if you can manage.

title: Ooe
description: Ooe is the latest period psychological horror mystery from ADELTA, developers of Hashihime of the Old Book Town and UUUltraC. A classic closed-circle mystery set on a remote island in 1950s Japan—revel in the intrigue and perverse pleasure of being deceived by the people you trust the most!

title: Arctictopia
description: Arctictopia is a puzzle-solving game in the Arctic Ocean. Figure out routes and plan your moves to help mama polar bear find her cub on the melting ice.

title: Grimm: Episode 3 - The Fisherman and His Wife
Grimm: Episode 7 - The Devil and His Three Golden Hairs
description: Episode 7 of Grimm - The Devil and His Three Golden Hairs

title: Grimm: Episode 8 - Beauty and the Beast
description: Grimm episode 8 - Beauty and the Beast

title: Grimm: Episode 21 - Sleeping Beauty
description: Grimm - Episode 21 - Sleeping Beauty

title: Blackberry the Witch: Journey
description: Embark on an adventure with the young witch Blackberry!

title: The Guardians of Peace
description: The Guardians of Peace is a sci-fi adventure, your goal is to save Hastina-Poora from the corruption of the darkling hordes. This unique society harnesses the seven energies of the universe and uses them in their advanced tech to live in harmony with the rest of the universe.

title: Gear Tunnel
description: Moving all the time is your only chance to survive. How long can you move?

title: Turtle vs. Portal
description: One of the twin turtles is trying to save his brother which was abducted by a monster. He decided to go after the monster via the portal system. When he exits from the portal system, things were different. He finds some surprising facts to move next in every level.

title: Red Rage
description: Red Rage is a gory, wave-based zombie FPS with a unique art variety of maps and unlockable weapons, where the player's objective is to reach the highest score before they die in order to unlock increasingly powerful guns.

title: Monster Shooter
description: Monster Shooter is a 3rd person point-based shooter in which you are humanity's last hope to protect your military base and the resources collected on the planet Hoperium against the Roncospheres. Take control and defend every part of the facility. Humanity depends on you!

title: -1: Minus Ichi
description: -1 is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, where you explore Sonoko's dreams, a girl who's falling asleep while travelling on a bus to an unknown destination.

title: Kyomu
description: Kyomu is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, where you explore Moyatsuki daydreams and collect effects.

title: Narrow Escape
description: Narrow Escape is an indie horror game in which you try to escape from different buildings alone or with up to three other players without being killed by a monster.

title: Yume Utsutsu
description: Yume Utsutsu is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It stars a young girl known as Utsutsuki, who wanders through worlds in her dreams, where you can collect effects. It tends to follow along some of the darker themes with unsettling music and worlds.

title: Hide & Seek
description: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.

title: Yume Noroi
description: Yume Noroi is a traditional Yume Nikki fangames, being the main objective collecting effects in Tsumetogi's dreams.

title: Love and Romance: A Study of Intimacy
description:
Amelia Waters is a brilliant 26-year-old romance writer, who, after years of hard dedication and work, became the top romance novelist of the millennium. However, she has always felt that something was wrong with her writing, and after reading her books again, she found won’t what it was: the sex scenes were garbage. In need to fix this issue, Amelia talks to her manager and agent, Lee Yoon Ho, and asks for help. He manages to grab keys to a cabin, isolated from society, and takes her there for a week to help her get her head in the game and for her to practice writing about sex.

When she hits a brick wall, Lee offers to help her again… with his body.

title: Madoro-Mu
description: Madoro-Mu is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Isokishi who, unlike most fangames, uses her bed to save and exits her room directly to the Nexus. Rather than having a nexus full of doors, Isokishi's nexus consists of three windows. One is nailed shut until later in the game. There is little to no sound in the game.

title: Muyuu
description: Muyuu is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It plays like most Yume Nikki fangames, focusing on exploration and collecting effects in Furatsuki's dreams. A unique feature about Muyuu is its multiple stage minigame containing herself.

title: Yume no Mata Yume
description: Yume no Mata Yume is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, starring Mukatsuki. It plays like most fangames, focusing on exploration in the character's dreams, but Mukatsuki can actually leave his room. He appears to be in some sort of hospital, and can go into other rooms.

title: Kind Heart
description: Kind Heart is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame in which the Aitsuki refuses to leave her room and instead explores her dream world with the goal of collecting effects. Kind Heart has various childish, simple worlds with themes such as school or fruits.

title: Amnesia
description:
Amnesia is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, the main goals are collecting effects and viewing events to try and piece together Toritsuki's past, and how and why she died. There are several NPCs and events that seem to give hints on Toritsuki's life before the game.
There is also a minigame, NEZU, that can be played on a handheld console in the bedroom.

title: Zombeez: A Killer Queen Remix
description:
The first single-player Killer Queen experience comes home! ZOMBEEZ: A Killer Queen Remix is a frantic 2D platformer built directly on top of the Killer Queen Arcade engine. Run, fly, and slay your way through the undead horde as you head towards a fated showdown with the terrifying Blood Queen!

Built directly on top of the Killer Queen engine, ZOMBEEZ: A Killer Queen Remix takes the skills and techniques found in Killer Queen and applies them to an entirely new experience, full of never-before-seen enemies and challenges. As the titular hero, Abs, you'll run, fly, and slay your way through the undead horde as you head towards a fated showdown with the terrifying, all-powerful Blood Queen!

title: Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life
description: Ayumu Kasuga's Mail Order Life is a fanmade interactive Osaka simulator from hirahira.net for PC. Osaka spends time in her room and occasionally walks out, possibly to a part-time job. Afterwards, she comes back with money used by the player to buy various items that appear on TV along with Chiyo-chichi.

title: Boys Be
description: Boys Be is a PlayStation game based off the manga of the same name.

title: Farfalle OS
description:
Farfalle OS is a narrative-driven pasta-based operating system experience. If you like hacknet, visual novels, or interactive fiction, this game is for you!

It's tough to jump into a new Operating System. Especially when the everyone is counting on you! Join Lead Developer Joey Pistachio as he guides you through the Farfalle OS terminal system in his quest to get his game to the production server.

The true ending happens after the call finishes. Can you achieve it?

title: Doki Doki Anomaly
description: A weird dating-sim where you can fall in love with the monsters from SCP lore. SCP-8008-1 IS A COGNITOHAZARDOUS DATING SIM. Do not run this software without Class-4 Authorization. If you do not know why you are seeing this warning alert your local authorities IMMEDIATELY.

title: Road Trip
description: Road Trip is a road trip simulator. In the game you will find beautiful locations, interesting levels, as well as various weather phenomena!

title: Vast Trivia of the Void
description:
Put your knowledge of several topics to the test! Sports, history, science, anime, video games and more! But since Thing of the Void thought that just knowing wasn’t fun enough, move around in his playground, collecting cards and increasing your combo! Cash out or go deeper, for higher rewards but possibly higher risks! Monetary, of course!

Do you have what it takes to make it big at the biggest game show from the darkest pits of the universe?

title: Inspiration
description:
Inspiration is one of the first non-Japanese Yume Nikki fangames. The game centers around a reclusive artist named Alex, who appears to live alone. His computer has broken down, so he has been reduced to reading books he has grown tired of and sleeping to explore his dream world.

Inspiration also makes use of character dialogue, which helps gain an insight into the mind of Alex and figures he sees in his dreams. Interacting with certain objects in the real world bedroom sometimes make Alex speak his thoughts on them.

title: NostAlgic
description: nostAlgic is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It is known for its very light color scheme and for having a generally more optimistic take on a Yume Nikki-based exploration game, with A's dreams being rather light and childlike.

title: Yume Aruki
description:
Yume Aruki is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The main objective is exploring Twill's dreams and collecting effects.

Notably absent from this game are aggressive NPCs, extensive events, and the horror overtones from both Yume Nikki and its many fangames. The game draws heavily on animal, tropical, and desert imagery.

title: Fantasy Tennis 2
description:
Fantasy tennis is an unique 3D anime based fantasy mmo developed by T3 Entertainment and published by Alaplaya.

There are many unique features in fantasy tennis, one is that players can have own NPC friends, after player has fully filled the skill cauge (it is filled by every shot), player can perform character's special attack, that is called "Skill Shot". This skill shot is usually hard to hit, so it is useful when facing hard situtations.

There is also feature that allows player to use "battlemons" those things are players "pets" that can be used in battlemon mode, these "pets" are players double partners in this mode, every Battlemon has its own very special advantages and disadvantages, battlemons can be purchased in the shop, the lifespan is 30 days but it can be increased by using items like "Leaf of Life Juice", battlemons powers can also decrease when through the playing, but can be increased again by feeding your battlemon.

When playing the game players can gain ranks, when leveling up, after every level up, players status points can be increased.

title: Hallucigenia
description: Hallucigenia is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It stars two young girls named Aya and Aine. Unlike most fangames, Hallucigenia lacks background music, and has only a handful of sound effects.

title: Rein
description: rein, to constrain or be guided by constraint, is a game about survival, escape and medical research! (mostly survival).

title: Kudaranu Mousou No
description:
Kudaranu Mousou No is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Kazaguruma and Jose.

Unlike other fangames, Kudaranu Mousou No introduces the concept of linear locations. Instead of exploring the entire dream world at once, the player is required to enter worlds and collect effects one at a time in order to reach an ending.

The initial version was created with RPG Maker 2000, but later (Ver.0.03) the game was renewed with WOLF RPG Editor.

title: Yume wa Maeyono
description: Yume wa Maeyono is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play a boy named Yoruzuki who stays in his room and refuses to go out.. The goal in the dream world is to explore and collect effects. Interacting with the music pod allows you to listen to music from the game.

title: Tsukumono Yume
description: Tsukumono Yume is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. There are two playable characters, Kozuki and Amatsuki. There are several endings that can be gotten with Amatsuki, depending on how many NPCs are killed, how many times the player is caught by chasers and whether or not certain events were seen.

title: Yume Kayoi
description: Yume Kayoi is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You can play as two girls named Kotozuki and Satotsuki, who stay in different apartments and can't leave their rooms.

title: Big Beautiful Cthulhu
description:
An arcade style 2.5D game where the player plays as Cthulhu, eating planets to get larger, whilst avoiding black holes and stars.

This game was made by a two man team for the Epic MegaJam 2021, with the theme 'running out of space'.

title: Eternity Egg
description: Chaotic adventure-platformer with pilotable mechs, grotesque characters & high-energy trance music.

title: Crypto Cars World
description:
Crypto Cars World is a video game base don NFT blockchain technology, inspired by Need for Speed or Gran Turismo, in which players compete in race within circuits where the fastest is the winner.

You can choose to be a mechanic, a racer or BOTH!!

title: Grim Tranquility
description: Grim Tranquility is a sci-fi-themed roguelite, tactics-based RPG where you explore alien worlds and battle vicious enemies in your quest to establish the first human settlement in space. Will humanity finally learn from their past mistakes or are they doomed to repeat the avoidable tragedies of their ancestors?

title: FeralHeart
description:
FeralHeart is the official replacement of KovuLKD's old game Impressive Title.

FeralHeart is an online animal based roleplaying game and chat where you choose what kind of feral you'll be. Create your character and explore worlds with it in this 3D game and maybe even make friends on the way.

title: Impressive Title
description: Impressive Title was a 3D RPG inspired by The Lion King.

title: Glob Dash
description: Speedrun to get the best time you can on each stage. Optimize your route to get faster and unlock more skins, but be careful to not punch your monitor out of pure rage.

title: Storror Parkour Pro
description: Escape Reality. The ultimate multiplayer parkour experience. Escape, race, and explore the streets and rooftops of London’s Isle of Dogs. Join team STORROR to save your estate, or challenge your friends to test their skills. STORROR Parkour Pro is complete control and freedom of movement.

title: Soukou Akki Muramasa: Shokuzai-hen
description:
Originally a piece of fan writing that won a contest, receiving a visual novel adaptation by Nitroplus.

A short, free story that continues after the true end of the main visual novel.

title: Hitler Hates Anime
description: Take Adolf Hitler under your control and with the power of mighty dildo destroy all naughty anime girls!

title: Blasphemer
description: Blasphemer is a project to create a free software/open source Heretic IWAD file. Combined with the free source code, this results in a complete Doom-based game. This is the Heretic equivalent to Freedoom.

title: Secret Trouble
description: A totally ordinary, average wizard is having problems with some troublesome magical artifacts. One of those troublesome magical beings is you. Try and juggle as much as you can and earn as much points as you can.

title: #21: The World
description: #21: The World is a surrealistic exploration game based on developer's dream journal. The game is heavily inspired by Osamu Sato's LSD Dream Emulator.

title: Street Dreams
description: Street Dreams is a fast-paced VR action FPS set in a psychedelic dream world. Evade opponents in a high-speed car chase using a variety of weapons at your disposal.

title: Fursan al-Aqsa: The Knights of the Al-Aqsa Mosque
description: Fursan al-Aqsa: The Knights of the Al-Aqsa Mosque is an Action Game on which you play as Ahmad al-Falastini, a young Palestinian Student who was unjustly tortured and jailed by Israeli Soldiers for 5 years, had all his family killed by an Israeli Airstrike and now, after getting out from prison, seeks revenge against those who wronged him, killed his family and stolen his homeland, by joining a new Palestinian Resistance Movement called Fursan al-Aqsa: The Knights of the Al-Aqsa Mosque.

title: Somnium
description: You trapped in an infinite dream loop. To reach the morning, you must carefully observe your surroundings.

title: Neko Yume
description: Neko Yume is an ambient exploration game heavily inspired by games like LSD Dream Emulator and Yume Nikki. Explore a cat-filled dream with a day/night cycle and dozens of randomized events. Even if you have explored an area once, there is no guarantee that it will be the same upon your return.

title: My Village Life
description: My Village Life is a open world village simulator vehicle driving game.

title: Of Light & Shadow
description:
Of Light & Shadow is an award winning sidescrolling puzzle platformer for PC and Mac released under CC BY-NC-ND. The game combines two areas in each level, light and shadow, as well as two protagonists in one playable character, Mr. Light and Dr. Shadow. While either can only survive in light or shadow areas respectively, the player has to constantly switch between them and make the right decision about whose abilities to utilise.

Of Light & Shadow was achieved as a final project at the Salzburg University of Applied Sciences by a team of students called 12 Angry Devs.

title: First Land
description: A story of human connection.

title: Ame Koi
description:
Ame Koi is an erotic visual novel developed by Noesis.

It was the last title released by the brand before the departure of Coffee Kizoku, which resulting in its closure.

title: Mr. Krabs Tax Evasion
description: Play as Mr. Krabs in this Epic third person shooter. Experience a heartfelt story exploring themes of friendship, loss and gratitude all while evading the IRS.

title: The Lonely Helmet
description: In a galaxy far far away, there was a collection of helmets. Some were stronger than others, some were smaller and some were bigger, but all helmets had a purpose - to protect their space-human and allow them to breath outside of the Universe.

title: Mong Jung Mong
description: Mong Jung Mong is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, the main goal being to explore the dream world and collect Effects. The protagonist is Lee Jin Hui, a girl refusing to leave her room.

title: The Looking Glass
description:
The Looking Glass is a Yume Nikki fangame that features spoken dialogue and flavortext when interacting with objects and characters. The game also features light adventure elements, such as simple puzzles and increased interactivity in the normal world. Unlike most fangames the player character is capable of leaving her room, and begins the game in her classroom at her school.

You play as Irene, who discovers a hidden world after falling through her mirror. The game follows her as she explores this new world after coming home from school.

title: Withers
description: Withers is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame where you play as Yakitsuki, the goal is to explore and find all the effects.

title: Yuque
description: Yuque is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. Sleeping in the bed lets you enter Nire's dream world. From there, you can explore various worlds and collect effects called Buffers.

title: Ephemreal
description: Ephemreal is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Sumitsuki and explore her dreams to collect effects.

title: If...
description: If - Invitations from Fantastic stories is a erotic game developed by Active.

title: DreaMarbleng
description:
DreaMarbleng is a Yume Nikki fangame, based upon Irotsuki's dreams. As opposed to most fangames, instead of refusing to leave her room, the protagonist refuses to leave her house.

Every time Irotsuki sleeps, you earn 1 Credit as "money" of this game, which can redeem a game guide or a single-time speed boost from the desk in real world.

title: N'Oubliez Jamais
description:
N'Oubliez Jamais is a Yume Nikki fangame, known for its unique, realistic approach to the dream system. As opposed to having a single, interconnected dream world, the player is randomly placed in a linear set of locations, the end of the dream depending on the choices of the player.

The game stars Al Ree, who, unlike many protagonists, lives in a three-room apartment with his parents and cat, and is able to exit his home.

title: Hana no Chiruramu
description: Hana no Chiruramu is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game contains various references to Japanese culture. You play as a girl named Kodama, who is either trapped inside or refusing to leave an empty classroom.

title: Yume Tagai
description:
Yume Tagai is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game's first act is centered around Makitsuki, a girl living in a small abandoned room who cannot leave.
Upon accomplishing a series of tasks, Sakiyuk becomes a playable character. From this point onwards, you can alternate between her and Makitsuki by waking up, with the dream world's bedroom being the main area.

title: moonLessL
description: moonLess*L is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Oborogi and Michitsuki, two girls living in an apartment. Both characters are able to leave their respective rooms and enter other rooms on the floor, as well as some on the ground floor below and in the basement, beside exploring their dreams.

title: Ill Ness
description: "Ill Ness" was inspired by Stephen King’s science fiction horror novel called Dreamcatcher.

title: Lost Game
description:
Lost † Game is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. Unlike most Yume Nikki fangames, the main character, Sakura, is already dreaming. She seems to be trapped in a dream world full of strange creatures. The chasers, known as reapers or "death gods", can harm Sakura directly.

Outside of minimal dialogue, Lost † Game is unique in its use of a Game Over system upon being captured by a chaser or otherwise trapped. To compensate for this, the player can save at any time from the menu. To reach the ending, all thirteen Symbols must be collected and placed in the coffins seen at the start of the game.

title: Miso Nikki
description:
Miso Nikki is a Japanese Yume Nikki Fangame developed by an anonymous 2ch member, referencing a meme on the site.

You play as Misotsuki and the goal is to collect 6 Miso (orbs) along with effects to see the ending. In this game, effects cannot be held in the inventory and are therefore collected one at a time.

title: Witoru
description:
Witoru / Neta Dream is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Yon Goh and seems to be a parody of other Yume Nikki fangames. It is one of the the first fangames to have a male protagonist, as well as one of the first to feature dialogue.

It is slightly different than most fangames but it still heavily focuses on exploration and collecting Effects, as well as containing puzzles and battles. In addition, there is an option to buy items, with some being consumables that increase stats and others which are essential for progressing the game.

title: Saigo no Uta
description:
Saigo no Uta is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The player starts as a girl named Kuroyuri and can travel to her dream world by sleeping in the bed. The goal is to explore and find effects.

After the player has achieved the "Game Over" ending, the game will switch to Ciste, a girl who appears in Kuroyuri's dream. Ciste's segment is similar to Kuroyuri's in that the player must enter the dream world and collects effects. In the dream room, there is a radio that allows the player to listen the game's BGM.

title: StreamInk
description: StreamInk is a tool that allows you to play conversational adventures in your Twitch Streams. Your viewers can vote and decide how the story progresses.

title: Plant vs Undead
description:
Grow your NFT Plants to defend your Mother Tree against fearsome Undead
Farming to earn more real PVU.

title: Let Me Die inside
description: The characters of Let Me Die (inside) have fallen into despair head over heels, so they want to leave this world and end their lives. Your duty is to fulfil their wish. In every level, the player is expected to find a way to die, but before that, he has to complete the death wishes of the character.

title: Tag Royale
description: A classic game of Tag with a battle royale twist. Everyone is your friend until they are IT. I hope you enjoy the views but be worried about those who are around you. They may betray you while using a power-up that can tag you and eliminate you from the game

title: Mini Island: Autumn
description: Mini Island: Autumn is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty!

title: Night Darkness
description: You have to take control of one of the most famous mercenaries and complete a special mission to save humanity from certain death.

title: Eyeballs are your Enemies!
description: Don't let The RulerEye establish his new reign of terror! Eliminate all eyes, collect the rewards and achieve new records!

title: You Must
description: In the social network, the main character plays the quest "Hide and Seek", but this time the organizers decided to move the quest to the real world. They indicate the coordinates of the place where the quest item was hidden, the one who finds it first will receive a cash prize.

title: Unnatural Freaks: Episode 1 Wolf At Evergreen
description: A supernatural-mystery, interactive-narrative VR experience. Are the rumours of a werewolf sighting true? Talk with townspeople and explore the museum to discover what's truly happening in the small town of Evergreen.

title: Verdict
description: Establish your written character in a world of many. Craft, fight, and befriend your way to the top against real players, all of which have their own goals and their own motives. Become the leader of a country- slay titans- create new magic- and more.

title: Towers Inc.
description: Build and manage your own corporate tower in this minimalist take on the tower building genre. Satisfy the needs of renters and keep them happy by adding services and utilities while balancing finances. Build and manage your tower the way you want to.

title: Airplane Tycoon
description: Airline Tycoon is a business simulation game by Thomas Holz and Robert Kleinert, in which the player must successfully manage an airline. The original was developed by Spellbound Entertainment, and published by Infogrames Deutschland, however, the succeeding versions were published by a variety of publishers.

title: Wild West Rogue
description: Wild West Rogue is a Top Down shooter game in which you need to shoot back from enemies, dodge traps, flying projectiles, look for ways out of intricate mazes and pump up your skills with the help of ancient power.

title: Neondrops
description: Turn your mice and keyboards into independent midi controllers or synthesizers. Use virtual ports to send MIDI to your DAW or plug in your own MIDI keyboard. Sampling functionality included.

title: Ball Bounce Maze
description: Ball Bounce Maze is a randomized physics-based puzzle game in which you make the ball bounce around until it hits the target without hitting the obstacles, walls, ceiling, or floor. Easy? No! With different scoring categories, you can spend all night trying to get a new best score.

title: Dice of Knights
description: Roll the dice, swing the sword and let the magic talk!

title: Yarn
description: In Yarn you play as a kitty, While playing with a special purple yarn ball, the kitty knocks it out into the world and sets out to recover it.

title: A Princess of Fallen Kingdom
description: 王国遭偷袭而隕落，勇士與青梅竹馬的公主被迫賣身淪落為奴隸，一夜之間一無所有。二人為了贖回自由身而在流放地努力工作，在冒险中互相救贖，同時也漸漸地揭開了事件真相的面紗……

title: Chicken Defender
description: Test your skills in this 2.5D, low-poly tower defense game. Your objective is to protect a chicken coop from the attacks of the cunning foxes using different items and power-ups. The possibility of modifying your approach before each wave leads to the existence of multiple winning strategies.

title: Eternal Warfare
description: Eternal Warfare is a turn-based strategy and war game where you harvest resources, build an army, and then destroy your opponents! Starting with a single building, construct production facilities, advance your tech level, and then fight through land, sea and air, until you emerge victorious!

title: Three Kingdom: The Journey
description: Three Kingdom: The Journey is an deck build roguelike game, fight to the end or journey back are all on your choices.

title: Deathly Stillness
description: The appearance of zombie, broke the quiet life, the only way is to eliminate them! Watch your bullet count Killing a single zombie will make it easy for you to complete the task, but surrounded by zombies will kill you

title: Danger: Electric Shock
description: A simple action puzzle game. Carry the rod to the finish line while avoiding the dangerous traps!!

title: Kingdom of Assetia: The Clicker Game
description: In Kingdom of Assetia: The Clicker Game you'll be assuming the role of the Mayor of Anywhere. After a disastrous flood hit the former prime adventuring hub you'll be working on restoring the village.

title: Hidden Object: Detective Holmes - Heirloom
description: Arthur Conan Doyle's detectives are conducting a new investigation! Train your brain with the best classic hidden object detective game!

title: Above the Skies
description: Dylan is the head of a small village and captain of The Eagle and he takes it upon himself to find The Grail and stop the Falls, saving those he cares for. The journey will be long and perilous, but the whole world above the skies depends on it.

title: Pixasso 3
description: "PIXASSO 3" - is a final chapter of relaxing franchise for lovers of the coloring pixel art. New game mode! New colors! New pictures! Have fun!

title: Tengin Music Engine
description: Tengin Music Engine is a psychedelic rhythm shooter that uses AI to adapt to any song. Designed to induce a trance-like state and get you totally in the zone, this free FPS has online co-op multiplayer and is perfect for training your aim, exploring new music, or simply vibing out.

title: YuuYuu Jiteki no Yuukarin
description: The story of Yuuka Kazami, the flower master of the four seasons who loves "flowers" more than anyone else in the world. A game that seems easy? A game that looks kind? Don't be fooled by the appearance. Please enjoy the world of adventure that becomes harsh as you progress to the end.

title: Fake Hostel
description: Fake Hostel this is exciting, puzzle game with Fancy Girls. Control your tube and find the way to pass the level and unlock a lot of beauty in the gallery

title: The Cruel kings
description: The Cruel kings is a top-down game in which you must either kill or survive. Each round starts with a split screen. The goal of the players is to destroy each other in 1 minute. There are also coins. If the players have an equal amount of life, then the one who collected the most coins wins.

title: Robosnow
description: Robosnow is a casual racing game. Collect bonuses to increase your speed. Challenge yourself in a new personal record time with precise turns and obstacle avoidance.

title: Puzzle Fever
description: Puzzle fever - Endless game for puzzle lovers! Place figures on the playing field to fill in lines and get coins and points for successful combinations, use bonuses in difficult situations and conquer point records!

title: Vazial Saga XX
description: Brainwash the fools, exploit taxes, strengthen your armaments, prosper your descendants, and conquer the world!

title: Food Delivery Battle
description: Hello, drivers! Have you ever wanted to play a game with your own original character? Well, “Food Delivery Battle” is your answer. “Food Delivery Battle” is a delivery game that is compatible with VRoidHub.

title: Neutron and the Tri-Spark
description: Neutron is an action maze runner where you will guide our hero on an adventure to collect the energy orbs of the Tri-Spark while avoiding capture by the security bots.

title: Two Hundred Ways
description: 200 tricky levels to solve in Two Hundred Ways. The goal is to make the ball(s) reach its goal(s). That will be hard because of up to three layers and a lot of traps. To finish the levels, you have some resources but only a limited budget. Think outside the box to have benefits.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Autumn 2021
description: Puzzles about Autumn!

title: Fantasy Sliding Puzzle
description: Challenging sliding puzzles with various levels of difficulty, featuring epic fantasy female characters.

title: 1001 Jigsaw Detective
description: Reveal fantastic secrets with 1001 Jigsaw Detective. 500 detective puzzles!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Tuwhena Volcano
description: What if you could ride a Roller Coaster just like the ones in Roller Coasters' Parks from real life in the middle of a Volcano? Yeah, that is Tuwhena Volcano. Epic Roller Coasters is a game with themed and realistic roller coasters with three different modes: casual, race and shooter.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Great Canyon
description: What adventure can I go in a canyon? In a hang glider? On a speedboat? No, on a roller coaster!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Snow Land
description: Snow land roller coaster for Epic Roller Coasters.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Wyvern Siege
description: Wyvern Siege is a medieval ride for Epic Roller Coasters!Here you'll take a ride between warriors fighting and dragons spreading fire!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Haunted Castle
description: A classic ride on a ghost train. Epic Roller Coasters is a game with themed and realistic roller coasters with three different modes: casual, race and shooter. You can choose companions to go with on the rides and even take selfies and photos to share on social medias. It is fun for the whole family and friends!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: T-Rex Kingdom
description: T-Rex Kingdom is a ride for Epic Roller Coasters between the Age of Dinosaurs.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Armageddon
description: Post-apocalyptic ride for Epic Roller Coasters.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Neon Rider
description: Neon Rider is a Sci-fi theme ride for Epic Roller Coasters.Start with a handmade cinematic between robots that just became evil and go straight forward in a roller coaster throughout a futuristic city in a raining day!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Twilight
description: Try this crazy and fast ride in the twilight. Epic Roller Coasters is a game with themed and realistic roller coasters with three different modes: casual, race and shooter. You can choose companions to go with on the rides and even take selfies and photos to share on social medias. It is fun for the whole family and friends!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Oasis
description: Usually an Oasis is a place to relax... But, we managed to change that.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Lost Forest
description: Lost Forest is a action ride for Epic Roller Coasters.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: North Pole
description: The place where christmas is all year. Epic Roller Coasters is a game with themed and realistic roller coasters with three different modes: casual, race and shooter. You can choose companions to go with on the rides and even take selfies and photos to share on social medias. It is fun for the whole family and friends!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Halloween
description: Halloween roller coaster for Epic Roller Coasters.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Dread Blood
description: Dread Blood is a horror ride for Epic Roller Coasters.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Space Station
description: Find out if the B4T astronauts can fix the space station.

title: Go! Go! Nippon! 2015
description: A standalone expansion of Go! Go! Nippon! that nearly doubles the content of the original game––adding new locations like Tokyo Skytree, Odaiba, Comiket, and more! The expansion renders the game in 720p widescreen format, with both new and old CGs in the new aspect ratio.

title: Go! Go! Nippon! 2016
description:
A new standalone expansion of Go! Go! Nippon! that includes 50% more content, including new sightseeing locations and love interest events.

New shitamachi locations and historical Japanese gardens have also been added for those who want a greater taste of traditional Japan, as well as new types of scenes such as Japanese culture workshops. An improved "wallet" system has been added to help you keep track of things you've bought, adding a new layer of realism to the sightseeing experience!

title: Minton Keibu no Sousa File Doukeshi Satsujin Jiken
description: A summer resort town Brighton stands not far from London, with a small circus troupe becomes the main attraction of the season. Just a day before the premiere clown Charles Dubois is found dead in a shower wagon, the cause of death is a knife strike from the back. Star as the detective who is called from London to resolve this case.

title: Clannad: Lost Winter
description: A fan-made kinetic novel based on Key/VisualArts' CLANNAD, continuing Ushio's path.

title: A Time of Life
description: A short ~5 minute romance Visyal novel set in the Rebuild of Evangelion universe, "A Time of Life" helps bridge a critical divide between Evangelion 2.22 You Can (Not) Advance and Evangelion 3.33 You Can (Not) Redo. Told from the perspective of Mari Illustrious Makinami.

title: Marry Me, Misato!
description: You are the hero, whose only love is Misato decides to marry her. But it's obvious - she is an anime character, how can you marry her then? However, your love is so strong... And you have a plan...

title: A Curious Pastime
description: You are a young person of the Fir Cruthen, the mightiest (and drunkenest) nation of the Warhost. You've ventured forth to join the Warhost and make a mighty name for yourself.
