You'll do this by completing an increasingly arbitrary, never ending, serious of inane puzzles; given to you by a colourful cast of characters doing terrible Scottish accents. Will you be able to rise above the status of Background Noob and earn a name for yourself? Unlikely, you'll probably be dead before the weekend's over.

title: Bustin' the Bastille
description:
The year is 1789. Anger is simmering and people take the street, they protest against the priviliges of the nobility and the clergy. The revolution is coming. It will bring liberty, fraternity, equality, and lots and lots of beheadings!
And unbeknownst to her, a fishmonger with a mid-life crisis finds herself in the middle of it all.

title: Absurdistan
description:
Absurdistan is a partially text-based, side-scrolling adventure game featuring simplistic graphics.

You play as Leszek, a young Absurdani, who, just like his family, is fed up with the regime imposed by the Party. But, dear Adventure Gamer, fear nothing! Despite the seemingly gloomy setting, the game doesn't intend to get you down, as its main goal is to poke fun at many absurdities of the daily life in a totalitarian-communist state.

The game features a whole variety of puzzles, which, unlike the state of Absurdistan, do make sense. Some of them may even require you to grab something to write and figure them out in real life.

title: My Best Nightmare
description: The quest with psychological horror elements, nice pixel art, and a non-linear story.

title: Tux and Fanny
description: Tux and Fanny just want to play soccer but their soccer ball is deflated. Go on an epic adventure to help them inflate their ball. Play as both Tux and Fanny as well as a cat and a flea. All four characters will have to work together if you're going to inflate the ball.

title: Forty Thieves Solitaire Collection
description: Do you love Forty Thieves Solitaire (also known as "Napoleon at St Helena" or "Big Forty"), but want a bigger challenge? Now you can play Forty Thieves Solitaire and other popular variants with different levels of difficulty.

title: Cave of Avarice
description: A former Dahomey Amazon turned mercenary has been hired by two explorers for leading them to a cave said to contain a great treasure. The mercenary has been tasked with guarding the entrance while the two explorers enter, but as gunshots are heard from within only to be followed by silence, the mercenary chooses to investigate...

title: Centipede: Recharged
description: The original bug-blasting arcade game is back! Centipede: Recharged has been reimagined for modern gameplay, with vibrant visuals designed for modern screens, a 16:9 field of play, and an original soundtrack from award-winning video game composer Megan McDuffee. Aim for a high score in the old school arcade mode and earn bragging rights with your name at the top of the leaderboard. Or test your skills and rank on the boards in one of 30 intensely creative challenges, which twist the gameplay in new and exciting ways. A dozen new power-ups can give you an edge by introducing abilities like screen-clearing explosions, rail guns, and even slowing down time. Every mode and level is playable in local co-op mode with a friend.

title: Chance of the Dead
description: Five years after her demise, Janet Burdie is granted a "night out" to make her greatest wish come true: Submitting her signature cake to the famous C3 baking competition!

title: Charlie Foxtrot & The Galaxy of Tomorrow
description:
A rebel clone meets a zany galaxy in this high-intensity sci-fi parody. Hundreds of animations, spectacular humour, full sound-track and a bunny's lair worth of easter eggs make this game a must play!

You play Charlie Foxtrot, a clone who rebels against conformity. Undertaking an intergalactic quest so that he can assert his autonomy, Charlie travels to strange planets inhabited by dozens of parodied sci-fi characters. The humour is somewhere between Space Quest and Red Dwarf, but the adventure is beyond comparison.

title: Build & Battle
description: Build&Battle is a turn-based tower defense with classic rts base building elements. Build your maze of towers, lay out your plan of attack and execute it with the next turn.

title: Drowned Helicopter
description: Drowned Helicopter is a 2d side-scroller game in which the player controls a helicopter, rescuing residents from flooding, dodging tall buildings, flying debris, and escaping from a downpour, he must be able to survive to the end.

title: Lost Kittens: Maze Garden
description: Find and save the kittens lost in the maze. This is a cute and relaxing game, but it will challenge your memory and hand coordination.

title: The Dark Way
description: The Game Revolves around a person who had an accident on a road and around a mysterious village find out by yourself what is happening!

title: Viral Firar
description: Viral Virar is an arcade running game. Try to reach the longest distance using the features of different YouTubers, earn more with each run and improve your characters.

title: Bad Bots Battle Arena
description: Enjoy Battle Bot Style Of Robot Fighting In Wide Battle Arena!

title: Clarence Goes to the F%ing Store
description: An absurdist comedy choose-your-own-adventure game featuring a massive cast of bizarre characters, notebook-doodle visuals, and 7 crazy endings! As you embark on your quest to go to the store, the denizens of this zany town will seek your help with their insane problems.

title: NeverDeath
description: NeverDeath is a fighting game set in our own solar system centuries in the future. Explore the intricacies of the unique left/right fighting system while battling across the solar system as nine distinct characters.

title: Mrs. Fantastic's Freaky Figurine Shop
description: Three lost souls find themselves stuck as figurines in a toy maker’s shop. They must use their new found bodies, a bear, a tiger, and a monkey, to escape the circus themed toy shop and return to their previous selves. Can they work together to find a way out?

title: Lullaby Days
description: Fairy fantasy simulation 『Lullaby Days』 is a game where the goal is to grow a duckling girl into a hero. Your duckling girl will grow through education, part-time work, exploration, and more. Create 70 endings in the Kingdom of Oberebach with around 90 sub-characters.

title: The Clockwork Labyrinth
Spaceship Trouble
description: Hey, pilot! Our spaceship get in trouble! We are in a dangerous place full of asteroids and pirates! Can you save your spaceship captain?

title: Alien Hunt
description: Alien hunt - Take on the role of an alien who loves to hunt for jewels in this extraordinary platformer! Climb deeper into the caves and collect all the gems, but beware of vampires who will be very unhappy that someone disturbed their peace.

title: Skeleton Troubles
description: Skeleton troubles - This platformer will put on your shoulders an unusual task - resurrect your skeleton hero, collecting bones and hearts in the dungeon so that he regains his strength and teach all his enemies a lesson. Jump over the spikes, dodge the cunning slugs that will shoot at you and run to victory!

title: Marble Mage
description: Dash and roll your way through 60 fast-paced levels to try and find the way back home after a magic exam goes wrong, leaving a young mage stranded in a strange dimension. Marble Mage offers classic marble-rolling platforming with a unique twist: Charge up and release to blast off in any direction!

title: Park the Car
description: Park the car is a racing game where you need to park your cars in a safe location!

title: The Lost Labyrinth
description: After waking up, Sophie finds herself in an eerie place and sets out to free tormented creatures and, discover if this is real or just a nightmare! Dive into a breathtaking match-3 adventure as you find your path through the cursed labyrinth and fight the dark forces that appose all who enter.

title: I Am Fly
description: A fly lives a short time, so collect poop and become a fat fly OR Eat rotten poop and die before you are satisfied!

title: Kingdom of Atham: Crown of the Champions
description: A multiplayer survival game set in a dark fantasy world that is continuously expanding in the Atham universe. Fight and survive in a sandbox world, build your home, and dominate your enemies… or your friends!

title: Cold Meat
description: Cold Meat is a short horror experience designed to mix classic horror themes with tension and a chill down your spine. Can you escape from the butcher shop before it is too late?

title: Long Live Caesar
description: 44 BC. Caesar, dictaror of Rome, finds out that the threat of conspiracy comes from the people closest to him. Can you resist the impending danger and rewrite history?

title: Zombies Beyond Me
description: Here you can lie. Zombies Beyond Me is a deduction, survival, and third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Communication and teamwork are essential to win, either as a traitor or a survivor. Build, loot, discover, kill zombies (or people), and survive to win!

title: White Eyes
description: The universe implodes and interstellar nomads race to get back home. Galaxies and stars are violently pushed toward their home, threatening to destroy it and any nomads who get caught in their path. Survive rounds of relentless onslaught to secure survival of the nomads.

title: Buddi Bot: Your Machine Learning AI Helper With Advanced Neural Networking!
description: Buddi Bot is an isometric puzzle game where you must (re)train Buddi Bot, an advanced AI with neural network technology. With just a click, Buddi will complete tasks like washing dishes or cooking a steak, by learning COLORS and SHAPES. Are you prepared for the future? Play and find out.

title: The Way Home
description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the remote countryside of South Korea in the 1990s. Over the course of just three days, you will encounter a series of mysterious events and come face-to-face with an unseen, encroaching threat

title: The Case of the Golden Idol
description: A new kind of detective game that allows you to think and investigate freely. Discover clues surrounding 12 strange and gruesome deaths and build your own theory. Pick your suspect, deduce the motive, unmask the awful truth.

title: Raging Fists: Retribution
description: Raging Fists: Retribution is an Action Fighting Game based in a sci-fi industrial era.

title: Lumiland
description: A sokoban-like 3D puzzle game in a colorful, stylized world of light and shadow.

title: Jump/Die/Live
description: Are you ready to beat this game? 50 levels, 2 boss battles. In this unique 2d platformer, you can only move with the mouse, jump, slide, kill the enemies, solve the levels!

title: Faded Grey
description: A short find it game that helps you make sense of a tragic accident as you uncover a piece of the story with each item found.

title: Wonder Defense: Chapter Earth
description: Wonder Defense: Chapter Earth is a strategy game based on Earth and Aliens in which you act as a General to accomplish survive and move to Mars.

title: Your wife
description: You have been set a curse, and your looks are growing old very fast.You visit a master, who points you to a very dangerous path. You need to go to the four magic worlds to find the antidote to the curse, in which live many fierc

title: Brain Test
description: Interesting quizzes on various topics. Take the tests and learn a lot. Improve your knowledge.

title: Fading Afternoon
description: Seiji Maruyama is a middle-aged yakuza recently released from prison. Known as "Gozuki" (one of the demon generals from Buddhist mythology) he is the power that his oyabun counts on. But there is one thing his aniki is not taking into account: Maruyama is getting old.

title: Project Crimson
description: Project Crimson is a 2D action-arcade clicker where your movement is restricted to a straight line in front of you. Use objects to manipulate your movement and, with some luck and good timing, fly through 75 levels of fun and satisfying challenges. No advertisements, no microtransactions.

title: Speechless
description: Speechless is an Escape the Loop experience. Every "loop" consists of different puzzle(s) solutions and actions you have to perform to escape the building.

title: Mechatronika
description: Mechatronika is an adventure genre game with puzzle elements. The action in the game circles around steampunk and tells a tale of a time after a biological war, the consequences of which proved fatal for the biosphere of the planet.

title: MotoRun
description: A great Biker on a small moped rushes to his dream, but what is it behind? A huge boulder has rolled down the mountain and is rolling right at us! Accelerate and rush forward, jumping, flying away and shooting everything that gets in your way!

title: MiniMap Kingdom
description: Build your own kingdom on unlimited mini maps!

title: Jester / King
description: You play the amnesiac jester Madion who woke up next to the king's lifeless body. A curse has fallen upon the kingdom, annihilating almost everyone, and driving the survivors to madness. Madion is torn between seeking the truth, helping the others, and a desire to escape.

title: Mayor of Defense
description: You are the village chief. Just when you thought the promised slow life was waiting for you... A monster that attacks without end! Almost a one-man operation! Black Village! Work to get materials, money and hire mercenaries to defend your village.

title: Epejsodion Dodgeball Defense
description: Time to hit the parquet! EPEJSODION Dodgeball is a sports game, where YOU can lead over 100 powerful teams to victory! Play an extensive singleplayer campaign, hone your skills, then beat your friends!

title: Disaster Crisis
description: 《灾难危机》主要讲述外来生物人入侵地球，为解救快崩溃的世界，你将扮演幸存者、战士等角色，从安德烈亚斯城市开始，在冒险的旅程上解决阻止这场外来生物人入侵地球的大灾难。你将组建英雄的队伍，在地图上升级刷怪，购买搜刮最强武器装备，带领他们完成艰巨的任务，直到打倒最后的幕后敌人。

title: Lucky day
description: "Lucky day" is a remastered classic 2D arcade game. The main goal is to collect all the coins in a maze while running away from monsters.

title: EchoBlade
description: Venture forth in this puzzle-combat dungeon explorer. Blinded and trapped inside a dungeon tower, every sound you make illuminates your path to freedom. Danger lurks around every corner: trapdoors, chambers filled with toxic fumes, and halls patrolled by crusader knights are only the beginning.

title: Crawlyard
description: Welcome to the Mansion of Whispers. Build a card deck and use it to carve your path through its boundless dungeons. Send puppets to battle, collect mysterious relics, find the ideal room pattern to meet the Wishmaster. Will you have your own wish granted? Or will you choose to help someone else?

title: Yeoubul
description: A platform game where you collect items to clear the stage, avoid or defeat enemies, pass through traps, and clear the stage with a system (operation) that uses the natural principle that creates a shadow when light does not pass through an object.

title: HangOutGame
description: HangOutGame is a game about climbing. Sometimes it may be difficult because of different obstacles. You can use a rope with hook, a blaster and your agility. Your task is getting to the finish in each world. You can do it by yourself or unite with a friend.

title: Unlock the Block
description: In unlock the block your objective is to activate a button, but for that you will have to push your way through and destroy blocks. This may seem easy but know one thing your movement is limited.

title: YRek Lost In Portals
description: An Action-Adventure First Person Shooter, with big boss fights encounter and dungeon exploration. Fps inspired by the old Fps of the 1990s, Getting ammo, weapons, and health to survive the Adventure against enemy foes is the game about.

title: Antimatter Elevator
description: Connect non-matching pieces to reach level 99.

title: Ahri and Bear
description: Ahri and Bear is a 3D puzzle adventure game, where players will take control of Ahri the cat and Bear the dog who embark on an emotional journey together to find their true home. Use Ahri and Bear's unique abilities to navigate through the daunting human world so they can find their way back home.

title: Save the Pirate: Sea Story
description: An adventure game with logic challenges about a funny pirate

title: Mess Cleanup
description: Think you can find any item in a mess? Mess Cleanup challenges you! Search for items and move on to the next challenging levels. Collect points and use your limited time wisely.

title: Shadow Eclipse
description: Shadow Eclipse is an action roguelite dungeon crawler. Build up your mage with diverse spell builds and abilities each run. You can play the game alone, or join 5-player online coop.

title: Curling on Line
description: Realistic Single Player, Local Multiplayer, online multiplayer Curling game.

title: Slimey Champions
description: Slimey Champions is all about hacking and slashing. Get loot, level up and learn new skills in this solo indie made action rpg.

title: Mouse Dream
description: Mouse dream is a platformer game where all surroundings are continuously morphing from the clouds into the new forms and adventures. You are not running anywhere, all dreams come to you. Dream is the story. Dream as long as you can.

title: The Horrorscope: Fatal Awakening
description: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal your potential fate. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Horrorscope, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?

title: SlideNSlip
description: SlideNSlip is a cute, casual, and challenging top-down puzzle game, in which the goal is to maneuver Mac and his penguin friends around so that Mac can get to his jet ski and escape the icy island he's stuck on.

title: Zombie Hazard
description: A remotely operated lab by a group of mad scientists lead to an outbreak of a Hazardous zombie virus which is now on its way to infect the world, Now it's your duty to stop the zombies break out and stop it from spreading to the rest of the world.

title: Wild Ice
description: When the world froze over, humanity's final stand to survive is left to the blades of it's most unlikely heroes - small town hockey players. Play solo or local co-op as best friends Max and Finley as they take on the frost and whatever lurks within it. Welcome to the a-puck-alypse!

title: Rogue Randy
description: This game is a TOP-DOWN, horror RPG. Visibility is very limited... everything else pretty much isn't. Explore the map, collect power-ups, and see how high your score can get before you beat the game.

title: Concurrence
description: Concurrence is a so called cinematic platform game. Unlike other platform games you will know (like Super Mario Bros. or Sonic the Hedgehog), this game focuses on realistic movements, puzzles and a dense atmosphere. If you have played games like Prince of Persia, Another World, or Flashback, you will know what awaits you. Many of parts of the game will require precise jumping and you might feel a little frustrated at the beginning. But don't despair, study the movements described in the manual and keep on practicing and you will find that it isn't so hard after all (you also have unlimited continues).

title: Balrog
description: The dwarves have abandoned the ringing forges and roaring breweries of Vul Buhldar, and in their absence other, less savory things of the dark have taken up residence...

title: Hyde and Zeke
description: Hyde and Zeke is a stealth game about a boy using light magic to escape a dark castle. The stakes are higher though as a cloaked figure chases him through the castle.

title: Junkyard Truck
description: Junkyard Truck is an open-world off road driving and mechanic simulator. Build, upgrade, and maintain an old off road truck, then use it to complete difficult off road missions and challenges.

title: PalmRide
description: PalmRide is a fast-paced driving game inspired by classic games like OutRun or Rad Racer and the popular "outrun" style.

title: Sqr 2
description: Sqr 2 is logical platformer with hardcore elements. It contains 3 difficulty and 100+ levels with different gameplay on each level. The simple controls & many mechanics with logical problems make game process more interesting.

title: Turkey Hunting Unlimited
description: Get ready to hit the Spring time woods and Hunt Turkey! The Gobblers are out there and depending on the difficulty level you choose it can be a "Gobble Fest" or a more realistic hunt! Hunt four states: New York, Ohio, Kansas, and Texas! Hunt with a Gun or a Bow!

title: Sons of Valhalla
description: Sons of Valhalla is a side scrolling base building strategy game that catapults you into the age of the Vikings. You slip into the role of the Viking Jarl son Thorald Olavson, who is leaving for England to save the love of his life.

title: CardMaker
description: This is a Rogue + Hearthstone like card game, but also a card making tool, you can play in addition to the official cards, creative workshop players a variety of card DIY.

title: Dr. Byte
description: Dr. Byte is an adventure in the depths of a computer full of monster viruses. Fight against the system destroyers - it's all in a top-down game.

title: Idle Monster Frontier
description: Collect monsters and combine them to conquer the frontier in this challenging idle RPG.

title: Misha Adventures
description: Misha Adventures is a challenging platformer in which you have to help Misha the bear save the forest from pollution.

title: Kingdom of the Dead
description: Immerse yourself in a dreadful hand-drawn horror world and push Death’s armies back to the underworld!

title: Anetona
description: Embark on a quest across a multi-era world against humans, creatures and machines in order to rescue the princess from the evil red dragon.

title: Poly Synth Gunner
description: Instance-based shooter with scaling endless wave of enemies

title: Captain Disaster in: The Dark Side of the Moon
description: A comedy scif-fi point & click adventure game with several odd characters (all voiced by the same person) and multiple strange inventory objects to try out! References to classic sci-fi and point & clicks abound.

title: Lactea Volleyball
description: Lactea Volleyball is a game made to be simple and fun to play, choose or create your team and aim well to beat your opponents.

title: Escape to Moscow
description: A story about a guy, a girl he met, and their adventure. Freelance IT specialist Semyon meet a girl from Dagestan on the Internet. However, their relationship quickly grow over the regular chatting - he decides to help her run away from home. That is how their amazing adventure begins.

title: FallTower
description: 2D action game that aims to go up

title: Jump Hero: Beginning
description: Jump Hero: Beginning is a game in which you have to complete all levels, however each new level becomes more difficult and difficult. Can you complete all levels?

title: Dört Model Müzesi
description: Four model contents in public relations, which is one of the topics in public relations education, have been developed to support the educational process using virtual reality technology.

title: Fairy Godmother Stories: Miraculous Dream - Collector's Edition
description: Who’s the fairest of them all?

title: Big Flappy Tower vs. Tiny Square
description: Fling, flip, and flap around a new delightfully difficult Big Tower game! No sprint and no floaty controls! Just quick deaths and generous respawn points. Can you reach the top of the tower and rescue your Pineapple?

title: Sokocat: Dungeon
description: kitten Jones adventure into a mysterious ancient temple on a volcanic island looking for relics, solving puzzles and avoiding dangers along the way. Does this cat have 9 lives?

title: Tres-Bashers
description: Tres-Bashers is a 2D monster-bashing adventure featuring a big interconnected map full of cryptids, secrets, and more! Find over 30 different monsters and whack 'em with your baseball bat!

title: Suddenly Meow
description: Tim is an adventurous cat who loves to explore mysterious places and is always hungry for more. In this Match3 adventure he is lost in a dark forest full of shadows and dangers lurking under the silent trees. Help Tim escape and restore peace to the forest!

title: Chimeras: What Wishes May Come - Collector's Edition
description: Always Read the Fine Print

title: The Orb Chambers Remastered
description: The Orb chambers is back. Remastered and ready to take on new challengers.

title: SimBus
description: SimBus is new, advanced bus simulator. Drive historic and modern vehicles from all parts of the world. Visit living cities of USA, Europe and China in different eras. Become bus driver, follow the timetable and meet other players on multiplayer mode.

title: Idle Poker
description: A collaboration between Poker and idle game!! How is your luck?

title: Content
description:
Content is a point-and-click horror adventure game. Become Anthony, an influencer looking for provocative content for his videos. Investigate the cases, combine and use tools to overcome the given challenges. Sometimes you have to use your reflexes to dodge the threat of an unexpectedly attacking creatures.

The fate of the protagonist, Anthony, is in your hands.

title: Fast Cubes
description: Fast Cubes is a puzzle game with time limits. Your objective is to place the cubes in their respective slots. Pass through portals, avoid spikes and find keys to achieve your objective. You'll need to think and to act to win this game.

title: ProtoStone
description: ProtoStone is a card game with local split-screen multiplayer (Offline), 4 different classes and over 150 different cards to collect.

title: Star Rover
description: Star Rover is a Third-Person Action platformer game in Metroidvania style that you as the player can play in various locations on a planet. Upgrade yourself and collect a lot of weapons to prepare for the battle.

title: Mimir's Recruit
description: A feedback-based logic and deduction game set in the Nordic world. Face to face with the advisor of the gods, prove your worth and earn the right to drink from the well of knowledge.

title: Indika
description: Play a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia of the late XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. INDIKA tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself.

title: Mimicry!
description: Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!

title: Fantasma Ville
description: Fantasma Ville is a wholesome puzzle-platformer game about guilt and redemption, where you control a memoryless ghost tasked to uncover why the village inhabitants and himself died.

title: No Honor
description: A pixel art style shooting adventure with challenging levels and bosses.

title: Toi
description: A new planet has been discovered, go through the three areas and conquer the planet Toi.

title: Liberation Mutagenix
description: Guide your comrades to freedom in this gravity-bending sci-fi puzzle game. Modify their genetic code, direct their movements, and provide them with the tools they need to escape.

title: Murder Diaries 2
description: In this game you abstractly follow the narration of a murderer and a joung detective through their lifes and thoughts. This leads you straight into the middle of an exciting murder case and a murder mystery unlike you have ever seen before unfolds.

title: Pixels: Digital Creatures
description: Pixels combines thrilling turn-based creature battles with the replayability of a roguelike. Pick your starter and journey through the Virtual World. Defy the odds by building a team of powerful Pixels to fight through the arenas! Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Pixel Coach?

title: The Mouse and the Cheese
description: An arcade-style strategy / maze game!! Collect all the cheeses to pass the level !!

title: Little Hearts

She's held out as long as she can, but if she doesn't escape tonight, Dorkus will force her to marry him! What's a girl in distress to do?

Well, wait for rescue, obviously. But when rescues go wrong, Damsels must do it for themselves!

Damsel is a short comedy adventure game, with full voice-acted dialogue. We hope you enjoy it, we had some really talented performers for it. :)

Every single Personality turns the protagonist into something that bears no resemblance to their original self, an unusual feature for a fangame.

Before version -0.75, the game was made with RPG Maker 2003, until it was remade in RPG Maker VX Ace.

title: Musou Yuugi
description: Musou Yuugi is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The game seems to have a theme of Japanese folklore/theatre. It focuses on exploration and collection effects, but ornaments for Shirayuki's dream room can also be bought from the market sellers in certain worlds.

title: Nijuu Yuumu
description:
Nijuu Yuumu is a Yume Nikki fangame. The game has a total of 15 effects to collect and no ending. Generally, the game's imagery sticks to a naive and simple style, which usually portrays the world seen by a child.

The game features a young girl known as Kizutsuki and her other personality, Kitsutsuki. Some effects can only be used by a certain personality or differ depending on which personality you use.

The money system in this game is different from most fangames, as you can receive money only by finding it. Nijuu Yumuu also doesn't have any vending machines, instead, you can spend your money by buying plant pots in a flower shop.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Dreams

title: Shoujo Kidan

title: Shoujo Gidan
description:
Waking up in a strange prison, "you" will work with a girl who is also there, to escape from the building.

A sequel to Shoujo Kidan.

title: Iffermoon
description:
The day the Iffermoon crashed, the world changed forever.

In Iffermoon, you will explore your new world and meet many unique characters who will be willing to join your party and help you on your quest to defeat Cosmose. Customize your party into a formidable fighting team for action based battles, engaging in physical combat as well as traditional rpg style commands.

There are also three complete games within this game, accessible through arcade machines, each with their own rewards to improve your abilities on your central quest.

title: Stellar Gun
description:
Your objective is to defeat the cosmic demons that have invaded your space. One by one, you must confront them and kill them, earning weapons, money and medals along the way. Who is behind it all? You will have to discover that for yourself.

You move your spaceship using the keys W,A,S,D as arrow keys. The mouse controls your target. This is a two-handed game. One hand will control your ship's position (while using W,A,S,D) and the other hand will use the mouse to target enemies. Space bar is used to respawn after losing a life. Left-clicking your mouse fires your weapon. Right-clicking your mouse cycles through your weapons. Current weapon and remaining ammo are indicated by an icon in the lower left portion of the screen.

When you lose a life, a flashing cursor will appear in your place. Control this cursor like your ship and position it out of harm's way. When the cursor is in a safe location, press space bar to respawn your next life. If you do not hit space bar, your next life will respawn at the cursor in 5 seconds.

New weapons and extra lives must be purchased using money acquired from battle. After each victory or defeat, you will return to your Main Menu screen. Here you can buy ammunition and extra lives for your next venture. Purchasing extra lives becomes increasingly expensive depending on how many you already have. This screen is also where you select your level. Levels 1-4 must be cleared before 5 can be played. Once 5 is cleared, you can play 6. Levels can be revisited even after you have beaten them for more cash or to retrieve missing medals. A medal is rewared for clearing a specific level without losing a life. Cleared levels are shown as grey icons, while uncleared levels are in color.

Status information is saved to your C: drive. Things like ammunition, cleared stages, and medals are saved automatically so that you can pick up where you left off at a later time.

title: Primal Rage II
description:
Primal Rage II is the cancelled sequel to Primal Rage. It started development in 1996 and was set to be released in 1997, but the game was cancelled due to the shrinking popularity of arcades. The game would feature avatars of the gods as playable characters. Necrosan trapped the gods so they couldn't fight him, so the avatars had to save the gods by fighting each other to reach Necrosan. If the player were to beat Necrosan then they would get an ending. Only one cabinet of the game is known to exist, and it can be found at the Galloping Ghost Arcade in Brookfield, Illinois.

As of 02/11/2017, the emulation of the game is fully functional, thanks to YouTube user GruntZilla94.

description: Hop in and participate in frantic combat racing on the mean streets of Midnight City, a place lit by bright neon lights. Earn money and reputation, upgrade your car, win to challenge all “legendary racers” of the city, and make your way to becoming a Midnight Legend.

title: Fat & Furious
description: Fat & Furious is a 2D combat game about fast food parody! Choose among these obese and comic characters! And beat the sinister minister of the restauration industry!

title: BlackJack Math
description: BlackJack Math is a game about mixing the cards to match the correct formula in order to get 21 as a result. Swap the cards in order to find the correct order to solve the puzzles.

title: The Bart Bonte Collection
description: Flash is dead, long live the Bart Bonte collection! A collection of 28 Flash games carefully packaged and remastered for you, all accessible from a selection menu with loads of achievements. All the classics you know from the browser, including the Sugar, Sugar and the Factory Balls series.

title: Into the Eternal
description: Into The Eternal is a massive action RPG featuring a unique blend of a third person overworld and side scrolling battles.

title: WarmSnow
description: 'Warm Snow' is a Rogue-like action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.

title: One Way Road
description: Take on the role of a Starfleet Command captain, participate in numerous space battles, travel through the galaxy, and fight for the survival of humanity.

title: Sigma World Online
description: Sigma World Online - is an online sandbox with a huge world from many star systems. Choose who to be: space explorer, miner, merchant, farmer, culinary specialist, scientist, builder or hunter, or build your empire.

title: Shem Ha Mephorash
description: "Shem Ha Mephorash" is a historical low fantasy strategy game set in the battlefield at the end of the 19th century, where you can explore the language of miracles. Treat the unique "rabbi" and the soldiers skillfully and guide them to the end.

title: Synthetic Hazard
description: 2107 AD, Hopi Desert, Arizona. A secret biotech weapons laboratory has suffered a containment breach. A dangerous biological weapon capable of modifying machinery at its will has escaped. It wants to escape the facility and reach the surface. Stop it before it's too late.

title: Legacy of Vane
description: You have the backing of the Goddess, Azraelle and gifts from the Archdemon, Zelbog. Use your powers of light and darkness on your long trek as you seek to unravel the mystery of your mother's death. However, all you can think of is the fate in store for you... Bringing about the end of the World!

title: Sacrifice of The Spirit
description: A Brazilian hunter makes a terrible mistake of reaping the life of an animal on a full moon night, but Mother Nature will not let it go, the spirits of the forest punished him!

title: Pummel Paladins
description: Pummel Paladins is a 1v1 brawler with a creative twist. Don't be mistaken, just because the knights lost their weapons doesn't mean they are going to stop their destined duel. Push, parry, utilize the environment and items to outplay your opponent in this retro, dungeon arena!

title: Extra Terrestrial Nation
description: In the year 2045 scientists discover a new planet that has extraterrestrial life on it, which they brought back to Earth to study. It wasn't long before they mutated and escaped into the city. The only safe place left is on the outskirts of town, can Nicole and Rocky make it safely out of town?

title: Dream of Summer Dusk
description: Shanghai Summer is an adventure game set in the millennium. Our protagonist, Baichuan, goes through a series of "anomalies" over the length of twelve days. In his pursuit of the truth, he found that his hopes and regrets from the past finally seem to converge. Will he be able to "fix" it for good?

title: Dispersion
description: Dispersion - is a fast paced arcade game where you control a ball. Break the golden orbs to earn points, but if you get to other objects, you will immediately lose. How many gold orbs can you break?

title: Red Trains
description: Red Trains is a strategic train simulator and management game. Build tracks to connect industry and cities. Customize locomotive designs to optimize for particular goods and routes. Manage your political clout to avoid being removed from your post.

title: Chinese Bull
description: Chinese Bull is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Dark Renaissance
description: An exciting Interactive History Drama that will let you experience first-hand the real and darker story of Renaissance. Take on the role of an indomitable mercenary captain, fight fearsome enemies, make influential choices and forge your own path to glory.

title: Stone Guardian
description: Stone Guardian is a low-poly style adventure 3D platformer where you play as a guardian that needs to find the disappeared Stone. To find it he needs to enter the magical world and face challenges.

title: Humans Connect
description: Humans Connect is an Adventure, Hack and Slash Game that is being developed by one person. This game is a journey of the main protagonist "Julia" discoveries of an incident while confronting an Anubis-like Character named "Inpu The Jackal".

title: Gang of Paws
description: Gang of Paws is a Roguelike Deck-Builder with a hybrid turn-based and real-time battle system. Inspired by the amazing Megaman Battle Network.

title: Kobolok
description: Kobolok is an ethnic retro horror game based on an Eastern European fairytale about round bread "Kolobok" aka "O Koblížkovi" aka "Pannkauken."

title: Abda Redeemer: Space Alien Invasion
description: Our brave hero Abda lost his father. After his death, he remained the only one of his kind. Everyone he loved died. After the funeral, he inherited his father's old starship. After fixing the flying saucer he had inherited, Abda got ready to go. Thus began the story of Abda Redeemer.

title: Dad's Monster House
description: Dad's Monster House is a hand-drawn puzzle game featuring horror and fantasy. It tells the story of Carlos' journey after he receives a distress call from his father, pleading for him to return to his old home and rescue his dad.

title: Anime Arena: Infinite War
description: Anime Arena: Infinite War is a unique action RPG game with survival elements. Zombies are everywhere and you are the only one who can defeat them!

title: Train 113
description: Train 113 is a first-person horror game in which you play a passenger who wakes up aboard a seemingly empty subway train. As you move around the train, trying to get from car to car, you'll begin to sense that things around you are not what they appear to be.

title: Last Escape
description: Last Escape - is one of some 3D shooters with surviving elements where you play as a cyborg Stephen. He is anxious to revenge everyone who made him who he is.

title: Critterland
description: Critterland is a fast-paced 2D real-time strategy (RTS) game that pits you against the forces of nature. Solve puzzles in the campaign, discovering synergies between species while enjoying the atmospheric OST. Alternatively, conduct your own ecological research in sandbox mode.

title: Super Bout: Champion's Tour
description: Super Bout: Champion's Tour is a 1v1 fighting game features state of the art 8-bit graphics and sound effects, 4 playable characters, online and offline versus modes, a single player arcade mode, and more. Super Bout's fast game play and deep strategy will blow your socks off!

title: Born to Kill
description: Seek and kill the dictator of the fictional country of Bahn, in this isometric-shooter game.

title: Hoop the Loop
description: This is an casual VR game where you try to hold your hoop steady so that it does not touch the bar. Extremely addicting with a pleasant low-poly style environment that will not burn up your computer. Enjoy this unique game that utilizes the best of VR at no cost and no in-app purchases!

title: 30 Birds
description:
Experience a seamless blend of 2D and 3D in this mesmerizing narrative adventure, with hand-drawn visuals inspired by Persian miniatures. Wander through the gorgeous neighborhoods of Lantern City while enjoying a ska - dub - reggae inspired soundtrack and help Zig gather thirty charismatic and chatty birds to save Simurgh! But beware, you might come across puzzling challenges on your way…

Discover a gorgeous universe laid out on the surface of rotating lanterns. Wander through a beautiful city inspired by Middle Eastern legends, meeting the local goofs, quirky djinns, and regular weirdos along the way. Solve puzzles and interesting challenges to help Zig rescue Simurgh!

title: Combat Cycle
description: Combat Cycle is an intensive, tactical FPS based on lethal close quarters combat singleplayer gameplay. Experience the furious combat on ever-changing modern battlefields with various strategies to keep breaking through your limit.

title: Z-Blood Mission
description: A slasher game with elements of horror and survival. 3D action with old school side camera view.

title: Pagan Age
description: Lead the families of the first pagan tribes to conquer virgin lands inhabited by mythical creatures. Obtain building materials, win favor with the gods, and use ancient beliefs and occult practices to create a home for your people in a harsh and hostile world.

title: The Life of Bally
description: Bally's life is like our lives. Go through Bally's life solving puzzles, facing new challenges and growing up with him.

title: BlockLock
description: BlockLock is a third-person 3D puzzle game unlike any other! You take the role of an android, tasked with returning the blocks to their matching home tiles. Walk up to a block, grab it and push it. Sounds simple? It's anything but! You'll need to think ahead or you may box yourself in!

title: Air Gun Fighter
description: Realistic Modern Air Combat Game

title: Tombstone
description: Tombstone is a fast paced wild west multiplayer FPS with multiple game modes, Rush, Capture the flag, Team deathmatch, and Deathmatch.

title: Arkos
description: Arkos is a first-person fantasy shooter with unique voxel render. You play as the white wizard Arkos, who went in search of a powerful weapon of his teacher elf Corvus, who disappeared without a trace many years ago in the dungeons of an ancient castle.

title: You Have to Play This Game
description: Explore the world of Celestia in this retro-inspired, top-down action adventure!

title: Argy Bargy Legends
description: A collectible card game about a confrontation between three factions: acorns, floats and candles. Build a unique, powerful deck and write yourself in the story of Argy Bargy crushing everyone and everything in your path.

title: Survival In Africa
description: 'Survival In Africa' is an RPG-type survival game that survives using items and crafted items that are dropped when various monsters are defeated.

title: Alone: Recode
description: Step into the world of Alone - a new take on the classic turn-based fantasy RPG. Featuring challenging bosses and asymmetric world design Alone will defy your expectations of gameplay and exploration. Whether you are a RPG veteran or a new to the genre, you must experience Alone.

title: LightBall
description: Can you see in the dark? Set in a 2D universe, Light Ball brings with it a concept of "Dark Puzzle", a legitimate platform game where you have to cross dark levels with different obstacles using LightBall, a sphere with its own light and capable of firing light.

title: A Hole In Space
description: A "small" universe simulation, where you play as a black hole and try to absorb the whole universe. You decide the size and shape of the universe. Could also be used as a less meaningful CPU benchmark.

title: Drum'n'Bass Massacre
description: DRUM'N'BASS MASSACRE is a high-velocity aerial combat shooter where you destoy your enemies while performing unimaginable maneuvers using your interstellar interceptor, accompanied by original drum and bass soundtrack

title: Sakura Mochi
description: Sakura Mochi is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Creeping Darkness
description: Escape the hostel by tricking the insane clown - psychopath

title: Rugby Union Team Manager 3
description: The third instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby Union Management Game”. Rugby Union Team Manager 3 gives you full control of managing your own Rugby Union team. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors, facilities and more. MUCH MORE!

title: Zero-based World
description: Zero Based World is a multiplayer sandbox survival game.

title: Odenavirus: Zombie Invasion
description: Odenavirus: Zombie Invasion is an online turn-based combat game where the city is infested with zombies and you have to do missions and tasks to progress with the story.

title: Matraquinha Pair
description: Stimulate children and teenagers with autism with picture matching activities. Matraquinha PAIR allows to stimulate the visual perceptive cognitive development with exercises of logic and memorization. And all this in a fun way!

title: Graywood: Noir Detective
description: GRAYWOOD is an unforgiving detective game that makes you think and feel like a real detective. Gather evidence, interrogate suspects, and make connections to craft your own lines of questioning in up to 14 cases. Follow your moral compass, or respect the law. The choice is yours.

title: Gravitaze: Two
description: Gravitaze: Two is a minimalist puzzle whose objective is to make the circle reach the center of the labyrinth, changing the gravity of the circle and rotating the labyrinth.

title: Five Steps From Hell
description: The has been movie star Daniel fights against the hordes of hell that his longtime stalker has unleashed to trap him.

title: Cubiscape 2
description: Solve hundreds of fun and challenging puzzles in this original turn-based puzzle game. Hide from your enemies or lure them into traps, press buttons to open up new paths or skip obstacles using the teleporter!

title: Bad Dream: Stories
description: Bad Dream: Stories is a collection of older games in the Bad Dream series in a new, remastered form. Play the series of short point & click titles and travel through the disturbing and atmospheric world of dreams.

title: Key
description: Spend hours having fun exploring this maze that gets bigger and bigger. In Key, with each level won, the maze gets bigger and harder. Dodge spikes and traps, push blocks of ice, find the key and open the door before time runs out.

title: 6 Takes!
description: 6 Takes! - Wolfgang Kramer's ingeniously simple card game with "bullheads". The aim of the game is to avoid getting cards. The player with the fewest bullheads at the end of the game is the winner. It sounds easier than it is, players will need some great tactics and perhaps a little luck.

title: Edifice of Fiends
description: A challenging Rogue-Like Strategy RPG where every choice matters. Can you conquer the Edifice of Fiends?

title: Button Soccer League
description: Use your skills and strategies to challenge your friends in local matches or online (via Steam Play Together), in this nostalgic game that brings the whole experience of button Soccer to your PC. There are 8 different teams, and different training scenarios.

title: Magic Stone Guardians
description: Magis Stone Guardians is a tower defense game that can be played in VR. You are the guardian god of an underground temple, and you must fight off enemies who try to steal the crystal. Summon Guardians by combining cubes made of magical stones!

title: Super Match! The Ultimate Matching Game
description: Fun and addicting physics-based matching game!

title: Siege of the Swine
description: Fight your way through a never-ending horde of piggy enemies. How many can you fend off before your kingdom falls to ruin?

title: Komora: Real World Escape
description: Vtuber「オシャレになりたい！ピーナッツくん」のキャラクター達が繰り広げる ACTRTSゲーム

title: Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals
description: Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals is a multiplayer horror party game with multiple modes where players take on the role of monsters or mortals from Dark Deception's universe (and other universes) and fight for soul shards in nightmarish mazes!

title: Move the Window
description: This is a game where you have to solve in unusual ways to collect all the coins in each level.

title: Push Blox 2
description: Block-pushing puzzle game with challenging high quality levels.

title: Enypnion
description: Enypnion is a short point & click adventure that takes place in a surreal and strange world that only the mind of a small boy could create.

title: Pulling No Punches
description: Pulling No Punches is a satirical game in the 2D beat'em up style with classic arcade influences and modern visuals. Survive a fictional pandemic in a city filled with madness and denial.

title: The Holy Orange
description: A Christian Ball Rolling Game

title: Lockdown Hero
description: The perfect video game to play during Lockdown!

title: Space Kettle
description: Have you ever played a game as a Flying Kettle? No? It’s time to fix this. In this game, your main goal is to reach the top of the unyielding surreal mountain at any cost, going through the test of inevitable falls, constant loss of progress, and deep frustration.

title: Skull Chainz
description: Smash your way out of Hell in this unique physics-based combat game!

title: Dark Blocks
description: PC game with 2D graphics. The player controls the bat and must remove all blocks from the level using the ball, which he must not miss. Each of the 96 levels contains one verse of motivational poems. Can you clear all the blocks and get all the poems?

title: Destroy the Shogun
description: Destroy the Shogun is an old school ninja inspired action platformer with a 16 bit art style, full boss battles and comic book styled cutscenes.

title: Yellowlooper
description: Yellowlooper is a short minimal, reaction/puzzle game. Yellowlooper looks minimalistic but is extremely difficult, one mistake and the level starts again.

title: Tactical Vanguard Saga
description: This story-driven, single-player, 2D turn-based strategy RPG in a sci-fi setting tells the story of a child from Earth, Audra, who is inspired by a trendy video game to break special agent Beaufort out of captivity on Mars, against the wishes of their shared enemy; the Space Frontier Colonies.

title: Tackle Girl
description: Platform game. You aim to clear over 60 stages use Jump , Dive and Tackle!

title: Alien's Armageddon
description: Alien's armageddon - This is a side-view shooter where the player acts as the destroyer of humanity. The player controls an alien ship, which technologically, many times exceeds the level of earthlings. People are giving up all efforts to stop the harvest, but will they succeed?

title: 100 Hidden Mice
description: Hidden object game in the laboratory setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Difficult and interesting! Very large location!

title: I Accidentally Restarted the USSR
description: Have you ever went on google and searched "I accidentally"? If you did then you saw that google autosuggest "I accidentally restarted the USSR". In this game you will be able to play the tail of Igor Ivanov as he accidentally restarts the USSR.

title: Ari's Journey
description: A retro precision platformer in a top-down action packed story. Navigate tight corridors and fly at high speeds using precise timing. A precision platformer without any platforms.

title: Dogpet
description: Who's a good doggy?

title: Impostor Inside Us
description: Impostor inside us is a type Social deduction game. Let try !

title: The Nightmare
description: You are trapped in a nightmare shaped by your inner darkness. To escape and awaken, you must solve puzzles and confront deep-seated traumas. Explore twisted versions of daily life—convenience stores, trains, stations, hometowns, endless tunnels. Face your fears and reclaim yourself.

title: Cannonship
description: Cannonship is an action-packed shootout in which your plane must fight a horde of enemies. You can fight your opponents alone or with another player. Upgrade your ship and tip the balance of victory to your side! Will you accept the challenge?

title: The Vampire Regent
description: Rule over a secret society of vampires in a game full of political intrigue, occult powers, and conflicting loyalties. Will you play or be played?

title: Raider Bots
description: The Raiders are expanding their territory and have selected you as the operative to tackle the next acquisition. With powerful MECH technology and armies of battle BOTs at your command, you must conquer your enemies and expand the Raiders reach.

title: DumbBots: Hello World
description: DumbBots: Hello World is the FREE introduction to the world of coding a DumbBot. Learn a new skill in 2020, and pickup the basics of coding with drag-and-drop ease in a fun setting. Or show your coding mettle by competing with other DumbBots.

title: Johnny Lionface
description: A twisted story-driven action-RPG with endless ways to build your party of colorful combatants.

title: Astronium
description: Astronium is an Metroidvania with Souls-Like aspects, with a focus on combat and on the grind for weapons. Defeat strong enemies, surpass ambushes, explore diferent biomes and meet interesting individuals on this hostile planet

title: Neon GraVel
description: Welcome to Neon GraVel! In this jump 'n' run/puzzle game you use gravity-affecting blocks to build a path for yourself, to then traverse that path with precise jumps.

title: Feudal Kingdoms
description: Feudal Kingdoms is a medieval Grand Strategy strategy game, which sets new limits to the genre with challenging features. The realistic population structure is only one of the few features you shouldn't miss.

title: Suspicious Spaceroads
description: Partake in a platforming romp through a series of increasingly suspicious space roads, engage in futile questions like why are these roads hanging in space? Who built them? Why am I platforming here?

title: Turn right
description: Very simple and easy games

title: Elly's Cake Cafe
description: Collect juicy fruits, candy, cookies and jam in our relaxing casual game

title: The Spirit of Snowflake
description: Platform game where you incarnate a ghost and go through lasers and fireballs on a background of epic music. You can create your own levels and share them with your friends...

title: 16bit vs. Reality
description: Retro-style platformer inspired by the 16bit classics. Jump and shoot your way through challenging levels. Watch two distinct visual styles collide. Enjoy the awesome rocking music. In the name of all that is childhood!

title: Post-Apo Builder
description: Build your own city in a post-apocalyptic future. Scavenge and fight for resources, everything counts! Restore civilization on the ashes of the fallen world! Explore wastelands to gather resources, protect and take care of your people! Fight off raiders, wild tribesman and natural disasters.

title: Detective Solitaire: Inspector Magic and the Forbidden Magic
description: 120 unique deals – investigate a mysterious crime!

title: Forest Farm
description: The definitive VR farming sim for Rift/Link, Index, HTC and WMR. Learn to manage your land and grow all plants from seed to harvest, including trees!

title: Glizzy Gobbler
description: Made for meat-lovers! Roll, devour and grow your glizzy to take your revenge on the humans who have eaten your kind. Unlock skills and achievements along your path to human destruction. But be careful - the dogs are on the hunt!

title: Draw music
description: "draw music" is a rhythm game made up of Dots. You can experience characters, musical instruments, and classical music of each Dot through game play.

title: The Ghost
description: Genre: Suspense. A simple novel with only screen transitions. A game for people who like novels.

title: Ghost or Trick
description: This game is a novel adventure game where the player becomes the assistant of Arthur, a detective, and solves mysteries. This time, you have to investigate the ghost that has appeared at the villa. Arthur is waiting for your help. Let's head to the villa as soon as possible.

title: Survival Engine
description: Can you survive 10 days or more in the wilderness? Find food, water, fight wild animals, and craft tools and constructions, sow different plants, and explore the map! Note: this is not a full game, it is just the demo of the Unity Asset store asset with the same!

title: Viy
description: Once upon a time, the great misfortune happened at an estate. The landowner's only daughter died under mysterious circumstances. People say that she was friendly with evil forces.Before she died, she had expressed a wish that for three days after her death the prayers for the dead should be recited by you...

title: Bosslords
description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

title: Hustomten
description: Collect snacks to keep your resident house elf happy until midnight of Christmas Eve.

title: Security Guard
description: Security Guard - a brand new game from the simulation category, which will allow you to become a security guard known from the most exciting action movies. Many interesting missions, equipment and various locations await you. Show us what you can do!

title: Holidays
description: In this interactive adventure, you play as a teacher suffering from delirium tremens. A world will open before you where every choice you make matters. Explore different locations, engage in battles, make decisions that will correspond to your desires and moral principles.

title: Music Racer 2000
description: Music Racer is a music-adapting racing/runner/action game in aesthetic retrowave world where you use your own music to race!

title: Cube Conflict
description: Cube Conflict is a free and open-source FPS where smileys are at war without mercy. If you see a Ninja firing a nuclear missile at a Priest with a GAU-8 in power armor, it's totally normal in this game!

title: The Drift Challenge
description: Slide your ride in different game modes. Earn XP points and complete challenges to level up and unlock cars or drift with friends in the Online Multiplayer mode.

title: Bleak End
description: Bleak end is a hand-drawn poetic game about a girl got lost in a suddenly faded reality. Wander around through the labyrinth of entangled thoughts and sorrow. Is there an end to it?

title: Eliseisk 2074
description: The year is 2074. “Spark” organization wants to «establish order» in your hometown of Eliseysk. It’s time to answer the call (of justice) and join the resistance. Will you be the one to shoulder the burden of this mission, and persist in this cruel and dangerous world in order to shape its future?

title: It's a Wrap!
description: It's a Wrap! is a challenging puzzle game about making movies in 1980s Hollywood. Figure out the perfect timing of props, actors, and special effects as the Director. Then jump into the scene as the movie's star in a traditional 2D platformer.

title: Fast Jump
description: Action game in which you teleport between platforms, pick up power-ups, and shoot all the monsters you encounter along the way.

title: Elastic Fantastic
description: Elastic Fantastic is a very difficult physics-platformer with a challenging game mechanic.

title: Allan
description: Allan is an immersive top-down view dungeon exploration and action game with a unique pixelart 3D style. Face your enemies, break throught the dungeon's puzzle. Walk in the dark. Crawl between those walls without letting them crush you.

title: Ski Doom VR
description: The classic ski survival game is back - and this time, in virtual reality. Pick your ride, hit the slopes, and outrun the mountain monster as long as possible. Compete for the #1 spot on the global leaderboards

title: Cinema Simulator
description: "Cinema Simulator" is a simulation video game, here you can experience watching movies in the cinema! What do you want to see!

title: Under Construction: Summer City
description: 3d house design game with a wide variety of options, customization and user-content support.

title: A New Leaf: Memories
description: You wake up on the beach of a foreign island, unable to recall anything. Alone and equipped with only basic farming tools provided by the town residents, you aim to recover your memories. Complete quests and explore Omoide Island to unfold your story.

title: Ero Snooker
description: Play snooker and admire the girls.

title: Poker Master
description: Free chips!Including Texas Hold'em,Short 6+,SNG,MTT and more poker games.

title: Escape from Tatris
description: Escape from Tatris is a parody puzzle game with traditional gameplay and new solutions. You must collect as much loot as possible in your character's inventory. To do this, collect rows of objects and remove them. Collect combos and transfer loot to backpacks.

title: The Runemaster's Diary
description: Explore environments full of secrets and meet quirky characters in this short rpg. Collect items, use them in battle and to get access to different places. And most importantly, help Mac in his adventure to save a puppy from some evil oranges!

title: Balloon Azuna
description: Balloon Azuna is a 2D Platform game based on the story of Azuna, a Balloon Girl, whose mission is to rescue her brother using her special ability of changing minds of the enemies.

title: Royale Island Showdown
description: An online 4 player Battle Royale FPS, where each player has an AI teammate.

title: Soul Delivery
description: A robot with amnesia ventures through the night of a neon city without humans in search of what happened between humans and AI.

title: Evergate: Ki's Awakening
description: Try this year’s must-play indie smash-hit for free, with Evergate Ki’s Awakening. Take on seven unique levels in this haunting precision puzzle-platformer, set in a stunning hand-drawn vision of the Afterlife, with an original score recorded by a live orchestra.

title: Battletronics
description: Free-for-all (2-4 players) top-down shooter game available for free. An epic arena battleground featuring a unique blend of powerups and arena environments.

title: Roar of Revenge
description: A game that puts together Rastan's action with adventure elements inspired by Faxanadu. An old school tribute for every lover of 8-bit classics!

title: Flipol
description: Flip and color it all. It is a simple puzzle game.

title: HoneyLand
description: Help Mr.Fluff to drink all the honey, and of course, reach the fabulous honey volcano! Your cards will direct Mr. Fluff in the right direction. Run! Jump! Fall on your stomach!

title: Dr Iwan
description: Dr Iwan is a hardcore turn-based roguelike game. Obtain, manage, upgrade your abilities through programmed generation journey. Final boss in new plus game will be your last character that you built and ended last game.

title: Apprentice Arriving
description: Apprentice Arriving is a 3D-Fantasy RPG where you dive into the role of a sorcerer's disciple, blessed with incredible powers. You are the next Apprentice. Set off on a new adventure with enormous proportions!

title: Sapling
description: A narrative walking simulator that packs an emotional punch. As the world's first spoken-word video game, it may speak truth into the bittersweet moments of your life.

title: Zenith Into Maronarium
description: Pilot the Kotel One aircraft. Survive the samozbor invasion.

title: Stone River
description: Because of the tornado, you are blown to a mysterious island, which is full of crisis and unknown. Exploring this island is still your only chance to survive. In this new environment, you will be tested and constantly remind yourself how close you are to death.

title: Chromatic Labyrinth
description: Chromatic Labyrinth is a first person shooter with roguelike elements. The game features a random level generator and collectable items with passive effects.

title: Color Souls
description: Color Souls is a Fast-paced Splatformer where platforms are invisible and you have to paint them. Walk, Jump, Double Jump, Slide and Wall Jump to paint everything, A vast amount of difficult levels for you challenge and powerful bosses to beat.

title: Monkey vs. Dino
description: Choose for whom you will fight a dinosaur and a monkey, fight.

title: Remorse
description: This game takes place in an ascending void where walls flank the sides and platforms of varying lengths rise upward.

title: LouveSystems' TrackMasters
description: Create your own tracks - challenge your friends!TrackMasters is a multiplayer arcade racing game inspired by MicroMachines, packed with a full level editor to make your own tracks the way you want, and share them with your friends!

title: Frog World
description: Venture into the depths of the Swamp as an adorable frog! Grapple, swing, jump, and swim to complete a secret quest in this short side scrolling adventure.

title: Hadrian's Villa Reborn: Stadium Garden
description: Take a virtual tour of the Stadium Garden at Hadrian’s Villa, the World Heritage Site located in Tivoli, Italy. After the virtual tour you will know far more about how the place was designed, decorated, and used than even a visitor to the actual archaeological site, now reduced to a grassy field.

title: Alan Wake Remastered
description:
Alan Wake Remastered is an updated version of the original psychological horror action-adventure game developed by Remedy Entertainment. The game retains the core narrative, which follows bestselling thriller novelist Alan Wake as he struggles with writer's block. He visits the small town of Bright Falls with his wife, Alice, in search of inspiration. Shortly after their arrival, Alice mysteriously disappears.

Alan finds pages of a thriller novel he does not remember writing, with events from the manuscript coming to life. He faces supernatural entities called the "Taken," who are controlled by darkness. The remastered version features enhanced graphics and improved performance, but the gameplay and storyline remain consistent with the original, focusing on themes of reality, fiction, and the power of the written word.

It also includes the two story DLCs "The Signal" and "The Writer".

title: Dot Dash Dot
description: "You were the only applicant. You have been accepted. Please report to Locke Key by Monday." Take the role of a lighthouse operator, and use your spacebar to send Morse code messages to ships in the sea.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Imrik
description: A direct descendant of Caledor the Phoenix King, Imrik is widely known as the greatest living Dragon Prince and shares a unique bond with Dragonkind.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Gor-Rok
description: Gor-Rok, or the Great White Lizard as he is known, is a veteran Saurus Warrior with the scars to prove it.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Tiktaq'to
description: Tiktaq'to, Master of Skies for the Temple-City of Hexoatl, is the greatest of all the Terradon Riders. Atop his fierce terradon, Zwup, he patrols the firmament, leading his squadron through the narrowest, ravines and steepest valleys, surprising the enemy by appearing from unexpected directions and bombarding them with a deadly hail of rocks.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Alith Anar
description: Alith Anar appears as a new High Elf Legendary Lord in both the Eye of the Vortex and Mortal Empires campaigns. Voiced by Hollywood actor Dylan Sprouse, Alith Anar brings a host of unique traits and abilities to High Elf campaign and battle gameplay.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Lokhir Fellheart
description: Lokhir Fellheart, the Krakenlord of Karond Kar, is loosed upon the world! The latest and most notorious of his line, he plies the coastlines and seaways of the world, plundering ports and settlements for their riches and enslaving their inhabitants.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Twisted & The Twilight
description: This Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II introduces two new Legendary lords for the Skaven and the Wood Elves. Each leads their own faction and features new characters, units, unique gameplay mechanics and narrative objectives.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Hunter & The Beast
description: The Hunter & The Beast is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle, for use in both the Eye of the Vortex and Mortal Empires campaigns, and custom/multiplayer battles.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Repanse de Lyonesse
description: Repanse de Lyonesse, or the 'Damoiselle de Guerre' as she is known throughout Bretonnia, is a revered knight of the Chevaliers de Lyonesse.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Warden & The Paunch
description: The Warden & the Paunch is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own factions, objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Shadow & The Blade
description: The Shadow & The Blade is the latest Legendary Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Introducing Malus Darkblade and Deathmaster Snikch both with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle.

title: Total War: Warhammer II: Steps of Isha
description: The Steps of Isha is a free downloadable Map Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. This Map Pack contains 4 new battle maps for custom and multiplayer battles in Total War: Warhammer II.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Queen & The Crone
description: The Queen & the Crone is the first Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Bolstering the forces of the High Elves and the Dark Elves, it introduces famous rival characters and new iconic units from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles to your campaigns and battles.

title: Total War Saga: Thrones of Britannia - Blood, Sweat and Spears
description: Rule Britannia with a bloodied iron fist and experience the true brutality of war. Blood, Sweat and Spears adds ultra-violence and gore to Total War Saga: Thrones of Britannia.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Eight Princes
description: The year is 291 CE, and a generation has passed since the tumultuous events of the Three Kingdoms period began. Despite the tripartite division of power which brought the conflict to a stalemate, and the brief unification of the kingdoms under the Jin dynasty, civil war is no more than a heartbeat away.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Tao Qian
description: Tao Qian has long been a steward of the Han and his own territory. He is renowned as a dependable and respectable governor, and one who focuses on building tall. He wants to make life better for the people he governs, and defends his lands against those would dare to encroach upon it.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Shi Xie
description: Nepotism rules in the world of Shi Xie, and he is determined to spread his inner circle across the whole of China. Shi Xie will stop at nothing to get his family into power; After all, it’s all about who you know.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Reign of Blood
description: This pack introduces a number of new gory and mature-rated effects, animations and kill-moves to the game in both Campaign and Battle.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Yellow Turban Rebellion
description: A brand-new sub-culture to play as: rekindle the Yellow Turban Rebellion, lead their struggle against the corrupt Han and bring about the Era of Great Peace.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - A World Betrayed
description: A World Betrayed portrays a seminal moment in the history of the Three Kingdoms. Many of the iconic warlords of Total War: Three Kingdoms have now passed on, a catalyst that has spurred a new generation of warlords into making a play for their own dynasties.

title: Skyforge: Bounty Hunter Collector's Edition
description: Let the hunt begin! This Collector’s Edition unlocks the Bounty Hunter, a powerful new AOE damage-dealing class armed to the teeth with explosive weapons, plus trick anti-grav and shield gadgets. You'll also receive an exclusive Costume, Legendary Weapon, and a host of useful items:

title: Ancient Souls Tamag
description: Help Erlik Khan to get out of Tamag. Defeat your enemies, solve puzzles and overcome challenging obstacles. Prince of Souls-Like kind a game.

title: American Truck Simulator: Texas
description:
Howdy, partners! Hope y'all will like your visit in the Lone Star State, Texas. This place ain't full of cowboys anymore but the spirit lives on, especially in ranches you can find all 'round. We also got a lot of cattle and other livestock so your truckin' adventures will be lively.

We also love music. Like, really love music. Just look at Austin, the live music capital of the world. Party on. Look plumb over yonder and you'll see the city which got the message about the problem. Sure'nuff, we're talking about Houston. So enjoy the drive.

Get your lasso ready and catch all the news by hittin' the follow button and wishlisting Texas. This probably ain’t your first rodeo.

title: American Truck Simulator: Colorado
description: Welcome to Colorful Colorado, a state that has some of the best wildlands and mountain ranges in the US. See a big metropolitan area of Denver on the edge of the Great Plains, travel across the beautiful Rocky Mountains and through deep canyons to see vast desert landscapes around Grand Junction.

title: Metal Swarm Infinity
description: Enter an ever changing, randomly generated galaxy and battle the Metal Swarm menance in this arcade style shoot 'em up. Blast through hordes of bugs, collect powerups and battle giant bosses as you harvest their power cores to upgrade your ship.

title: Escape From School
description: Confused, you wake up sucked into an empty classroom. You have to try to escape from school by solving puzzles and discovering secrets.

title: Blon
description: Blon is a cute pixel-art 2D platformer game. Unlock spells, heroes and weapons, fight monsters and bosses and explore an unknown world in hopes of rescuing your family.

title: FGTeev Goozy
description: Explore a house full of weird technology and slimy surprises as you attempt to save the FGTeeV family.

title: Payday 2: The Charlie Santa Heist
description: The Charlie Santa Heist is the first annual OVERKILL Xmas heist for PAYDAY 2 and lets players do a classic bank job - robbing the GO Bank, based on a map from Counterstrike: Global Offensive, in the outskirts of Washington D.C. This heist was a part of update 20 and is completely free for our players.

title: Payday 2: The Diamond Heist
description: Time to Shine.The Diamond Heist DLC is the 13th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and adds the fourth heist from the new contact known as the Dentist. It's time to shine for the PAYDAY gang with the most exciting heist yet - the Diamond heist. You've heard the legend of the Diamond. A meteorite that was found by Genghis Khan.

title: Payday 2: John Wick Heists
description: THE LEGEND IS BACK IN TOWNThe John Wick Heist Pack is the 38th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2. The John Wick Heist Pack comes with 2 brand-new Heists: Brooklyn 10-10 and Yacht Heist, 2 new weapons, 4 masks, patterns, materials, 2 songs and 12 new achievements.

title: Payday 2: The Shadow Raid Heist
description: The Shadow Raid Heist is the fourth free heist update to PAYDAY 2. It allows heisters to take a new contract from Bain and Gage called the Shadow Raid job. A stealth only heist, it includes a free mask, the “Somen Mempo” mask, as well as 6 new achievements. This heist was a part of update 29 and is completely free for our players.

title: Payday 2: Buluc's Mansion Heist
description: Vlad contacts the Payday Gang and wants them to infiltrate the crime lord Buluc’s well-guarded mansion and assassinate him.

title: Payday 2: The Alesso Heist
description: Gang! Listen up!The Alesso Heist DLC is the 23rd DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and is a collaboration with the DJ Alesso. Navigate through the Gensec arena, quiet or loud, and keep the show going while trying to crack Gensec's state of the art exhibition vaults containing loads of cash.

title: Payday 2: The Bomb Heists
description: Bombs Away!The Bomb Heists DLC is the 15th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and adds the first two heists from the new contact known as the Butcher. It's bombs away as you help the Butcher succeed with the heists Dockyard and Forest as a part of the Bomb job.

title: Payday 2: The Golden Grin Casino Heist
description: Las Vegas is a Desert Mirage, a Jewel Amongst the Sands.The Golden Grin Casino Heist DLC is the 24th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and is the final contract from the Dentist. She boasts more Five Diamond hotels than any other city in the world. Her shine and sparkle attracts tens of millions of dreamers every year.

title: Payday 2: The Point Break Heists
description: Crime Has No Limit.The Point Break Heists DLC is the 29th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and represents a dream come true collaboration for us developers in the OVERKILL crew. For those of you who've been playing PAYDAY games since the first one came out, you know Point Break was one of the heist movies that was the core inspiration for PAYDAY.

title: Payday 2: The Diamond Store Heist
description: The Diamond Store Heist is the first free heist that was released for PAYDAY 2 and lets players do a classy heist against the Gioielli Di Famiglia jewelry store in downtown Washington D.C.This heist was a part of update 11 and is completely free for our players.
