title: Payday 2: Armored Transport
description: The Armored Transport DLC is the second DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and lets players do every heisters dream – robbing armored transports, full of valuables, right in the middle of Washington D.C. If they're lucky, they can hit it big with a classic train robbery.

title: Payday 2: The Election Day Heist
description: The Election Day Heist is the third free heist update to PAYDAY 2. It allows heisters to take a new contract from the corrupt politician the Elephant called the Election Day job. A free pistol weapon, skill changes, a big stealth update and new assets have been added.

title: Payday 2: Scarface Heist
description: YOU WANNA PLAY ROUGH?The Scarface Heist Pack is the 37th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2. The Scarface Heist Pack comes with The Scarface Mansion Heist, 2 new weapons, 4 masks, materials and patterns and 6 Achievements.

title: Payday 2: The Ukrainian Prisoner Heist
description: This heist DLC sees the Payday Gang hitting the San Francisco docks in order to rescue a friend in trouble.

title: Payday 2: Border Crossing Heist
description: The Payday Gang is going to Mexico! This DLC contains two heists. The main heist is playable in both stealth and loud and includes pre-planning options. The secondary "cooking" heist is loud only and takes place in the same location but with a different scenario.

title: Panel Attack
description: Fast, flashy, and free.A modern twist on classic Panel de Pon / Tetris Attack–style match-3 action. Swap tiles, trigger insane chains, and push your skills to the limit as the board rises beneath you. Easy to learn, hard to master, and built for pure, arcade-speed fun.

title: Hentai Beach Girls
description: Visit sunny beach with the cutest girls walking around. But your intentions are very vulgar. Use beach balls to knockdown girls and kidnap them with drones.

title: Touch Melbourne
description: Explore the city of Melbourne through its various, tiny everyday interactions.

title: Inside the Void
description: Inside the Void is an exploration game where you must navigate through seven alien structures in an effort to unravel the disappearance of lost crew members. You will encounter messages left by the lost crew members that offer a glimpse into their fate.

title: Floating Sandbox
description: This game is a realistic two-dimensional particle system, which uses mass-spring networks to simulate rigid bodies (such as ships) floating in water and exchanging heat with their surroundings. You can punch holes in an object, slice it, apply forces and heat to it, set it on fire, and smash it with bomb explosions. Once water starts rushing inside the object, it will start sinking and, if you're lucky enough, it will start breaking up!

title: Can Androids Survive
description:
Becoming a walking, 2-ton supply line in a new shortform sandbox mech FPS from the writer of Can Androids Pray. In Can Androids Survive, you are a battlefield courier, sent to an active warzone on the Moon to deliver supplies to Starbound Alliance bases--even if it costs your life in the process. Battle a draining fuel gauge, hordes of mechanized hazards, and a treacherous lunar surface to unravel the nature of your existence. Jettison fuel through your exhaust ports to escape stellar float mines and launch your chassis across craters. End the war itself--by destroying the field.

In 2143, a rogue AI commandeers the defense satellites surrounding a dead Earth, and blows up the Moon.

This is how you do it.

title: Scourge Outbreak: Blindside
description: The brutal struggle between Echo Squad and Nogari continues with "Blindside", Scourge: Outbreak's first Multiplayer PvP Map DLC Pack, featuring six new action-filled Versus maps. With extreme heights, speeding trains, death-dealing lasers and toxic gas, danger lurks around every corner.

title: Zoners
description: Zoners is a fast paced, 1-on-1, competitive sports action game. Featuring a cast of atypical characters, a Milky Way galaxy not exactly as you know it, simple but deep mechanics & tons of profile based accessibility & customization features. It's time to get into the zone!

title: Scary Buddies
description: Play online in VR with 3-15 players in a mysterious mansion, identify the killer and get him down!

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: USA Utah
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the fantastic state of Utah with many airports, like Salt Lake City and the Monument Valley area. Additionally this DLC features high resolution aerial images of Utah with up to 1 meter resolution.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Monterey Regional Airport
description: A classic Orbx destination brought to life for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator, virtual pilots are welcomed to Monterey Regional Airport, one of California's most scenic airports.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Switzerland
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator feature over 30 of the best known airports of Switzerland, including Zürich, Grenchen, Samedan and Birrfeld. Furthermore this DLC features high resolution aerial images of Switzerland with a resolution of up to 1 meter.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: USA South Florida
description: Welcome to south Florida and the Florida Keys! This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the southern part of Florida, including historic Key West. You will be mesmerized by the breathtaking views while you fly over major attractions like Fort Zachary Taylor, the Martello Museum, Duval Street, Key West cemetery, The Key West Southernmost Point, etc.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: USA Colorado
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the fantastic state of Colorado with over 30 airports, like Denver International, Aspen and scenic airports like Telluride. Additionally this DLC features high resolution aerial images of Colorado with up to 1 meter resolution.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Eagle County Colorado
description: Located in the heart of the Colorado Rockies, Eagle-Vail is famous for both it's dramatic scenery, as well as it's dangerous approach. Surrounded by difficult terrain and prone to bad weather, KEGE is a high-altitude airport that will test even seasoned pilots.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Palm Springs International Airport
description: A classic Orbx destination developed by Jarrad Marshall, Palm Springs has been brought to life for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator! With one of the most dramatically scenic backdrops in the United States, Palm Springs is a resort city situated 100 miles east of Los Angeles in Southern California.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Innsbruck Airport
description: A destination that needs no introduction, Innsbruck is one of the iconic airports of the world, with a jaw-dropping backdrop, heart-stopping approaches and a location in the heart of Europe.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Aerosoft - Lukla Mount Everest
description: “Gateway to Mount Everest” and “World's Most Dangerous Airport” are certainly the most commonly used attributes for Lukla – an airport that seems out of this world.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: France VFR - Paris-Ile-de-France
description: Take off to Paris, the romantic and artistic city with a thousand faces ! Fly over the capital but also the entire "Ile de France" region by discovering the diversity of its landscapes and its rich cultural and tourist heritage...

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Netherlands TrueEarth
description: TrueEarth technology is finally landing in Aerofly FS 2 starting with The Netherlands! Expect to find extremely dense building & vegetation cultivation, incredible crisp terrain textures, and effortlessly smooth performance.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Aerosoft - Germany Helgoland
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the famous island of Helgoland in Germany with detailed buildings and a a very detailed airport. Additionally this DLC includes surrounding landmarks like the fishing and tourist town Büsum as well as Germany's largest oil field Mittelplate.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Northeastern USA
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the area of New York with detailed city buildings and over 10 airports, like KJFK John F. Kennedy International and KGLA La Guardia. Additionally this DLC features high resolution aerial images of New York and the surrounding area with up to 1 meter resolution.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Q400
description: One of the most famous turboprop regional airliners, the Dash 8 Q400 for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features realistic flight dynamics, a detailed auto flight system and avionics system as well as an accurate turboprop engine simulation. The Dash 8 Q400 is the largest regional airliner of the Q Series and can seat up to 86 passengers.

title: The Necromancer's Tale
description: A story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.

title: Free Kick X
description: Become the legendary freekicker in the Football arena with Free Kick X. Play with different countries. Think tactical, be quick against the time and enjoy the free kicks!

title: Lost and Found: What if I Come and Find It
description: "Lost and found - What if I come and find It" is a first-person narrative game whose story will take you to the depths of working in a great corporation. After finishing your studies, you have achieved an internship in the maintenance department of SilverCup, the most renowned technological company in your city. A unique opportunity which will bring you a promising future.

title: HyperViolent
description: An ancient evil has awoken in the depths of a remote mining asteroid, stirred from its slumber by man's lust for power. Unaware, you answer a distress call and become stranded, surrounded by monstrous foes. Unravel the mystery of this madness and stop its spread in this violent retro shooter!

title: Video Horror Society
description: Choose between good and evil and fight for your life in Video Horror Society, a thrilling 4v1 asymmetric action tribute to the 1980s horror era-- where small town teens face off against terrifying monsters brought to life from the aisles of a 1980s video store.

title: The Enthralling Realms: The Blacksmith's Revenge
description: A challenging fantasy match-3 game! Help the Blacksmiths daughter Ara to avenge her village and defeat a vicious dragon.

title: Doom 3: The Lost Mission
description: The Lost Mission is the second official Doom 3 expansion pack, released in 2012 as part of Doom 3: BFG Edition. The player takes control of a surviving member of the marine squad Bravo Team, which the hero of the original campaign was meant to rejoin. The primary objective, given to the marine by Dr. Richard Meyers, is to shut down a high-powered long-range teleporter in the top secret Exis Labs in order to prevent the demons from using it to reach Earth.

title: Lotus Simulator: München Tram
description: The first add-on for the Lotus Simulator: the Munich Tram. With the tram R2.2b of MVG you can virtually drive through the city centre of Munich and explore the scenery along routes 27 & 28. Detailed reconstructed and perfectly animated. Take control at the driver's seat, let's go.

title: Covid 2069
description: Short descriptione were told to wash our hands. We were told to wear a mask. We were told to stay at home. We didn't, now we've got countless undead on our hands

title: Mafalda: Jugando con Números y Palabras
description: An Argentinean edutainment game featuring the characters of the comic strip Mafalda. You play as the main character, Mafalda, who has to aim at various posters in order to unlock her birthday party (Math) or a trip to the beach (Language). There are also a couple of mini-games in between.

title: Conan Exiles: Isle of Siptah
description: Isle of Siptah is a massive expansion to the open world survival game Conan Exiles, featuring a vast new island to explore, huge and vile new creatures to slay, new building sets and a host of new features.

title: System32
description: Teleport into a 1988 personal computer running a visually intense bullet hell simulation. Fight alongside your team to destroy Russian hackers in real-time.

title: Viscera Cleanup Detail: House of Horror
description: In an old house, on a gloomy Halloween night, a dark force was woken and terrible deeds were done. Now it's your turn to remove the stains of evil and clean up this mess!

title: Viscera Cleanup Detail: The Vulcan Affair
description: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to get on with the job and clean this place up! In this DLC for Viscera Cleanup Detail, you will have to deal with the aftermath of a mission on Dr. Hades lair.

title: Myth of Mist: Legacy
description: In the mist-surrounded City of Time and Eternity, you are the son of a noble family, going between various factions aiming to fight against the upcoming disaster of the Mist of Doomsday. This game is for players who love SLGs and multi-ending RPGs. Join us and write your own legend!

title: Darq: The Crypt
description: Lloyd's adventure continues. This time he explores a mysterious crypt full of dark surprises.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: ETR 1000 - Frecciarossa
description: The ETR 1000 "Frecciarossa" is a train, that lives superlatives: being one of the world's fastest trains, it reached a lunatic 400 km/h.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: NYC J3a-Dreyfuss Streamlined Hudson
description: New York Central J3a-Dreyfuss streamlined Hudson built by American Locomotive Company in 1938.

title: Space Crisis
description: The enemy is attacking in the spaceship. You are a combatant, so you have to fight.

title: Unshaded
description: A game from the creator of Within the Blade. Complete 100 hardcore stealth missions. Become a ninja master.

title: Push the Box 3D
description: This game is based on Sokoban in 3D with new mechanics and puzzles.

title: Rekkr: Sunken Land
description: A retro FPS set in a faux norse-celtic fantasy world in the midst of a war with the dead. Grab an axe, get revenge.

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Lauren Shiba Super Samurai
description: This unlocks Lauren Shiba - Super Samurai Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Dai Shi
description: This unlocks Dai Shi - Jungle Fury Villain, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Robert James Jungle Fury
description: This unlocks Robert James - Jungle Fury Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Lord Zedd
description: This unlocks Lord Zedd, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Ryu Crimson Hawk Ranger
description: This unlocks Ryu - Crimson Hawk Ranger in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Trey of Triforia: Gold Zeo Ranger
description: This unlocks Trey of Triforia - Gold Zeo Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Chun-Li Blue Phoenix Ranger
description: This unlocks the character: Chun Li - Blue Phoenix Ranger for Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Anubis Cruger SPD Shadow Ranger
description: This unlocks Anubis 'Doggie' Cruger SPD Shadow Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Scorpina
description: This unlocks Scorpina, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Eric Myers Time Force Quantum Ranger
description: This unlocks Eric Myers Time Force Quantum Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Pulsar
description: Pulsar is a casual game where it takes reasoning and analysis to find the way to the goal.

title: Syrian Warfare: Return to Palmyra
description: A large expansion to "Syrian Warfare". A new single-player campaign is focused on the dramatic events between December 2016 and March 2017 around Palmyra.

title: Battle Academy: Operation Market Garden
description: After fighting some of the most iconic moments of World War II, it’s time again to use all your tactical skills to capture Arnhem bridge and secure a crucial victory against the Germans in one of the most complex and articulated battles ever fought.

title: Boat Crew
description: Command your crew in Boat Crew, a gripping action-strategy experience amidst the Pacific War. Take charge of a PT boat against Imperial Japan, skillfully managing resources and personnel by any means necessary to ensure victory in this high-stakes conflict.

title: Base Defense VR
description: A classic tower defense game made for VR!

title: Gravel: Armored Operation
description: A selection of military vehicles, adapted to racing and finished off with weaponry join the Gravel roster. A new Off-road Masters episode was created for these unusual yet spectacular vehicles.

title: 100 Doors: Escape from Work
description: This escape logic puzzle game takes you to the most beautiful company in the world. Just when you're busy looking around, you find out that you can't leave. Solve the puzzles, find the keys to all of the doors & escape from work!

title: Hentai Mosaique Neko Waifus
description: Hentai puzzler, micro visual novel, with a sprinkle of RPG. All the neko girls in town heard all about you, now they can finally meet you!

title: Mosaique Neko Waifus 2
description: Hentai puzzle, micro visual novel, with a sprinkle of RPG.

title: Mosaique Neko Waifus 4
description: Hentai puzzle with elements of RPG and meaningful dialogue choices. Flirt with all the Neko girls!

title: Combo Babies
description: Rollback netcode physics-based fighting game made by a solo developer.

title: Lost in Space
description: Humanity ran out of the resources over one hundred years ago. Now we are searching for a new planet to make it our home.

title: Detention Club: School's Out
description: Detention Club: School's Out is a femdom game featuring a visual novel interface that blends seamlessly with gruelling turn based boss fights to progress the story.

title: Mana Go Round
description: A fantastical puzzle game where you match mana and magic circles to cast spells, clear the field, and win!

title: Minesweeper Ultimate
description: Play classic minesweeper or face new challenges in hex and triangular minesweeper modes.

title: Infinity War
description: Inifinity War is a multiplayer turn-based strategy game where you will have to defend your capital, explore modules, create tanks and of course fight. To win the game, you need to capture all the enemy capitals.

title: Splash Girls
description: Splash Girls is an exhilarating shooting action game in which you must save girls who have grown gigantic due to a mysterious virus. Players wield a vaccine-firing gun and a massive syringe to stand against the rampaging virus. The only thing that can save these giant girls is your extra-thick injection!? An flashy rescue mission of extraordinary scale and intensity is about to begin.

title: Don't Hate My Music Taste
description: Don't Hate My Music Taste is a first person shooter with a dynamic map that changes according to the playing music. You play your music so that no one can hate your music taste.

title: Dead by Daylight: Hellraiser Chapter
description: Hellraiser is a new Chapter in Dead by Daylight. It includes a new Killer, Pinhead. Demon to some, angel to others Pinhead seeks to unleash the limitless thrill of pleasure and pain upon any who cross his path. Purchasing the add-on will unlock the new Killer and an exclusive universal charm.

title: Slimefrog
description: Use your tongue as a grappling hook to navigate up an exotic and unforgiving world, while being verbally abused by a flying snake. Be careful, any fall can send you all the way back down...

title: OnlyGame: Working Girls
description: Relax class puzzle game to keep you in a good mood with sexy girls.

title: Tiny Robots Recharged
description: It was all fun and games until the bad guy took your friends. It's not their fault he built his super-secret laboratory next to the park.

title: 2 Synchro Hedgehogs
description: A puzzle-platformer with two hedgehogs moving in sync! Polish your logic by controlling a team of twins in one move!

title: Animalia Survival
description: Live as your favourite african animal, choose between being a carnivore, herbivore or omnivore, predator or prey. In this multiplayer ecosystem, with a realistic open world, choose to become a lion, a elephant or even a swift gazelle! But remember, the savannahs law is to survive at any cost!

title: Exploaris: Vermis story
description: Exploaris: Vermis story is a metrodvania game where you have to explore a mysterious planet,a group of researchers recently disappeared on the planet, help the main character to solve the secret of this planet, and find researchers.

title: Niffelheim: Odin's Blessing
description: This DLC has been created especially for all those who would like to play Niffelheim in a more relaxed mode. As you can tell from the title, Odin’s blessing will be with you at all times!

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: Texas Motor Speedway Dirt Track
description: Take a trip to the Lone Star State with The Texas Motor Speedway Dirt Track!

title: Teravit
description: Teravit is an open-world sandbox RPG where you can run, fly, dig, build, and explore the voxel world in your own unique way. Adventurers explore a vast, randomly generated world with a variety of biomes and cities with different characteristics, crafting equipment and items to take on strongholds of vicious monsters to save the world from the clutches of evil. Set forth on an adventure and create your own lasting story. Explore the map in earnest, collecting items, excavating terrain with explosives, and even creating block art. The ultimate goal in this open-world is yours to decide.

title: Summercamp
description: Step into a world straight out of the classic films. SummerCamp brings slasher themes into a thrilling new multiplayer video game experience!

title: One Day in London: Chapter IV
description: The long-awaited Fourth Chapter of the visual novel One Day in London! When the enemy seems to have already won, will Jeremy be able to continue to fight?

title: One Day in London: Chapter III
description: The third chapter continues the story of the visual novel One Day in London. Find out what happens after the events in the Bethlehem hospital...

title: One Day in London: Chapter V
description: The final chapter of visual novel One Day in London! Trapped enemy is the most dangerous... It's time for extreme measures!

title: Anime World
description: Immerse yourself in ANIME WORLD with impressive cel-shaded animations and look right into the soul of every character.

title: Aruna
description: Aruna is a beautiful and intense 3rd-person adventure game. Dive deep with your soul inside a mystical environment and bring back the light to your corrupted world, heading towards a mysterious place hidden in the mountains.

title: Zup! Zero: DLC
description: A DLC of Zup! Zero that brings 11 new levels to enjoy!

title: Deja Vu: Collector's Edition
description: Young American seeking his girlfriend who has gone missing in a backwater Russian city where it seems nothing much has changed since Soviet times

title: Freakshow: Episode 2
description: After thwarting the schemes of Lord Nosferatu, Alex must now fight witches and sexy teachers!!!

title: Freakshow: Episode 3
description: Lord Nosferatu invokes the undead to get rid of the Huntress and her sidekick...

title: Freakshow: Episode 1
description: Freakshow is a Serial Visual Novel where you battle supernatural threats while dealing with college life and dating. In the first season of Freakshow you will take on the role of Alex, a young man who discover the existence of the unknown and the horrors that hides in the shadows.

title: Domination
description: Domination is a first-person horror, action and story game, where you get involved in conspiracies about the Reptilians

title: Grunnd
description: This is a 100% handcrafted point and click adventure about traveling to a seemingly ordinary place, right next to you that slowly introduces itself as a surreal and twisted world that has it's own invisible gods, agendas, and order.

title: Fastest Hands in the Wasd
description: A Wild West themed incremental/clicker game, but this time you type WASD to shoot. Utilize and customize the various weapons to find a combo that works for you, or use the Showdown and Training modes to benchmark how fast you can type WASD.

title: Offworld Trading Company: Interdimensional
description: Your conquest of offworld markets has taken you not only to Mars, but to the moons of Ceres, Europa, and Io. Each world comes with its own trials and challenges - now, you can face all of them down at once in Offworld Trading Company: Interdimensional.

title: Offworld Trading Company: Market Corrections
description: Market Corrections is a new piece of downloadable content for Offworld Trading Company that features 12 brand new maps and 3 new character campaigns that share why humanity began to colonize Mars.

title: Offworld Trading Company: The Europa Wager Expansion
description: If you thought turning a profit on Mars was tough, just wait until you try your hand building a business on Europa. The smallest of Jupiter’s Galilean moons, Europa presents new challenges - and new opportunities! - for brave space entrepreneurs.

title: Fill and Cross: Trick or Treat 2
description: Trick or treat? No tricks! 120 new Halloween-themed levels is a real treat for griddlers fans on Halloween!

title: Alien Attack: Zero
description: You are a brave stormtrooper, Alien Forces Annihilators Squad member. Your mission is to destroy every single enemy inside of your sector. At least, to try.

title: Atomicrops: Invasive Species
description: Atomicrops: Invasive Species update introduces four new bosses, rare Blood Moon nights, and vicious enemies. New content includes an Alien Ant, unique scrolls, 10 achievements, and Topiaries with permanent bonuses. Changes modify gameplay mechanics, seed sowing, and boss interactions. Balance adjustments fine-tune weapons, tractors, and enemy spawns. Bug fixes address audio issues, seed drops, and various gameplay mechanics.

title: Maze Workout: Lost Urban Exit Game - Trials 1
description: It's a maze game with 60 levels, you are alone, find the keys and the exit.

title: Survival on Amazonia
description: "Survival on Amazonia" is a survival RPG with four women to romance. You will craft and fight your way through powerful monsters, while making sure to keep yourself fed and well rested for optimal performance.

title: 0°N 0°W: VR
description: A first person surreal exploration adventure of visual auditory stimuli now available in VR! Participate in the early access development process.

title: Little Busters! Ecstasy
description: Little Busters! Ecstasy, also known as Little Busters! EX, is a visual novel released by Key which expands the game with new routes and a new character.

title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - I Am the Boss
description: Embody the four powerful bosses - Azexez, Count Carlyle, Ludmilla, and Azh-Rafir - in Quick Battle, online or offline Multiplayer modes. Master their four new spells: Azexez's Demon Portal, Ludmilla's Spider Swarm, Count Carlyle's Bile Blast and Azh-Rafir's Palm Blast!

title: Arslan: The Warriors of Legend - Skill Card Set 2
description: Adds 15 set of Limited Skill Cards. A set contains 3 cards. The Skill Cards can be acquired in Free Mode by selecting "Add" under "Skill Cards".

title: Panzer Corps: Grand Campaign - '40
description: May 10th, 1940The Maginot Line, shield of France and the battleship on land, was supposed to be impenetrable, but the Germans have a secret and daring plan aimed to topple their old enemy! Import your experienced troops from the first campaign, or start with a pre-generated brand new core and lead your forces to victory.

title: Panzer Corps: Grand Campaign - '41
description: 1941The largest invasion in the history of the world, Operation Barbarossa, is about to begin! Before it can, however, the Balkans must be secured! Take command of your forces once again and lead them to victory in this next installment of the Grand Campaign!

title: Panzer Corps 2: Pacific
description: For the first time in its 10 year history, Panzer Corps series is going to thoroughly explore the Pacific Theatre of Operations in the Second World War.

title: Extinction: Ravenii Rampage
description: As the sole warrior equipped with the skills to save humanity, you must use everything in your arsenal to defeat the ogre onslaught.

title: Hitman 2: Hawke's Bay
description: Enjoy a moonlit stroll to the sounds of roaring waves off the coast of Hawke's Bay, New Zealand, and retire for the evening on the deck of a highly secured luxury beach house designed by renowned architect Oscar Wong.

title: Hitman 2: Santa Fortuna
description: Explore the remote village of Santa Fortuna, entrenched deep inside the lush Colombian rainforest and located at the foot of the infamous Delgado mansion.

title: Hitman 2: Mumbai
description: Nicknamed 'City of Dreams', lose yourself in the crowds of Mumbai's infamous slums, or admire Bollywood movie locations from afar; Mumbai will not disappoint with its colorful life and countless hidden secrets.

title: Hitman 2: Isle of Sgàil
description: The Isle of Sgàil, North Sea, is one of the most secretive places in the world. Rumored to have served as everything from a Roman outpost to a "black site" prison for Russian spies, the island is a mystery to virtually everyone.

title: Hitman 2: Whittleton Creek
description: Picture perfect, Whittleton Creek in Vermont, USA, is the quintessential American suburb. Experience roads flanked by yellowing maple trees, carefully groomed yards and beautiful houses with neighborly people enjoying a quiet Saturday.

title: Hitman 2: Himmelstein
description: Perched in a sniper nest overlooking a lush Chateau during a lavish wedding ceremony, eliminate an international gang of thieves. Play alone as Agent 47 or choose a new operative and play online co-op with a friend.

title: One Piece: World Seeker - Extra Episode 1: Void Mirror Prototype
description: Play as Zoro as he takes the stage as a new playable character in this extra episode. Unfold the secrets of "the Factory" and give chase to a new boss character named KAGERO!

title: One Piece: World Seeker - Extra Episode 2: Where Justice Lies
description:
Experience Sabo's abilities as he takes the stage as a new playable character is this extra episode.

He heads to Prison Island to investigate the World Government's plot and finds underground mining tunnels.
Expose this conspiracy and dispense your justice!

title: One Piece: World Seeker - Extra Episode 3: The Unfinished Map
description: Play as Law as he takes the stage as a new playable character in this extra episode. Explore a new area, Skypiea, and unshroud the mystery of the island with the young Roule.

title: Overlay Balls & Mouse Tails
description: A game to kill boredom. You can bump or dribble balls and score better and beautify your system using mouse effects.

title: Astrokicker
description: Mixing old and new, Astrokicker is inspired by classic shootemups going back to the 80s, with a few twists. The player gets to fly in any direction, and using a combination of skill and strategy, takes out the starbases controlling warpfields.

title: Foglight Online
description: Foglight Online is a multiplayer horror survival game. One player plays as the Legendary Farberto, a monster with a bloodhounds nose, that can smell the other players. The other players have to hide or fight back in this intense nail-biting multiplayer experience!

title: Mémoire d'Arumac
description: Aidez Mia à suivre les traces de son grand père en retrouvant le trésor perdu ! Explorez, résolvez les énigmes et collectez d’anciens artefacts.

title: Swords and Sandals Crusader Redux
description: The world of Swords and Sandals is at war! Join the Crusade against Emperor Antares! For the first time since 2007, the beloved Swords and Sandals Crusader returns, reforged from the ground up. Fast paced, addictive tactical warfare is back and better than ever!

title: Azur Lane: Crosswave - Taihou
description: Unlocks Taihou, 3 new Support Ships, and additional Story Mode content.

title: Azur Lane: Crosswave - Formidable
description: Unlocks Formidable, 3 new Support Ships, and additional Story Mode content.

title: Tales of Zestiria: Additional Chapter - Alisha's Story
description: Alisha has ended her journey with Sorey and begins to walk her path as a lawmaker and politician. Yet, she is still unsure of so many things. Will she find Sorey... And her own answers? An all new adventure in the world of Zestiria awaits you!

title: Spell Swap
description: A 2D wizard fighting game about swapping spells with your opponents. Everyone gets their own spell and swaps on impact! Use your spell to kill your opponents... or use it to steal their own!

title: Roze Blud
description: Command your squad to seek and destroy in this fast-paced Tactical Arena Shooter. Defend the Homeland as Druidic Eco-Warriors (Roze Blud), or consolidate power as Corporate Mercenaries (NEED). Know your friends, find your enemies, fight until the last drop!

title: Parking light
description: Parking light is a racing game. The goal of the game is to put the bus in the parking space within the allotted time. The game has 104 different levels. To go to the next level you need to get at least one star. Stars stand out for collision-free passage.

title: Silo27: Crashlanded
description: An interstellar cargo ship crashlands on a planet that should not have been there.Explore, solve puzzles and fight your way through ancient ruins to find the portal that will bring you back on Earth.

title: Powertrip
description: Powertrip is a 3D Platformer with a twist. You've been captured by a cocky madman and if you want to escape, you'll have to complete his challenges.

title: Speedpunk: Last neo
description: Unlock new map Last neo!

title: Last Archmage Journey of Light
description: The legendary mage Merlin betrayed by his teammates in the holy war, fall from one of the legendary heroes to a rookie mage, and proceed the journey to the light with the help of new teammates. Along the way, you'll have to collect various magic scrolls and items to use in the combat.

title: Key 10th Memorial BOX
description: A special box celebrating the tenth anniversary of Key which contains six games: Kanon, Air, CLANNAD, planetarian ~the reverie of a little planet~, Tomoyo After ~It's a Wonderful Life~, Little Busters! Ecstasy, a large-sized t-shirt, a coffee mug, an artbook, six boxes of posters featuring characters from the game, several postcards depicting the heroines of each game, and a thank you document which is signed by all of the key members at Key.

title: The Disaster
description: Defend, survive, unlock, interact, upgrade and eliminate all zombies. A first person shooter game against zombies.

title: Autonima
description: Ohm, a recordkeeper from the great library, has been sent to the Crescent Mountains to uncover the origin of life. It has been 100 years since the Last Advent and now the metal bodies of the Autons are failing. They must find the Makers before their civilization disappears.

title: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 2
description:
DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 2 is the second part of a five-part story.

In Chapter 2, Sammy finds herself in a temporary shelter where she lives among total strangers and reunites with a few familiar faces. In this new environment, Sammy has to prepare herself to the changes that happened. Will she be able to find her footing again before getting to her parents?

title: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 3
description: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 3

title: Half-Life 2: Genry's Great Escape From City 13
description: Half-Life 2: Genry's Great Escape From City 13 is a free custom modification for Half-life 2. The game takes place a month before the events of Half-life 2. The mod is an action, with often changing locations and first-person shooter.

title: Opec Idle
description: Become an oil magnate in a few days! Without investing real money, you'll get real pleasure from the profits! From pipette of oil to sales of trains to the Kingdom of Esvatini!

title: HellCat: Redux
description: HellCat Redux comes with a bunch of improvements and new features.

title: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 5
description: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 5

title: Shuzzler
description: Shuzzler, the classic word game first released on iOS, has returned and is now available for the first time on Steam. The Steam edition comes with all new game modes to play single-player or with friends on the same device.

title: Relic Guardians: Complete
description: Rock, paper, scissors meet anime turn-based fights and time travel!

title: Peopledown
description: Are you looking for a cruel slaughter game? "PEOPLEDOWN" is an action game where you become a cruel murderer and kill people. This game is for people who like villainous slaughter games.

title: Rrrr3
description: An action adventure in the roguelike style with a few puzzles.

title: Slide Stories: Bonds & Memories
description: Follow a beautiful romantic story about an inseparable bond of a young couple in this relaxing and minimalist sliding puzzle game.

title: Siren Head Hentai Edition
description: This is a classic indie horror game. You are alone in the middle of a dark forest, help will not come and you can only count on yourself. Explore the location, find all the hentai drawings before the siren head finds you.

title: ZombieWave: Unlimited Challenges
description: This is a game to lead soldiers against zombies.You can lead soldiers to complete challenges without limit.

title: Koi-Koi Japan: Hana-Awase Rule
description: Let's enjoy "Hana-Awase", another fun and exciting game played with hanafuda cards that is different from "Koi-Koi". Three players compete to create matching pairs and sets of flower cards which is where the name Hana-Awase (Flower Matching) comes from.

title: Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire: Green
description: Let's go GREEN and get back to nature! This time all of the Pretty Girls have animal features. Find pairs of tiles to delete them. After you complete three rounds an anime girl in a sexy costume begins to reveal herself... As you clear stages, these beautiful animal girls get sexier and sexier!

title: MiniRacer
description: Choose your little car and race!

title: VR Wonderland: mini civilizations in a forest
description: This game will satisfy your fantasy. You will become a man/woman smaller than a rabbit, going through time and space through a magical stone door, and come to the mini-world island.

title: Textreme 2
description: A fully functional text editor topped with lots of juicy animations and effects that exaggerate your every action.

title: Covid: Survive the PlanDemic
description: A vaccine creates the undead. Survive, search for a cure, and endure waves of zombies.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Lightning War Doctrine
description: GERMAN COMMANDER: LIGHTNING WAR DOCTRINE; Provide air cover for your tanks while rapidly moving infantry capture territory from dazed enemy forces.STUKA CLOSE AIR SUPPORTA Stuka JU-87 will patrol the designated area, targeting enemy units with heavy 37mm cannons.

title: Vanguard Princess Lilith
description: Vanguard Princess Lilith DLC stars the dark and mysterious Daughter Of The Devil. The DLC is an updated and uncensored version of Vanguard Princess that features new battle stages, additional in-game music, as well as alternate story-lines and endings.

title: Power & Revolution 2020 Edition: 2017 Scenarios
description: Play as a Head of State or as the opposition on 01/01/2017: play as the new US president in Ronald Drump's Challenge and try to implement your policies, participate in the French election, improve the well-being of your people or play as a combatant in the 2017 war in Syria and Iraq.

title: Power & Revolution: 2019 Edition - 2018 Scenarios
description: With the 2018 Scenarios add-on, set out to conquer Mars and other unexplored planets; as the head of the American opposition party, prevent the start of nuclear war between the USA and North Korea; foil planned attacks on your territory; and take advantage of all the data updated for 2018, including historical conflict maps.

title: Power & Revolution: 2019 Edition - 2017 Scenarios
description: With the 2017 Scenarios add-on, play as the new President of the United States and try to implement your bold and controversial policies; participate in the French elections with the official candidates; increase the happiness of your people; and take advantage of all the data updated for 2017, including historical conflict maps.

title: 1775: Rebellion - Southern Theatre Scenario
description: Additional scenario for 1775: Rebellion.

title: Obscurite Magie: The City of Sin
description: A classic-style, turn-based RPG. After her precious family dagger is stolen, Louise tracks the thieves to the infamous town of Ruedidalia. But her situation becomes even more difficult when she is tasked with incredibly tough bounties.

title: Shambled Spiral
description: Singleplayer Genre - Weird/Casual/FPS Purchase now to possibly get a much better version in the future for FREE!

title: Plumber 3
description: The Plumber 3 is a popular logical game, whose goal is to connect two water points in a short time to drain the water. This game has 30 levels with a gradually increasing degree of complexity, and the game is ideally suited for mobile devices.

title: Detective VR: NFT Secret Files
description: The mysterious missing of a collector challenges you to start your own investigation. Explore secret locations, pick up details like a detective, build logic chains and solve riddles. Use vintage gadgets and incredible alchemical compounds. Resist the digital spirits of the NFT. Be careful!

title: Infinite sky
description: This is an escape flight game. The pace of the game is very tight. The player's goal is to survive as much as possible.

title: Tank Rampage
description: Tank Rampage is an online team action game where you control a tank in small arenas in fast battles against players from all over the world!

title: Afterglow
description: A wholesome slice-of-life visual novel. Experience a laidback, character-driven narrative set in an idyllic suburban neighborhood.

title: Craft Craft Craft!
description: Craft Craft Craft! As the name suggests, you produce items and sell them to other kingdoms, whether in our own city and develop our army and fight with other countries and villages.

title: Legacy of Datura
description: Embark on a magical adventure between a cyberpunk and a medieval world. A 2D fantasy inspired by Hong Kong recent historical events.

title: IT Startup: Tech Fodder
description: A dev themed Roguelike Deckbuilder. Play Developer Cards to gain project points. Raise your DEV’s efficiency with Knowledge Cards. Sabotage your opponents or steal their Developers. Craft a unique deck and squeeze out your employees to win the next Project Battle!

title: Freedom! Do or Die
description: When terrorism threatens the world there is no need to send a bunch of iconic movie heroes back from the '80s. One under-funded over-powered mercenary is all that's needed to save the world in this epic run 'n' gun destruction-fest of a homage to Broforce!

title: Maenovan
description: You are America's only hope! Work to bring the Federation to its knees in this interstellar space adventure game featuring space combat, mining, and a lore rich story!

title: Keo
description: Keo is a team-based online multiplayer vehicle combat game set in a sci-fi post-apocalyptic world. Build your loadout to suit your playstyle and balance your team to dominate the battlefield using futuristic remote controlled vehicles!

title: Mint Muse Sound Flare
description: Sound Flare is a new digital audio workstation (DAW) built from the ground up for mixing 3D spatial audio in VR. Its intuitive design enables fast audio production in VR and efficient production schedules for both 3D audio and 3D video projects.

title: RaceLeague
description: Car racing game with heavy focus on user-created tracks and multiplayer

title: Reloader: test_subject
description:
Reloader: test_subject is an experimental "Bullet Counting Reload Action" game that features realistic gun control combined with movie-style cinematics. We were inspired by numerous classic shootouts from movies and the indie game called Receiver.
Experience being a Reloader: having legendary shooting skills and engaging in Close-Quarters Combat. You just have to remember how to use the gun you're holding.

title: Totally Working Game
description: Inspired by infamous Clicker- type games, TWG is a mixture of casual AFK- point grinder, torture simulator and weird RPG. It allows you to upgrade torture methods, customize the torturing environment, and simply dive into ocean of silly violence against a lame gamedev.

title: Duck City
description: Duck City is a children's edutatinment title where you play as a talking duck in 6 games set around the titular Duck City, including basketball, racing, farming and hairdressing

title: DriftZ
description: In a world where drift is your only weapon of defense against Zombie invasion, you have been recruited for your skill. You are the only hope for your community.

title: BeatJunkies
description: MUSIC RHYTHM MULTIPLAYER BATTLE! A multiplayer game in which you can show how fast you are to catch the notes and squeeze your opponent off the stage.

title: Cat Simulator: Animals on Farm
description: Sneak up on your enemies, help Farmer, Goat and Piggy, and start a family!

title: Hunting Moon
description: Before Yoru try to end his own life, a succubus girl named Lilith appeared.

title: Loop Room
description: The loop room is a horror game from the first person point of view, and the goal is to operate 5 panels in 100 repeated rooms and escape to the emergency exit. Run away from the endless room through various equipment and items.

title: RaceRoom Racing Experience: DTM Experience 2014
description: Enter the world of a professional race car driver and experience the 2014 Championship season in the most authentic simulation to date. DTM Experience 2014 brings all 23 cars and 9 tracks from the 2014 race season to your PC. Ten races stand between you and becoming a DTM champion, enjoy the drive!

title: Cubox: Awakening of Gods
description: 3D blocky MMORPG open-world game. Build castles with friends, discover new biomes, new monsters and resources. Craft Items and upgrade equipment. Find new cities
