title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4 - Road to Boruto Next Generations
description: We're celebrating with the Next Generations DLC, which comes with a bonus theme and new playable characters: Momoshiki Otsutsuki and Kinshiki Otsutsuki. That's not all! 11 famous shinobi are joining the battle in new Boruto-era costumes!

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier - Khyber Strike
description: The third downloadable content pack for Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier, Khyber Strike features three new multiplayer maps, a new multiplayer game mode called Takeover, a new Guerrilla Mode co-op map, new achievements, and an increased level cap.

title: Pro Strategy Football 2021
description: Manage, Coach, or enjoy watching live sims! Create custom schedules! Configure playoffs formats, create manual brackets, or standalone tournaments! Enjoy custom sounds, music, and more! Season play with up to 130 teams! Career play with custom leagues!

title: Blaster Master Zero 2: Kanna Raising Simulator
description: Adds the ultra weird mini-game "Kanna Raising Simulator" to the EXTRA menu. Capture a variety of materials to make fertilizer and grow your very own Kanna! There are loads of potential Kannas to grow, and you can check out every one you've completed in "Kanna's Strangallery"!

title: Grim Tales: Trace in Time - Collector's Edition
description: Bad omens are on the horizon…

title: Vanguard Princess: Online Deluxe
description: Vanguard Princess: Online Deluxe features online netplay support for the Steam version of Vanguard Princess. The DLC is also an updated version of the game that also features unlocked characters, additional battle stages, in-game music, and story-lines.

title: My Lil Horror
description: Just a basic puzzle solving/survival game. Kill zombies, have fun, get to the end without dying! Updated versions may include more weapons, extra chapters, and more.

title: Quantum Conundrum: IKE-aramba!
description: Just when you thought you were done with rescue duty, it's up to you to save Ike! In this all-new adventure, rescue Ike and leap seemingly endless chasms as you travel through an all-new wing of Quadwrangle Manor.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Night Striker
description: From the unique arcade machine with an analog joystick and pseudo 3D, comes Night Striker. Pilot Inter Gray in 2D sidescrolling levels, and shoot down enemies with your homing missiles.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Galaxy Force II
description: An extreme motion game in a fantastic universe, Galaxy Force II was a pioneer in pseudo-3D graphics. Use your evasion roll while shooting missiles to down enemies.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Mahoudaisakusen
description: A game set in a world pervaded by the smell of oil and steel, where fantasy and steampunk are fused together. In true RPG fashion, your rivals reappear with new gear time and time again!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Soukyuugurentai
description: A 'lock-on' shooter set in a science-fiction world telling the tale of private armies and a battle for resources in the near future. Featuring a targeting system and widespread use of Japanese lettering at key moments to enhance the near-future setting meant it stood apart from its peers.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Space Harrier
description: Space Harrier is an all-time SEGA classic and pioneer in pseudo-3D graphics. With Harrier, you can set up fixed bursts and shoot all around.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Fantasy Zone
description: Fantasy Zone is famous for its free scrolling and shop system. Similar to the original, shooting down enemies will drop coins, which you can use to buy stronger attacks.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - RayForce
description: The beginning of the lock-on laser series, RayForce! Lock on to multiple enemies, before firing your laser, to get the highest multipliers.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Ketsui
description: Hyper aggressive game design brought many enthusiastic fans to this side scrolling shooting game. Welcome to special round!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Side Arms Hyper Dyne
description: Robot shooting with the tagline "Ultimate combination of α and β". The player ship, Alpha (nicknamed Mobichan), would go on to appear in many Capcom titles, including Varth!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - DoDonPachi Resurrection
description: Dondonpachi, the Cave masterpiece receives Resurrection after a Blissful Death. Feast on firepower in bullet hell!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Battle Garegga
description: Widely considered as both the origin of the bullet hell sub-genre and one of its standouts, the true joy of Battle Garegga's lies in unravelling the game’s various complex systems.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Metal Black
description: From its hard-boiled world, comes Metal Black. Gather Newalones to fill up your gauge and use your Focused Beam and Release Beam.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Deathsmiles
description: Side scrolling shooting in a Gothic Horror world! That distinctive cave touch wasn't lost with the switch to horizontal scrolling!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Varth: Operation Thunderstorm
description: Varth had the tagline "The Final Battle. Regain the planet VARTH!!" and was 30 stages of classic, vertically scrolling shooting with bullet-shielding pods and a self-charging bomb. Planet Varth wasn’t the final battle! Saber returns!

title: The Outbreak Guardian
description: The Outbreak Guardian is a third person open-world game where you are in charge of ensuring the welfare of the citizens of Patriam by managing the cities resources and agents, which involves delivering equipment and some driving.

title: The Pit: Infinity - Juggernaut
description: Summoned to Arbuda by the promise of a huge reward, Tor Makari is here to rescue a kidnapped human from a high-security alien facility and pull down the biggest bounty of his career. He is a force to be reckoned with, nigh unstoppable. He is a Juggernaut!

title: The Pit: Infinity - Healer
description: With a planet ravaged by disease and the only cure at the bottom of a long-abandoned alien science facility, SolForce medic Astryd Jemison must lay down her oath to do no harm, pick up her Transfuser pistol, and enter... The Pit.

title: XOXO Droplets: Full Version Extension
description: Bump your boyfriend prospects up by six more with the option to date Bae Pyoun, Jeremy King, Pran Taylor, Kam Sung, Adrian Wulu, and Lucas Kaiser.

title: ClickCells: Winter Lady
description: ClickCells: Winter Lady is an erotic casual puzzle! The player's goal to keep the blue block on the platform for 3 seconds in order to pass the level. As a reward you get pictures of a beautiful girl!

title: Watch Dogs 2: Zodiac Killer
description:
Zodiac Killer is a DLC-exclusive mission in Watch Dogs 2, available by pre-ordering the game or with the Season Pass. It is unlocked after completing the story mission Looking Glass and reaching 1,185,000 followers.

It features the return of the infamous Zodiac Killer, who haunted San Francisco for years. Players also receive an exclusive outfit and bonuses after completing the mission.

title: Kanamono
description: Destroy your enemies and use the scraps that come out to destroy them even more! Side-scrolling space fantasy shooting game, that is "Kanamono".

title: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Ostfront Veteranen
description: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Ostfront Veteranen is a new faction DLC for the critically acclaimed RTS series and expands on the game with a new unit selection, unseen in the franchise so far.

title: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Airborne
description: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Airborne is the second DLC for AS2. It comes with a set of new features and additional singleplayer content. Fight as airborne commander behind enemy lines and support allied landing operations. The success of these operations will depend solely on you!

title: Sokoban: Bunny Tales
description: How smart are you? Try this cute indie modernized take on the classic puzzle game Sokoban. The player must place colored boxes and balls on their goals to solve the 200 fun, interesting and increasingly challenging puzzles. Entertaining Bunny Tales stories included throughout the game.

title: Assau!t
description: Assau!t is a defense first person rail shooter. Defend yourself against the advancing, enemy charge. Although you have to stop it yourself, you can do it with good handling of the gun. Apply and use a variety of weapons to survive long with your guns from enemies.

title: Mira and the Mysteries of Alchemy
description: After making a big mistake while trying to craft a potion at the alchemy university, the apprentice alchemist Mira finds that she has exposed herself to an elixir that made fundamental changes to her body. Now she must go in search of the ingredients in order to craft the antidote.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Aya, the Calm Big Sister Swordswoman from "OneeChanbara"
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. Aya, the calm and composed swordswoman from the zombie-infested world of "OneeChanbara," has joined the fight, wearing not only her trademark 10-gallon hat and bikini, but also with a katana as her weapon.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Hostess Setsu from Dream Club, Giving the EDF a Try!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. This hostess was chosen to join the fight from "Dream Club," a club for adults that can only be joined by those with a pure heart.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Prowl Rider (EDF: IR), KR Prototype & Special Gear
description: In the world of "Earth Defense Force: Iron Rain," the Kindred Rebellion ceded from the EDF and developed their own experimental Prowl Rider PA-Gear.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Saki, the Crazed Little Sister Swordswoman from "OneeChanbara"
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. Saki, the crazed swordswoman from the zombie-infested world of "OneeChanbara," is here and ready to fight using her super long katana and acrobatics.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Colonist: "We'll Help, If It Means Saving the Planet"!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. The Colonists who invaded the planet in "Earth Defense Force 5" have rushed to join the fight.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Hostess Mian from Dream Club, Giving the EDF a Try!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. This hostess was chosen to join the fight from "Dream Club," a club for adults that can only be joined by those with a pure heart.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Hostess ILI from Dream Club, Giving the EDF a Try!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. This hostess was chosen to join the fight from "Dream Club," a club for adults that can only be joined by those with a pure heart.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - The Legendary Mr. Y, Reborn as "Mecha Yuki" After His Acid Incident!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. There was once a soldier who defended the Earth valiantly against the Invaders until he was defeated.

title: Electrified
description: Electrified is a captivating 2-player puzzle platformer. Switch your charge anytime to interact with other charges, the other player, and circuits to solve tricky puzzles. Use your skills to work together against a power-hungry corporation and reclaim your honor!

title: Planet Coaster: Knight Rider K.I.T.T. Construction Kit
description: The Knight Rider K.I.T.T. Construction Kit features in-game replicas of K.I.T.T., K.I.T.T. in Super Pursuit mode, and the evil Knight Industries prototype K.A.R.R. with silver and black finish.

title: Planet Coaster: Back to the Future Time Machine Construction Kit
description: The Back to the Future Construction Kit features in-game replicas of the DeLorean Time Machine in its original 1985 form, and in its 2015, 1955 and 1885 variants, with optional standard tires, ‘hover’ wheels, white-rimmed classic tires, or railway wheels.

title: Planet Coaster: Quick Draw Interactive Shooting Ride
description: Sharpen your aim in this target shooting ride. Ride the track, shoot the targets and log your high score in this test of accuracy. Or create your own themed interactive shooting galleries for a different experience every time.

title: Planet Coaster: The Munsters Munster Koach Construction Kit
description: The Munsters Munster Koach Construction Kit features in-game replicas of the Munster Koach and the DRAG-U-LA drag racer from The Munsters episode ‘Hot Rod Herman’ and the classic 1966 movie Munster, Go Home!

title: Dungeon of the Endless: Deep Freeze
description: Deep-Freeze adds the “The Refreezerator” spaceship that unlocks a new mode for the game, and adds Kreyang to the hero cast of the game.

title: Dungeon of the Endless: Rescue Team
description: Add-on for Dungeon of the Endless, the critically acclaimed Rogue-like Dungeon Defense hybrid, featuring 3 new heroes from the Rescue Team. What could go wrong? Open the Door!

title: Mr. Fish and his Assistants Sardines
description: Explore Mr. Fish's underwater museum on Human Evolution! This game attempts to make culture accessible to as many people as possible through a simple and fun style. The collections and objects belong to the Leibniz Research Museums.

title: Overmorrow
description: Overmorrow is a serene, nonviolent, exploration adventure game that deletes your save after 30 days.

title: Gravity Oddity
description: Defy gravity and warp your way through a procedurally generated galaxy in this roguelike space adventure. Put on your gravity boots and ready your teleport gun to find the best approach to defeat your enemies and loot their spaceships.

title: Crazy Lemmings
description: Control entire armies of lemmings and solve puzzles.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Urban Defense Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Urban Defense Tactics; Muster your defenses to fight the enemy street to street and house to house. Plant traps and build forward emplacements to strengthen your line. Incendiary Artillery Barrage: Areas if the map can be bombarded with incendiary round to burn infantry and deny access.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Anti-Infantry Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Anti-Infantry Tactics; Kill or drive off your enemy’s infantry forces with short-range shock troops, artillery and flamethrower tanks. Fear Propaganda Artillery: Airburst propaganda leaflets make targeted soldiers question the morality of their actions.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Elite Troops Doctrine
description: German Commander - Elite Troops Doctrine; Utilize Germany's most elite companies using stronger base troops with added abilities. Tiger Ace: High command sends in a legendary Tiger Ace. Only one is available, once deployed fuel income will be reduced by 90% and manpower will be reduced by 25% until the Tiger Ace is destroyed.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Storm Doctrine
description: German Commander - Storm Doctrine; Focused firepower and the ability to weather enemy counterattacks are hallmarks of this doctrine. Stuka Bombing Strikea JU-87D: Stuka will dive in and drop a 50kg bomb on the target location. Capture points are neutralized if hit. LEFH 18 Artillery: This light 10.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Osttruppen Doctrine
description: German Commander - Osttruppen Doctrine; Mobilize early-game infantry and improved resources to overwhelm your opponents and gain early map control. Railway Artillery Support: Off-map railway artillery will fire three large caliber shells at the designated target.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Mechanized Assault Doctrine
description: German Commander - Mechanized Assault Doctrine; Move quickly and strike hard with a variety of units trained for fighting at close quarters. Use vehicles and infantry together to outmaneuver your opponent. Tiger Tank: Allows the requisition of the Tiger Heavy Tank to the battlefield.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Luftwaffe Supply Doctrine
description: German Commander - Luftwaffe Supply Doctrine; Using the power of the Luftwaffe, keep your troops on the front lines as long as possible, even if cut off! Stuka Bombing Strike A JU-87D: Stuka will dive in and drop a 50kg bomb on the target location. Capture points are neutralized if hit.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Fortified Armor Doctrine
description: German Commander - Fortified Armor Doctrine; Your vehicles can live longer and fight harder with better vision, recon, defensive options and the presence of a Command Tank. Elefant Tank Destroyer: This heavy tank destroyer has a massive armor envelope and one of the most potent guns ever mounted on a fighting vehicle; the 88mm Pak43.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Encirclement Doctrine
description: German Commander - Encirclement Doctrine; Combine stealth and mobility to outflank the enemy and destroy them. Stormtroopers can be deployed to scout ahead or cut off the enemies supply lines, while vehicles and air support can be utilized to complete the encirclement.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Joint Operations Doctrine
description: German Commander - Joint Operations Doctrine; Spot your enemy and disrupt their operations, troop concentrations, and armored spearheads with artillery. Light Artillery Barragea: light artillery barrage from nearby 7.5 cm le. IG 18 infantry support guns can scatter enemy forces. LEFH 18 Artillery: This light 10.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Soviet Industry Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Soviet Industry Tactics; Using the built up Soviet industry, make use of more and stronger vehicle units at the cost of infantry numbers. KV-2 Heavy Assault Tank: A KV-2 Heavy Assault Tank can be ordered in to the battlefield.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Armored Assault Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Armored Assault Tactics; Heavy and medium armor is supported by IL-2 attack aircraft. Enemy forces identified through radio intercepts. Il-2 Sturmovik Attacks: IL-2 Sturmovik will loiter over the battlefield, strafing targets of opportunity with its powerful 23mm cannons.

title: Company of Heroes 2: OKW Commander - Elite Armor Doctrine
description: OKW Commander - Elite Armor Doctrine; Use superior equipment and experienced crewmen to augment your armored forces. Plan your tactics with Signal Relay or recover your armor with an Emergency Repair. Use the Sturmtiger to spearhead the assault. Signal Relay: Boosting signal range briefly reveals enemy vehicles on the mini-map.

title: Company of Heroes 2: OKW Commander - Fortifications Doctrine
description: OKW Commander - Fortifications Doctrine; Hold back the enemy at all costs with heavy defensive structures. Infantry can construct advanced defensive buildings. Heavy weapons such as the Pak43 can be combined with zeroing artillery to zone out and eradicate breakthroughs. leFH 18 Artillery: This light 10.

title: Company of Heroes 2: OKW Commander - Scavenge Doctrine
description: OKW Commander - Scavenge Doctrine; Gather whatever resources you can from the battlefield and defeated enemies. Troops are trained to be more thorough in their salvage operations while infiltrating light infantry can disrupt enemy supplies and lay traps.

title: Company of Heroes 2: US Forces Commander - Mechanized Company
description: US Forces Commander - Mechanized Company; Light vehicles provide valuable support to advancing American infantry units. Take advantage of a wide range of light US vehicles along with air support, as the battle escalates withdraw lighter units to replace them with more armored counterparts.

title: Company of Heroes 2: US Forces Commander - Rifle Company
description: US Forces Commander - Rifle Company; The Rifleman is the backbone of the American army emphasizing the American doctrine of versatility and individual firepower. Riflemen receive additional time in training to be more experienced against multiple threats as well as having access to more versatile weapon packages.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Partisan Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Partisan Tactics; Make use of the Soviet Partisan network to harass enemies from behind the lines while destroying them with the soviet main army. Mark Vehicle: Targeted vehicle is subject to an increase in focused fire from nearby opponents.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Tank Hunter Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Tank Hunter Tactics; Disable enemy tanks and armored vehicles more easily with a variety of upgrades and abilities to support existing AT options. Conscripts gain increased versatility against tanks, when that fails IL-2 planes can deliver a devastating anti-tank bombing run.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Terror Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Terror Tactics; A pantheon of combat forces guaranteed to cause fear in your enemy. IL-2 Precision Bombing Strike: The IL-2 will make a high-speed bombing run, clustering four FAB-50 50kg bombs into the target area.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Spearhead Doctrine
description:
German Commander - Spearhead Doctrine; Crush enemy defenses with heavy armor and powerful airstrikes. Recon enemy concentrations for mortar halftracks.
Fragmentation Bomb: High-explosive fragmentation bombs are dropped on the target location. Tiger Tank: Allows the requisition of the Tiger Heavy Tank to the battlefield.

title: Battle of Empires: 1914-1918 - French Campaign
description: The first campaign of the series - Battle of Empires: France - is devoted to the battles between the French and German armies on the Western Front.

title: Enchanted Kingdom: The Secret of the Golden Lamp - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save your dad from a genie bent on revenge?

title: GunBlocks
description: Stranded on a mysterious planet you need to find your ships lost cargo and collect resources to repair your ship and get off planet. Use tetrominos to make your way through the strange new world, solve puzzles and get to know its not too friendly inhabitants.

title: Faction Wars
description: A grid based single / local multiplayer strategy game where two factions clash in deadly turn based battles.

title: Dracula Frames
description: Dracula's castle consists of 8 floors. Each floor has a large picture with a magnificent painting representing landmarks of Dracula's life. Your goal is to rebuild each painting through a slide puzzle and get to the top floor!

title: Max, an Autistic Journey: Max's Birthday
description: Spend a day with Max as he excitedly wakes up eager to celebrate his birthday!

title: Dark Disciples II
description:
DD2 is, unsurprisingly, the sequel to DD1. The look and feel is therefore similar to that of the first game. However a number of significant improvements have been made to the game system:

DD2 features a new story line (unconnected to that of DD1). It takes place over 4 continents and ~130 levels.

The game features non linear gameplay - feel free to explore (there are tons of side missions, secret areas and off the beaten track oddities to discover).
There is now a proper skill system. There are 11 skills available from Pick Locks, to Dual Weapons to Curse to Gemlore.
Monster AI has also be greatly improved (DD2 uses the A* pathfinding algorithm).
Monsters now have proper abilities (called 'powers'): they can shoot arrows and cast spells.
Speaking of arrows, missile combat has been implemented in DD2 (there were no missile weapons in DD1).
Also new is mp3 quality music (if you choose to download the 'music pack').
The level editor is more useful and much better laid out. It's now possible to completely design your own campaign using the editor, including importing new item, tile and monster pics.
A Bag of Holding has been implemented - characters can now carry twice as much once they have purchased the bag.
There are also 'super' monsters: 3x3 tiles in size!

title: Disharmony
description: A dialogue-heavy turn-based RPG featuring a rhythm-based battle system, a world inspired by music, and a retro aesthetic. Explore the dreams of the game's characters, solve puzzles, and find cryptic secrets to uncover the true nature of this mysterious world. (Or don't. Most of it is optional!)

title: Malfunction FPS
description: In Malfunction FPS, your job is to defeat the robots and escape the robots to get to a door at the end of each level.

title: Ardarium
description: Watch nations grow and forests spread in this casual sandbox game where everything is automatic and gameplay is optional. It's like a screensaver that you can play. Make explosions that deform the ground, start forest fires, trigger earthquakes that wipe out civilizations, or just watch the sunrise.

title: The Dawning Clocks of Time
description: A classic story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic turn based RPG with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms with energy and exciting weapons and skills for the battle of the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity?

title: Neon Depth
description: In this puzzle-platform game, you must make mistakes in order to progress. Place blocks when you fail, and shape the level in your favor. Discover how to use blocks with different effects to escape from within yourself while learning to live with your mistakes.

title: Shine Within
description: A top-down action-adventure game as you collect & solve puzzles in order for you to explore & unravel this mysterious world.

title: Big Klondike: Classic Solitaire
description:
Big Klondike is a version of the very popular Klondike variation of solitaire. This version of solitaire is what generally is called Windows Solitaire, or what some people think Solitaire just is as a general term (when the truth is that Solitaire is a huge genre of games just as wide as FPS is).

Big Klondike features 1 Draw, 3 Draw, Random shuffles and Winnable shuffles. You can choose to have the Timer enabled or not if you prefer a relaxing experience.

Our Winnable shuffles are originally Random shuffles which our custom coded solitaire bot has play tested to ensure is actually possible. We ship the game with 50,000 known Winnable shuffles for both 1 Draw and 3 Draw variations. The 1.0.0 version of our solitaire bot was made to not be too incredibly clever, so all Winnable shuffles are guaranteed to be possible below 200 moves. Though a Winnable game is guaranteed to be possible, that does not mean you will always win it first time as sometimes moves can be made in ways where the game becomes bricked - impossible to finish in that state. If that happens you can Retry that same game and go for different moves to beat it!

In Big Klondike, cards can be dragged or clicked to move them to possible moves. Right click is also supported.

Once a game is deemed as mostly complete, Big Klondike will show a button to Auto Complete the game and move the rest of the cards into place in the foundations.

title: Smash MAGA! Trump Zombie Apocalypse
description: Anti-fascist gamers fight the Trump Zombie plague in this spree of rioting and looting!

title: Bubble Breaking
description: Bubbles come in different sizes (depths) and they rise at different speeds. Players have 60 seconds to pop as many as they can. When bubbles are popped points are scored. The smaller, faster bubbles score more points than the bigger, slower bubbles. Beware of the 'stink' bubbles.

title: Brambles in the Mist
description: In this SRPG, you play as a bard traveling in a foreign land in search of your muse. During your journey, you will meet numerous women to serve as your muses and also have romantic interactions with them. Faced with a common enemy that threatens the kingdom, you fight together to save it.

title: The Lion's Song: Episode 2 - Anthology
description: In "Episode 2 - Anthology" you play as the aspiring painter Franz who has a unique but unsettling ability to see the hidden layers of his subjects' personalities. Can he overcome his fears and self-doubt to finally see himself?

title: The Lion's Song: Episode 4 - Closure
description: "Episode 4 – Closure", will take players on a mysterious train journey that brings together four strangers and connects the storylines of all three previously released episodes. What stories will they share along the way and where will their journey end?

title: The Lion's Song: Episode 3 - Derivation
description: In "Episode 3 – Derivation", you take on the role of Emma, a brilliant mathematician, who struggles to make her voice heard in the male-dominated world of academics at the beginning of the 20th century. Can she lift the curtain of reality to get a glimpse of the principles governing her world?

title: Logistical 2: Suriname - Xmas 2018
description: Logistical: Suriname - Xmas 2018 is a small add-on module for Logistical 2 that covers a couple of tiny countries on the north end of South America. Suriname is the first module to fully make use of the road upgrading ability. There are many businesses and towns that would be so much easier to do if the roads took bigger trucks.

title: Logistical 2: Mall Rats
description: This Logistical 2: Mall Rats has over 150 towns and 1,000 businesses to complete. There are many malls throughout the United States of America. Mall Rats (teenagers) require large amounts of resources from these malls. Complete the malls to unlock critical resources to further unlock more of the map.

title: MotoGP 13: MotoGP Champions
description: MotoGP Champions gives you the opportunity to race as, and against, legendary riders of the past, including Doohan, Schwantz, Rainey, Spencer, Gardner, Capirossi and many others. Ride their historical 2 stroke 500 CC bikes and experience all the excitement of being a Motogp legend.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft Seychelles XP
description: The Seychelles are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean but what comes into most people’s minds when they think about the name is a tropical paradise, luxurious holidays, excellent diving spots and breathtakingly beautiful nature.

title: The Alpha 001
description: Dive into the simulation, explore, play mini games, break loot boxes, grow plantations on your farm, fight orcs, play with your friends, rescue robots, increase your village's population, mine resources, conquer villages! The simulation will prepare a lot of different things for you, get ready.

title: Zooma:Chapter 4 - "Temple of the Damned"
description: Nobody is welcome at the Temple, and only the moans of ghosts and the breath of the volcano that slowly devours the once-mighty fortress break the silence. Do you have what it takes to defeat the prehistoric evil and revive this dark stronghold to its previous glory?

title: Fallen Enchantress: Legendary Heroes - Battlegrounds DLC
description: Enhance your tactical battles and map options with this new DLC. Adds more than a dozen new tactical battle maps and over 20 new stamps to expand the random map generator.

title: Fallen Enchantress: Legendary Heroes - The Dead World DLC
description: Take command of the Empire of the Dead and lead them to grim victory as your undead armies strike fear into their mortal counterparts. Includes new monsters, spells and monsters to play with or against.

title: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine
description: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine is an Action-Adventure Metroidvania. The game features decision making, crafting, fast-paced combat, multiple endings, intricate storytelling, an open world to explore, and more!

title: Day of the Dimetrodon
description: A short little game about a day in the life of the prehistoric predator Dimetrodon.

title: Death Wore Endless Feathers
description:
Jakob is a hacker for Sector H, a new branch of Black Sun, a crypto-anarchistic organisation that looks after its own.

Funded by mysterious benefactors, Jakob and the rest of Sector H break open ractives to ensure that everyone can play them. It's a dog-eat-dog political minefield that Jakob wants no part of.

All Jakob wants to do is play ractives, watch the new Ripsaw Bloodgore concert, and have fun. He has no place in this war - but fate conspire against him, dragging him into the very core of this matter. He will never forget the day

DEATH WORE ENDLESS FEATHERS.

title: Dinner for Pigeons
description:
Dinner For Pigeons is a freeware, snack-size adventure game with candy-colored cartoon graphics and a gentle arcade slant.

Close your eyes. Imagine you are a pigeon. You are a hungry pigeon. Fortunately, these are the streets of plenty. So fly over to the diner and steal an evening meal from under people's noses. Try not to get killed in the process. That is this game.

title: Donald Dowell and the Ghost of Barker Manor
description: Donald Dowell is a nice old man in his eighties, retired for many years. Donald's life, except for his "intolerable" wife, is quiet. But Donald feels empty. He has the so-called retiree's syndrome : he's bored to death! The only way to cure his boredom is TO GO BACK TO WORK. After many hours spent in his city, trying to get hired for various jobs, he finally finds his calling: to be a GHOSTBUSTER! Donald will try to become Bob Delano's assistant (the most famous occult detective in Ireland), be involved in the investigation of Barker Manor and, hopefully, solve the mystery.

title: Draculator II: Byte of the Draculator
description: Corporal Merrick was on leave one evening and tried to hook up with some cute vampire twins. In an attempt to impress them, he allowed himself to be made into a vampire. Unfortunately his army found out and enrolled him in a secret experimental bionic implant program. Now half vampire, half robot, and more than half confused, Merrick must escape the base where he is being held or spend the rest of his life being drip-fed poodle blood to keep him obedient! Can you help Merrick escape?

title: Echoes of The Past
description: Welcome to Echoes of the Past, where the past comes alive and fears take shape. You are a night guard in a psychiatric hospital. Sinister creature emerge from the darkness, and your survival depends on cameras, light, and hiding. Every action matters. Can you survive the night?

title: Egress - The Test of STS-417
description: Egress is a short form sci-fi adventure game set in the outer reaches of space. The story begins when you, the commander of a two man recon team, are sent hurtling into space during maintenance on an interplanetary probe. After a sudden attack from an black alien substance, you awake on a mysterious planet. Where are you? How did you get there? And why is your partner screaming for help down the intercom…

title: Emerald Eyes
description: "It all startet with a dream. I saw myself - standing in front of a swimming bath. I felt strange. I felt strong. I felt the desire to kill. I knew my victim. She was in there. She had to die, she had to drown. Water was the first element. I couldn't stop myself. I had to kill..."

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - Aerosoft Reggio Calabria XP
description: Fly to the tip of Italy's distinctive boot shape with Reggio Calabria XP. This highly detailed scenery brings you to Reggio Calabria, named after Italian Royal Air Force war-hero Tito Minniti, who was born in Reggio Calabria.

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - SAM FollowMe
description: Don't get lost on any airport by using SAM FollowMe service to guide you to your parking position.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - MKJS: Montego Bay Jamaica
description: In partnership with LatinVFR, Skyline Simulations brings you the very first detailed Jamaican airport for X-Plane 11.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - Faroe Islands XP
description: The scenery Faroe Islands XP now recreates the entire archipelago for XPlane 11.

title: X-Plane 11: FSDG - Sharm El-Sheikh XP
description: The popular Sharm El-Sheikh International Airport scenery from FSDG is now available for XPlane 11!

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - JustAsia: Real World Malaysia
description: Realworld Malaysia covers a whopping 330,803 km² and covers west and east Malaysia. JustAsia harness the lastest autogen technology especially for XPlane which allows for region specific houses, shops, highrise and buildings to be placed using XPlane built in OSM data to ensure maximum immersion.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - CRJ 200
description: The Canadair Regional Jet CRJ-200 is a short-range, single-aisle commuter jet and with 1021 built units the most popular regional jet today. The JRollon CRJ-200 brings this famous airliner to the simulator known for its accurate flight dynamics.

title: X-Plane 11: FSDG - Mauritius
description: Paradise at its best - the unique Ile de Maurice, one of the most beautiful and scenic islands in the world, now available for XPlane!

title: X-Plane 11: Global Scenery - Africa
description: X-Plane 11 Global Scenery: Africa is a free DLC that you can activate thru your Steam Client. It will give you the default Africa Scenery.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - KSNA: John Wayne International
description: John Wayne International Airport (IATA: SNA, ICAO: KSNA, FAA LID: SNA) is located in Orange County near Los Angeles, USA. KSNA provides General aviation operations, commercial operations and several facilities.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - KCVG: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International XP
description: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport offers non-stop passenger service to 62 destinations with 179 peak daily departures. The airport's international destinations include Cancún, Cozumel, Freeport, Montego Bay, Paris, Punta Cana, Reykjavík, and Toronto.

title: X-Plane 11: FSDG - Agadir

description: Play as Scarlett, a freelance cyborg ninja, in a neon city filled with corporate drones. Use her top of the line sword and bio enhancements to dash throughout the city and chain your dashes through drones. Make sure to watch your health, too many mistakes and you might Flatline.

title: Qbio
description: This is a very cute real-time economic strategy game. Grow plants, level up, unlock new buildings.

title: Dressmaker
description:
Dressmaker is a cozy game inspired by real dressmaking.

Become a dressmaker, choose dress designs, cut out fabric and sew them all together to satisfy (or sabotage!) customers.

title: War War
description: A 4-player multiplayer real-time / turn-based strategy game. Move armies on the board in turn-based mode and invade other armies to enter real-time strategy "skirmish" battles! Win enough small battles to take over the board and win the War!

title: "Draw a card" Simulator
description: You don't even need a board game or a party magician anymore, this simulator will fulfill all your needs!

title: Light and Embers
description: Relax. Listen to the crackle of the fire and the chirping of the birds. Add a log or two if the fire starts to burn out. Enjoy a calm and stress-free campfire.

title: Halver
description: Halve the blocks into two equal parts and solve the unique puzzles in a game with a blueprint visual style and meditative music

title: Magic Fluids
description: Click the screen and experience an amazing, lifelike simulator of fluid physics that you can interact and play with. Gorgeous visual effects give a out of this world feel. Experiment with infinite configurations, find the perfect one and create beautiful images or just sit back and enjoy the view!

title: Gravity in Space
description: Gravity in Space is an acurate-physics-based spacecraft flight and combat simulation. Learn how to use gravitational forces to navigate through surreal worlds, while you outplay your enemies and shoot them.

title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic - Remake
description: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic - Remake is a modernized recreation of BioWare's 2003 role-playing classic set 4,000 years before the events of the Star Wars films. Players create a Jedi character and navigate the sprawling galactic conflict between the Republic and the Sith Empire. Through choices, lightsaber combat, and Force powers, players uncover a story that reveals their character's true identity while shaping the fate of the galaxy. The remake features rebuilt visuals, updated gameplay mechanics, and refined combat systems while preserving the original's narrative and role-playing elements.

title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End - Remastered
description: A remastered version of Uncharted 4: A Thief's End included in the Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection. It features multiple graphical options with varying framerates and resolutions, faster load times and DualSense haptic feedback and adaptive triggers.

title: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy - Remastered
description: A remastered version of Uncharted: The Lost Legacy included in the Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection. It features multiple graphical options with varying framerates and resolutions, faster load times and DualSense haptic feedback and adaptive triggers.

title: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection
description:
Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is a remastered collection of two games in the Uncharted saga: Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End and Uncharted: The Lost Legacy.

This includes multiple graphical options with varying framerates and resolutions, faster load times and DualSense haptic feedback and adaptive triggers.

title: Idol Queens Production

An idol making simulation game, Idol Queens!

Produce your own idols in the way the real k-pop idols are produced!

title: M.I.C.E.

The moon has run out of cheese!

Join the forces of the Massive Interplanetary Cheesefinding Expedition (M.i.C.E.), pillage all the cheese and precious Cheesemaking Organisms of Wholesome Sustenance (C.O.W.S.) you can for the glory of the lunar rodent nation!

Player 1, move with the arrow keys, Player 2 move with WASD

One day, the last man on Earth came home to find a girl sleeping on his bed.

This is a free to play Visual-Novel by Sonnet009

Bubble Shooter FX is a classic bubble shoot game.

This addictive classic bubble blast match-three game comes with clean and modern graphics, hundreds of great challenging levels and some nice special items for better game experience in harder levels.

Clean and simple 3D graphics with nice light effects gives the game a special touch.

title: Brink Traveler
description: BRINK Traveler is a virtual travel experience that takes you to amazing natural locations in full 3D to feel like you're really there. Step into a postcard and visit some of the most breathtaking places on Earth today!

title: Detective Solitaire: The Ghost Agency
description: 200 magical layouts - find all the evidence! Visit a magical world right now!

Combine items in your inventory to get into locked areas of the house and find other useful tools that can help you uncover the truth while meeting a few familiar faces.

description: Action shooter with story elements.

description: Monstrum is a new Chapter for Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals. It includes 2 playable monsters (Brute & Fiend), 1 playable mortal (Prisoner Borisov), and a new map (Monstrum Madness).

title: Brother!!! Save him!
description: The legendary game is now on Steam! Can you prove that you are a good player, go through a difficult path and save your brother? This challenge is not for wimps!

title: Half-Life 2: Year Long Alarm
description: Year Long Alarm is a Half-Life 2 single-player mod that is set in an abandoned mine outside of City 17. A Scanner has discovered you, and the Combine are closing in on your position. Fight your way through a vast underground mine to try and meet up with the Resistance members of Station 12.

title: Half-Life: Absolute Zero
description: Half-Life: Absolute Zero is a fan-made modification that re-creates the original ideas and plans from the award-winning classic: Half-Life.

title: Gate
description: Gate is a text-based furry homo romance game developed by NVL maker, in which the player will play the role of the protagonist to "break the system" as an opportunity to establish a relationship with the furries and find a way to achieve peace between races.

title: Hunted
description: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.

title: Cooking Simulator: Cooking with Food Network
description: Play the new Contest mode with fresh recipes inspired by various Food Network TV shows. Set yourself up for an exciting culinary adventure or cook at your own pace for a more relaxing experience. Change your ordinary kitchen into a professional TV studio!

title: Cooking Simulator: Shelter
description: Master the art of post-apocalyptic cooking in an underground shelter. Gather scarce resources, trade with other settlements, and become the best food provider in the wasteland!

title: Time Freeze
description: Stop time whenever you want! Dive into a sandbox world where you infiltrate enemy strongholds using various crazy skills and tools. Combine them and conquer your enemies with your own creative ideas.

title: Waveform: Eris
description: Eris, a world of discord and darkness, needs your help! Restore the light to a new planet in Waveform's first DLC pack. Play new levels and even re-play in challenge mode for remastered experienced. Interact with the brand new object - the PulsarExperience another mind-bending bonus level in Reverse Mode!

title: 112 Operator: The Last Duty
description: The time has come for your last duty. For how long can you protect your area? What threats await you? This semi-realistic DLC brings new exciting gameplay to the game.

title: 112 Operator: Water Operations
description: New DLC Water Operations will extend your responsibility to rivers, lakes, and seas.

title: 112 Operator: Pandemic Outbreak
description: New DLC will challenge you in the direst situation - the pandemic taking over your city.

title: The Chase
description: “The chase” is a first-person survival horror game developed by RAM Studios. The story revolves around a couple that has been separated for some time. The only hope for him is to strive through the darkness and pray to God that everything will be alright.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Africa
description: Join us in a safari through the Heart of Africa and discover new common and uncommon inhabitants for your Wildlife Park! Encounter Spotted Hyenas, Red river hogs, Black-backed Jackals, Kudus, African Buffaloes and other species on one of the biggest and most variable continents in the world.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Down Under
description: An adventure trip to "Down Under"! The continent offers a wide range of the fauna and flora: kangaroos, koalas, emus and - of course - the cute wombat and the weird platpyus, the trademarks of down under.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Amazonas
description: Plunge into the amazon rainforest and be stunned by the abundance of fauna. Encounter Giant Anteaters, Pink River Dolphins, Amazonian Manatees, Armadillos, Tapirs, Capybaras, Ocelots and other species native to the biggest river basin of our planet!

title: Wildlife Park 3: Asia
description: Wildlife Park 3 Asia - A true animal resort Asia is the largest continent on earth. It covers about one third of the total landmass. The rainforest of Southeast Asia is probably the richest ecosystem in the world.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Creatures of the Caribbean
description: Get the fantastic Caribbean experience now! Create magnificent palm beaches with lagoons and bays. Animate these with dolphins, dangerous sharks, giant turtles, colourful flamingos and many other animal inhabitants of the Caribbean Sea. Let your park visitors immerse themselves in the world of pirates.

title: Zup! Z
description: Minimal physical puzzle with explosions

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Eyes of the Nine
description: In the name of the mighty Tzeentch, god of magic and sorcery, Vortemis the All-seeing and his sworn acolytes seek to open a pathway between Shadespire and the Realm of Chaos. Unlock this warband and play as the Eyes of the Nine in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Sepulchral Guard
description: Sworn to the God of Death's service, the Sepulchral Warden and his fleshless undying swarm the streets of Shadespire. Their sheer numbers overwhelm all who would oppose them. Unlock this warband and play as the Sepulchral Guard in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Spiteclaw's Swarm
description: Seemingly infinite in number, the devious and malicious ratmen known as skaven blight every corner and crevice in the city of Shadespire. Unlock this warband and play as Spiteclaw's Swarm in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: The Farstriders
description: Clad in gleaming sigmarite and armed with heaven-forged weaponry, the grizzled hunters of the Stormcast Eternals are the sworn enemies of Chaos. Unlock this warband and play as The Farstriders in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Ironskull's Boyz
description: Iron-clad and muscle-bound, these brutal Orruks are trapped in an endless battle within the shifting city of Shadespire. They wield huge, rusted weapons and thirst for combat. Unlock this warband and play as the Ironskull's Boyz in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: The Chosen Axes
description: Honor, gold, and a desire to banish the curse that haunts the city of Shadespire - these are what drive the mercenary Fyreslayers. Unlock this warband and play as The Chosen Axes in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Thorns of the Briar Queen
description: Dragged out from her crystal tomb beneath the city of Shadespire, the Briar Queen and her spectral army of geists, and spirits are ready to combat all who trespass in the Mirrored City. Unlock this warband and play as the Thorns of the Briar Queen in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: The Storm of Celestus
description: Drakan Celestus, accompanied by his loyal gryph-hound and an elite retinue of Castigators, is tasked with the investigation of the curse that has taken hold of the city of Shadespire. Unlock this warband and play as Storm of Celestus in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Garrek's Reavers
description: This warband, led by the brutal killer known as Garrek Gorebeard, are frenzied cannibals, mortals whose dark excesses have drawn them ever further into the thrall of the Blood God. Blinded by battle madness, lost to the exultant sensations of combat, they care for nothing but the kill.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Drepur's Wraithcreepers
description: Eternal hunters in service of the Great Necromancer Nagash, this band of Glaivewraith Stalkers are driven ever onwards toward their prey by the ceaseless beating of the Patrician's skin drum. Unlock this warband and play as Drepur's Wraithcreepers in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Mibt
description: Help the government agents in black thong to end the alien threat and the invasion of the machines. 1 or 2 players. Individual and cooperative. Gamepad compatible. Demo available.

title: The Evil in the Forest
description: The Evil in the Forest is a 3rd-person fantasy horror adventure game. The game tells you the dark story of a man named Derek Bain - a single father who, being a researcher in the field of natural resources, arrives with his daughter Kate in a mystical forest...

title: Aerofly RC 8
description: Aerofly RC 8 is THE model flight simulator with extremely real flight physics, fantastic graphics and VR mode. Targeted model flight training and incredible fun with airrace, limbo flying, balloon piercing, helitrainer, aerobatics, landing contests, slope flying, 4D scenery and much more.

title: Infinite Mana
description: Infinite Mana is a RPG about exploration, a light sandbox, and glitch mechanics set in the magickal world of Arukea. You are the Wanderer: branded and without memory. Make friends and discover who you are, unlock unique Guises (classes), seek Relics, talk to animals, collect items, fish, and more!

title: Dreadful Shadows
description: A Survival Horror, team based brawler. Hunt and Be Hunted, Defend or Destroy . Its up to you to collect weapons, spells and traps and tear through enemies all on your pursuit to become a Legendary Hunter. A Hunter who can be the most Dreadful in Shadows.

title: Kong's Wrath: City of Mayhem
description: Become the banana-hungry kaiju, Kong. Climb, fight, and leap your way through a highly militarized concrete jungle. Collect bananas, and compete for the highest banana count on a world-wide leaderboard. This is a roguelike, arcade style game with no ending, only further mayhem.

title: Hate Free Heroes Tactics
description: Hate Free Heroes Tactics is a community based online game and adventure. Help your city reduce aggro levels by building your agency, defeating aggromites and researching new ways of keeping city aggro levels at a minimum. Play from any web browser, PC, tablet or phone.

title: The Importance of Choosing: Second Chance
description: This story tells us about a girl who went through a lot in her life, and each of her decisions led to certain consequences. In this game, you will see the consequences of one of the elections, and understand what decision will be correct.

title: VR Skydiving
description: Welcome to our spaceship! You can choose different landscape scenes on the Earth, including mountains, deserts, and Gobi deserts etc. By pressing the touchpad and the trigger of the left controller for selection. Using the touchpad of your right controller for movement.

title: Doodle God Blitz: Doodle Kingdom
description: It's time to get MEDIEVAL! Try a new fantasy brain-teaser where you can create your own Kingdom with Castles, Knights, Warlocks and Dragons! Great for gamers of ALL ages. Create a New Kingdom Today!

title: Happy Valentine's Day
description: Happy Valentine's Day is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Secret Agent Allan Martin in ... Phoenix Erupting
description: You are Allan Martin, an occasionally suave British superspy armed with a licence to cause an international incident. Can you survive international assassins? Can you stop an evil mastermind's nefarious plans? Can you avoid contracting an STD?

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 20 'Chopper' Loco
description: A veteran in every right, the Class 20 has earned its place among enthusiasts' hearts; and now Type 1 traction comes to life in Train Sim World, ready for hard-working duty on the Tees Valley Line!

title: Train Sim World 2020: LIRR M3 EMU Loco
description: Take the controls of a "Big Apple" railroading classic with the Long Island Rail Road M3 electric-multiple-unit (EMU) for Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 2020: DB BR 182 Loco
description: In Train Sim World, the DB BR 182 adds a dash of red to the "Rapid Transit" route, and depicts the Mitteldeutschland S-Bahn S2 line during the transitional period where DB BR 1442 EMUs were still being delivered.

title: Train Sim World 2020: CSX GP40-2 Loco
description: Arguably the ultimate edition of the Geep road-switcher was the GP40-2 and now you can challenge your limits as this famed diesel workhorse comes to Train Sim World in classic CSX "YN2" livery!

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 52 'Western' Loco
description: Built to work top-link expresses, the BR Class 52 spent its days racing through BR's Western Region and now enjoys retirement on heritage railways.

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 33 Loco
description: The Train Sim World BR Class 33 now joins the BR Class 47 and BR Class 09 to further bring to life the heritage festivities of the West Somerset Railway route's diesel gala.

title: Train Sim World 2020: DB BR 204 Loco
description: A hard-working classic comes to life in Train Sim World with the stunning DB BR 204 diesel locomotive!

title: Train Sim World 2020: DB BR 155 Loco
description: The "Electric Container", as it's affectionately known to railfans, has stood the test of time and you can take to the rails hauling heavy freight with a nostalgic twist.

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 31 Loco
description: After having a career spanning decades, and a successful life in preservation, it's time to turn back the clock and experience the iconic BR Class 31 in its heyday in Train Sim World!

title: Forsaken World: Gods and Demons
description: The most popular Fantasy RPG of 2021 is finally available!

title: Tower of Origin 2: Worm's Nest
description: This is a traditional rpg game which contains multiple maps and a great story enough to play for several hours.

title: Escape the Outbreak
description: On a remote island, Jack Colt finds himself isolated after being kidnapped. After the accident with the helicopter transporting him, Jack has his first contact with the island, and soon discovers that he is not alone in that place, and will have to be careful if he wants to escape alive.

title: Space Battle SVF
description: This game is a 3D space flight shooter. Arcade type game. It's a game to shoot a lot of missiles.

title: Bot Wars
description: Bot Wars is an action RTS about managing a squad of kill-bots and their bases as you work to take over all the capture points across the map. Featuring corporate kill bot armies, ranging from a firearms and beverage manufacturer to a lovecraftian burger cult.

title: Prop Factory
description: 100% 3D Prop Factory is a fun puzzle where you memorize an object and need to assemble it in order but before that you will need to find the pieces in a mess of scraps and throw them on the conveyor simply by dragging.

title: Osylla
description: Osylla is a horror game based on real events. Try to escape from your own house and help your mother to get medical help. Are you able to help everyone in the household?

title: Time Voyeur
description: Save hot babes from the emperor's claws. Be rewarded in a very delicious way. Remember...stay hard!

title: Dungeon Crawler Daniel
description: Daniel and a group of adventurers must complete the Ravana Dungeon to win the ultimate prize so he can buy his house back from his parents.

title: Basic Rogue
description: BASIC ROGUE is a turn-based dungeon crawler. You have very limited inventory space, skills, weapons, armor, and stats which all need to be managed while fighting enemies, gathering treasure, and figuring out what your primary objective is. This game will appeal to players looking for a challenge.

title: Terraform Inc
description: Terraform Inc is a game to build a reliable physics-based delivery network. You will get new planets, add enhancements in transit, then deliver to buyers. Construct elaborate designs to prove your ingenuity. Choose your friends wisely, working to earn respect and unlock even further opportunities.

title: Battlefield 4: Night Operations
description: As day turns to night, the Graveyard Shift begins. A new set of soldiers takes the battlefield. Adapt to the darkness... or else. Use night vision and thermal imaging to expose enemies. Flashlights and flares are at your disposal, but beware – they can give away your position. The night is your ally – use it.

title: Battlefield 4: Legacy Operations
description: The Return of a Classic

title: Battlefield 4: Community Operations
description: Welcome to the jungle.

title: Furry Shakespeare: The Reverse Hamlet Championships
description: Partake in an underground arcade game competition. It's gonna be so cool.

title: Furry Shakespeare: Hamlet(s)
description: Uncover what exactly happened to the Hamlet twins, and interact with a new character.

title: Furry Shakespeare: Dashing Dinosaurs & Sexy Centaurs - The Meerkats from Arkham
description: Kit Marlowe, Amber, and Quince meet another acting troop.

title: Electronic Super Joy: A Hot Sticky Mess
description: ***WARNING: HARDCORE!*** You thought the adventure was over? BAD NEWS SUCKER! The new pope Boris the Super Sexy has a mission for your mute buttless self so listen up! A bad Boogie Bro has stolen the only food, a giant pudding! He’s probably going to do weird and kinky science to it! You gotta save it! Save the Boogie Bros!

title: Blaster Master Zero II: Copen from "Luminous Avenger iX"
description: Adds COPEN from "Luminous Avenger iX" as a playable character in EX Character Mode. Blast mutant scum across the galaxy alongside your robo-partner, Lola!

title: Blaster Master Zero II: Empress from "Dragon Marked For Death"
description: Adds EMPRESS from "Dragon Marked for Death" as a playable character in EX Character Mode.

title: Space Ship Drift
description: Drift in space on spaceships.

title: The fairy tale you don't know
description:
Little Red Riding Hood, Snow White, Alice in Wonderland, Thumbelina...
Let's travel to these well-known fairy tales' world, and play hide and seek with the heroines! In this game, you can rewrite the ending of these well-known fairy tales.

title: Atomicrops: Feline Good
description: Atomicrops: Feline Good update introduces numerous new features and improvements to the game. New achievements, farm timelapse, elite enemies, surplus mode, cat plushies, and stats and upgrades expand gameplay content. Balance changes adjust game mechanics, rebalance enemy and player interactions, and modify reward systems. Bug fixes and quality of life improvements resolve spawning issues, correct art and sorting problems, and enhance tractor and ability mechanics.

title: Atomicrops: Doom & Bloom
description: Atomicrops: Doom and Bloom update introduces Deervil's Den, a new high-risk, high-reward location, and a powerful Motivator Tractor. Extensive upgrades focus on transforming weeds into flowers, enhancing farm animals with unique abilities, and adding new mechanics like bullet-blocking cows and truffle-finding pigs. Balance changes adjust enemy behaviors, game progression, and item pools. Numerous bug fixes and quality of life improvements refine gameplay mechanics, UI, and player interactions.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Pathfinder
description: In Pathfinder, there are 3 worlds with 16 puzzles each that require you to find the path connecting dots across the shape lines without going over a line more than once. You can currently play Pathfinder for free in My Neighborhood Arcade.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Number Crunchers
description: Enjoy Several Number based puzzle casual games: Power Puzzle, Get 11, 2048 Bricks, Hexa Power Puzzle and 10x10. You can currently play for free in My Neighborhood Arcade.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Rolling Ball 3D Unit
description: Guide your ball through an obstacle course in Rolling Ball 3D. Stay on platforms, travel through tunnels, jump ramps and avoid blocks to reach new levels in this infinite runner game.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Tower Stacker Unit
description: Enjoy this classic stacking-style game as you build towering sky scrapers. Precision matters to achieve the highest heights—any part of a block that doesn’t align with the building falls away, making your target increasingly smaller.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Speed Box Unit
description: In this infinite runner, you guide your box inside another box avoiding obstacles to collect cubes. Collect enough cubes and go up in challenge rating. (This game is currently available to play for free in My Neighborhood Arcade)

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Hoop Swish
description: Hoop Swish is one of the My Neighborhood Arcade ticket machines. You get a ticket for new difficulty level you reach in this spin on the classic basket ball game where you move the hoop to where the ball is going. You can currently play this game for free in My Neighborhood Arcade.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: RC Targets - Dronez
description: Pilot an RC drone through a target course In RC Targets: Dronez @ Castle^Punk. Beat your best times as you navigate through target gates on multiple courses in 2 environments, Medieval Castle and CyberPunk settings.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: InfiniMath Unit
description: Challenge and hone your math and logic skills with InfiniMath, an endless math puzzle game. From simple to complex, the puzzle difficulty increases as you progress.

title: My Neighborhood Arcade: Wheels of Fortunes Unit
description: Wheels of Fortunes is one of the My Neighborhood Arcade Ticket Machines. In Wheels of Fortunes, spin up to four wheels at a time to earn credits and tickets—you could win big…or you could walk away with fewer tickets* than you started with.
:3 s̶a̶v̶e̶s̶ ̶t̶e̶h̶ ̶w̶o̶r̶l̶d goes from a red place to a blue place in search of a more colorful life, while chasing balls of yarn across switches and potentially dying a lot and solving puzzles.

title: Feel Up a Sexy Lifeguard!
description: Feel Up a Sexy Lifeguard! is an animated girl-touching game.

title: Re:Destiny
description: This is a game that combines match-3 with light RPG elements, a GALGAME style of presentation with beautiful character. The story is strongly inspired by Japan mythology background and characters.

title: Soft Wind
description: Soft Wind is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Swimmer Admiration
description: A visual novel about swimsuit girls and sports!

title: Sand Bullets
description: The game is Top-Down Shooter with Telephony as a Service. Help our team to shape something new!

title: Flesh
description: Third person horror adventure designed for Half-Life 2.

title: Space Cube Tower Defense
description: You control a space station in the form of a cube that protects the planet from invaders.

title: From Frontier
description: By an accident，the protagonist set out on a journey to the "Lemuria Continent" with the second princess of the demon country who was running away from home.Awaiting in the pioneer land is encounters with dangerous monsters, unexplored land, and fascinating beauties.

title: Succubus With Guns
description: It's a simple campaign-style, third-person shooter. Shoot zombies and other monsters to move to other worlds. Defeat all the bosses guarding the portals.

title: Sexy Caravan
description: Sexy Caravan is a micro tower defense in which you have to seduce the monsters before they reach Anastacia's caravan. Combine different spells, Seduce a lot of monsters, Help Anastacia's girls to serve everyone one who wants sex, and Upgrade the most famous Sexy Caravan of the Kingdom.

title: Adventure of Bears
description: Adventure of Bears is a platformer 2d game in which you are a Bear. You must to run through differents jungles and other dangerous places by avoiding obstacles and enemies.

title: Techno Tower Defense
description: A wave-based action game, where you fight to survive for as long as you can.

title: Lights Camera Slaughter
description: Play as an intern on the set of an upcoming movie, "Lights, Camera, Slaughter!" - where things turn BLOODY. Try and escape this ever-evolving, living hell - OR DIE TRYING. A game inspired by earlier PS1 horror titles.

title: Battle Strike World War
description: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online. Try casual, or invite friends to a private room. Play cross-platform with millions of players on Android and Steam! Frequent updates. Over Many Characters.

title: Lust Vessel
description: Lust Vessel follows the story of Kate, she took a space cruise for her vacation but after getting drunk she woke up without memories of the last couple days, as she leaves her room she finds out that everyone has lost themselves to passion, now she has to find out what is happening.

title: Rebirth: Mr Wang
description: This is a plot game that uses mouse clicks to interact and level puzzles. The game has beautiful graphics and interesting plot. Use your wisdom to help your neighbors!

title: Mystika 4: Dark Omens
description: Sarel, a power-hungry dragon, stole the book "Dark Omens" causing the activation of an ancient inter-dimensional portal located north of Lumina, allowing evil creatures to invade the world.Help Alrik and Tenebria seal this gate! Explore the world of Lumina through 160 magic levels.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted - Curse of Dreadbear
description:
The Curse of Dreadbear DLC unlocks a new Halloween themed hub packed with spooky new mini-games and prizes.

New spine-tingling mini-games include; Trick or Treat, Mangle Repair, Corn Maze, the Plushkin-Patch, “Cap’n Foxy’s Pirate Adventure” dark ride and many more!

Featured frightening animatronics include; Nightmare Bonnie, Nightmare Chica, Nightmare Freddy, Jack-o-Chica, Jack-o-Bonnie and a few... surprises.

title: Great Marble Adventure
description: Guide the marble in the journey through more than 40 thematic levels across three difficulties: Easy, Normal, and Hard, with various challenges in Great Marble Adventure, an unforgettable 3D ball-rolling game! Are you ready for the unforgettable marble adventure?

title: The Cursed Revenant
description: The Revenant has returned to break the curse, This is a story of a legend who got cursed for ages traveling through different dimensions to find who cursed him.

title: Total Seduction
description: A real time sims-like rpg game with quests, char. building and main story line.

title: Ghost Marriage Matchmaking
description: Ghost Marriage Matchmaking is a game centered around ghost marriages and building your relationship with the two ethereal heroines: Dai'er and Yuan. As a matchmaker, your job is to get Dai'er and Yuan "ghost married".

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 10
description: Enjoy a beautiful collection of Hidden Object Scenes and puzzles set in the great outdoors. Tidy up the Park and do your bit for the environment by collecting all the bonus trash items to Recycle. Earn extra bonuses for finding all the Lost & Found items scattered around the Park

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 5
description: Spend a sensational summer vacation helping rangers run Pinecreek Hills National Park. It’s centennial year and the park is bigger and better than ever. Enjoy this outstanding collection of Hidden Object scenes and puzzles set in an idyllic national park. As well as finding Hidden Objects around the park you will need to perform your duties as a park ranger. Protect the environment by collecting all the bonus trash items to recycle and catalogue all the wildlife throughout the park in your wildlife Journal.

title: Argus Panoptes

title: The Second Reproduction

The Second Reproduction is an otome game, set in the same universe as Queen of Darkness, the circle's first game, as well as serving as a sort of sequel.

Christina was the third princess of Almenan, and born in the era of war against the Demons. Having the status of a “Champion”, Christina had countless battle victories upon her shoulders and was feared by the Demon race.

Being the most successful of her three sisters, her mother the queen sent her on a secret mission to assassinate the Demon Lord Gardis in return for his ruthless annihilation of the Kingdom of Crofts.

Obeying her mother’s orders for the sake of her kingdom, Christina set out alongside with her most loyal knight Lezette to take the Demon Lord’s head, and to bring peace to the land. But they soon discover the Demon Lord and his people are not as ruthless as they have been told all their life.

Tobi Tsukihime is a typical shooting game in which the player takes the role of Kohaku, a maid in the Tohno mansion, along with Len the demon succubus. The player's firepower consists of a main shot (allows for rapid fire), a number of bombs for moderate damage and a spinning marble created by Len. Power-ups are available for the main shot by collecting items or enemy shot down. During level-up Kohaku is invicible for a short of time. The marble plays as an indestructable weapon which can firing forward or moved freely in any direction. By holding down shoot button will gives player hit box icon and reduces Kohaku's speed.

title: Neon City Riders: Super-Powered Edition
description:
Players can look forward to an easier default difficulty, with an extra challenge relegated to “Old-School” mode. Navigation has also been enhanced while updating the UI. There are some other changes as well.

Here’s the full rundown:
- New Difficulty
By default, Neon City Riders’ enemies, hazards, puzzles, checkpoint locations and map designs were re-balanced to be more accessible.

And, if you are a fan of challenges, like we do, the new option “Old-School mode” is available to increase the overall difficulty of your quest.

- Enhanced Navigation
We introduce Cypher Kid, a chatty little robot who will gladly (and optionally) sell you maps for the different turfs to help you navigate its sections.

Also, your mentor, Evergray, will help you at the begging of each zone by pointing you at the right direction.

- Optional Flashy UI
Thinking on the players with light sensitivity, we decided to add a new option that turns on/off the fast paced colors in the user’s interface across the game to make their journey as comfy as possible.

In addition to this changes, tons of small improvements were added, and, If you already started your adventure, this changes will be compatible with your current save file.

title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits - Digital Deluxe
description:
Kena: Bridge of Spirits is a 2021 action-adventure video game developed and published by Ember Lab. The story follows Kena, a young spirit guide who uses her magical abilities to help deceased people move from the physical to the spirit world. The game is presented through a third-person perspective. The player uses Kena's staff for attacking enemies, and her pulse ability for defending against attacks. They are tasked with collecting small spirit companions known as the Rot, who help to complete tasks and battle against enemies.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the base game, the Official Digital Soundtrack, a unique Kena Staff, and Golden Rot Skin.

description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor or a nurse! Diagnose illnesses and infections so you can treat and help your many patients. Set out on an adventure in a buzzing hospital environment, meet all sorts of characters and discover a story full of surprises!

Play as two new hospital recruits! Gradually realize that your day-to-day existence is going to be anything but restful. Build relationships with the other members of your team and get to know their personalities. Over the course of your next adventure, you’ll take care of various patients, listen to them carefully to understand their symptoms and play fun mini-games to treat them. Every day is a new challenge with its fair share of surprises including a rival colleague called Doctor Pierce! Try not to let him distract you from your patient’s care!

title: My Universe: Interior Designer
description:
Start your own agency as a young interior designer and receive your first clients in your office. Discuss with them to find out their ideas, preferences, and expectations for their dream house. Once the project has been defined, you will have to renovate their home and fulfill the objectives of the mission to satisfy each client. The happier your client is with the result, the more your fame and level increase, unlocking new items, styles, decoration possibilities and bigger projects! With hard work and a sense of style you’ll soon become the most famous designer in town!

Once an experienced designer, you can decide to keep working on a client’s project or to design your own and even choose between the renovation mode or the decoration mode. In renovation mode, modify the house’s structure by destroying or building walls, remove the hard wood floor or tiles, paint, change the lining, fix the electricity installation, or add a water supply. Then switch to the decoration mode to choose and set up furniture, plants, carpets, wallpapers, curtains and so on. It’s up to you to give each house a real personality.

Feel free to work on your own projects whenever you want. You can choose the structure of your house: Flat, studio, house or duplex and decorate as you wish.

title: My Universe: Puppies and Kittens
description: Whether you’re a dog or a cat person, your new companions are waiting for you to take them home and give them endless love. Help them grow daily with good care and proper training so they will become well behaved pets. Do not forget to give them lots of cuddles and play with them often. Each animal is unique and has its own personality and preferences so pay attention to your animal needs and they will give it back to you by becoming the most loyal of friends. You can even teach your pet tricks and train them to enter competitions and unlock rewards & new accessories. Participate also in various activities like exploring your neighborhood to find treasures, visiting the meadow and the dog park or go to the shop to acquire new items.
