"Run and Gun" will have you blasting ghosts and collecting coins in this fast-paced endless shooter. Try "Rock and Stone" a thrilling 3-D Asteroid defence! What will your high score be?

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure
description: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure is a casual puzzle, adventure game in which the young girl Emma finds herself in ancient Greece. Follow Emma as she helps Hercules on all of his adventures!

title: Ninja Kunoichi
description: This is an exciting "NINJA" action game with a 16-bit taste!

title: Falta
description: Falta is a survival-horror game set in a brazilian public school. Play as Davi, as you look for your missing best-friend Tiago through the dark hallways and classroms of your school. Find and collect "mementos", clues about your friend's whereabouts...

title: Metu Caligine
description: The fear of the dark. It haunts a person from time immemorial, when during the darkness of the night dangerous predators could hide. Your memory is erased, you almost do not remember anything. Explore the mansion and try to shed light on the secrets of your past. But be careful with its inhabitants.

title: Emotion
description: This is the story of an android that regains the deprived emotions Defeat a large number of enemies and strong enemy bosses and proceed while growing Dark 2D action game

title: Eggineer
description: Eggineer is a physics based vehicle sandbox game. The goal is simple, build fully destructible vehicles to help your fragile egg companion finish challenging levels in the campaign mode, or design the most complex sets of vehicles in the sandbox and make everything crash or explode!

title: Mind Over Melee Radio
description: Dank Tunes, Dank Memes and everything in-between. Play a stupid game, win stupid rewards. Fill the void in your life with some simple numerical validation for the glorious cause of the Infinite Grind.

title: Summer in Trigue
description: Summer in Trigue is a yuri only dating sim set in the mysterious island of Trigue

title: The Witch Eye
description: The Witch Eye is an indie psychological horror game . As a local hunter vicky explore valley of majuli village and try to survive long enough to discover the terrible secrets of the witch "nale ba"

title: Kolo
description: Kolo is a medieval settlement simulator where you lead a group of adventurers ready to start a new life in the wilderness.

title: Macro golf
description: Macro golf is a game consisting of courses which each have 8 holes. With each hole, you need to hit the ball through it so that it sinks in the hole. You need to navigate the ball around the course, to sink it in the hole to move onto the next one. This game also includes local multiplayer.

title: The Sin Collector: Repentless
description: The Sin Collector: Repentless is a game on the border of a visual novel and a classic text RPG, set in the world of The Sin Collector. Action takes place a couple of years before the events presented in the books.

title: Cats and Food 4: New Year
description: Cats and Food 4: New Year is a 2D precision platformer for cat lovers everywhere. It's time to play the perfect game for the new year! The cute little kitten is hungry. Help him jump to overcome all obstacles and collect the maximum amount of delicious food.

title: The Village Story
description: This is the story of a kid name Jorah and his adventures throughout the beautiful pixel art towns. It has been foretold that anybody who does good deeds will be granted access to the Village of Gods. Fulfill Jorah's quest by visiting beautiful pixel art towns like Christmas,Snowtown,Waterworld etc.

title: Violet Girl
description: The girl of your dreams could be anywhere. Basking under the rays of sun at the nearest park, strolling across the busy city the streets, enjoying a pleasant noon at your local book shop or coffee shop, and splashing in the warm waters of the nearest beach.

title: Ludo King
description: Ludo King is a cross platform multiplayer game that supports Desktop, Android, iOS and Windows mobile platform at same time. This game also support offline mode, where player can play with Computer or, Local multiplayer (pass and play mode).

title: Neko Hacker Plus
description: Hack all the pictures by solving ChanOS puzzles!

title: TC Strikers 3
description: Who are you fighting for? My usual job turns into a big mission. An easy-to-understand system reminiscent of the old barrage STG. Pave the way with powerful PowerShots!

title: Best Elf
description: Best Elf is an erotic 2D visual novel spinoff of Faulty Apprentice, following Eleanna and Zariinna. When an innocent competition between the two elves turns into a rescue mission, it's up to you and your friends to save the day! With two sexy elves at your side, what could go wrong?

title: Dark Forest Project
description: You are a military man who was sent on an assignment to investigate in a dark forest due to the frequent disappearance of people. After spending a little time, you realize that ancient prisoners are being revived in this forest, and the longer you are in it, the more and more of them.

title: Vampire Revenge
description: Vampire Revenge is an adult 2D game developed by Gaweb Studio. Play as a weakened vampire lord and fight your way to the top, either by fighting or seducing. Includes the following themes : blood sucking, hypnotism, fight, animated sex, maze exploration, power-ups and more!

title: Aim Master H
description: Aim Master H is the first 2D Aim Game on Steam, designed to warmup and boost your aim quickly and easily.

title: Fill & Cross: Christmas Riddles
description: The most magical night of the year. It's coming... RIGHT NOW! 120 new levels in Christmas Griddlers!

title: MegaRamp
description: In this game you have to position the game elements in a exact way to get the ball from the top of a ramp inside a basket on its botton. The game uses real world physics on the ball movement and all your sense of localization will be demanded to complete the challenges.

title: Larcin Lazer
description: The best tool for a good theft? Your memory! Observe your surroundings and remember the location of the lasers, they disappear as soon as you move. Move with style to dodge the many obstacles spread across more than 100 levels. Prepare for a memorable heist!

title: Hyparxis
description: As an artificially created being with unlimited potential, explore the foundations and extensions of existence! Find friends and companions on this way, but take good care of them, because lives are fragile. Hyparxis is a turn-based, classic JRPG with unlimited character development.

title: Ark Mobius
description: This is a game containing "beautiful girl + rhythm game + multi ending GALGAME". In 2320, a huge monster appeared on the earth.Only magic energy can do harm to the monster.However,there is no more magic energy left on earth. So,you need to gain the energy from magical girls and save your world.

title: RPG Idle
description: RPG Idle is an IDLE game with inspiration from most RPGS... In this game you will be controlling Clovis, a brave Knight in search of training.

title: Rescue Rina
description: Rescue Rina is a 2D Top-Down Sci-Fi themed adventure game based on the story of Rina, a young girl, who got kidnapped by the Evil scientists of Magix Group, whose purpose was to channel her emotions into a Heart-shaped crystal to give life to Robots.

title: The Well
description: Isolation. Hopelessness. Starvation. By the will of an unknown force, you find yourself isolated from the outside world. Now you are doomed to starve to death. No one will come to your aid. No one will hear your prayers.

title: Rocky Ride
description: Welcome to the "Rocky Ride" arcade race! The "Rocky Ride" game is unpredictable tracks, crazy speeds and dangerous rivals. Upgrade your buggy car, choose any of a huge number of different tracks, and - go! To the prize places!

title: Age of Jura
description: The Jurassic RTS dinosaur game. Prepare for an extinction in a long forgotten age, the Age of Jura, where humans are still living among dinosaurs. Take the human race to the top of the food chain. It's now or never: Kill or be killed.

title: City of Robots
description: Play as a super advanced AI- take control over the city of robots and expand your futuristic metropolis. Build your dream city and be the heart and brain of it. Craft technology and equipment for humankind or prepare for war against them.

title: TC Strikers 1
description: The first game in the TC Strikers series. The simple controls make it fun for everyone.

title: The Indestructible Moxy Boxy
description: Heal and reload by inhaling defeated enemies in this precision, twin-stick shooter. Solve action-oriented puzzles and explore an adorably violent world, in a thoughtful story - told through shoebox dioramas.

title: Cyan
description: Incarnate as Xiaoqing, head to Jinshan base alone to find her sister. In the process, it is necessary to resist the attacks of mutants, solve the mystery of the mechanism, and discover the secrets and conspiracy behind the Jinshan base.

title: Ingredienta
description: Discovering, brewing and perfecting powerful elixirs, mixtures and droughts. Exploring unique, randomly-generated fantasy lands. Overcoming obstacles and dangers using various potions and gathering ingredients for stronger ones. Welcome to Ingredienta!

title: Cybermere
description: Cybermere is a sci-fi hacking game. Use warez to penetrate ICE, mine for password fragments and break into database of various companies. You play as Lance, a novice hacker in 2033.

title: Godo
description: 《Godo》 is a puzzle game that explores adventure, Work hard to find pieces of information and solve the final puzzle

title: Annual Intruders
description: A home invasion horror game about participating in an annual challenge.

title: Robot Invasion
description: Robot Invasion is a game set in the near future when robots have invaded Earth. There are robots everywhere and they are deadly. Avoid them at all costs.

title: Gothic Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Bikini Island Challenge
description: The girls of Bikini Island are eager to fulfill your wildest fantasies. All you have to do is survive the island. Battle your way through the treacherous environment, man-eating tigers, and savage natives to save the girls and unlock their unique pleasuring powers.

title: ACT
description: Bluff, build alliances, betray your friends, and become the richest player! Speak with other players, guess their job, and kill them if it can bring you money. Between Police, FBI, Robber, Mafia, Kamikaze, and Serial Killer, you will find the best job to win.

title: 20b
description: Eight peculiar students, a pair of highly-trained assassins, extraterrestrials plotting a full-scale invasion of Earth, a secret society on the verge of toppling the US presidency and a Doomsday cult gearing to wipe California off the map.

title: Finger Breaker
description: Can you hold down 2 or 3 buttons at the same time, easily ? And what about 5, 8, 11, even with a time limit. Try it in this simple game.

title: Toxa
description: ToxΔ adapts the action, adventure and unique genre. Equipped with magic warfare, teleportation, forest, sci-fi city and sea. On the same Maps, there are 2 graphic modes, namely soft and natural.

title: Click Quest 3D
description: Click Quest 3D is an indie erotic clicker, with 5 beautiful naked girls in different poses. With awesome 3D animation, this is a must play!

title: Tap-Tap Adventure
description: So what do we have here? Another masterpiece of game development? -It is interesting, but I do not pretend. Unique features? -Sure! Will not even lag on the calculator! Is it difficult? -It is said that only the bravest will bring sound to the world of Tap-tap. Perhaps you will succeed?

title: Determinant
description: Post-apocalyptic physics-based open-world survival adventure game. Planned to include combat, base building, crafting, puzzles, survival and a compelling story to drive it. Building will be a core gameplay mechanic where you build structures to overcome challenges and solve puzzles in the world.

title: Mirrored Pawns
description: Mirrored Pawns is a relaxing puzzle game that will challenge your spatial reasoning. Your goal is to successfully navigate 2 pawns across a chess-like board to the goal positions by working with the axes of symmetry provided to you.

title: Urizen Frosty Plus the New Warriors
description: Stretch across lands of unforeseeable cold, and trouble in Urizen Shadows of the Cold Deluxe Frosty Edition which includes a massive 54 warrior, 69 stage "head bopping", sword slashing lineup with characters raging from beasts, ogres, ninjas, knights, aliens, sorcerers, mermaids and demons.

title: Comet Crusher: Block Breaker
description: While exploring deep space, you have come across our solar system. It is up to you to crush each layer of every planet in our solar system in this beautiful block breaker. See if you can complete each set of levels corresponding to each planet in order to unlock the next.

title: The Crafter's Defense
description: An active strategy game where you customize your dungeon and defend against waves of invaders. Create your dungeon, place monsters and traps, and protect your core! Take direct control of any of your dungeon's monsters to directly engage in the combat or sit back watch the battle unfold.

title: Car Constructor
description: Car Constructor will allow you to build, repair and paint your own car, then check it out on the race track!

title: Waifu Secret
description: Exciting, puzzle game with fancy girls. Control yourtube and find the way to pass the level and unlock a lot of beauty in the gallery. Gameplay is beautiful and relaxing.

title: Space Castle
description: Space Strategy. A mix of tower hold games and role-playing action.

title: Soarocity
description: An exciting 2d platformer with a painterly art style and unique rotation mechanic.

title: Crazy Mafioso
description: Crazy Mafioso is a addicting multi-level survival game. Don`t let yourself be killed! Upgrade your barricades, weapons and gun power. Kill and earn game money.

title: Save Aisha
description: Help Emran rescue his daughter (Aisha) who has been taken from his arms. You will join him in his journey through the castles and forests to meet the king.

title: Magissy
description: Magissy is an Open-World Story-Driven Adult RPG where you take place as a charismatic adventurer and excellent lover, who fears not the danger of dark corners of the Lyrn nor the darkest fantasies of it's behaviors.

title: Critter Clicker
description: Casual farming simulator with unique, flexible gameplay. Autoclicker is built-in and free. Gather resources, upgrade critters and buildings, sell your farm when you want a bigger one and never stop expanding.

title: Nami
description: Nami is a pixel art horror game based on the Brazilian coastline and the works of Junji Ito.

title: 1x! Space Adventure
description: 1x! Space Adventure is an arcade top-down shump with gradually increasing difficulty.

title: Hardcore Trivia
description: Challenge your brains and have a fun time with multiple challenging questions! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. With a Commercial licence, you can arrange a new event easily for example in your bar and provide entertainment to the customers.

title: We Die
description: As a Reaper Class 4, Unit 82 (R482), your current job is to collect the remaining souls from a previous reaper's attempt. Your outcome is determined by your exploration, your reaping, and your attitude towards the many lost souls. You only get one chance to make an impression.

title: Destroy All the Cubes
description: Classic Endless Balls without ads, a unique minimalist design and lots of cannons to destroy all the cubes before they hit the ground. 2 game modes: get as many points as possible in Rush Point and complete all levels.

title: Hack Grid
description: Hack Grid is a puzzle game & love letter to DOS gaming. Only one piece must remain on the board. Each type of piece has its own set of rules. Retro Sound Blaster 16 style audio will accompany you throughout the game. Hack the Grid!

title: Snowman Saves Christmas
description: Snowman Saves Christmas is a 1980s Inspired 2D platformer. Featuring 250 Levels of retro inspired platforming fun split across 5 game modes and Multiple PowerUp items.

title: Atlas Wept
description: A Humanist retro-style RPG game about sincerity and empathy, featuring friendly robot dogs and evil smiley faces.

title: Aisling and the Tavern of Elves
description: “Aisling and the Tavern of Elves” is an Isekai Fantasy-Comedy Dating Sim Visual Novel, where you play as Aisling Whitehorse, a hapless mercenary turned tavern owner eking out a living in the Elven Kingdom of Eiredagh.

title: Mayday: The Survival Island
description: After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

title: Amira
description: Amira: A story driven adventure about a girl born in a middle eastern-fantasy world who finds by chance that her life is written and predetermined as she was helping her family, thus she fights for acceptance, love and writing her own life.

title: Amulet of Time: Shadow of La Rochelle
description: When the ghost of the beautiful Diane de Poitiers appears in front of you, you are transported back in time in "Amulet of Time: Shadow of la Rochelle"! Explore France and an incredible love story in this amazing Hidden Object Adventure game.

title: Museum of Extravagance
description: A surrealist experience in a strange museum

title: The Scary Square
description: The Dark Side Of Mr.Square To Be Discovered.

title: Get Tanked!
description: Why settle for regular tanks when you can drive a super tank? Forget about physics laws and challenge your friends in dynamic and rule-free clashes on one of many exciting arenas. Wishlist now and Get Tanked! in multiplayer combat arena.

title: Hikikomori Life
description: Adventures of a reclusive gamer with elements of a simulator, quest and roguelike. Explore parallel worlds in an attempt to remove the curse from a magician in the body of a cat. Conquer a changing dungeon with many enemies. In the real world, equip a home, create objects, cook food, travel.

title: Qubie: Invader of Worlds
description: Qubie is an in-development platformer game designed to bring happiness and joy to all. Squash enemies, collect coins, and avoid various traps to progress through the levels. Oh and try to keep your cool!

title: Danger Forever
description:
Danger Forever is 3D Shoot'Em Up with RPG elements. Lone human rides her mecha-dragon through a hostile world of mechanoids and techno-demons.

Unlike most scrolling shooters, you fly through a 3D environment — use it to your advantage, and beware of bumping into walls or ground. Also, instead of traditional showering enemies with bullets, you must think ahead a bit - the fuel/heat system adds more depth to combat.

title: Endless Soul Light Solitaire
description: Help your friends in their search! Classic solitaire in a fantasy setting!

title: The Curse of Esrevni
description: Turn-based strategy game Use your cards well Survive Board game Don't give up !

title: TinyCrack
description: 'Tiny Crack' is a story-based, stage-breaking action game in which you must defeat all enemies within the time limit. Enjoy the action and story of each character and check out different endings.

title: Buyhads
description: Buyhads -2D puzzle platformer in which you have to fight robots to find the codes you need to complete.

title: Sand Witch Adventures
description: Sand Witch Adventures is a roguelike game with bullet-hell elements. Cursed lands full of undead are fraught with wealth and knowledge for the young witches.

title: The Curse of Illmoore Bay
description: A 90's Halloween/Horror comical platforming adventure! Can you stop Illmoore Bay from a world of perpetual Halloween?

title: Nofrills Solitaire
description: A fresh take on Solitaire Klondike with no distractions.

title: Timothy and the Tower of Mu
description: Ascend the tower to save your grandfather in this classic, hardcore action-platformer. The Tower of Mu is waiting for you... Push past each check point to the next awaiting challenge; dashing, jumping, and slinging your way up to the towers peak. Die. learn. Overcome.

title: T.W. Burgess Presents: Pylons
description:
It's a beautiful day to play in the countryside! Just make sure to not play near the PYLONS.

Abandoned in the late 70s and restored today for all to play! Play PYLONS and learn of all the safe ways to avoid an accidental death by PYLONS.

title: Mr. Krasnoludek, Teach Me Your Magic Spells
description:
In this game, a cat named Theremin tries to learn the magic spells of Polish dwarves.
Wield devastating dark magic and explore an enchanted forest.
Experience a day and night system which changes the nature of enemy mobs.
Pick onions and potatoes and stuff, or make a friend!

title: Smack Studio
description: Smack Studio is a sandbox platform fighting game with built-in creation tools for characters and stages.

title: Space Blaster (Lines)
description:
An experimental horror game. A simple space blaster game made from code borrowed off the internet becomes angry it was never finished.
The game starts off simple, but develops itself to entrap the user.

title: Spirited Thief
description: Scout, loot, and get out in Spirited Thief, a tactical turn-based stealth game with a twist. Search ahead as spirit, Trin, and grab the goods as thief, Elaj. Just make sure you have the loot before the guards come looking!

title: RollMe
description: RollMe is a physical-based platform puzzle game, where you can roll over 120 levels in 6 different places. Your ball can change the direction of gravity and you can use jumpers, teleporters to complete levels soon as you can. You can earn points when you collect consumables and finish the levels in a shorter time. Every act has new challenges and riddles.

title: Ghost Suburb Zero
description: Ghost Suburb Zero is a RPG where you, as May, become thrown into a bizzare world and it's many inhabitants- such as, crazed gun-holding girls, bizzare cryptids from foriegn realms, persistantly blurred memories, daemonic brothels, strange bird viruses, and much more!

title: Beyond the Phone Screen
description:
Welcome to the latest and greatest in Geolocation based Augmented Reality entertainment!

Thanks to our deal with Shivers City we've integrated the hit videogame Civilian GO! in an unprecedented way with your town! Enjoy extremely immersive events and activities while you stroll around your beautiful home.

Go out there and make your Mayor proud!

title: Fun, Sun & Mishaps
description: A light-hearted comedy about a girl, an island and a vacation gone wrong. That is, until you meet someone you think has the answer to all your problems. But, is his solution all it's cracked up to be, or is something else going on behind that smile? Find out as you scour a tropical island in search of a way to salvage your ill-fated vacation. Along the way, you will meet many interesting characters, some of whom, might need a little more convincing than others. But, no matter who or what you encounter, it will always be an adventure in......Fun, Sun & Mishaps

title: Goat Herd and the Gods
description: Life was pretty peaceful for Atl the Aztec goat herder. That is until the legendary El Chupacabra showed up to decimate his four legged friends. Against such a mighty foe, how can Atl save the day? Maybe with a little divine intervention? Join our cowardly goat herd on his journey and find out in Goat Herd and the Gods! Goat Herd and the Gods is a short point and click adventures game, and is the second title from Dropped Monocle's team.

title: Graveyard
description:
Short game about three kids trying to save a friend.

Dave, Phil and Clarence will have to cooperate to reach their goal, and save their friend Ron from a gruesome fate.

Entry for MAGS September 2016.

title: Grr! Bearly Sane
description:
Daniel is having a bad day.

Forced to wear a rancid bear suit and endure endless torment from his boss, and an endless multitude of horrid children, just so he can afford to keep his small crummy suburban flat, Dan finally SNAPS!

title: Hang On
description:
Martha is getting away from it all, up in the clouds on the lonely but peaceful slopes of the Trollspitze mountain. When a quick trip to the village below goes awry, who will come to her rescue? And is there any truth in the local legend of an abominable snowman?

Featuring:

* Two playable characters!

* Sublime alpine scenery!

* Vertiginous thrills!

* Accurate bird audio from the public domain!

title: Headbanger's Heaven: A Rock & Roll Adventure
description:
Jason Miller is a typical teenage rocker. Loves to stay up all night and sleep all day. And of course, headbang to his favourite music.

When he enters a competition in Kerplow Rock Magazine, he never dreamed he would actually win first prize!

But won, he has. And now he gets to spend the afternoon with his favourite band, Uptempo Maniacs, and get a private performance of their new song.

He is SO excited! He still can't believe it, even when the limo driver drops him off at the band's mansion.

He has his autograph book, all ready to get autographs from all 6 of the band members. And he CANNOT WAIT for the special private performance.

But if he thinks he's in for an easy afternoon, he's got another think coming.

title: Sprite Generator
description: Sprite Generator lets you rapidly create thousands of interesting procedurally generated sprites.

title: Tangent Rush
description: Tangent Rush is a casual game with unique controls and tricky levels. Challenge yourself through dodging obstacles and breaking records. Get the hang of throwing yourself around tangentially and getting to the goal in time!

title: Veneficium: A witch's tale
description: Veneficium is a cute and magical 3D platformer in which you help Alice uncover the faith of her coven. Alice has to use her magic to interact with different objects within a vast and magical world to overcome puzzles and obstacles.

title: Death Crown: Demonic Menace
description: Lead the Demon invasion and go down to the giant Undead's Dungeons to face Death.

title: Pesky Humans
description: Pesky Humans is a real-time, top-down, point-and-click sci-fi shooter. It is single player, with setting-appropriate music unique to each difficulty level. Talkative Ship AIs respond to players actions, spoken in English but subtitled for other languages.

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: The Dirt Track at Charlotte
description: Welcome to The Dirt Track at Charlotte, the home of Saturday night action!

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: The Dirt Track at Las Vegas Motor Speedway
description: Roll the dice and go all-in at The Dirt Track at Las Vegas Motor Speedway!

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: Knoxville Raceway
description: Head to Iowa and take on Knoxville Raceway!

title: Cauldrons of War: Barbarossa
description: Cauldrons of War Barbarossa is the turn-based strategic wargame you will launch whenever you want your WW2 shot but don't have time for a monster strategy game.From June 1941 until the Battle of Moscow, play the USSR or the Axis forces in one of the largest and bloodiest operations in history.

title: Hope VR: Emotional Intelligence Assistant
description: H.O.P.E is designed to be a calming experience in Virtual Reality that allows you to disconnect from the stress of the real world, and reconnect with your self in one of the many spectacular environments available, along with guided breathing exercises.

title: How to Survive 2: Dead Dynamite
description: Dare to go deep underground to solve the ancient curse that could be the root of the undead apocalypse. Meet a mysterious psychic lady with a good hand for explosives and help her get rid of this curse. You can stop the undead plague once and for all!

title: Life Simulator
description: Life Simulator is a simulation game with relaxed atmosphere. Players will play as a college graduate getting into the big city, you will fight for your life for four years, you can be a winner with cars, houses and soul mate, or maybe a salty fish with nothing, and you can also find love...

title: Mage: Enchanted
description: Unlock Mirror Mode and Skin Packs

title: Home Designer: Living Room
description: In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment. Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams!

title: Banner of the Maid: Miss Elisa's Journal
description: Banner of the Maid is a turn-base strategy game set in the time of the French Revolution. You will lead the army to break through the difficulties and experience the different stories of that most uncommon time with wine of salon and the smoke of battlefield.

title: Eisenbahn X: Modellset 1 - Bahnhof, Häuser, Scheunen
description: MODELSET 1 for Railroad XThis MODELSET contains 63 individual models consisting of a railway station, houses, townhouses and barns.

title: Rugby 18: The British and Irish Lions 2017 Team
description: Slip into the prestigious jersey of the 2017 British and Irish Lions. 35 players, including Owen Farrell, Jonathan Sexton and Leigh Halfpenny, available in "Quick Match," "Online Match" and "My Squad" modes.

title: Jewel Match Origins: Palais Imperial - Collector's Edition
description: Play a Match-3 game like you've never seen before! Journey back to the Baroque Era in this imperial Match-3 adventure! Traverse 180 vast levels and collect resources to construct a breathtaking palace.

title: Aggressor
description: Aggressor is a flashy air combat shooter with simple destruction physics. Fly the greatest planes of the cold war and bring down the enemy with an arsenal of unique weaponry, ranging from gunpods to bombs and air-to-air missiles.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C - Aggressors BFM Campaign
description: The FA-18C Aggressors BFM campaign puts you in the cockpit of an FA-18C Hornet, as a new Aggressor pilot with VFC-12 the "Fighting Omars" on loan to the 65th Aggressor Squadron at Nellis Air Force Base. Based on real world procedures you will fly as Red Air against Blue Air Forces.

title: Mend Arcade Battle
description: MEND Arcade Battle is a turn-based RPG inspired by Fighting Game core mechanics. Players must tackle the Fighting Game staple challenge known as Arcade Mode with a Turn-based RPG twist! Choose your character and follow their path to defeating the final boss awaiting them at the end.

title: Steel Storm: Forgotten Prison
description: Of course you all remember Steel Storm, well known for its fierce and intense action. This DLC is not only action packed, but also brings a challenge full of puzzles and traps, you need to think your way through. Think outside the box, explore, observe, and you shall succeed at your mission!

title: Portal 2: Community Edition
description: Portal 2: Community Edition is the best way to play and create Portal community content. This community maintained game can be used by anyone to create their own unique never before possible puzzles. Portal 2: Community Edition is built on top of Strata Source, a community maintained fork of the CS:GO engine.

title: Yuna: Sugar Hearts and Love - New Love
description: Hello and welcome to Yuna World. Help Yuna collect candy hearts and accompany her through the day. Candy hearts are an important currency in the world of Yuna. Get to know her better privately, maybe you will like each other. You like collecting achievements? You've come to the right place.

title: The Book of Yorle: Save the Village
description: This DLC, the first of four, entitled Save The Village, allows access to the warehouse and to the tavern's wine cellar. Is there more to discover than these areas? Yes! Search and explore to uncover the secrets hidden therein. Seal the gates to the village and prevent further infiltration from the Evil Ones.

title: Star Tactics Redux
description: Turn-based strategy game full of spacefleet battles. 30+ hours of gameplay, randomized battles, huge campaign with different ways of completion. Experience infinite tactical situations and outsmart the tricky AI using dozens of ships and special abilities.

title: Clown
description: You're trapped inside a series of mazes with a killer clown. Find the 8 playing cards to banish him before he finds you. Can you escape?

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Gigantica Road Lake
description: The Gigantica Road Lake is a fully-licensed venue in France known for the number and size of the carp present. With over 900 carp in the lake, including 50 trophy fish, you are assured plenty of action! The stock in this lake weigh in at an average of over 30lbs, with the biggest being over 60lbs.

title: Odd Adventure of Chub, Color, 23 and You
description: Very funny, very short and very sweet text adventure game about Chub, Color, 23 and You.

title: Metropocre
description: Felix is an ordinary rabbit trying to get a brand new pair of wings. To accomplish that, he must go through a bloody and unusual adventure.

title: Europa Universalis IV: National Monuments II
description: This pack adds new graphical national monuments to the already stunning Europa Universalis IV map.Hagia SophiaThe Hagia Sophia traces its origins to the year 4th century, with the current structure being constructed in the 6th century.

title: Our Way
description:
Our Way is an action, puzzles and stealth sidescroller, where the player uses his mechanics to unravel puzzles, defeat enemies and advance the level. The character features a grappling hook that he uses synchronized with his companion and a combat mode where he can pull and destroy enemies. 
Our Way is about two distinct views of the world and a conflict in overcoming ideals over the weak. These conflicts are fought between humans and robots. The game will come for Playstation 4 in a not defined date

title: Kselebox
description: Kselebox is a sandbox game, which means you can do whatever you want in it! You can build a rocket and go to explore the vastness of space. Or maybe you want to build a huge car? No problem! Players can save their buildings and then publish them to the Steam Workshop.

title: Heed
description: An encounter with a strange spirit and an even stranger fly leave a traveler with questions about purpose, fate and the source. Follow this traveler as they seek to find something more from their life and find their true purpose.

title: Hjarta
description: Hjarta is the Norse word for "heart". It is a collection of short stories and a point and click adventure game. It is set in a futuristic world and has three chapters, which you can play in any order you want.

title: How They Found Silence
description:
I am the last of the treasure hunters.

I've spent my whole life finding treasure: not boring ordinary treasure, real treasure, under mountains, in dark jungles, at the very ends of the earth. You'd think I'd be rich, but I'm not. It usually gets taken away. Museums get rich. I don't. I just keep going. It's all I really love.

Not long ago I got an unusual call. Most people don't know I exist, except government interferers and museum curators, and a few real die hards of treasure hunting who wish the good old days would come back. They won't. But I digress. I got a call from a man called Lord Fern, asking me to find a something for him. It's not something I ever do, find things for other people, but I've been getting bored and tired with my usual expeditions, and besides I haven't been on a usual expedition for over a year now. I'm beginning to fear that there isn't anything left for me to find.

So I accepted.

title: Airwave: I Fought the Law and the Law One
description: Elodie Major has been running a little indie radio station called Airwave Radio with her friend Zak for 5 years now, and they've manage to win a strong following amongst the people of the small town of Wave. Recently, however, they've found themselves under pressure from mainstream record labels to play their music, and have resisted quite forcefully, but they haven't seen an end to this attempted interference just yet... This is the first part in the ~airwave~ series of games.

title: Jacqueline White: Bad Trouble in the Red Desert
description: In the 1920's Jacqueline White, aviatrix and adventuress, is hired by the Two Bad Pennies Movie Studio. Soon mysterious things starts to happen.

title: Jessica Plunkenstein and the Dusseldorf Conspiracy
description:
It's been a peculiar day for Jessica Plunkenstein. By a freak twist of fate and airline security, our heroine finds herself battling evil barons bent on world domination, evil headmistresses bent on pathological propriety, and evil yodelers bent on nothing in particular. Full of llamas, ninjas, French people, pickled herring, dubious German accents, yetis in heat, and musical theatre up the wazoo, Jessica's adventures bring her from the Amazonian Rain Forests to the Norwegian Alps with layovers along the Eastern seaboard. So tag along, and you, too, can unravel The Düsseldorf Conspiracy in what the New York Times calls the Best Adventure Game of 2005!

Features:

* Zany intercontinental escapades with absolutely no mammoths or talking robots

* Eight hours of addicting gameplay, divided over four parts and fifty unique locations

* Full score and professional voice acting

* Writing that would put James Joyce, Jane Austen, and Anton Chekov to shame

* Art that would put them to suicide

title: Beyond Contact
description:
Beyond Contact is a fiercely formidable survival game, inspired by the art and style of pulp science-fiction comics, the moral dilemmas of contemporary science-fiction films, and the unforgiving gameplay of survival genre classics.

Taking place on the often mysterious and always deadly, procedurally-generated, alien world of Ketern, Beyond Contact features exploration and discovery, a robust system of research and crafting, intuitive base building and defense, farming and creature feeding, narrative-driven objectives to save the inhabitants of the planet, and enough flora, fauna, extreme weather, and environmental hazards to kill even the toughest players 1000 times over... and trust us if the planet gets the chance, it will.

title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars
description: Embark on a journey full of danger in this action RPG, inspired by Greek and Roman mythologies. Explore the breathtaking city of Aphes and forge your way through legions of unique foes and mythical bosses to discover the truth behind the city’s curse.

title: Bassmaster Fishing 2022
description: Bassmaster Fishing 2022, the official video game is coming this Fall, bringing the thrill of competitive big bass fishing to PC. Dive into the fully licensed content from the Bassmaster series from amateur to elite events.

title: Dreams of Being
description: An Exploration Through A Dream Journal

title: Courage: The Videogame
description: Fan horror ARG game based on the cartoon "Courage the Cowardly Dog"

title: Peppered: An Existential Platformer
description:
A light hearted 2D platformer about the meaningless of existence. Dark humour. Big focus on narrative-driven gameplay. Regret. Currently being developed for PC and Mac.
You play as a nameless civilian of an immortal world an hour before a return of the God of death. Life presents you with an opportunity to take this matter into your own hands. And then presents you with countless ways to fail spectacularly.

title: Azazel
description: A roguelike about goats, sin, and the Book of Leviticus

title: Corpse Party D2: Depths of Despair
description: Corpse Party D2: Depths of Despair is an RPG Maker VX Ace game based on the original NEC PC-9801 version of CORPSE-PARTY featuring influences and designs from Corpse Party for the PlayStation Portable. The game was written by Jackkel Dragon and illustrated by Hiragi-HOUX, and was released on November 15, 2013. It is known under the abbreviation CPD2.

title: Zoo Explorers
description: Join Splash the Penguin, Hedda Feathers, Gilda Gorgeous and all the characters of Zoo Explorers for hours of fun and learning.

title: Total War: Warhammer - Dark Gods Edition
description: This edition includes three race packs (along with unique Legendary Lords and gameplay mechanics), new artwork, and a free Warhammer ebook.

title: Five Nights at F***boy's: Final Mix
description: Five Nights at F***boy’s is a FNaF fangame created by Sable Lynn and Joshua Shaw in RPG Maker VX Ace featuring unfair difficulty, text-to-speech voice acting, and beautiful, beautiful animatronic...things. The Final Mix edition add's two extra playable side stories, each with their own plots and characters.

title: Joe's Miserable Life
description: A game about a sad man who lives in a small house, his only two friends are his dog and a toiler spider. What he doesn't know, there is a big misfortune awaiting him.

title: Joe's Horrible Hell
description: A sequel to Joe's Miserable Life. Joe now goes to hell and must find out why. If possible, then play this game with sound, music and voice on, it is a very important part of the experience.

title: Just Another Point n Click Adventure
description: Follow Andrew, and his brother Alistair as they go on a quest... to get a life.

title: Kanji Gakusei
description: Have you ever wanted to learn some Japanese? Now you can do this by helping our little girl to finish her homework. Find the six required Japanese characters in a classic point-and-click adventure. Then learn to write them in her notebook with the help of a stroke recognition system.

title: KTX-1
description: You play as an agent, briefed to defuse a bomb on a high-speed train. A DAW (Digital Warfare Assistant, ie. a hacker) is assigned to you and helps you through the game.

title: Kuma Story
description: It’s Kuma Bear’s anniversary with his girlfriend, Cinnamon Bear. He is hoping to surprise her on their anniversary with a small present, but doesn’t have anything to give to her yet. Help Kuma Bear find something nice to give to Cinnamon Bear, and a way to surprise her with it. Kuma Story was originally created as an anniversary gift from SpacePirateCaine to his girlfriend for their 3-year anniversary. She enjoyed it very much, and asked that it be continued, and shared with the rest of the world. Please note that what little text there is in the game is generally in Japanese. There is nothing specifically important written at any point as Kuma Story is intended to be a short, mostly textless adventure game, playable and accessible by anybody in any language.

title: Call of Duty: Vanguard - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition: loaded with bonus content for the ultimate fan.

Includes:
- Cross Gen Bundle of Call of Duty: Vanguard game

- 3 Weapon Blueprints with Tracer Rounds

title: NASCAR 21: Ignition
description: NASCAR 21: Ignition redefines the official video game of the world’s most popular stock car racing series. With incredible graphics and immersive gameplay, NASCAR 21: Ignition brings a whole new level of authenticity and atmosphere to the Nascar Cup Series.

description:
Nascar 21: Ignition redefines the official video game of the world’s most popular stock car racing series. With incredible graphics and immersive gameplay, Nascar 21: Ignition brings a whole new level of authenticity and atmosphere to the Nascar Cup Series.

Exclusive access to race as Nascar Hall of Fame driver and Nascar Cup Series champion Bill Elliott!

description: In deep space, one waste-processing employee stands above the rest: Limey Lizard, an incredibly lazy but lovable bloke who always seems to find himself in trouble. In episode 72, this is no exception, and if he doesn't fix the waste disposers the ship'll be flooded with filth, so get out your spanner and your chemically-resistant overalls -- it's gonna be a mucky ride!

description: Witness the final moments of the life of a man overdosing on a street corner. See the world through his eyes, meet strangers, and people from his life as he struggles to stay alive for just a few more precious minutes.

description: You play as Joy, a lost controller trying to find their buttons back after you've been smashed to pieces. You will have to cross a cyberpunk style city, and a fantasy filled forest using the simple buttons you can find, and some of the more advanced ones. Good luck, and watch out for dragons.

title: Dogs.Io
description: Can you create the biggest dog pack?

description: You play John Falcon, a rogueish space adventurer, down on his luck, who gets involved in uncovering a huge conspiracy that will determine the future of mankind.

title: PrincessCliffhouse
description: princess simulation game. 프린세스 시뮬레이션 육성게임입니다. 플레이어는 4주씩 10달 총, 40턴 동안의 시간이 주어지며 그 안에 스탯을 올려 다양한 엔딩을 보는 것이 목표입니다. 수업, 아르바이트, 던전탐험, 한달에 한 번 있는 마을로의 외출, 메인 시나리오 및 서브 시나리오 옷 갈아입히기 등의 컨텐츠를 즐길 수 있습니다.

description: Mojin Returns is a multiplayer online adventure survival game. You need to collect, make and build it to find clues for going to the tomb. Dive deep and cruise through the endless uncharted nature of the ocean and you will see clownfish, dolphins, penguins and mysterious sea animals. Get close to the sea surface and sail in the open sea with your cruise ship

title: Halloween Memory: Reborn
description: Halloween Memory: Reborn – is a Memory game. Match all the identical cards before time runs out! This game has 14 levels with a gradually increasing degree of complexity.Play, train your memory, and earn points.Compete with your friends who will score more

title: Three Pigeons in a Trench Coat
description: A game about Three Pigeons in a Trench Coat stuck in a time loop until they save the world. Pretty Simple.

title: Alphabetical Order
description: Experience an exciting journey in a surreal world, fight for your name, your social status and to survive. Leave the arena as a winner, with money, a lot of loot and hopefully a good speedrun time. Retry to improve, test different weapons, loadouts and skillsets.

title: Europa Universalis IV: American Dream
description: On July 4, 1776, the Continental Congress of the 13 American Colonies declared independence from Great Britain. The American Revolutionary War, having started the year before, would last for another seven years, and see the birth of a new nation, the United States of America.

title: Idle Master Hunter: Steam Edition
description: Slay monsters and get through the campaign that includes alot of monsters, raids and other challenges. Upgrade yourself and your companions to beat those horrible monsters Compete against friends to ranking list and complete all achievements in the game.

title: Surface: Lost Tales - Collector's Edition
description: Not all fairy tales are just stories…

title: Cricket 19: Ultimate Edition
description: With more ways to play, hundreds of new officially licensed players, the ECB’s thrilling new The Hundred competition and the Caribbean Premier League, Cricket 19 Ultimate Edition DLC takes the greatest cricket competitions and rivalries to a new level.

title: The Adventures of Fatman: Intergalactic Indigestion
description: Emerge from the Fat-cave once more and help Fatman defeat the Intergalactic Indigestion! A cheap and cheerful continuation to The Adventures of Fatman series, by Mike Doak.

title: Sea Dogs: To Each His Own - The Caleuche
description: She's returned and she's after you. Dive into a mystic and tragic adventure, prove yourself against the most dreadful and dangerous enemy. Survive and claim the greatest prize any captain would dream of.

title: Master of Orion: Terran Khanate
description: Liberate the galaxy as the Terran Khanate, a twisted reflection of the noble Human race. The Khanate excel at rapidly producing larger fleets than most empires can muster -- crushing their enemies with the might of their armada. Teach the errant races the will of the Khan as you conquer the stars!

title: Gremlins, Inc.: Agents of Chaos
description: This DLC delivers an array of cosmetic items, plus a whole new single-player campaign with custom decks and custom playing field rules for each of its 12 challenges.

title: Gremlins, Inc.: Famous Figures
description: This exceptional DLC presents the famous figures of the past, who to this day serve as the prime example of what it means to be a true gremlin! New portraits, new music theme, new main menu visuals – and new special items!

title: DCS World: Mi-8MTV2 - The Border Campaign
description: "The Border" is the storyline campaign of a Russian Air-Force pilot flying the Mi-8MTV2 helicopter inside DCS World. The player serves as a helicopter commander in the South Ossetia border area.

title: DCS World: UH-1H - Argo Campaign
description: "Argo" is a story-driven campaign comprising a series of Naval Operations with the iconic UH-1H. As a pilot of the Hellenic Navy, assigned to the recently obtained FFG-46 Argo Frigate, your day-by-day missions include a variety of demanding tasks such as flying in all-weather conditions, Search & Rescue ops, Cargo delivery,...

title: DCS World: F-15C - Red Flag Campaign
description: The F-15C 16-2 Red Flag Campaign is a depiction of flying the F-15C Eagle during a typical Red Flag exercise in the skies over Nevada. This campaign includes extensive briefing, map, and lineup card PDF files for each mission and was designed in consultation with the renowned author Steve Davies, the authority on the F-15C.

title: DCS World: P-51D - High Stakes Campaign
description: The "P-51D: High Stakes" campaign is a single-player, story-driven campaign for DCS: P-51D Mustang. The premise of the campaign is that a powerful businessman and gambler named "Maslov" has employed the pilot-for-hire pilot Vasily Sinitsa with promises of mountains of money.

title: DCS World: F-15C - Aggressors BFM Campaign
description: The F-15C Aggressors BFM campaign puts you in the cockpit of an F-15C Eagle as a new Aggressor pilot with the 65th Aggressor Squadron at Nellis Air Force Base. Based on real world procedures, you will fly as "Red Air" against "Blue Air" forces.

title: DCS World: F-5E - Aggressors Basic Fighter Maneuvers Campaign
description: The F-5E Aggressors Basic Fighter Maneuvers (BFM) campaign puts you in the cockpit of an F-5E Tiger II, as a new Aggressor pilot with the 65th Aggressor Squadron at Nellis Air Force Base.Based on real world procedures you will fly as Red Air against Blue Air Forces.

title: DCS World: F-5E - Aggressors Air Combat Maneuver Campaign
description: The F-5E Aggressors ACM campaign puts you in the cockpit of an F-5E Tiger II, as a new Aggressor pilot with the 65th Aggressor Squadron at Nellis Air Force Base. Based on real world procedures you will fly as Red Air against Blue Air Forces.

title: DCS World: F-15C - The Georgian War Campaign
description: "The Georgian War" is a fictional campaign created by Chris "Viper" Long and Baltic Dragon, and is inspired by real events that took place during the Russo-Georgian War of 2008. This campaign puts you in the role of a pilot who arrives in Tbilisi as part of a small detachment intended to present the capabilities of...

title: DCS World: Mi-8MTV2 - Oilfield Campaign
description: Life in civil aviation is far removed from dangers of military conflict. Instead, it’s based on strict time tables and lunch breaks. Meet a group of old friends: captain Jury Maksimovich Protasov and his Mi-8MTV2 crew. After the events of the "Spring Tension" conflict, they are again in business together.

title: DCS World: Su-27 - The Ultimate Argument Campaign
description: “Su-27 - The Ultimate Argument” is the storyline campaign for a Russian Air Force pilot flying the Su-27 fighter aircraft in the Digital Combat Simulator. The campaign is based on a fictional Caucasus conflict scenario, into which border states of the region got involved.

title: DCS World: Black Shark 2 - Republic Campaign
description: The Black Shark: Republic campaign is a hand-crafted campaign that tells the story of you as a Black Shark attack helicopter pilot. The campaign is non-linear and has story arcs that branch based on your mission results.

title: Space Hulk: Harbinger of Torment Campaign
description: As the Space Hulk, the Harbinger of Torment, emerged from the warp it is discovered to be on a collision course with the planet Baal. Several attempts are made to change course, but all fail. A team of the Imperium’s finest warriors is sent to the Harbinger of Torment to try and reverse the engines or stop them altogether. Failure is not an option.

title: Space Hulk: Defilement of Honour Campaign
description: Space Hulks do not usually move under their own power, the winds and tides of warpspace usually determine the course of these derelict clusters of ships. The Defilement of Honour was different, being equipped with a functioning engine room of sorts, as well as an ancient navigational device in control of its course.

title: DCS World: Spitfire - Epsom Campaign
description: Fly the legendary Spitfire LF Mk. IX over Normandy in June 1944 as the allies attempt to break out of the D-Day landing beachheads. Battle German forces in the air and on the ground as the allies push south over 12 missions south of the Juno and Gold landing beaches.

title: The Political Machine 2016: Campaign DLC
description: Battle for your spot in the White House against some of the most famous (and infamous!) presidents in American history. In the new ladder mode, you will choose your political party and launch your campaign against increasingly challenging opponents. Do you have what it takes to go down in history?

title: OneShot: Aftermath
description: OneShot: Aftermath is the fan sequel to the surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game “OneShot”. One year after the events of Solstice, you and Niko find yourselves thrown back inside the world, but something has changed.

description: Return to Rosemount to stop the Ice Queen this updated classic!

description: Can you claim your powers and save your mom in time?
