description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with furries.

title: Axilon: Legend of Artifacts - Prologue
description: Axilon: Legend of Artifacts - Prologue is a first-person fantasy action RPG game. Awaken your true power and resist the forces of evil that are trying to destroy your world.

title: Super Drag Race
description: Modify and tune your sport cars, drive quarter mile drag races, get money and upgrade your car better. Enjoy for awesome cars and drag strips

title: Tortuga
description: The goal is is to explore the island and collect all the fruits without dying. You have to be perfect and it' nearly impossible. You have to be precise and it's really difficult. You have to have a lot of patience and it's demanding. But definitely work hard.

title: My Lovely Daughter: The Inquisitor
description: A mysterious guest is coming to the Salach Village. The Inquisitor DLC includes new game mechanic, new story and gameplay adjustment for My Lovely Daughter.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Lincoln
description: The level-80 sense of purpose helped him to reach incredible heights. He is ready to share it with you. Pinch off just a small piece and you will become a great president ... that is a monopolist. And Uncle Abe's inheritance of 100 gold, 50.000 chips and the legendary dice will help to establish yourself in your new status.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Napoleon
description: He majestically walks over conquered lands. He holds his head proudly. He directs his victorious gaze towards new territories. He sets the goal. He reaches one. His main gift to you is a sense of distinctiveness. You'll also get 100 gold and 50,000 chips.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Cleopatra
description: Brush up your leopard grace, get the gold of all the desert sands and the greatness of the sun as a bonus. It's Cleopatra! The great queen of Egypt is ready to give you the vacant seat of her favorite cat. Together you will bring everyone to their knees within a radius of the Business Tour.

title: Business Tour: Crazy Heroes - Wild bird
description: Behold the superman, superpigeon, superpostman! And yeah, he can never have enough "super". He is a real superguy! Long time ago when he was a little kid he found his true calling. He delivers parcels at the speed of light anywhere in the world! But not exactly at the speed of light, because he isn't a very good pilot.

title: Business Tour: Football - Forward Number 10
description: It is so hard for one to pretend to be a normal man, and those wings under one's shirt are not making it any better. But he has to be patient if he wants to play. And he loves to play so much! He may lend you his nimbus, if you want it.

title: Business Tour: Football - Forward Number 7
description: Victory is always around you! Guru of motivation will explain to you why fortitude and self-improvement are important. He will teach you how to turn on your handsome-man mode, and how to go only forward to victory! And of course your self-confidence will grow. Dice, 100 gold and 50.000 chips will only contribute to this.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - King
description: Everyone has a dream. Someone wants a castle made of cotton candy, someone wants to rule the world, and someone wants to build a super-mega monopoly! But often dreams are just dreams... That's when Martin Luther King comes to your rescue! Should you follow him and he will lead to the fulfillment of all your plans for sure.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Caesar
description: This time-management genius can teach you how to plan out your day. Only with him, last on the agenda is always victory over your enemies. For added confidence in your success, the indestructible Caesar pack includes 100 gold, 50,000 chips and his legendary dice. Ave, Caesar!

title: Business Tour: Crazy Heroes - Rainbow Mercenary
description: Do you like to dream, have your head in the clouds, build sweet castles in the air, and ride the rainbow? He definitely doesn't like it. At all! He isn't an ordinary unicorn. He didn't get rose-colored glasses at birth.

title: Broken World
description: "Broken World" is an exciting post-apocalyptic low-poly game where players have to survive in a world overrun by zombies and chaos. Build and strengthen your shelters, fight various threats and explore a dangerous world full of secrets and dangers.

title: Amaranto
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world divided into districts, Mio and her childhood friend Shizuku hears strange rumors at school about "vampiric" murders. Who is the culprit, and how does it tie to that mysterious girl in white?

title: Fukawa-chan
description: This is a fangame about one of the protagonists of the Danganronpa series. Touko Fukawa doesn't have a fun life. In fact, she has a pretty miserable one. Between bullying, self-loathing, and mental illness, an average day in Touko's life is very painful. And today, you get to follow her through it.

title: Crave
description: Ceaseless hunger draws you yet a bit closer to the gates of Foghorn. Devour men and beasts alike to acquire a wide array of combat abilities. Through shadows and mold, track down the paling memories of this bygone kingdom, all in a classic hand-drawn action platformer.

title: SpellForce III: Reforced
description: SpellForce III Reforced is a unique mix of an epic RPG storyline blended with accessible real-time strategy elements, designed to offer a riveting console experience to fans and newcomers alike.

title: Guy: By Hook or by Crook
description: Guide Guy through his day, first by finding what to do, then hopefully and ultimately achieve the goal, by any mean necessary!

title: Linn the Protector and the Seven Daughters of Ran
description:
Linn, hand maiden of Lady Frigg, must protect Eric - the son of the Jarl of North Anglia-, from being drowned by the seven daughters of Ran.

And then she must face Ran herself.

title: Motivational Hero
description: Motivational Hero is a Emotional and Motivational Puzzle-Platformer 2d with levels based in Motivational Analogies

title: Bright Lights of Svetlov
description: Bright Lights of Svetlov is a short, story-focused first person quest about a Soviet family facing harsh trials. Set in a fictional provincial town, it carefuly recreates the atmosphere and vibe of mid 1980s.

title: Into the Metaverse: Theme Park Dark Ride Experience
description: Into the Metaverse is a VR Dark Ride Pilot about humanity's quest for ever deeper immersion showing scenes from the past, present and future. VR may be the ultimate Dark Ride tech. This is a 10 minute polished Dark Ride "Pilot" that will leave you wanting more.

title: Tower of Magic
description: Randomly generated Magic Tower dungeons A strategy-based fixed-value Roguelike RPG

title: Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle
description: “Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle”is a suspense reasoning emotional work based on werewolf killing rules.A group of college students accidentally came to a mysterious villa. They wanted to play a game of werewolf killing.You have only five days left to refute the truth.

title: Beauty vs. Robot
description: "Beautiful Girl vs Mecha" is a card RPG game with the theme of the future eschatology. Players will be transformed into army commanders, and they will fight through card battles by means of instant battles and four different occupations.

title: Zee.End
description: A secret organization makes a critical mistake in the development of chemical weapons. As a result, the entire population of the Montib island is infected with an unknown virus. You need to survive among zombies on a huge 20x20 km map.

title: Night of the Meteor
description:
'Night of the Meteor' is a non commercial Fan-Adventure in development.

"Ah! An unwelcome visitor!
How silly of me, I should have tied you to my bed!"
That's how Edna Edison (a nurse who's as nasty as she is ugly) used to greet the male visitors, which were unmindfull enough to enter the old Victorian mansion, built on the outskirts of town, where a meteor has crashed over 20 years ago.

Nothing has changed since then. Her husband, Dr.Fred still wasn't at dinner for the past five years and their son, Weird Ed a paramilitary nut is still waiting for his commando package.

So, every time when you play this game, it'll be The Night of the Meteor!

title: Loftus and the Sky Cap
description: Inessa is woken by the smell of smoke. She races down the stair case to discover the workshop torched and no trace of her Master Loftus. The townsfolk are convinced that a dragon must be responsible or that the crazy inventor must simply have blown himself up- but Inessa believes otherwise.

title: Crossfire II
description: Crossfire II is an Retro / Arcade / Top-Down Shooter, originally released in 2002 for the AMIGA. The main part of the game is a classic, fast paced, single player story campaign. Fly different space ships and fight, to save the universe as you know it. Also you get a survival and a local PvP mode.

title: Apex Legends: Bangalore Edition
description:
Includes:

- Exclusive Legendary “Super Soldier" Bangalore Skin
- Exclusive Legendary "Trusty Sidekick" G7 Skin
- Exclusive "Mark of a Hero" Gun Charm
- Exclusive "Striker" Badge
- 1000 Apex Coins

title: Perfect Crime: Collector's Death
description: Love and hate between a collector and several ghostly visitors.

title: Ashes of the Singularity: Escalation - Juggernaut
description: Pummel your enemies into submission with brand new, heavy-hitting Juggernauts! These massive warships may be expensive to make, but they have the potential to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of a war quickly.

title: Voltage: Episode 2
description: In Episode 2, you try to bring freedom to Voltage and fight against evil forces as you traverse the Voltage Town, Red Forest and many other areas. Your mission is to find resistance scientists, together you might be able to bring peace to the Voltage.

title: Professor Crackbrain: And the Awakening of the Weredog
description: Professor Crackbrain - and the awakening of the weredog is a classic point & click adventure game full of nostalgic allusions, pixelish puzzles and chiptunish music.

title: Tekling 2: Overdrive
description: Suit up and Boot up! Tekling is back in an all new adventure as you battle your way to defeat robots from taking over the world! Wear new suits and use new abilities to stop the robot uprising once and for all!

title: World War Academy: Commander 1
description: The Alliance Army and the Group Army have almost officially broken up, and the war is imminent. I was ordered to come to the Central South Theater command, and that's where the story begins...

title: Ship Surveyor Through the Ages: VR
description: The Lloyd's Register Foundation Heritage & Education Centre is proud to introduce our unique VR experience, set across three different time periods. You take on the role of surveyor, tasked with tracking down and investigating hazards and faults on board three ships throughout history.

title: Breach: Veil Demon DLC
description: Every session is different in Breach with a new type of enemy: The Veil Demon. The Veil Demon Pack is the perfect complement for the demon inside of you.

title: Bunker
description: You have to visit an abandoned bunker and find mysterious artifacts in a limited time, your flashlight charge will not last long and staying in such a place in complete darkness will mean certain death

title: Five Nights at F***boy's 2: Final Mix
description:
Five Nights at F***boy’s 2 is a FNaF fangame and sequel to surprise hit Five Nights at F***boy's created by Sable Lynn and Joshua Shaw in RPG Maker VX Ace.

This version includes the Final Mix: Game of the Year content, including the elusive Afterstory.

title: Lost Valley
description: Lost Valley is an excellent freeware action-oriented RPG that offers over 25 hours of gameplay, a lot of neat weapons and magic items, and smooth animations.

title: Defender of the Crown: Digitally Remastered Edition
description:
This edition is the first release of Defender of the Crown for Windows / Macintosh and it is a remake of the original game. This digitally remastered edition features enhanced graphics and sound, and additional material.

Years later, an original version of the game with original graphics and sounds was also released for Windows, which makes this a remake and a separate game to the regular port of the original MS-DOS version to Windows.

title: Dire Vengeance
description: Pandora ventures into the Dark Realm to slay the demons who threaten her world. Collect Soul Orbs to upgrade your abilities and uncover arcane weaponry. Slash your way through frozen wastelands, lava filled chambers, and caverns of putrefying flesh as you slaughter hordes of condemned monstrosities.

title: Lunatic Dawn: Book of Futures
description: Lunatic Dawn - Book of Futures is an RPG Windows PC game released by Artdink. You can be a hero or a villain depending on what tasks you wish to undertake. You can also smuggle, kidnap, assassinate, rescue, kill monsters, deliver items, and more. The game offers non-linear game-play where you can roam as you please in a randomly generated world with each game-play. The game also has Medieval Japan, Arabian, and Medieval European styled environments where you can start from or travel to. You can also recruit your own party members from each area as you wish also. If you are looking for a different type of RPG where you can play as you want, this is a must try.

title: Maverick Gunn and the Eye of Oggun
description: You are Maverick Gunn, treasure hunter and renegade History teacher. You start the morning at home as usual and after a few minutes of conversation with a mysterious and dangerous looking man, you are drawn into the chase for a huge diamond...and face to face with an ancient mystery.

title: Memories Fade
description: Made for MAGS February 2017, with the theme "As Time Goes By". After the loss of his beloved wife, an old man seems to be forgetting her. With the help of an old photo, can his son remind him of the good times they once had?

title: Minifeg: The Search
description: In the search for his father, our hero, Minifeg, gets stuck in time when his newly built machine does not work as expected. Now he must also find out how to return home.

title: Money Mansion
description:
This is Episode 100 of the Maniac Mansion Mania series.
It could also be played without knowing any other episode.

As Fred and Edna come back after a journey, they have to notice that
their house is on sale at Stan's. To buy it back they need one million
dollars.
Fortunately, Fred's uncle Edenezer is that rich he wouldn't mind lending them the money. Or isn't it?

- 3 playable characters with individual abilities
- a huge and completely new location
- countless references to Maniac Mansion, other episodes, other games, movies, series, music and much more.

title: My Father's Secret
description: Your father abandoned you as a child. After many years of searching, you have tracked down where he lives. What awaits you in this mysterious house on the hill?

title: Mysterious Song
description: Mysterious Song is an RPG strongly influenced by the style of the early Final Fantasy games. Your character is a knight, sent by the king to investigate the trouble arising in the land, with the help of two other party members whom you pick up as you travel. The combat is turn-based, with a very simple magic system based on spell points. One party member is a mage, one specializes in physical combat, and your main character is a mix. There is no class selection, only leveling up.

title: Q1K3
description: An homage to Quake in 13kb of JavaScript.

title: Evan Quest
description: EVAN QUEST - Bad Dudes have taken over New York City. The DoD sends in Evan Quest to stop them. Save the Hostages and clear the Bad Dudes from several progressively challenging levels.

title: Hide Seek Survive
description: Experience true horror as you move from room to room, looking for a doll that can get you out of the most dangerous game of hide and seek ever played. Be careful though because there is something in the house looking for you as well...

title: Chicken Duty
description: You've agreed to watch over the neighbor's chicken while they're away, and now you must lead it to safety as quick as possible!

title: Where's My Lunch?!
description: Where's My Lunch?! is an action stealth adventure game, with the quest of finding your lunch during the zombie apocalypse. Use impromptu weapons such as rakes, vacuums, wax machines, good ole Sally, and more! Set up zombies in environmental traps to help you move closer to your glorious lunch.

title: Piggy: Hunt
description: Piggy: Hunt is a fast-paced survival horror multiplayer game. Survivors must work together to survive and escape from the Infected.

title: YouRiding: Surfing and Bodyboarding Game
description: A realistic surfing and bodyboarding game. Play for the top spot of the ranking at real spots like Kirra in Australia or Supertubes in Portugal, create your own waves and share them to the community, or play against other players in 16 surfers bracket competitions.

title: Sexcraft: Sofiya and the Lewd Clan
description: Play as Sofiya, Defeat monsters, Become a powerful witch and Have sex along the way. Can you beat her old master?

title: Squad: Canadian Armed Forces
description: A new battlefield for SquadThe Canadian Armed Forces DLC is free for all owners of Squad and is an all new faction developed by community members together with Offworld Industries. Featuring two new maps on the North American continent, three new vehicles and completely custom and hand crafted character models it will add a complete new...

title: Spooky Night: Remastered
description: Grimelda is still at it but with some new tricks and treats in store! Spooky Night Remastered is a Casual Fantasy FPS for the whole family We have overhauled and updated the original Spooky Night VR game also available for the Oculus Quest.

title: Combat Mission Shock Force 2: NATO Forces
description: NATO Forces is the third module in the Combat Mission: Shock Force family of contemporary land warfare simulations. Now you have a chance to play with the forces of three additional NATO countries; Germany, Canada, and the Netherlands.

title: Heroes of Dungeon
description: Heroes of Dungeon-a Game based on the mechanics of " 3 in a row" Features Fun and memorable graphics Epic music A wide variety of enemies

title: Mei Qi: Season 6
description: The sixth season of "Mei qi" series contains a total of 6 DLCs, which will be updated one after another. The update cycle is one DLC every 2 weeks.

title: Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire: Blue
description: More Pretty Girls!! Can you solve the puzzle? Find pairs of tiles to delete them. Delete all tiles before time runs out to clear a round. Once you make it to the third round a girl in a sexy costume begins to reveal herself as you delete tiles... As you clear stages, the girls get sexier and sexier!

title: Gubble
description: Gubble is a puzzle game where your goal is to unscrew all the screws on each level in order to win.

title: Anarchy Legends: Online
description: Anarchy Legends Online is a multiplayer tactical action third-person shooter inspired by old competitive multiplayer games focusing on team-based tactics and real individual skills.

title: The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I
description: Let's the show begin! The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I is a prologue of "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish" full game. Together with the Actress Ella, embark on a journey through the past and discover the secrets left by the brilliant Director in his magical performances.

title: Jumping Joe! Friends Edition
description: Jump right into the action in this jolly pick ‘n play platformer. An Indie action game perfect for intense playtimes with your friends and family. Help Joe and his fellas on their upwards journey. Be quick as a flash and dodge roaring cannonballs, vicious bats and other traps.

title: Command Ops 2: Bastogne Vol. 4
description: Bastogne contains 12 scenarios covering the southern shoulder of the 1944 Battle of the Bulge.

title: Welcome to... Chichester 2: Part II - No Extra Regrets For the Future
description: Grendel Jinx is in danger of having to repeat a school year. Refusing to allow this to happen, she enlists the services of the protagonist - her newly found "Best Friend" - and is promptly rebuffed. Grendels drastic actions soon catches the attention of her mother.

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth3: V Generation - Mini Island
description: Mini Island DLC introduces an island dungeon filled with miniature monsters, but with more experience points to gain!

title: Paper Dolls 2: Escape
description: Ghosts and spirits will prowl the mansion on All Hallows' Eve! Within the new game mode you will act as an exorcist, slaying spirits aplenty! Make sure to explode each wine jar at the opportune moment to blow up as many enemies as possible.

title: Antigraviator: Viper Trails
description: This DLC introduces you to some very exciting new race tracks built in the forest of the Orval planet system, known as the Viper Trails. Strap yourself into your new Venom Class Grav and be the victor!

title: Horizon Chase Turbo: Summer Vibes
description: Summer Vibes is HORIZON CHASE TURBO first DLC. Featuring the most classic arcades roadster, you'll love to put your sunglasses and feel every mile of this warm coast to coast experience.

title: Horizon Chase Turbo: Rookie Series
description: A new campaign tailored for new players. Bring your friends and family together into ROOKIE SERIES!

title: City of God I: Prison Empire - Outrage
description: Outrage have 5 new gangster persioner into your prison.

title: Beyond the Thaw
description: You are a Max Gilbert, a former military doctor. While taking a trip to your usual place of stay, the next moment you find yourself alone in the middle of nowhere, fighting fierce cold and facing series of trials. What is it: reality or mind games, behind which lies your deep secret?

title: How to Survive: Barricade!
description: So, you decided to settle down did you?That’s great but let’s see how long can you survive...Spend your days searching for resources and materials to create obstacles, barricades and traps to defend the occupants of your camp from the hordes of night flesh-hungry monsters.Learn to craft obstacles, barricades and traps!

title: For Honor: Warmonger Hero
description: Prey on the weak as a Warmonger, new playable Hero. Strike and impale with the Flamberge, a legendary two-handed sword!

title: For Honor: Kyoshin Hero
description: Become a Kyoshin, a mystical Samurai whose elegance and prowess will leave everyone in awe on the battlefield.

title: For Honor: Gryphon Hero
description: A well-known veteran has returned! Wield the mighty Bardiche as Gryphon, a new playable hero.

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: World Wonder Ring Stardom Collaboration
description: Stardom, Japan's leading women's professional wrestling promotion, join the Fire Pro ring with 10 new wrestlers, including their signature moves, costumes, entrance themes, and voices! Believe now, shine tomorrow! We are stardom!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Yoshihiro Takayama Charity DLC Part 2
description: Add rings, logos and T-shirts representing legendary Japanese pro-wrestler and MMA combatant Yoshihiro Takayama with this Edit Part DLC.

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Fighting Road - Champion Road Beyond
description:
Wrestler Morio Sumisu’s life ended in tragedy at the height of his career. Now his son has set out on the same path of glory, but can he find a way to the top without following in his father’s haunted footsteps?

Scenario writer SUDA51 returns to the Fire Pro ring for the sequel to his infamous Champion Road scenario that launched his career 26 years ago.

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Entrance Craft
description: Set the tone of the match before you even step in the ring with this entrance sequence editor! Customize your entrance outfit, pre-match taunts, venue lighting and effects, and more!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: World Wonder Ring Stardom Collaboration Part 2
description: Stardom, Japan's leading women's professional wrestling promotion, are back with 11 new wrestlers, including their signature moves, costumes, entrance themes, and voices!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Fighting Road - 2017 NJPW Junior Heavyweight Championship
description: You never forgot the excitement you felt when your father showed you your first junior heavyweight match... Now you step into the NJPW dojo to realize your childhood dream of becoming the best junior heavyweight the world has ever seen!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: New Japan Pro-Wrestling Collaboration
description: NJPW, Japan’s premiere pro-wrestling promotion, joins the roster! Battle alongside and against your favorites in the all-new Fighting Road scenario mode.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Where the Cat and Wolf Play...'
description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest "Where the Cat and Wolf Play..." is a free DLC quest released in July 2015. In this quest, Geralt investigates a village whose inhabitants have been mysteriously killed. The story centers on a confrontation with a Witcher from the School of the Cat and introduces choices that affect the outcome of the mission.

It adds a new standalone side quest with unique dialogue, a new location, and narrative ties to the broader Witcher lore.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Fool's Gold'
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Fool's Gold' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red on June 3, 2015. In this humorous side quest, Geralt teams up with a character named Hystian to investigate a seemingly cursed village inhabited by pigs.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners'
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red in May 2015. In this contract, Geralt investigates the disappearance of miners near the village of Blandare in Skellige.

title: Wargame: Red Dragon - Norse Dragons
description: Norse Dragons is the third free DLC for Wargame: Red Dragon. Dedicated to the Scandinavian coalition, it features more than 60 new units for Sweden, Denmark & Norway. Effectively propelling this coalition as well as the individual countries into the early 90's era, it will bring them onto an equal footing with the other nations.

title: Wargame: Red Dragon - Second Korean War
description: Second Korean War is Wargame: Red Dragon’s second free DLC. It features a new solo campaign, set in an uchronical 1992 where the previous year's coup against Mikhaïl Gorbatchev has succeeded. The Party's old guard has restored Soviet order, getting closer to its Asian communist neighbors in the process, but is set on a confrontation..

title: Wargame: Red Dragon - The Millionth Mile
description: The Millionth Mile is the first free DLC for Wargame: Red Dragon. Focusing on the Eastern Bloc coalition, it will feature more than 60 new units for Poland, Czechoslovakia & East-Germany, bringing them in the 90's and on an equal footing with Wargame: Red Dragon's main nations.

title: Kalpa
description: A next-generation rhythm game where story and music intertwine. Enjoy a tracklist filled with famous licensed songs and exclusive original songs made by renowned composers Discover an immersive story, and face endless challenges. Your performance will dictate the fate of the world.

title: Snake
description: The classic and pure Snake game.

title: Raindrops
description: Raindrops is a stereo rhythm game, played with your mouse. Notes will be poured from both sides, and the sound will wave towards the direction of succesful hits. Move your mouse, click with both buttons, even scroll to take care of these notes.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Williams
description: Located in California, Lake Williams is surrounded by a stunning backdrop of dry arid land and forest-covered steep hills.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lough Kerr
description: Lough Kerr is a perfectly formed, historic venue found in Ireland where anglers flock to try and catch a national bream record with the biggest being an incredible 21lbs. The lough also contains good sized carp, tench, roach and rudd.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Dylan
description: Located in Minnesota, Lake Dylan is over 2000 acres with 11 different species of fish to target. As well as containing trophy sized bass, this lake also contains giant Muskie, Tiger Muskie and Longnose Gar with the Muskie growing to a huge 53lbs.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Jezioro Bestii
description: Jezioro Bestii or ‘Lake of the Beast’, a scenic lake in the mountains of Poland, is famous for its predators including pike to over 50lbs, zander to over 20lbs and catfish to 85lbs. With 13 different species to catch and 25 boss fish to successfully land, this lake will be a unique challenge.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Talon Fishery
description: Talon Fishery is the epitome of a pleasure fishing complex and gives you four separate lakes in one venue. Each contain their own stock of fish and species and are perfect for honing your match and float fishing skills.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lago Del Mundo
description: Based in Andalucia, Spain, Lago del mundo (Lake of the World) is the first venue to offer fishing from static pegs around the lake as well as from a brand-new rigid inflatable boat. With catfish to 200lbs, huge largemouth (black bass), carp, pike, zander and roach, there is something for everyone!

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Laguna Iquitos
description: Laguna Iquitos, in the heart of the rainforests of Peru adds two new species of fish - the beautiful peacock bass and terrifying giant wolf fish as well as a new style of boat, a kayak. Also catch huge arapaima, black pacu and red tail catfish.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Arnold
description: The habitation around Lake Arnold in Tennessee provides a range of fishing opportunities for the ten different species found here.

title: Fishing Sim World: Bass Pro Shops Edition
description: Fully endorsed by Bass Pro Shops and featuring an array of your favourite Bass Pro Shops equipment. Choose from 8 glorious US locations from Fishing Sim World and compete in career mode or play your way in multiplayer. An underwater camera will allow you to see the moment the fish strikes lure!

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Nelson
description: Lake Nelson is a picturesque fishing venue located in the heart of Texas. Fish for 15 different species including bass to 15lbs, as well as enter three different tournaments and three new career events with 25 new Boss Fish to hunt down and catch.

title: The Black Watchmen: Alone in the Dark Web
description: In the Alone in the Dark Web DLC, you'll need to complete an all new in-client mission that brings you to the brink of the dark web - and insanity. Investigate the hidden secrets behind an occult website to discover the ultimate truths.

title: The Black Watchmen: Mother Russia
description: In the Mother Russia DLC, you'll need to complete an all new in-client mission set that brings you through the cold case files of Agent Msika and the circumstances surrounding her disappearance. Investigate the dark truths behind secret Soviet weapons programs and their modern day counterparts.

title: The Black Watchmen: Whitechapel
description: Rumors have emerged suggesting the return of one of the Agency's most dangerous enemies. Where he goes, mayhem surely follows...

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Dead Ends
description: Step lively as more of Harry's friends join you in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! Includes two new character decks — JARED KINCAID and MORTIMER LINDQUIST — and two new book decks — CHANGES and GHOST STORY.

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Wardens Attack
description:
WE’VE GOT YOUR BACK!
The White Council’s grey cloaks, the Wardens, join the fray in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! This expansion includes two new character decks—Carlos Ramirez and Anastasia Luccio—and two new book decks—Small Favor and Turn Coat.

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Ra Crossover
description:
A crossover with Greater Than Games' Sentinels Comics universe and its game Sentinels of the Multiverse!
The sun god Ra steps into a new avatar in the Dresdenverse with this fully playable character deck. When one supernatural fire-slinger isn't enough, it's time to call down the flames!

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Helping Hands
description:
NEED A HAND?
You’re in luck as more of Harry’s friends join you in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! This expansion includes two new character decks—Sanya and Molly Carpenter—and two new book decks—Proven Guilty and White Night.

title: Femboy Bangers: Pub & Grill
description: Your visit to Femboy Bangers turns into a memorable encounter with various employees, eager to please. Read through an exciting story as well as some pretty raunchy(erotic) dialogue, accompanied by spicy nude depictions. * Don't forget to tip your waiter!

title: The Surfeit: Episode 1

title: First Hero: Epic of Gilgamesh
description: "First Hero" is a third person hack 'n' slash, based on the epic of Gilgamesh: the holdest in our history. With an enormous strenght, various weapons and combinations you'll face a lot of soldiers, beasts, traps, demons and even the gods, during your quest to become immortal.

title: Pathfinder Adventures: A Fighter's Tale - Valeros
description: Delve into five scenarios specifically tailored to the Iconic Valeros, 30 new cards, and introduces a new Fighter to the roster of playable characters: the gnome Tontelizi "Legbreaker", master of polearms.

title: Pathfinder Adventures: Rise of the Goblins Deck 2
description: The Rise of the Goblins takes place in an alternate version of the Rise of the Runelords, where the heroes are the Goblins and the villains are the heroes. This is a continuation of the story that follows immediately after the first series of five scenarios. Goblins Only!

title: Professional Farmer 2014: Good Ol' Times
description: 7 additional, historical Tractor models for Professional Farmer 2014:Friend 15FTorino Mk. 25Rainman Model 3Brownman 88Friend Bauer Oliveman Mk. 5FarmMaster 6x1

title: Hero Siege: Class - Shield Lancer
description: The Shield Lancer class

title: Gene Rain: Wind Tower - Sky City's Rebirth
description: "Sky City Rebirth" tells that Alex has fallen into an endless space after boarding the Sky City. The battle is endless, and the enemy's level will be higher and higher. You can get powerful weapons here. Every time you challenge through the reincarnation, you will Get a generous reward.

title: Gene Rain: Wind Tower - Way to Heaven
description: ‘Way To Heaven’ tells the story of the Human rebels army opening the passage to the Sky City. The new chapter tells Alex about the adventures in Oil City, and you will face new giant boss and new enemies.

title: Automobilista: Legendary Tracks Part 1 - Imola
description: Part 1 of Legendary Tracks has arrived - the classic Imola circuit from Italy, oozing history with 4 distinct versions from 4 different decades - 1972, 1988, 2001 and 2016.

title: Wargame: AirLand Battle - Magna Carta
description: Magna Carta for Wargame: AirLand Battle offers 12 new units (one per nation) and new large-scale multiplayer maps. Wargame AirLand Battle therefore has 7 new maps: Gjöll and Ásgard, 2 totally new maps specifically designed for the massive battles with 20 players, and 4 new additional maps for 1 vs 1 up to 3 vs 3 players.

title: Wargame: AirLand Battle - Vox Populi
description: Vox Populi, the first free DLC from Wargame AirLand Battle, has been developed specifically to respond to the demands of the community… and has just landed with a whole arsenal of new features! "Conquest" mode makes a great comeback in Multiplayer mode and against the AI, offering a range of new objectives to commanders all over the world.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Master Chicken and Li
description: This pack unlocks Master Chicken and Li as playable characters.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Kai and Master's Garden
description: This pack unlocks Kai as a playable character. It also unlocks the Master's Garden Level.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Warrior Po and Jombie Master Chicken
description: This pack unlocks Warrior Po as a playable character. It also comes with an alternate Jombie skin for Master Chicken.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Rhino Armor Li and Jombie Master Bear
description: This pack unlocks Rhino Armor Li as a playable character. It also comes with an alternate Jombie skin for Master Bear.

title: Euro Fishing: Manor Farm Lake
description: Manor Farm Lake is part of the famous Linear Fisheries complex and is a beautiful and picturesque venue. Don’t be fooled by the idyllic setting though, this 14 acre venue has hundreds of big, hard fighting Carp including many fish over 30lbs and several breaking the 40lb barrier, as well as specimen Roach, Tench, Bream and Catfish to...

title: Euro Fishing: Hunters Lake
description: This 8-acre lake is famed for its quality Roach fishing. The five islands situated around the lake and the number of overhanging trees provide plenty of features to try and help you land that monster 4lb specimen.

title: Euro Fishing: Bergsee
description: Bergsee (Mountain Lake) is found in the foothills of the Austrian mountains where the scenery is as spectacular as the fishing.

title: Euro Fishing: Lilies
description: Lilies is a 10 acre venue that is as beautiful as its residents and is named after the abundance of lilies on the surface of the lake. This venue is known for its big fish with Carp up to 50lbs and Catfish up to 100lbs.

title: Euro Fishing: Le Lac d'or
description: Le Lac d’or (The Golden Lake) is a 25 acre venue surrounded by woodland and nestled in the French countryside. This mature lake is an ideal holiday venue with three log cabins each with their own pegs accommodating up to 4 anglers for you to fish from.

title: Euro Fishing: Waldsee
description: Waldsee is an 10 acre venue hidden deep in the famous forests of Germany. An intimate venue with wooden platforms surrounding the lake but still plenty of different features to fish towards.

title: Buzz Aldrin: Cycling Pathways to Mars
description: Buzz Aldrin wants to be remembered for more than just "kicking up moon dust." He wants his legacy to include laying the groundwork for a permanent human settlement on Mars, and he has a plan. As NASA prepares to send the first humans to Mars, 8i and Time Inc's LIFE VR have collaborated with the celebrated astronaut and...

title: Deltarune: Chapter 2
description:
Deltarune: Chapter 2 is the next installment of the sequel to beloved indie darling Undertale...in a different world! This time around, two more classmates join the protagonists in their adventure as they, too, discover a mysterious world hidden behind a door, called the "Cyber World".

Players with no save data will be able to start right at Chapter 2. “As long as you generally remember what happened story-wise, you’ll be fine,” the developers said in an FAQ.

title: Magical Drop CPC
description: A homebrew CPC conversion by Oscar Sanchez (aka Mochilote) of the 1995 classic from Data East

title: Garrison
description: Traverse a broken empire to help the people and learn the truth. Discover items and combine them in new ways to destroy obstacles or enemies as you explore both side-scrolling and top-down perspective areas. Set out on an action/adventure journey.

title: Girlfight 2024
description: GirlFight 2024 is the girl fighting game with physical effects that make realistic boobs movements and clothing destruction systems.

title: Chigau!!!+
description: Mirai Minato, a boy student who attends Mokuyo High School, is woken up by a noisy childhood friend who takes care of him as usual.

title: Grim Wanderings II
description: This game combines a deep role-playing system inspired by classic board games and a full-fledged 4X strategy

title: Cossacks 3: Summer Fair
description: Cossacks 3: Summer Fair introduces special seasonal event content to all our players.

title: Warlock II: The Exiled - Three Mighty Mages
description: This pack brings you three new exciting Great Mages to choose from in your fight for Ardania. Each mages comes with special faction perks.This pack includes:Chief Justice: The Chief Justice of Dauros Court already passed the sentence on the United One, and now joins the ranks of the Great Mages to personally see the sentence executed.

title: Hungry Horace
description: 8-bit hero Horace is often considered the unofficial mascot of the ZX Spectrum. In later years he’d go skiing and battle spiders, but the 1982 game Hungry Horace – now remastered on Steam for your gaming pleasure – saw him run around a maze eating flowers, ringing alarms and avoiding angry parkies.

title: Mirror: The Lost Shards
description: This DLC has 4 more characters, with better animation, more CGs and more enchanting stories!

title: Sky Mirror: Strolling
description: Relax and stroll in this dreamland, get positive energy and avoid negative energy.

title: Legends of Aria: Citizen's Pass
description: Expand your sandbox with the Legends of Aria Citizen’s Pass, which grants you permanent citizenship to the world of Celador. Build a home, launch a player-run shop, unlock your bank’s full capacity, and more.

title: R.A.I.D
description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 4-player co-op action.

title: Making History: The Great War - The Red Army
description: The first expansion to the acclaimed WWI strategy game Making History: The Great War takes the action into the turbulent period as the war is ending and empires are beginning to collapse. The Russians have already quit the war and fallen into civil war, and on the western front the final showdown is in progress.

title: Wax Museum: Seek and Find - Mystery Hidden Object Adventure
description: Enjoy the beautiful and extraordinary exhibits of the abandoned Wax Museum! Immerse yourself in a mystical detective story full of secrets and puzzles! The newest hidden object game.

title: Fortune's Tavern: The Fantasy Tavern Simulator - Guns and Goblins
description: Guns and Goblins brings two new things to the world of Fortune's Tavern: Guns and Goblins!

title: Retrold
description: In RETROLD you can play many games inspired by old arcades from 70`s, 80`s and even 90`s.

title: Endless Furry Clicker
description: Welcome to Endless Furry Clicker! The third installment of the "Endless Furry" Series! Just a basic clicker game. Click the Furry and stack your score!

title: Oval Racer Series: Sandbox
description: HOME OF THE OVAL RACER Very First EVER dedicated pc game for UK oval racing Feel what it is like to get on one of the UK Oval Circuits in a Racecar

title: Carnage
description: Dive into exhilarating combat in this roguelite, top-down shooter where survival is key! Face relentless hordes of monstrous foes, and conquer epic boss battles. Play solo or team up in co-op to race against time and see if you have what it takes to survive this mayhem of blood butts and guts!

title: PlayZ
description: PlayZ is arcade-style singleplayer puzzle style game! You have different levels and at each level, you have different gameplay styles! The aim of the game is to finish as fast as you can.

title: Infinite Minigolf: Tortuga
description: Set sail to the lovely Caribbean pirate town of Tortuga and play along side a crazy cast of pirates as you embark on a new Infinite Minigolf adventure! Captain Salvador and his crew of buccaneers have many pirate inspired surprises while you play through the 108 holes across four brand new tournaments.

title: Infinite Minigolf: Hangar 37
description: Put on your space suits and prepare for landing in Hangar 37 on the Intergalactic Spaceport in this sci-fi Infinite Minigolf adventure! Meet a goofy team of aliens and robots who will help you complete four new and challenging courses, consisting 108 brand new minigolf holes.

title: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey - Heintz
description: This is an additional character for Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey. This will allow you to add "Heintz" to your party.

title: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey - Shanon
description: With this DLC you will be able to interact with the new character Shanon and a new outfit will become available to use under the Change Outfit option inside the Atelier. *You need to progress the story to the certain point to add Shanon to your party.

title: Home Designer: Home Sweet Home
description: Help Hazel redesign client homes in this fun Hidden Objects game, "Home Designer: Home Sweet Home".

title: Dark Cave
description: Dark Cave is a third person slasher action game set in a dark fantasy world. Built by one-man development studio Denoriks, powered by the Unreal Engine. Your enemies are ruthless, so survival requires the highest alertness and precision.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Extra Mission: "VS ???"
description: It's time for an eXtreme challenge! A new mission has been added that pits you against an incredibly powerful Blade. You may even get a small reward if you're victorious...

title: Fighting Fantasy Classics: Caverns of the Snow Witch
description: Deep within the Crystal Caves of the Icefinger Mountains, the dreaded Snow Witch is plotting to bring on a new ice age. A brave trapper dies in your arms and lays the burden of his mission on your shoulders But time is running out – will YOU take up the challenge?

title: Ggg Collection
description: Dodge others as a line, jump as high as you can as a jumper, dodge hornets as a frog, throw pizzas at shades as scaterboy, blow up obstacles as bombman and smile away your foes.

title: The Remainder: Act 1
description: The Remainder is a dark fantasy mystery where you will try to save The High Magus Vyn from certain death. Will you find your way alone or will you reignite a lost love? Is it worth the sacrifice? Do you deserve to be saved?

title: Teenage Blob: Paperperson - The First Single
description: Grab some sandwiches, get on your bike and hit the streets! Paperperson is the first single from the upcoming game/ album split-release Teenage Blob; a colourful art-punk adventure towards the best night of your life!

title: The Trap: Remastered
description: The game includes inside the Buzludzha Monument.

title: Faircroft's Antiques: Treasures of Treffenburg
description: Dive into the world of art with Faircrofts Antiques! Join conservator Mia Faircroft as she explores the town of Treffenburg to find and restore priceless antiques. Tour Treffenburg through 20 beautiful hidden object scenes! Get to know the town's residents and find their connections to the past!

title: Puppy Cross: Kitty Cross
description: Nonograms and cute cats, welcome to Kitty Cross!

title: Spiral Knights: Operation Crimson Hammer
description: Challenge Warmaster Seerus and claim his mighty weapons for your own in this all-new Expansion Mission Pack!

title: Twin-Turbo Supercharged Nitro-Fueled Papamobile
description: Cyber-noir platformer in which you steer high-performance papamobile through a future city in order to deliver a cure that could save humanity.

title: Liberated: Glory to the Heroes
description: The second free story DLC for Liberated - an action-adventure game inside a living, hand-drawn comic book.

title: Liberated: For the Homeland
description: Liberated: For The Homeland is the first of two short story addons for Liberated. In this story-driven epilogue, you’ll peek behind the curtains of an oppressive system operated by very ordinary people. It’s a story of the daily grind and crushing violence against individuality.

title: Ghost Beat
description: Ghost Beat is a rhythm based precision platformer.

title: Decarnation
description: Decarnation is a story rich adventure horror game. Solve cryptic puzzles, fight disturbing enemies, explore a phantasmagorical world of dreams and nightmares, and face the most terrifying monsters from the darkest parts of your soul.

title: My Life As An Archeologist
description: Click your way through 100 levels of archeological treasure hunting, loot and improve your equipment, uncover build-defining artefacts on every boss, choose between three different classes and find the one that best fits your playstyle! Research monsters cards and improve every run!

title: Dragon Mission
description: Order in Chaos is kidnapping all the leaders of Dragonia, only Calanguito can stop them. Your chance to become a hero you've always dreamed of, in this action-packed game.

title: CyberSex 2069
description: Collect loads of “sensitive data” (hentai) on the Cyber by defeating sexy hackers in real time combat. Hack networks and devices to amass even more “data”. What else is the Cyber good for? A good laugh, actually.

title: Amborettio
description: Amborettio is a post-apocalyptic mining/survival RPG with a focus on crafting, equipment upgrades, and resource management. Mine, craft, and fight your way through the caverns as you try to uncover the truth about the PR0T3CH coalition's goals.

title: Flak
description: Send in your spitfires, bombers and divers. Play as the invading force, destroy your opponents before they rebuild their base!
Life is short. Time is precious. Can you discover and solve the mysterious sequence of puzzles that will save the world before you are... eighty-sixed?

title: Stranded 2
description: Following a not highly unexpected crash landing (which seems to happen to you a lot), you find yourself stranded on a hostile alien world full of humour, mystery and quite a bit of walking - Your task is clear, find a way off of this planet and get home. - Should be simple!

title: Logic Light
description: A minimalist puzzle experience to restore the electricity of the houses after a blackout

title: Among Ass 2: Butt Warfare
description: Asses are back in an adrenaline-pumping sequel! Now you can fight back bad asses with big boom-sticks! Gather friends and choose a side of the conflict.

title: Kira and the Life Stone
description: This the journey of Kira a lost soul in the state of limbo trying to get back to life and find out why is he dead. Follow him in his journey of getting back to life and get new powers, fight different enemies and find hidden secrets.

title: Lost Remnant: The End Tides
description: A Mysterious Point & Click Adventure of Discovery, set in the world of Lost Remnant. Inspired by SCP and the 'Hero of The Kingdom' series.

title: Tierra
description: A mystery puzzle adventure, inspired by hidden object escape room games.

title: Caveblazers: Together
description: Caveblazers Together is an online multiplayer mod for Caveblazers - team up with up to 3 friends on your adventures!

title: Escape the City
description: Silva's first map

title: Radiolight
description: Ashwood Creek, 1985. A child disappears without a trace. A local policeman is drawn into a national park, seeking the truth. Mysterious radio signals beckon him further and further. Investigate, survive and face the unknown in Radiolight— an '80s thriller by solo dev Krystof Knesl.

title: Carnival and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Only Hope: Episode 1
description: Decades since we last heard the Gods spoken. The evil soon broke into our world with the full power, causing it to tremble. The world had changed. Colors left us for many centuries, and a new powerful entity dwells. We divided. The matter of blood has never been so important before, as it is now.

title: Serious Sam HD: The Second Encounter - Legend of the Beast
description: Grab a fistful of rockets and step into the bright red shoes of the legendary Sam "Serious" Stone as he reloads for an all-new battle against the nefarious minions of Lord Mental. Hunt down the mysterious ram-god of the Great Obelisk and unlock the secrets buried beneath the mystical temples dotting the sands of ancient Egypt.

title: Beyond Horror: Episode One - A Father's Journey
description: The game is the first episode of a survival horror first person adventure, featuring action, stealth, shooting and puzzle solving. Every chapter has a specific theme and will play differently according to the plot, with tons of references to the classics that made the horror genre what it is today.

title: Lola: The Escape
description: In this challenging action platformer. Help the little cow Lola to escape from the Martians who kidnapped her. Explore and avoid obstacles in each level. Her main ability is to float while she falls.

title: Voidwalkers: Soul Hunters
description: Enter the Realm of Astora and fight for redemption in a non-stop battle for glory! Future Knights is a fast-paced dueling simulation where you are pitted against foes in numerous arenas to prove your worth.

title: My Journey to Your World
description: A casual free-to-play puzzle game with randomly scrambled puzzle pieces that can be solved under a certain time to win.

title: How to Volley Ball
description: A simple game about volleyball made by a member of a school volleyball team. Hope you would enjoy it and arouse your interest of volleyball. Maybe one day you would pick up a ball, walk in the court, join in the team and try the real game. I'll be glad to hear that!

title: Aquarist: My First Job
description: Get your first job in the Aquarist! Learn how to set up aquarium, decorate it and take care of your fish!

title: Hedgie Simulator
description: Trapped within the offices of a large hedge fund called Sipadel Finance. It's your job to take a sip and make the apes dip.

title: Jujubos
description: Jujubos is a puzzle game that you need to use different tools to build a path until the end and rescue all the Jujubos.

title: Legends of Snooker: One Shot
description: Legends of Snooker: One Shot, is a game that will bring out the best of your snooker skills. The puzzle will challenge you with several possible moves that vary according to your progress in the game.

title: Bloodwash
description: A serial killer is terrorizing the city, and Sara's deadbeat boyfriend hasn't done the laundry. Can Sara survive a late-night trip to the laundromat, or will the Womb Ripper perform an early delivery?

title: Voidwalkers: Astora's Darkness
description: You are the chosen, free of all, but in order to transcend, you must be the servant of many. For in order to gain the weak, ye must become the weak. Enter the Void, and walk the path of the Enigma. For many chase a corruptible crown, and you must prove that you are incorruptible.

title: Klondike Re-Imagined
description: Standard 3-card draw Klondike. But with a zillion gizmos to make it tedium-free. If its mundane, the app does it for you! You are just left with the fun stuff. This may be the most advanced solitaire game ever.

title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame - Compound
description: Expand your gameplay with the new Monster Energy Supercross - Compound. Discover the outdoor compound with two tracks and test your abilities with new and exciting challenges.

title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame 3 - Monster Energy Cup
description: Buy Monster Energy Supercross 3 - Monster Energy Cup now and enjoy the full experience of the most spectacular Supercross race ever!

title: Aircraft War: Shape Wars
description: Aircraft war now continues its adventure with shape wars. Fight the shapes with this new DLC package. New maps and new characters have been added to the game. Have fun.

title: Aircraft War: Tank Wars
description: Distinguished aircraft war followers, now the tanks are involved in the battle, choose your tank and start the war immediately. With this dlc package, 6 player tanks and 5 enemy tanks have been added to the game. Have fun.

title: Aircraft War: Dragon Wars
description: New DLC for Aircraft War. The war continues with all the excitement. Now dragons are involved in the war. You can also play two players from the same computer with the latest update. There is also co-op and versus option in the game.

title: Aircraft War: Car Wars
description: Aircraft War, now with Car Wars continue to have fun. The game adds more excitement to you with 5 different maps with different player cars and enemy cars. You can also play co-op on the same computer screen as your friend. Or, you can choose versus and try to shoot each other with your friend.

title: Generation Zero: Apparel Crafting
description: It’s time to turn your ultimate 80s outfits into battle worthy garments with the addition of the Apparel Crafting in this latest update. By exploring and scavenging in Östertörn and Himfjäll, you will be able to find crafting materials or objects you can strip down for parts. Use these resources to enhance your clothing, making them as strong as they are fashionable.

title: Insights: Maniac Vortex
description: An old school point and click adventure game in a nostalgic pixelart look. Young journalist Thomas wants to write a newspaper article about the psychatric asylum in the small town Fuchsberg. Not knowing yet that he will be going on a great adventure leading to the greatest article of his life.

title: B.D.K
description: B.D.K is a short experimental first person horror game that mainly relies on atmosphere and sounds to create a creepy experience.

title: Presence
description: Presence is a 2D tile based strategy game with RogueLike Elements. Explore randomly generated levels as you battle your way in a fierce turn based combat system. Gather loot and gain XP to ascend the Classes to gain ever more power.

title: Ideology in Friction: Append
description: Following up from the critically acclaimed Dark Fantasy RPG, this DLC features 81 New Event CGs, alterations to existing story events, and an entirely new chapter revolving around Sachiyo - the strongest of the Viktor Knights and Zepp's mentor.

title: Enchanted Kingdom: Descent of the Elders - Collector's Edition
description: Play puzzles and brain teasers in one of the best new mystery seek and find hidden object games free! In this one of the top easy search and find object finding games your goal is to find hidden objects needed to become a hero!

title: Equilibrium
description: This game is developed by a senior high school student who fall in love with games.I will take into consideration the sales to keep updating and develop a bigger service.

title: One Night with Clara
description: A simple NSFW visual novel game. It's full 3D real-time rendering.

title: Search Party: Director's Cut
description: Claire's 8-year-old brother is missing. While looking for him during a search party, she finds herself completely lost and alone in the woods. She eventually spots a strange house in the distance... could Daniel be inside?

title: Space Bar at the End of the Galaxy
description: Space Bar at the End of the Galaxy is a Heist Comedy Space Opera Visual Novel where you play as Captain Leo Mancini, a tenacious and charming Space Pirate always looking for the next big heist.

title: Battlestar Galactica Deadlock: Armistice
description: Armistice is an explosive 8-mission story campaign that brings Season Two of Battlestar Galactica Deadlock to a thrilling conclusion! Unravel Clothos’ plot for dominion, and take part in the legendary Operation Raptor Talon.

title: Wushu Chronicles 2
description: Wushu Chronicles 2 is a martial arts sandbox ARPG game. It is the orthodox sequel to Wushu Chronicles, using the latest self-developed engine flexi3.0, the picture effect is greatly improved. The game uses a seamless big map exploration mechanism, and you can write your arena freely.

title: Cellar: Rags and Knife
description: Adventure game based on a real life story! Get a knife, put on rags and go down!

title: Mind-Blowing Girls 2
description: A puzzle game where you need to assemble a complete image from several pieces.

title: Stellar Monarch: The Age of Technology
description: The first expansion for Stellar Monarch. It focuses on technology and science. New alien races, terraformation, megastructures, construction of a fearsome battlestar, random technologies, etc.

title: WWII: Rising
description: Become a hero during WWII in an Epic Online Multiplayer battles. Play up to 4 different maps with 4 game modes. You can choose to support your teammates with the support class or either fight off the enemy from a long distance with the Recon. The battle has started, come and fight for your country.

title: A Game of Dwarves: Star Dwarves
description: Many Dwarven clans disappeared during the Magic War. One clan even went where no Dwarf has ever gone before; space. Now they have returned and brought with them new and strange technology for their Dwarven brethren.Dig deep and prosper!

title: Territory
description: Territory is an immersive, atmospheric, crafting and survival game. Developed with Unreal Engine 5.

title: Neighbor Watching
description: She is unable to resist our hero's coercion, but remains resolute that she is only doing these things to protect her family. But by reluctantly complying with his lecherous demands, she begins to learn things about herself she never thought possible...

title: 1 Hop
description: Play as a rabbit and go looking for carrots and food bags avoiding the dog. Try to get the mountain first to become the ultimate rabbit, play split screen with your friend and work together to become the King Rabbit.

title: Pepo
description: Pepo is a 2D platformer shooting game that fights boss by firing three colors. Join Pepo's adventure of meeting mutant bosses on the extinct planet and leaving to find Pepo's home!

title: Dollar Dash: More Ways to Win
description: Now unlock a completely new game mode "Topscorer" with six maps and a mass of new exciting in-game shop content, such as a new victory dance, costumes and in-game icons! The challenge is set, as each player carries a money bag which can hold $1,000.00 dollars.

title: Tic-Toc-Tower: Teslagrad
description: Teslakid, from the game Teslagrad, will be a playable character in this new DLC for Tic-Toc-Tower.

title: Hot Spring Hero
description: A hot spring hotel deep in the forest. There are natural silly hostesses, gluttonous dog-eared female chefs, cat-eared female fishermen, and even the hot spring goddess, all for the revival of this hot spring hotel! The adventurous life with the lovely heroines day and night, look forward to your arrival!

title: Labyrinth 3
description: A relaxing labyrinth game.

title: Femboys of the Phalanx
description: The year was 432 BC and Athens was at its peak. Set out on an adventure and meet Femboys and other characters as you make your way through this interesting time in history.

title: Tomorrow
description: Rescue your bunny from the hands of the artist known as Jaye!

title: Wildlife Park 3: Dino Invasion
description: Living with dinosaurs is only fancifulness? No, it is real now. Blow the time dimension and beam the prehistoric jurassic giants with many other futuristic visitor attractions to your Wildlife Park. Dinosaurs, theme park attractions, a bunch of SF service facilities, extinct plants and new decorations.

title: Universe 25: The Loop
description: A Pythonesque Indie point and click adventure game set in the year 2035. Follow the journey of a bureaucrat as he tracks down a malevolent force running experiments on citizens. Armed with a government issue briefcase and a pet mouse, he tracks down an evil agent only to find more than he expected

title: Space Smack!
description: Space Smack! is a 1 to 4 player party game exploding with chaos and sabotage. Enter into the vast expanse of space and clash in a variety of minigames. In this controller-only game, cooperate or undermine your friends to become victorious!

title: Attack: Helicopter Simulator 2020
description: Attack: Helicopter Simulator 2020 is a simulator about a pilot of a helicopter, who battles in some places. Realistic Physics of helicopters.

title: Automobilista: Donington Park
description: Donington Park is one of the most internationally renowned and historically significant circuits in the world, The latest version of this classic track modelled with LIDAR scan data now features in Automobilista!

title: Automobilista 2: Spa-Francorchamps
description: The epic Spa-Francorchamps arrives for Automobilista 2, initially featuring a laser-scanned version of the modern track as well as the historical variant from 1993.

title: Automobilista: Formula Truck
description: Formula Truck for Automobilista brings the official simulation of the popular Brazilian Formula Truck series - the most competitive truck racing series in the world!

title: Automobilista: Brazilian Touring Car Classics
description: Brazilian Touring Car Classics for Automobilista

title: Automobilista: Snetterton
description: Snetterton is one of the finest circuits in the UK, blending a challenging and complex layout with fast straights to create a unique challenge!

title: Apocalypse Hotel: The Post-Apocalyptic Hotel Simulator! - Museum of Horror!
description: Yes the world has ended, yes most people are dead, and yes you are trying to run a hotel under terrible conditions: but that’s no reason not to think about expanding your business to attract more guests. Transform your parents’ museum for hotel paraphernalia into a museum of macabre horror, one that puts on show some of the horrors that took place in the city since the zombie apocalypse!

title: Roll For Confidence
description:
A wholesome story about what it means to be a strong, confident woman.

Everyone in the town of Fernweh knows and adores Sophia, the sweet co-owner of Screen Time arcade. Well, almost everyone. Sophia is tired of avoiding confrontation and keeping herself small. She wants to be a strong woman, but WHAT DOES THAT EVEN MEAN?

title: Y: The Game
description: Y: The Game is a passion project platformer where you are a Y avoiding enemies and spikes trying to get all of the objectives in levels. Perfect for hardcore speedrunners, imaginative level creators, and casual players.

title: Mandinga: A Tale of Banzo
description: Mandinga: A tale of Banzo is a role-playing game with game style of Japanese RPG classics, with a unique battle system using dice in turn-based combat, full of strategy and challenges. A game with an immersive history, based on a historical moment in Brazil.

title: Citizens: Far Lands
description: Citizens is a blend between turn based city builder and a puzzler for strategy masterminds. Build a thriving settlement, extract and process resources and manage your population by catering to their needs, thus allowing you to build bigger and better!

title: Fantasy Sliding Puzzle 2
description: Challenging sliding puzzles with various levels of difficulty, featuring epic fantasy female characters and backgrounds.

title: Wraiths of Sentinel
description: Harness the phenomenal abilities of an unliving wraith to preserve liberty—or to subvert it. Will you use your powers over quintessence to save your nation, or will you profit from its broken shell?

title: Dumb: Treasure
description: Use a remote-controlled robot to find the treasure lost under the bed.

title: Jaksaljabi
description: Jaksaljabi is a kinetic novel that you can experience unique set-up and story.

title: Sit Down, Please
description: Step into a scientist's shoes in a story driven game which leads you to discover a mysterious and unknown world by torturing characters. In order to find out all the hidden secrets, try to keep the guinea pigs alive for as long as possible by using the scientist's machinery.

title: Tales of a Rabbit: The Story of Willie Hop
description: Tales of a Rabbit: The Story of Willie Hop is a 3D educational platformer about an adventurous rabbit on a grand treasure hunt! This short 3D platformer is designed to teach players how to solve math problems that deal with the order of operations, one-step equations, and two-step equations.

title: Voidwalkers: The Gates of Hell
description: You are one of the Voidwalkers, tasked with a life-long oath to defend the Gates Of Hell from any who would try to cross into the land of the living. After a thousand years without incident, thousands of undead warriors have begun crossing the plane, and it's up to you to stop them!

title: Mechanica: A Ballad of the Rabbit and Mercury
description: 5029 AD, "Guillotine", the Japanese territory on Mercury, a city full of neon signs and drunks. You will explore the beautiful cyberpunk-style 2D world, play music to the residents of Mercury to gather intelligence, and finally achieve the goal of saving the world.

title: Barn Finders: Bid Wars
description: Take part in an endless number of auctions. Win access to more garages, abandoned containers, unclaimed luggage and sell found items for a lot of money. Become the king of bidding. Bid'em All!

title: Bubble Star Party
description: It's a 3D multiplayer world with more than 30 characters with various skills to unlock, and a level editor with more than 500 terrain modules, dozens of obstacles and traps. In addition to built-in levels, you can make your level!Let other players have fun cooperating and competing in your level!

title: Trains Continental
description: Build your own transcontinental railroad in western America of XIX century. Collect and manage tracks, rebuild them to find the most optimal way for the train to cross even the most difficult terrains. Beware though! The clock is ticking and you need to finish the work before the time runs out!

title: Kick Ball
description: Kick Ball is a puzzle-style game, in which the player will have to go through challenges such as saws, thorns, bombs in order to reach the goal.

title: First Class Escape: The Train of Thought
description: "First Class Escape: The Train of Thought" is a co-operative atmospheric escape room puzzle game, set in a beautifully realized vintage train. Do you think you have what it takes to solve the puzzles and escape the train?

title: Jìmò Shénmíng de Xīnyuàn Shǒujì
description: What kind of courage and change can the connection between people bring? The story takes place in the ancient eastern country, where a foreign girl from Silazi kingdom got involved with various humans, spirits and even gods. Here, she heard voices unknown to others and met people unknown to others.

title: Tarakan: Point and Click Adventure
description: Tarakan is a puzzle mystery adventure, inspired by escape room style games. Take control of a submarine and visit multiple coastal laboratories. Solve puzzles as you go to unlock the tools you need to solve the mystery!

title: Robogal
description: This is a role-playing game. In the game, you will play the role of bio robot manufacturer. Through the data collection of prototype, you can make the robot customers want.

title: Demon Lord Jill: Revival
description: “Jill”‘s family is a two hundred thousand years-lasted Demon consanguinity. But Jill was in deep trouble as his father passed away. The number of demons and humans were decreasing.

title: Helper Cat
description: Helper cat is a puzzle game, in which your objective is to help a magician, putting his potions in the correct places, but for that you'll have to face all the puzzles in the castle.

title: Fantasy Match Puzzle
description: Are you ready to test your eyes with Fantasy Match Puzzle, your seek and find skills will be challenged like never before. Develops your secret seeker skill to find objects. This is a puzzle game similar to Hidden Object games, in which you have to find the objects while the clock is ticking.

title: Portals World
description: A sci-fi action strategy tower defense digging 2D top down game, Dig, explore, build production and defensive facilities, take care of robot's battery and manage power wisely..

title: VR Hot
description: VR HOT is a virtual adult experience for creating and interacting with dream partners. It gives you the opportunity to explore your most intimate desires in a non-judgmental surrounding. VR HOT offers a virtual environment and a construction kit for dream partners and the interaction with them.

title: Blockee
description: Blockee is a simple slide-puzzle game. Just slide the blocks!

title: Sānguó Yǎnyì zhī Shǔhàn Chuánqí
description: "The Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Legend of Shu Han" is an RPG game with a theme of the history of the Three Kingdoms that happened in China. In the game, player operates Liu Bei's army to suppress anti Han bandits on the vast land of China, maintain the legitimacy of the Han Dynasty.

title: Grow Big or Go Home: Ultimate Edition
description: Play as Bruce, the world's most talented indoor gardener, in this 2D pixel-art puzzle game. Through now 30+ fast-paced levels, you will travel to different locations and eras in order to water, light, and tend to plants with the high-tech magic of a watering can and a reflective mirror.

title: Galaxy Reavers: Titan
description:
A paid DLC for “Galaxy Reavers”, allowing commanders to unlock the giant warship “Titan” and build up a more diverse and powerful fleet to challenge higher level stages!

To allow commanders build up a more diverse and powerful fleet, this DLC will release a special giant warship–the Titan!

Content
1.Unlocks a giant warship, “Titan”.
2.Unlocks a device, “Torpedo IV”.
3.Gains 200 Khorium.

Titan is a giant warship in “Galaxy Reavers”. Like a great castle, it possesses great defense as well as highest CPU value in game. Along with its most enormous space for devices, the full power Titian is nightmare to the enemy fleet!

In addition, there is 200 Gold in this DLC as well, allowing commanders to purchase more powerful warships and devices!

title: Tactical Three Kingdoms: Strategy & War
description: Recruit famous heroes from the Three Kingdoms era to end the turbulent age!

title: 20XX: Draco Character
description: This DLC introduces Draco, a powerful playable Contractor who wields an endless arsenal of unique Weapons. Master the shadow-dashing Vega Claws and the platform-creating Rapture Bubble to destroy your foes in style!

title: Valkyria Chronicles 4: The Two Valkyria
description:
This cataclysmic reunion of "1933 EC. Behind the Empire's towering facade, Crymaria awaits a crucial test with Lieutenant Colonel Selvaria Bles.

This cataclysmic reunion of the two Valkyria will determine Crymaria's fate.

This story can be played after completing Chapter 18 of the main story. Complete this extra story to unlock Crymaria, Nikola, Chiara, and Selvaria for use in the main game, along with swimsuit uniforms for each. To access this story, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories."the two Valkyria will determine Crymaria's fate.

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth3: V Generation - Let's Get Nepucated
description: Let's Get Nepucated DLC unlocks a special event called Nepucation

title: SpaceXplorer
description: Desktop and VR interactive space experience/game. Fan homage to SpaceX's efforts of inspiring humanity to finally become a spacefaring civilization! Experience launches, flights and landings of starships first-hand, engage with challenging mini-games, explore funny memes and more. :-)

title: Cursed Night: The House
description: 1972, Texas. One night, you had a car accident near the Stafford farm. You wanted to get help, so you went there. But it was your worst decision of your life. What after came...it was the real CURSED NIGHT for you.

title: Speedway Challenge 2021
description: Speedway Challenge 2021 is a 3D speedway game. Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Heroines of Swords & Spells: Green Furies
description: An Anti-Heroic DLC for an epic and funny jRPG adventure with intricately detailed world and story. Revisit this world and look at the familiar story through the eyes of completely different protagonists.

title: The Maze
description: In a pitch dark maze like factory, you must avoid He, secure secret documents, and escape with only a flashlight. If He finds you, He’ll charge from the dark with an axe. Can you survive and escape?

title: Imperiums: Troy
description: Imperiums: Troy is a small-scale tactical scenario that sets the stage for participation in one of the most epic battles of ancient times. Join the greatest of Trojan and Greek heroes and prove your worth on the plains of Troy!

title: Trash Can Dungeon: Battle Against the Zoo
description: This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Shitsudo Kei. Keep the peace in Neo Tokyo in this Dungeon Action RPG

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 4
description:
Dive into the Sunken Kingdom to solve puzzles and unearth the secrets of its Siren Shrines, or battle through waves of Ocean Crawlers and Sirens to raid the Siren Treasuries.

Seasonal progression allows all players to earn Renown and rewards, with a fresh array of Trials and Deeds to boost progress and an optional Plunder Pass to expand the reward pool.

title: Pangea
description: Unique combination of turn-based strategy, tabletop game and roguelike. Make moves according to the roll of the dice on a randomly generated field and destroying enemies in tactical battles. Available 4 different factions.

title: REM Cycles
description: One night, ten people fall asleep and find themselves in someone else's dream. Guide these unlikely heroes as they traverse strange lands filled with enemies and memories. Confront a mysterious antagonist and witness chats between battles while you search for reason in sleep.

title: Mighty!
description: MIGHTY! is a fast-paced top-down roguelike set inside cramped dungeon walls which forces constant resource management and stat min/maxing skills to get as far as you possibly can in an endless creep of levels.

title: Covert Commando
description: A no frills rogue ultra-lite top down dual stick looter shooter.

title: Hero Siege: Class - Samurai
description: Samurai is an offensive melee fighter with lots of movability.

title: Hero Siege: Class - Shaman
description: The Shaman- Unlock the Shaman class.

title: Hero Siege: Class - Amazon
description: Get Amazon and exclusive Jungle content!

title: Hero Siege: Class - Marauder
description: Marauder is a semi-ranged class that uses chains, bombs and a flail to demolish it's enemies

title: Inspector Schmidt: A Bavarian Tale
description: "Inspector Schmidt - A Bavarian Tale" is a third-person detective RPG, set in rural Bavaria in 1866. As the young Medical student Valentin Schmidt you will travel to Wolpertshofen in order to write a report of the peoples' living situation for the King, when a sudden death causes turmoil in the small Bavarian village.

title: Fatal Evidence: The Cursed Island - Collector's Edition
