description: Claire Barnes is about to discover what kind of horrors lurk in the darkness of a deserted road. Welcome to a dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

title: ChromaBeat
description: Rhythm-based matching madness! Lineup holograms of matching colors in time with the beat in this exciting and smutty science-punk puzzler!

title: Rabi-Ribi: Cocoa Mode & Before Next Adventure
description: Rabi-Ribi 3rd Anniversary! The final DLC for the dedicated Rabi-Ribi fans! Challenge new Special Bosses with new Erina and Ribbon's new costumes! Also a new playable character!

title: The Hurricane of the Varstray: Threat of Third Force
description: The Hurricane of the Varstray -Threat of 3rd Force- Studio siestA high speed SF shooting game!The story will be the day before "The Hurricane of the Varstray". An additional story of full voice. All 8 stages of play stage. New weapons "Diverion" and "Highgrabaster" added!

title: Veterinary Clinic Simulator
description: Play as a veterinarian whose job is to save the lives of various animals. During the game, to save your patients, you will have to be observative and react quickly to various events. The fate of the animals is in your hands!

title: Blaze
description: Blaze is a 3rd person over the shoulder action adventure game where you a budding fire elemental seek to cleanse your fellow elementals from the corruption of humanity.

title: Deus Ex Machina: Episode 1
description: Deus ex Machina is a VR room escape game where you solve puzzles in the lab of a crazy scientist. Become a member of DEM ( Deus Ex Machina ) and save the world in danger.

title: Mage Tower: Call of Zadeus
description: A single player roguelike deckbuilder adventure! Travel across a randomly-generated world, visit towns, and collect cards. Delve into dungeons, fight monsters, and wager resources on every battle. A digital sequel to the 2013 card game.

title: Conquer the Universe
description: Conquer the Universe(CTU) is a Free To Play Idle Incremental game. Build up yourself a robot army and try to conquer the universe with endless grow.

title: ChineseZodiac
description: The game is a first-person single-player shooting game. The lower right corner will randomly list the targets that need to be killed.The quantity of ammunition is limited and the target needs to be killed within a specified period of time.

title: Aspen: Uncanny Home
description: Aspen: Uncanny Home puts the player in a state of psychological terror. Players will find themselves in puzzling situations and search to find the hidden story.

title: Drekirökr: Dusk of the Dragon
description: A classic-inspired RPG set in a post-apocaliptic world.

title: Underground Keeper II
description: Underground Keeper II is a logical 3D puzzle game from a first person view. You will enjoy hours of entertainment in a 60 levels and 5 different environments. Levels generator included.

title: 2945VR
description: This is an unconventional VR shooting game.In the game, you can use time slots to activate bullet-time to avoid enemy attacks.And use weapons of different styles to destroy the enemy.

title: Must Reach
description: Must Reach is a platformer in which you have to play as a schoolgirl who needs help finding books that will open the way to the next level. Destroy all monsters and go around all obstacles on your way.

title: Quarantine Simulator
description: You have to stay at home in quarantine. Get out of here, unless you want to blow your brain. Are you a real pro? I got a little surprise for you!

title: Clad In Iron: Carolines 1885
description: An additional alternative historical scenario of the colonial conflict between Germany and Spain in 1885 for control of the Caroline Islands in the Pacific Ocean.

title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond the Summer
description:
A text adventure game depicting girls traveling the world to the end.

You found an old computer which can connect to talk with strange garl you have never met.

The girl's name is Natsuno.
She said said to be traveling alone in a world collapsed by a pandemic.

But in the world, you know, there is no pandemic or social collapse.
Where is the world she is in and why are the calls connected each other?
As you talk to Natsuno and watch over her journey, you will explore the mysteries of the end of the world.

title: On the Wire
description: Sur Le Fil or On the Wire (OTW for Friends) is a game focused on the electricity / electronics, in an interactive and fun way. The Wire Guy (Prof'Fil) will give you hundreds of missions, as funny as it is interesting, helped by Kelhann , one of young Prof' student .

title: Cafe Simulator
description: Cafe Simulator is an cafe business simulation game. Destruc-Build-Design the best cafe in the world!

title: Playing Pride & Prejudice 1: An Austen Armoire
description: An Austen Armoire is a time-based cozy game that illuminates Volume 1 of Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen. Combining cosplay with collecting, sharing, and daily character messages, An Austen Armoire progresses over real time. Players can read the novel in easy, snack-sized sections.

title: Oblivity: Find your perfect Sensitivity
description: Oblivity is a tool for FPS players that determines the perfect, intuitive mouse sensitivity based on your mouse movement data and your preferences. In order to achieve an optimal result, Oblivity offers many scenarios and supports over 20 games and presets.

title: Kanapocalypse
description: Kanapocalypse is an educative RPG guesser game. Train your Hiragana and Katakana while raiding a city during the apocalypse. Earn money, buy new weapons and keep study/learn more Japanese alphabet.

title: Omniblast
description: Blast off through space, dodge asteroids, and beat bosses!

title: Devastation 2: Repatriation
description: Kill enemies, earn a multiplier, build score, unlock weapons, upgrade content, achievements. Battle in a revolutionized futuristic environment with 12 dynamic levels, fight bosses and waves of enemies. Equip 11 weapon types, 6 missiles types, customize classes, repair damage and unlock skins

title: Shrimp
description: Click Shrimp, get more shrimp, shrimp.

title: HRO: Adventures of a Humanoid Resources Officer
description: HRO: Adventures of a Humanoid Resources Officer is a puzzle-driven visual novel set in a retro sci-fi universe. When the Endeavor stumbles into universe-shaking trouble, can you harness the power of the bureaucracy to rein in your crew’s worst impulses and survive to the next episode?

title: Fear Protocol: Codename Omega Starring Agent Jack Banger
description: It's a nice dark day in Escondido, California and special agent Jack Banger and his superior Gilbert Simpson are planning their next operation. Their life of luxury is soon interrupted however when strange biomonster creatures start appearing all over the city...

title: Rock Star Simulator
description: Taste the life of a famous musician, go on the live tour across the USA and have fun just like a real star - welcome to the rock and roll heaven!

title: CyberNeon
description: This game takes the classic MATCH-THREE concept for a spin. A competitive and rapid gameplay, set in a dystopian CYBERPUNK future. Match three signs to colorize the board and DOMINATE your opponent.

title: Colosseum VR
description: Come and visit the Roman Colosseum! This guided tour will take you through its rise and downfall, bring you face to face with gladiators, and allow you to experience the glory of roman architecture like never before. Welcome!

title: Tame It!
description: In Tame It! you end up stranded on a tropical island, with the many challenges ahead, as well as hot but dangerous creatures. So will it become your demise, or you could overcome all, tame the savages and even win their hearts?

title: Droplet: States of Matter
description: Change between the different states of matter in this 3D platforming adventure!

title: Kaiju Wars
description: Play out a Kaiju movie as the (hopelessly) outclassed military in this stylish 2D turn-based strategy game. Construct buildings and defend your city with cannon-fodder tanks, jets and more as the devastating kaiju grow in power with every attack.

title: Any Fish
description: Any Fish is a simple match 3 game, tap screen drag and drop the fish get high score. Made in Construct 2. Enjoy the game!The game has nice graphics and music.Collect as many Jelly as you can and get the most points.Forward!

title: Beku
description: Captured by a plotting king of Beku and forced to embark on a challenging quest to finalise his plans, you'll master your devastating ethereal abilities in this 2D platformer to overcome increasing waves of formidable foes. What secrets will you find along the way?

title: Star Island
description: Star Island is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty.

title: Industrial Firefighters
description: Industrial Firefighters is the new edition of our well-known firefighter series. With modern graphics, new soundtrack and intensive atmosphere our well-known fire department series comes to new life.

title: Rainbows, Toilets & Unicorns: Political Drama
description: Face off ruthless political leaders in the Political Drama DLC

title: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars
description: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is an RPG set in a world of swords and sorcery, told entirely through the medium of cards. The story follows a self proclaimed hero as they set off to slay a recently awakened dragon, presented in the manner of a tabletop RPG and playing out through narration from the gamesmaster.

title: Sheep Quest
description: An atmospheric frustration platformer. Overcome obstacles in your struggle against wolf-kind.

title: Shifter's Box: Outside In
description: Sally is taking a walk outside one fine day when she comes across a strange box. Curious as to who would leave such a strange box lying around, she opens it - only to find herself in a very strange place indeed. Help Sally uncover the true nature of the box and find her way home!

title: Sniper and Spotter Being Patriotic
description: A newly recruited red army soldier finds himself assigned to a new partner and the two of them soon find themselves in a series of misadventures in a war-torn soviet town...

title: Sniper and Spotter Serving the Motherland
description: Ivan and Olga, two soldiers in the red army, finds themselves tasked with preventing a small village from falling into enemy hands. Their orders are simple, destroy the bridge and poison the food and water supply before the enemy soldiers can reach the village and destroy the bridge or poison the food and water supply... Sniper and spotter serving the motherland is a standalone sequel to my previous game Sniper and spotter being patriotic.

title: Space Rangers: Episode 46 - The Devil Within
description:
You will play the part of special agent Yaz KreJonns of the Space Rangers, the organization that is called in when regular Star fleet is not enough.
This time something strange is happening on a mining planetoid. The miners has gone missing.. and then the team of soldiers sent in to find them.
In a galaxy near you, you are to boldly go where no one else dares.

title: Spaceman in Space
description: He is the Spaceman! He is in space!

title: Star Trek Newton: Part One - Anomaly
description: Crewman John Fischer is a recent graduate of Starfleet Academy assigned to the USS Newton, a Constitution-class vessel currently tasked with performing scientific surveys in Sector 004. On the completion of his first week aboard his new assignment, John begins to realize that the reality of life in Starfleet isn't all chasing hostile aliens and meeting strange cultures. In fact, it can be quite dull. No sooner does he log this gloomy summary than the ship is rattled by some unseen force that disables many of the ships systems! Isolated and unaware of what is wreaking havoc on the Newton, John must get to his duty station and help himself and his crew stabilize the ship.

title: subAtomic
description: A dysfunctional family are miniaturised in their misguided search for a holiday, thanks to the scientific minds at S.H.A.T. (Space Holidays via Accelerated Transport).

title: Submerged: LaSol
description: A short one-room escape game, which won the February 2011 MAGS by a single vote! Stan Winston, a janitor working on a luxurious man-made island resort, the LaSol, is about to have his life turned upside down, quite literally.

title: Return to Melanat
description: Return to Melanat is a King's Field fangame. Is an attempt to recreate the environments of King's Field 2 in a whole new light, while delivering an entirely new story. Like all King's Field games, its gameplay centers around exploration, methodical combat, and light puzzle solving. All seven areas of Melanat are recreated to scale using nothing but the SOM toolset and very few custom resources.

title: Sunrise Paradise
description: Getting bored of living on a campsite, a young girl sets off to find a promised city where dreams come true and everyone is blessed with eternal happiness. Will it offer a chance at a new life or a decision she'll always regret? Originally made for OROW 9.

title: Tales of Jayvin
description:
Jayvin an unlikely hero, if every there was one, stumbles into a portal and finds himself in the land of Naturnum.
Unbeknown to him, his arrival has been expected.
Evil forces, commanded by the Dark Lord, Arachemon, are wreaking havoc across the Universe.
Only Jayvin has the power to fight these forces and put an end to Arachemon's reign of terror.

title: Tarthenia
description: Debbie Johnson thought her days of adventure were over. But when an evil warlock intervenes on behalf of his cousin, Esmeralda, she is whisked away to the island of Tarthenia. A place beyond the realm of imagination; where beauty and danger go hand in hand. And in order to save not only her life, but her sister's as well, Debbie will have to use every ounce of ingenuity she possesses. Can she thwart the plans of a madman bent on revenge? Only time will tell!

title: Terror of the Vampire!
description: Featuring 8-bit graphics and MIDI music, Terror of the Vampire! takes place in the vaguely 19th century, in vaguely Eastern Europe, where a vampire menace grips the countryside! The menace of superstition and the belief that vampires exist! Join Dr. Ego Goodmind, BHD, as he does research for his newest psychology book, The Empirical Vampirical. But is he in over his incredibly big head this time?

title: 6 Day Assassin
description: The life of an assassin is not an easy one... and often not a very long one. After receiving a phone call from a distressed friend and coworker, you find yourself in a compromising situation. In order to survive, you must rely on your minimal resources, keen sense of logic, and limited number of bullets. Meow, baaaaby!

title: The Bum
description: The game tells a story of a homeless man who communicates with the world using an old sock on his right hand. He's a huge football fan and plays it a lot near his backalley. One day he gets mugged by a wandering bully and looses his precious ball in the process. Now he must pull himself together, team up with a local superhero, find a new ball and confront his oppressor again. Available in English, German & Polish

title: Tile Blocks
description: A building game where you'll use your ingenuity to help Clampy reach his destination by placing objects from your inventory. Objects have unique functionalities, so you'll need to use them strategically to complete the level.

title: G1deon: Towards God
description: G1Deon: Towards God is an adventure game with elements of quest. The game consists of 2 storylines. At first you have to play for Alan Sparks, the historian from America, who is looking for a fabulous City of Rain. The action takes place in 1979. The second you're playing for the G1Deon, painted character from the diary of Sparks, who travels to places of stories about the City of Rain.

title: The Ramen Prince
description: A Visual Novel game that chronicles the loves and tribulations of a young man who, thanks to a generous benefactor, is starting fresh in a new city and opening a new ramen restaurant.

title: Lewd Maze
description: Lewd Maze (formerly Corrupted Dungeon) is an Isometric dungeon crawler with turnbased pixel fighting part, with some nice in-battle sex. You have two main characters for now, tanned neko and elf girl.

title: Ore No Animism: Hell Chapter
description: A free Touhou-like game made in Danmakufu v0.12m with various animal characters. Gameplay revolves around score-extends by use of a screen-clearing attack charged by collecting point items via grazing / PoC. Much tougher than a typical Touhou-like game, and only has two difficulty levels. However, it features an "Another" Stage, a second kind of Extra Stage where each of the two player characters gets a unique stage, ending with a fight against the other character. Also contains ten boss special attacks, one for each character.

title: Ore no Animism: Heaven Chapter
description: Sequel to Ore no Animism, now using Danmakufu ph3. Features strange gameplay based around purchasing upgrades and bombs in real time. Significantly easier than the first game, and introduces a full set of four difficulties. Also introduces two more player characters, originally bosses from the previous game. Boss special attacks are called "Works" here. Contains ten boss Works for the ten new characters, but these must be unlocked by completing certain tasks.

title: Ore no Animism: Resurrection Chapter
description: Third game in the series. Centers around filling a temperature gauge by staying alive and generally playing well; as it rises, enemies become more dangerous, but more points are rewarded for collecting items and clearing boss special attacks, now called "Tricks". A new type of special attack, the "Ignite Shot", is introduced to allow the player to decrease this gauge. Features four playable characters (including bosses from the previous game). Also contains eight Challenge Tricks for the eight new characters, but these must be unlocked by capturing certain Tricks on all difficulties.

title: Farkeep
description: Farkeep is an action adventure roleplaying game heavily inspired by games such as Legend of Zelda: Link to the Past, Undertale and Hyper Light Drifter. Grab your sword and head out on an adventure in the beautiful world of Kerroan! Explore mystical forests, venture into dark temples, make friends, slay foes and solve puzzles! With a great emphasis on the roleplay, your choices affect both gameplay and story.

title: Udongein X
description: Help Reisen Udongein Inaba navigate through 14 action packed stages in this exhilarating 2D Bullet Hell Platformer based on Touhou Project!

title: Wild West Z
description: Wild West Z is the story of the Wild West, enslaved by a supernatural force and its monsters. Take part in gang warfare and battles with monsters on American soil.

title: Alchemistry
description:
Merge elements to discover new ones !

Through challenges, use the given elements to craft transitional elements to reach given objective. Or use sandbox mode to freely craft items together and maybe succeed to create rare items, and to discover everything.

title: Summoner's Mess
description:
Enter a huge manor to fix the mess you've made summoning a beast from the depths.

Look for the three sacred grimoires, hidden in a labyrinth made of rooms, closed doors and unsolved mysteries.

Will you find it before it gets too dark and you'll get consumed by the fears that we can't see?

Enjoy a short time trial experience, memorize the scenario and reach one of the three endings before your torch gets out completely!

title: Pokémon Trading Card Game Live
description: Experience the fun and strategy of the Pokémon Trading Card Game in a whole new way with Pokémon Trading Card Game Live! Build your collection of cards in the Battle Pass, and test your skills against other players from around the world in the Ranked Ladder!

title: Referee Simulator
description: A first-person soccer referee simulator will let you see how hard the job of a soccer referee is on the field.

title: Slavania
description: Fantasy metroidvania with a moral choice and hunting the bosses who are not going to patiently wait for you in their lair. Study the monsters. Track'em. Kill'em. Exploration of the vast interconnected fairytale world, an acrobatic combat system and weird locals are what awaits you.

title: Your Way
description: Your Way is a travel simulator with a conundrum element. Here you can walk through the forest and admire nature.

title: Pyro Fighters
description: Pyro Fighters is a scrolling space shooter with platforming physics. Use your flame gun to propel yourself in the air and fight through an alien army with up to four players.

title: Frog's Princess
description: This is a movie-length children's storybook. A young princess strives to save her kingdom, but a frog-prince on a quest to rescue his bodyguard overturns her plans. Rescue Iron Henry and save the kingdom of Kassel in this 2D click-through movie-length children's story. Filled with humor, strong characters, ethical questions, poignant moments, and beautiful evocative music, Frog's Princess is a story you can play again and again. Choose from 10 moods each time the prince and princess speak. Everybody saves the kingdom, some just do it in a more comical way than others.

title: Red Robin
description: There is a place that seems to be invisible, no one can find it, and no signal can be sent from it. "Red Bird", tells of a stranger with endless problems in life and work on a rainy night. Because of an accidental car accident, accidentally found a deep forest where no one knew Houses.

title: Immersys
description: Immersys is a Multiplayer Immersive NFT Metaverse. Players can participating in a vast economy built on the WAX Blockchain. Immersys has is own cryptocurrency named FATE which can be earned through gameplay. The game's equipment, land, and resources are all Non-Fungible Tokens which can be verified on the blockchain.

title: Moratheia
description: Moratheia is a King's Field-inspired game. It will take you to the land of Pelmora, a torn land where savage beasts await those who would dare explore its depths, where allies are few and trickery and temptation attempt to knock you off balance... A story so daring it will take you to some of the strangest and eeriest places imaginable, testing your resolve and commitment at every turn.

title: The Burgomaster
description: A dark plague is consuming the town. One doctor is left to learn the truth, and try to find a cure.

title: The Cadaver Synod
description: The year is 897. Pope Stephen the sixth or seventh, is holding a trial against his predecessor Formosus, and you have been chosen as Formosus defender. The thing is, you hardly know a thing about law. That's probably why Stephen chose you. This game was made for MAGS in June 2016 with the theme "Neglected Historical Eras".

title: The Dark Convergence
description:
The Dark Convergence is a very rare horror adventure game from the early '90s.

The plot is simple: one night the player and some friends have a car crash on a near-deserted road. The player is sent out to search for some help and stumbles on an abandoned house. Inside it bloody bodies are found, and unknown menaces from other worlds and other dimensions try to kill the player. Will you survive the night and save the day?

The game is programmed in QBasic (there is even the .bas file inside the game's folder) and the engine is similar to the one used in the Hugo's House of Horror series. The player controls the character with arrow keys and types the desired action using the parser.

The game focuses on a morbid atmosphere and on violence with many nasty and gory situations in it. The plot and atmosphere for some ideas are reminiscent of Dark Seed.

title: The Disgraced Prince
description: This is the story of a prince who, due to a tiny attempt to murder his own sister and usurp the throne, has been forced into exile in a remote mountain monastery. Surprising to none, something sinister dwells among this isolated group of men dressed in dark hooded cloaks. Seriously, has anyone seen a story about a rural community that DIDN'T hide something fishy?

title: The Execution of Anne Boleyn
description: Created for MAGS September 2017, for the theme "Past and Future Collide". When villains from the future alter the past, a time traveler must try to set history back on track with the help of an imprisoned queen.

title: The Frame on the Wall
description: This project was made in collaboration with Blondbraid for Mags october 2017. An old woman ends up in a small cabin in the woods a stormy night, but is everything alright with the strange old painting hung on the wall?

title: The Man From Fugue State
description: A stranger arrives in the sleepy town of Tumbleweed with no memory of his identity only to find the residents suffering at the hands of feared outlaw El Marcado, 'the marked one'. Soon he finds himself caught up in a plot to defeat the outlaw once and for all. But who is this stranger and why is the mysterious El Marcado so interested in Tumbleweed?

title: Dusk Diver 2
description: Dragon Vein is a type of special energy that spans throughout all dimensions. Kunlun is the homeland of the higher dimensional beings who have developed advanced Dragon Vein technologies. The story begins with a girl named Yang Yumo and her classmate Liu Yusha when they accidentally trespassed Youshanding and started an adventure.

title: I Love Finding Cats
description: I Love Finding Cats is a classic Hidden Object game. Explore a variety of different hidden object scenes, lots of minigame puzzles and most importantly collect all the adorable cats!

title: The Revenant Protocol
description: The Revenant Protocol is a third person shooter with hack'n slash features where you will combine your deadly blade and vicious firepower to become the apex hunter in a world mutated by an experimental technology.

title: TitTok
description: TitTok - Minimalistic adventure 2D puzzle platformer with cats, explosions and spinning saws!

title: Cubyrinth
description: Cubyrinth is a 3D puzzle game. Will you be able to navigate and find the correct solution in the labyrinth located on the 6 sides of the cube? This game will provide you with an infinite number of auto-generated 3D labyrinths!

title: The Elm Game
description: A board game for two players that is easy to learn yet hard to master, played on a stylized tree stump. The computer can substitute for a second player at any time.

title: Mud River
description: Mud River is a horizontal 2D Shoot‘em Up game. The Rio Doce (Sweet River) was a paradise for mankind and animals, but now it has become a territory destroyed by the unscrupulous activities of Dr. Wellin. This is Pacal's first destination, ascending the Rio Doce preventing its complete destruction.

title: The Long Journey to Farewell
description: An SNES style action\puzzle RPG. Help two friends caught as a queen tries to save her brother but curses him instead. Dramatic story, loveable characters, strategic action battles, amusing puzzles and a fantasy\sci-fi world to explore.

title: Gpi
description: Jump and jump to reach the goal.Play with one button.There are 5 stages and all mixed stages.Jump with timing in the direction that changes every 1 second.No thorns and no time limit, but it will be difficult to reach the goal.

title: Sorcerer Knights
description: Fight terrible enemies through a varied fantasy world.

title: ToruTaru
description: Delve into the infinitely AI-generated, ghastly haunted mansion of TORUTARU. Use talismans, maps, your wits, and the friends you make along the way to fight off the angered spirits and survive. Every playthrough is a unique experience.

title: Sword of Hypotenuse
description: Cut, squash, and headbutt other tofu ninja in this adventure searching for the truth of the Pythagoreans' Theorem! Explore various world permutations and collect rare Alogon history as you break and link different worlds to create the true Number Line.

title: One Fateful Night
description: One Fateful Night is a horror game where the player attempts to survive the night inside a scientific research base that has appeared mysteriously. The player must explore and use things they find to survive and escape.

title: Kingdom of Heroes
description: An RPG game that grows by defeating monsters to level up and making a variety of items.

title: Nuremberg: VRdict of Nations
description: A VR investigation of the crimes against humanity committed by the Nazi leaders.

title: Sokobear: Winter
description: Sokobear is the spa's maintenance bear, his job is to turn on the heating and massage system of all the natural pools in this winter spa.

title: Movers in the Warehouse
description: Movers in the Warehouse is a puzzle game about workers in a warehouse with strategy and arcade elements, made in a 2D drawn style.

title: Ball.io
description: Shoot and survive, Play with other people online.

title: Survival Zone
description: Rich levels, in-depth gameplay, and diverse turrets. In the game, you will use your turret to defend against a variety of enemies.

title: You are a slave!
description: You are a slave! is a first-person adventure. In this game you are taken into slavery. For fear of death, you decide to escape from the castle with the help of your new friend. You will need to solve puzzles and complete various tasks to escape from the castle.

title: Zakesta
description: Zakesta is a Doujin STG similar in style to Caravan STGs of the early 90s. It notably includes the use of music that utilizes vocaloid software to provide lyrics as background music.

title: Five Nights at F***boy's 3: Final Mix
description:
Springtrap embarks on the most thrilling night of debauchery yet...

Five Nights at F***boy’s 3 is a FNaF fangame developed by Sable Lynn and Joshua Shaw. It is the climactic sequel to Five Nights at F***boy's and Five Nights at F***boy's 2.
Featuring multiple scenarios, a complex and intuitive battle system, a plethora of enemies, and loads of secrets!

title: Quizee
description: Quizee is a Trivia based party game that can be played locally with friends, or online with a Twitch community! If you're a streamer on Twitch, then get your community involved! Link the game with your Twitch chat, and your community can type their answers to the questions to compete to see who is the smartest in your community! If you want to play with your friends, hook up gamepads and play locally!

title: Endless Blue
description: Endless Blue is a classic survival horror adventure set in a mysterious underwater research facility.

title: Super Mega Baseball 2: El Viejo Stadium
description: Take a step back in time with the classical grandstand design and vibrant cityscape of historic El Viejo Stadium. This DLC gets you El Viejo Stadium, an additional ballpark for Super Mega Baseball 2.

title: Super Huey 1 & 2 Airdrop
description: In 1985, Cosmi stunned the gaming world with the first helicopter flight simulator for the Commodore 64, then followed it up with an amazing sequel. Now, the original groundbreaking series returns together in one package! Pilot an experimental helicopter in these groundbreaking 8-bit sims.

title: Sixtieth Kilometer: Eightieth Kilometer
description: The pink for disappeared about a year ago. The world had changed forever. We no longer lived – we survived.What happened to the world and the characters you love - find out after the end of the Sixtieth Kilometer.

title: Island Saver: Fantasy Island
description: Suit up as a Bionaut and explore the Floating Islands in a bright mythical adventure. Use your trash blaster to help save bankimals like minotaurs, dragons, unicorns, and other creatures, and use your money sense to get Rainbow Cat’s smoothie business back on track—while you ride a magical unicorn, glide on a dragon, and collect golden eggs to grow a giant beanstalk.

title: Death Crown: Era of Human
description: Learn the King’s story, clear the primitive lands of evil and unite humanity in a new campaign of the Death Crown.

title: Elios VR
description: In a virtual reality space with a fantasy background, three basic classes (warrior, wizard, archer) raid giant boss monsters. MMORPG VR game content that allows you to perform special role missions with a special class called Ghost (Ghost) if you fall into spirit escape during battle with a boss.

title: B-17 Squadron
description: Take control of a B-17 in a realistic bomber simulator. Destroy key targets by dropping tons of bombs on them. Command each member of the crew and feel their stress and tension. Take part in the historical campaign across occupied Europe.

title: Mineirinho Director's Cut: Mineirinho Hoversurf DC
description: A new adventure of Miner, you will surf a lot and have a lot of radical adrenaline, a casual third person game with a lot of emotion.

title: Slime Pandemic TD
description: Defend the galaxy against a slimey pandemic in this classic Tower Defence game. Choose what towers you want to

title: Solar Sails
description: Solar Sails is a satirical space pirates adventure game. Take control of a 17th-century pirate ship, upgrade it with powerful alien technologies, and sail onwards to plunder a galaxy full of treasures and mysteries.

title: Premier Manager 04/05
description: You’ll experience all the emotions of football management in Premier Manager 2004-2005. Find out if you’ve got what it takes…

title: Hover Ship
description: Hover Ship is an arcade game in which you have to control a floating ship on an obstacle course, collect coins and set new records.

title: Sakura Knight 3
description: Estelle's adventures in the land of Lemuria come to a head in this yuri fantasy visual novel. Estelle faces a fierce challenge in the form of the wicked dragonkin Saga, all while deciding which member of her party she wants to pledge her to heart to. It's hard to fight evil and fall in love!

title: Eight-Minute Empire: Mountains
description: Scouts inform that new lands are full of mountains. Control most important valleys and hills gives you best position in the final battle. Build mountain city to increase your influence. Natives settlers and builders might help you, so collect goods and save money to pay them.

title: Eight-Minute Empire: Archipelago of Azra Map
description: The recently discovered Islands of Azra are full of rare animal species and new opportunity for factions looking to expand their influence on the seas. Change of the rules for this map: For a coin you can upgrade the basic troop movement to water movement.

title: Regions of Ruin: Sieges
description:
Do you want more Regions of Ruin? Did you feel you wanted to add Siege mechanics to the game? New characters, companions, and loot? Then this is your DLC!

Introducing the Regions of Ruin Sieges DLC which includes :
- 7 New siege event areas
- 2 New mercenary types for hire
- New building (Training Ground)
- Loads'o'loot
- Greatly upgrade companions
- Repeatedly challenge yourself with sieges to earn unending loot and rewards
- Hire new companions to help in the fray and from afar

title: Be a Maid in the Demon World: The Secret Cafe of the Demon Angel Hero
description: The protagonist who Reincarnated to the Demon World became a black mascot, in order to restore his original appearance. Use the knowledge of the "different world" to transform the little devil's tavern into a maid cafe, and aim for the first maid cafe in the demon world!

title: Soda Crisis
description: Soda Crisis is a fast-paced side-scrolling shooter game. You play a mysterious character of unknown origin, equipped with advanced high-tech gears and fierce combating skills - definitely the chosen one for this rescue mission!

title: Lingering
description: An LGBTQ+ Mystery Visual Novel with comic panel style aesthetics and pixel styled backgrounds. Join The Heart Breachers operatives as they navigate the world of desire, treachery, and emotional turmoil while learning to understand lofty concepts such as friendship, hope, and belief in oneself.

title: alt:V
description: alt:V is a free alternative multiplayer client for GTA:V. It provides perfect synchronization on custom dedicated servers. Play with your friends and make your own game modes with JS, C# and much more.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 2 - Season 8
description: Chapter 2: Season 8, is the eighteenth season in Fortnite: Battle Royale that started on September 13th, 2021 and finished on December 4th, 2021. It's themed around the Cubes that fell on the island after the Alien Mothership was destroyed and is title Cubed.

title: Tint n Ink
description:
Tint n Ink is a first person shooter videogame about Paintball, fight & hit your rivals and get fun everytime.

Find strategies, use the best techniques and create amazing tactics to destroy your opponents.

title: Battle Craze!!
description: Battle Craze follows the events of the Battle Craze Tournament Series, a martial arts competition that takes place every five years, with the best of the world willing to compete. Although, something else draws those to this tournament. A hidden threat? The promise of wealth? Scores to be settled? For Ajit Sinha, he's here to save the world from a foreseen destruction only known to him, and nothing will stop him.

title: All the Way Down
description: A Lovecraftian adventure set in rural Yorkshire, England.

title: Him
description:
In the music galaxy, a prince awaits an attack from outsiders.

Thousands of spaceships entered the galaxy to mine what does not belong to them! Him is a third person casual game where the player runs and jump between home planets to destroy the invading space pirates and their spaceships under a limited time before they mine the lands.

You will have the option to choose between different instruments. Each instrument represent a different shooting style for the player. Choose carefully which shooting style you want to play with based on what goals you want to accomplish.

title: The Ever-Beginning Tale
description: You find yourself in a strange new world and now you must find your way back home!

title: Slash Quest
description: In this game you'll have to manage limited controls and help a courageous little knight swing (and stumble) his evergrowing sword to victory. Created for a ludum dare with the "two button controls" and "growing" themes.

title: The McCarthy Chronicles: Episode 1
description:
A film-noir inspired, supernatural detective story.

Rick McCarthy is a private detective marred by a secretive and destructive past.

He is pulled into a world of blood sacrifice and invocation.

Can he hide his past, solve the crime and get the girl?

title: Jeebo & Jerbo vs. Life
description: An indie Metroidvania/JRPG that is heavily story-based about a goo creature who hates his job and his lazy cousin

title: QField
description: Fast paced multiplayer FPS / TPS arena soccer-shooter offering tight and frenetic matches in beautiful arena environments.

title: CityBeat: The Sorority Shuffle
description: Adult Interactive Fiction. Tasked by the chief editor of the Scandals Section, you must put your wits and cunning to work to break a story about sex, secrets, and corruption.

title: Perseverance: Part 2
description: Perseverance is a horror/crime thriller visual novel. Play as Karen, a calculated assassin, and witness the gripping story of secrets, passion, and violence.

title: Closer: Anagnorisis
description: Closer: Anagnorisis is a game with distinctive art and gameplay. It contains a lot of creative designs. Here you will feel the spiritual experience.

title: Antadin DX
description: A dark jrpg with tough choices that change the story. You play as the last of the antadins, the protector of the queen of your colony. You have to traverse bleak, corrupted caverns, inhabitated by a myriad of different insects. Trying to protect your ward.

title: Sapphire Safari
description: Answer the call of the wild with Sapphire Safari, an open-world Photography Adventure Game! Capture the beauty of real-life Monster Girls in their natural habitats, use tools to lure them into more erotic poses, and become intimate with them if you are brave enough...

title: Ally Gory: The Great Mushroom Hunt
description: "Ally Gory: The Great Mushroom Hunt" by Fortuitous Development, LLC. is a top-down action-adventure game where you collect objects, solve puzzles, and fight monsters across over 25 story-driven levels.

title: Stellaren II
description: A space sci-fi visual novel in post-apocalyptic worldCombines a unique visual novel experience with multiple mini-games!Travel across multiple locations across space and meet a diverse set of interesting characters.

title: Ninja Hanrei
description: Ninja Hanrei is a 2D run and gun Platformer game inspired on Ancient Japan but with Super Powers.

title: Fantasy Heroes 2
description: Follow the adventures of mentalist Valentin and princess knight Anais, caught up in a race against time to stop a deadly virus. Who's behind the disease? Can your heroes find a cure and save the world? Play Fantasy Heroes 2 and find out!

title: Retro Run
description: Retro run will put you in the sneakers of the runner Neon. You platform and swing your way over to get the precious Runner energy drink!

title: Onmyoji in the Otherworld: Sayaka's Story
description: Turn-based combat & erotic sex! Along with her childhood friend Haru and a talking furball (rabbit?) god, Sayaka lives a peaceful life, but when an earthquake strikes, aggressive spirits suddenly appear and her world is torn apart.

title: Blood and Zombies
description: Blood and Zombies is a thrilling first-person shooter with horror elements and lots of zombies. You need to withstand as many waves of zombies as possible, by building up defenses and heavy weapons, using a large amount of guns.

title: Merge Chess
description: A brand new approach to Chess!

title: Meow'n'Dash
description: Meow 'n' Dash is a tiny, highly-addictive and fast paced arcade game. Play as one of the adorable kittens and clear stages by turning all the yarn balls to the same color by pushing them against each other.

title: Cherry Blossom Fleet
description: cherry blossom fleet is a 2D shooting game set in the Japanese Navy of World War II.

title: Kaya Joshi: Magical Detective
description: Kaya Joshi: Magical Detective is a family friendly Hidden Object Adventure. The game blends Hidden Object game play with Adventure gameplay.

title: Combat Casino
description: Do you have what it takes to survive the Combat Casino?

title: Charlie: The Legend
description: Equip yourself with the best weapons and get ready to face your worst fears... Charlie: The Legend aspires to become a must have for all those who enjoy multiplayer horror games. Charlie is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror video game in which 4 Survivors must face a diabolical doll possessed by a demon. It's up to you! Play as Charlie and defeat the other players or take on Charlie as a survivor.

title: My Friendly Neighborhood
description: Something is amiss with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show! For years, the colorful cast of The Friendly Neighborhood delighted audiences across the globe with their cooky capers and educational adventures. However, as time went on and interest waned, the production studio found themselves out of money and closed their doors for good. Toy sales would dwindle, and birthday balloons and cakes would find new mascots. In time, the once household names would fade into increasingly niche fandoms. Until one night years later, the studio unexpectedly clicks back to life and starts broadcasting The Friendly Neighborhood. TV sets across the globe flicker for a moment before the familiar puppets return for a surprise encore! But this isn't your typical family-friendly holiday special... are those puppets eating each other!?

title: Turbo Overkill
description: Johnny Turbo needs to clean up Paradise, a cyber city overrun by augmented minions under the cult control of the world's most advanced AI, Syn, who's looking to expand to world domination if not stopped here and now. Wall-running, Hero-Time, chain saw leg augments, flying cars and lots of booms. Fight to purge Syn with five new augments, dual chainsaw arms and a second chainsaw leg in the final episode, part 1.

title: Halloween is Crazy as Hell
description: Halloween is Crazy as Hell is a roguelike and bullet hell game, where you can have weapons that are completely different from each other with different special abilities, as well as items and little friends that will help you on your journey.

title: Cold Scream
description: Survival Horror Text Adventure

title: The Madness of Roland
description: Interactive novel and audiobook with FMV cutscenes that adapts the epic poem Orlando Furioso about medieval French king Charlemagne's heroic paladin Roland who falls tragically in love with sorceress Angelica and loses his mind.

title: Last Resort
description: Last Resort is an arcade shoot 'em up video game by SNK released in 1992.

title: Shoal
description: Hungry for shark games? Start fishing! Go fish for food as a hungry shark swimming in a shoal of fish.

title: Vectors
description: Avoid obstacles and reach the end of each level by controlling the direction of Vectors. Can you manage your actions without going off the tangent?

title: BooM
description: You can't play BooM... Boom plays you!

title: ColorCube
description: A first-person 3D puzzle game. Objects of the same color cannot collide with each other, and you're no exception. But not only you can change the color of yourself, but also you can change the color of other objects with a wand. This game has 43 levels. It takes about an hour to pass.

title: Sentry
description: Become a SENTRY. SENTRY is a stylish minimalistic twin-stick shooter with silky smooth controls where your only goal is to eliminate the hostile invaders.

title: Gravel: King of Buggies
description: Off-road vehicles par excellence, the daredevil Buggies join the race with their quick and nimble handling. Gravel Channel now includes a new Off-road Masters episode where you can put yourself to the test.

title: Gravel: Ice and Fire
description: Gravel Channel lands in Iceland, where it has created a new Off-road Masters episode and new breathtaking Cross Country races. Snow and ice will be your travel companions, from the cold beach to the slopes of an active volcano.

title: The Book of Yorle: Save the Kingdom
description: In the final chapter of The Book of Yorle, you must Save the Kingdom and banish the Evil Ones forever! Battle your way through Castle, a hidden Pirate Ship, and Caverns to find the secret lair of the Evil Ones. Complete your book with one of two unique endings - one is only possible if you own all 4 DLCs.

title: Azy
description: Destroy enemies and bosses using a variety of weapons. Visit different times and places with unique enemies. Inspired by classic games from the of 90s genre.

title: Move Forward
description: Move Forward is an atmospheric adventure in the inner world with unique and diverse levels and interesting mechanics!

title: Rise of Three Kingdoms
description: Rise Of Kingdoms is a game with features that connected with strategies and turn-based system. It is also mixed with real historical events and monarchs that appeared in the history.

title: Zombie Alert
description: Zombie Alert is a survival game. Survive by hunting zombies, build your own territory, capture cities and collect items - whether alone or with your friends!

title: Keylogger
description: Each person’s family name in the Continuum is given a debt which they must pay back, or they risk being wiped by the Grid.

title: September 12th: A Toy World
description:
September 12th is a serious game with a political statement about the USA's War on Terror which started after September 11th 2001.

In the game, the player is presented with a Middle Eastern market place in a top-down isometric view. Walking around the market and the surrounding buildings are innocent civilians - men, women, children, and dogs. There also several terrorist walking among them.

All the player can do is scroll the camera and fire missiles. Missiles will impact on the exact location of the targeting reticule, but with a small delay. Killing a terrorist will remove the terrorist from play. If another civilian encounters his or her body, the civilian will burst into an emotional display and become determined to go on a jihad and thus also become a terrorist. The more civilians you kill the more terrorists come into play.

Buildings also get destroyed when hit by the rather large blast radius of the player's missiles. Civilians surrounding collapsing buildings also die. After a long period of waiting buildings will also slowly be reconstructed again. Terrorists will after a while cool down and become normal civilians again, but a small number of terrorists will always remain terrorists.

title: Rubicon
description: Rubicon is a local multiplayer split-screen party shooter inside an omnidirectional puzzle cube, an action-packed PvP game show where every round has a powerful new weapon and each battle adds a zany new twist.

title: Incarnatia
description: This Japanese game is a fusion of art and games in one place. It involves the 20th century painter Salvador Dali. With his own interpretation, CG artist Shimo Hirokazu has his mysterious art world rebuilt into a three-dimensional world.

title: Charge Champs
description: Charge Champs is a 2D platform fighter with a unique combat system where players charge their character to temporarily unlock abilities and gain an advantage over their opponents.

title: How to Survive: El Diablo Islands - Host
description: Download this DLC and venture onto a new set of volcanic Islands: discover new fauna and characters, learn to craft fantastic tools and weapons taking advantage of the different weather effects to face the most surprising enemies.

title: Marcella Moon: Secret on the Hill
description: Follow amateur sleuth Marcella Moon to Ireland to investigate the disappearance of a famous writer.

title: Family Quiz
description: Running out of questions to use during your weekly family video chat quiz night? Look no further...Family Quiz does exactly what name suggests....a quiz for all the family.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch Renovation: Day Stage
description: You can play the Day stage. It is a very difficult stage, so it is recommended to play after all stages have been completed.

title: Neon Abyss: Alter Ego
description: Take on the New Gods with a series of Alter Egos for your Characters.

title: Pirate Island
description: A survival game on an island in the middle of the ocean. Collect items, cut down trees, mine stones, and build structures with them. Defend yourself against enemies who want to kill you. The difficulty of the enemies increases over time, so build the island properly.

title: Brain Off
description: Brain Off is a game of hide and seek and catch up on the net. Here a brave hunter tries to catch cunning zombies that hide behind objects and use unique abilities to escape and confuse the hunter. You are welcome to the world of fun and zombies!

title: Enga Extreme Battle Race
description: Time to battle race

title: Virtual World Primus
description: A virtual world Primus with different cultures and worldviews. At Primus, you can enjoy a life different from the real world. Why don't you come to the virtual world Primus for new encounters and unknown experiences that you really wanted to do? This game is an open world walking simulator.

title: Sweet Dream
description: Sweet Dream is an English fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 3. You play as Shurui Shian, a boy who is trying to find happiness through his dreams.

title: Kinda Heroes
description: Side-View & Scroll RPG made with love!

title: Escape From Woomera
description: Escape from Woomera is an unfinished point-and-click adventure video game, intended to criticise the treatment of mandatorily detained asylum seekers in Australia as well as the Australian government's attempt to impose a media blackout on the detention centres.

title: Panic Station
description: After exploring the new planet, the space crew became infected with an unknown virus. After a long epidemic, the space station plunged into chaos. Various mutations took place with the crew of the ship, which clouded their minds. Make your way to the rescue shuttle through the mysterious danger.

title: 7th Sector: Museum
description: You have the opportunity to wander through the gloomy halls of the 7th Sector museum.

title: Dawn of Andromeda: Subterfuge
description: Subterfuge offers a whole new dimension to playing Dawn of Andromeda. The 2 new races, new gameplay mechanics (espionage, planetary projects and fuel range) as well as lots of other new content, add hours of replayability!

title: Quantum Rush Champions: Jump Start Tournament
description: This DLC contains the campaign "Jump Start Tournament" of the Early Access version. It is accessible to all 3 racer manufacturers and offers 5 tiers with many challenges, boss fights and unlocks, which are available only in this DLC!

title: Robots, Death & Venice
description: Defeat the Robot Mafia in a dystopian Venice in this thrilling shooting game. Join Fio Bucceri, a former secret agent now turned into a bounty hunter seeking revenge of the Robot Mafia.

title: Scrap Bringer
description: A Stylish & Intense Twin-Stick... Puncher! Wake up in an alleyway and get into the scrap of your life as you explore the streets of a gritty/cartoony megacity.

title: Camper Renovator
description: Build your dream RV in this incredibly detailed and highly realistic simulation game. Find classic, unique campers, busses, minivans or caravans. Restore them, give them a new look and bring them back to life!

title: Simple Story: Alex - Two Guys
description: This is a new story content. This DLC will tell you the story of of two minor characters from the main game, and how they appeared on the deserted and snowy islands.

title: Tomb Raider: Shanty Town
description: Shanty Town Multiplayer Map: This ramshackle area features steep climbs, multiple ziplines for quick escapes, and deadly traps to set for your enemies (multiplayer map).

title: Darkest Dungeon: The Butcher's Circus
description: The Circus is in town, and the Butcher demands a show! Assemble teams of 4 heroes and compete in the ring in brutal, unforgiving PvP combat against friend and foe. Climb the ranks and show off your prestige while blowing off steam while taking a break from assaulting the Darkest Dungeon below.

title: Beyond Solar
description: Beyond Solar is a bullet hell / SHMUP pixel art game. You play the protagonist “Gravity” a space ship pilot who grew up in the space colony “ARD”, humanity last hope and shelter as planet Earth was on the brink of extinction.

title: Stardrytch
description: Stardrytch is a challenging action-platformer set in a lost world where sci-fi and fantasy collide. Embark on a dangerous journey, discover a forgotten land, unlock mighty powers and battle terrifying monsters to find a way home.

title: Clouds No More
description: This game is a reversed platformer. In the sense that your goal is not to jump on platforms, but to avoid them. In this world you are going to fall. And then die. And then fall again. Faster.

title: The Trolley Problem Game
description: The Trolley Problem Game creates has over 500 different interpretations of The Trolley Problem for the player to solve!

title: Destroy Geometric Shapes
description: Imagine yourself throwing balls to destroy geometric shapes like cubes, triangles, lozenges and hexagons. The big problem is, you need to find the perfect trajectory of the balls for them destroy everything at once. But you are persistent and this is your challenge from now on, can you do it?

title: Jude
description: Explore the deep metroidvania world of Jude as you jump, collect, run for survival, and mentally build strategies to uncover the mysteries behind creation and purpose. Explore through the forests to the the dark side of the bayou and more as you are challenged to open the doors and find answers.

title: Last Days of Lazarus
description: After their mother's suicide, Lazarus returns home to his sister Lyudmila. But unexplained events make the world and even reality collapse around him. Looming death, a spreading malediction and the supernatural threaten his sanity, yet Lazarus pushes forward to find the truth about his family.

title: The Spirit
description: The Spirit is a simple Action RPG with elements of old school dungeon crawlers. Creatures and Demons are entering through the Rift. The people of the realm need you, but so does your family.

title: MindGym
description: MindGym is a surreal game about creative thinking.

title: Medicinal Herbs: Cannabis Grow Simulator
description: Do you have a green thumb and always wanted to grow Cannabis? With Medicinal Herbs you can virtually simulate the cultivation. Make the finest medical Cannabis for your patients. From simple cellars to professional cultivation, everything is possible.

title: Crazy Fun Ball
description: Competitive Platformer

title: Curse of the Deadwood
description: In this action-packed fantasy adventure game, prepare to embark on a fantastical journey as Lathe and Roguard. The gameplay is a unique evolution of the twin-stick genre. You control both characters at once, making simultaneous ranged and melee attacks a core element of the game's thrilling combat.

title: Carma
description: Out drive your friends in fast, arcade-style vehicle combat, using power-ups, killstreaks, and the environment to smash your foes! Battle across a miniature world, avoiding dangers and earning the gods favour to level up and unlock a wide range of customisables to help you stand out from the crowd.

title: Duo Defenders
description: Cute and cooperative tower defense game where you and your partner must reload towers with ammunition together.

title: Kyoki
description: Kyoki takes the concept of original goal board games and makes it more fun to play every day. Kyoki is a three mode board sport. In Kyoki the aim of the game is to clear the play area of all the coloured tiles.

title: Offroad Racing on Line
description: Drift, slide, skid! Offroad Racing Online is the isometric 3D perspective car racing game that makes racing funnier than ever.

title: Goblin Takes No Argument[s]
description: In this retro style tower defence, we have created a short experience for all of you seeking a true Atari-like experience.

title: Dungeons of Dredmor: Conquest of the Wizardlands
description: Deep within the pocket dimensions of the Wizardlands, the mighty Wizardkings plunge their hands greedily into their stashes of magical wizarding booze, desperately searching for more mana. Their time has passed, and they have faded into the drunken myths of obscurity.

title: Ostalgie: The Berlin Wall - Legacy of Hoxha
description: The world is changing, but Albania is not. The covenants of Enver Hoxha are honored with all responsibility and authority. But how long will this last in the world of the end of the Cold War? Albanian Gorbachev, Islamic socialism or still aligned to Hoxha? So many ways... And the choice is in your hands.

title: Viking Idle
description: Breathtaking Dual Prestige System Idle Clicker of Doom and Darkness!

title: Story of a Tiny Earth: The Symbolic Ages
description: Deliciously retro ! Spherical and labyrinthine levels full of traps and mysteries, with actions, puzzles and strategies. Find your own way, escaping malicious opponents and defending biodiversity !

title: Splendor: The Strongholds
description: In Splendor: The Strongholds, you build strongholds to reserve cards and block your opponents, or destroy those of other players to slow their progress. Discover an entirely new way to play Splendor's strategic scenarios in this expansion!

title: On Pixels: A Lights Out Game
description: Turn on the lights and light up your life! This game is a variation of the "Lights Out" games of the 90s. Each light you turn on changes the state of the adjacent lights. Can you turn on all the lights?

title: Outsp4ce
description: Our tiny green triangle tries to destroy enemies in the shape of red circles that are approaching our world by shooting them.

title: Me vs. You
description: You play a normal Match3 game but this time, you can actually battle others. Attack them directly, weaken them, buff yourself, manipulate the board to your liking or to your enemies disliking. Prove that you are better than anyone else on the battlefield.

title: Kujlevka
description: A flying saucer crash-lands in a distant Russian village, turning a rundown kolkhoz into the first, thin bridge between civilizations. As the first point of contact, you must dictate how this encounter unfolds and ultimately determine history’s outcome.

title: Into the Timeverse
description: Into the Timeverse is a hard non forgiving action platformer game. Into the Timeverse is a constant"runner" game that you need to match your color to the appropriate color of the enemy platforms. Expect to die a lot in this game.

title: Virtual Rehab Art 4 Health
description: VR designed for awe and rehab. The experience combines virtual art, technology, and rehabilitation. When we, in reality, are contained to our home or hospital room. We can in the VR experience wonder in redwoodforest or oceanscapes. A remarkable intersection between art, pain relief, and exercise.

title: Knuckers Test Fight
description: Knuckers Test Fight is a couch fighting game with funny characters, cute costumes, various weapons, tricky levels, and mini-games.

title: War Theatre: Blood of Winter - Beak and Talon
description: Add Gaten, the Crow Knight, and Vincenzo, the Doctor, to your roster! This DLC includes single-player campaigns for Gaten and Vincenzo, and unlocks both characters permanently for use in multiplayer.

title: Boinihi: The Ki Codex
description: Visit the moon of Boïnihi. An exiled Talifan hermit has left a mysterious Codex for his future visitors. A new scifi episode in the Black Cube series, this time inspired by the famous Voynich manuscript.

title: Super Dream Dasher
description: Dash and roll through a charming world in this fast-paced, momentum-based, fun-filled platformer! Uncover the mysteries surrounding the destruction of this peaceful planet and leave no tasty turnUp behind!

title: Goblin.Life
description: Imagination with friends. Forge playable 3D worlds in real time, script them with astral Glyphs, and fill them with adorable Goblins.

title: Eclipse
description: Eclipse is a new survival horror experience that combines modern horror with classic horror elements. Drawing inspiration from classic horror games, Eclipse delivers a new and fresh take on survival horror.

title: Mission Idle
description: Mission Idle is an idle game where your main focus is to grind for levels gold and other riches that will allow you to move further in the zone stages. Mission Idle is played by being AFK. Most of the mechanics in the game are automated.

title: A Sad Journey
description: A wonderful third-person adventure game about a rabbit looking for his missing parents. In this journey you will search for Paws that will take you to special places where you will get your memories back.

title: Cassius
description: Cassius is a first-person story-driven puzzle game exploring the mysteries of Blackhaven Hall, a sprawling historically accurate colonial estate evacuated at the height of the American Revolution. Journey back to the 1781 and decode the dark secrets lurking behind America's founding.

title: Synthwave Hop
description: Synthwave Hop, a hardcore game made for people who enjoy a challenge, and speed running. A game where time is your friend and your enemy. No complicated story, just speed and frustration. Can you be the fastest runner?

title: Sheriff Rage
description: Sheriff on guard for the defense of Oldstone city against extraterrestrial forces

title: Champoo Club
description: Champoo Club is a challenging action game with arena fighting, involving sword, missile and cute characters.

title: The Little Drone 2
description: You are a little drone sent to investigate a debris field on the edge of Dark Space in a lost world behind the Bermuda Triangle, that seems to be caught in some kind of state of flux. You must collect all Data Nodes lost there so that their data can be retrieved by your makers back in Cloud Space.

title: Turbo Machines Mini Racing
description: Drift, slide, skid ! Turbo Machines Mini Racing let you drive 14 cars on 18 tracks, single, local mutiplayer or on line multiplayer.

title: 3D Math: Ultra
description: 3D Math: Ultra is both simple and complex challenges!

title: Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim 2
description: The apocalypse is in full swing! Date Elder Gods, win back the Dreamlands - and all of reality as you know it - in this cosmic horror-comedy RPG.

title: Timore Redo
description: Timore Redo is a psychological horror game about sadness.

title: Dragon's Tower
description: An old-style pixel 2D platformer who becomes an apprentice swordsman, confronts dragons and rescues princesses. You can easily enjoy your adventure with simple operations such as jumping and dashing attacks. Enjoy the world of charming enemy characters, items that grow apprentice swordsmen, and a simple and nostalgic game world.

title: A World Abandoned
description: Explore an abandoned planet, find upgrades, build your character and reveal the truth about what happened to the planet and its people.

title: Ouroboros Dungeon
description: All the pleasure from the 90's Action RPGs put into a quirky infinite procedural dungeon. Explore, find treasures, loot and clear hallways from enemies within.

title: Dros
description:
Discover the world of Dros, a beautifully detailed story-driven adventure about a slimy little creature and her human bounty hunter shell.

Little Dros and Captain both have different strengths and weaknesses and you’ll switch between them to solve puzzles, fight off enemies and sneak through a vast steampunk Tower.

The world of Dros features a fantasy story with a huge cast of odd and interesting characters to interact with. Unravel the mysteries within the Tower as you explore, unlock journal entries and collect strange alchemical treasures.

title: Secrets of Magic 3: Happy Halloween
description: Dive in this spooky adventure through a magical land and help Victoria make the best Halloween display the School of Magic has ever seen! Match your way through charms and challenges in this phantasmal Match 3 game.

title: Cyber Manhunt: Home Sweet Home
description: Behind this seemingly sweet and happy family, everyone has their own secrets, what is the truth hidden behind?!

title: Assignment 42
description: You’re the new CONTROLLER.The AI know that, and they’ll probably tease you, the machine derps. Don’t be concerned, though. The instant there’s an assignment on the projector, they are ready to follow their program. Every literal command you set.

title: Red Tether
description: Red Tether is an action-packed "combat-puzzle" roguelite. You will tear apart massive space fleets, using nothing but your advanced tether harpoons. Pull and crash ships into another, rip their components off, then grapple-swing your way out of danger.

title: Halloween Night Mahjong 2
description: A Halloween atmosphere in every level! Ready to fight a mighty sorceress! Complete 120 unique levels of Mahjong!

title: Cute Lady
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Massage Salon Story: Spring Breeze
description: Customers of all personalities are waiting for you here. You can tempt your customers with different massage techniques and positions to satisfy their desires. Of course, it is important to work hard to earn money. So Work hard and enjoy the life!

title: Beautiful Girls
description: Relaxing puzzle game with beautiful girls

title: FartPart
description: Fart Part-Arcade game with toilet humor will not let you get bored. Resorting to the sharpness of the mind and the reaction of the mongoose, you must press the button at the right moment and spew out extra gases from the hero, which will give him the right push and add speed to further flight.

title: Ultra Resort Keroncuel
description: Ultra Resort Keroncuel is an exploration-oriented FMV adventure game. The player is transported to a fantastic space resort and given free reign to explore and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. There is only a light story and some gentle puzzles; the focus is on exploration and relaxation instead of problem-solving.

title: Solenars Edge II: Champions
description: Create your character, pick your ally and assemble a powerful team of over 70 champions. Fight your way through the VR Arena and become the greatest champion of the entire universe.

title: Divinity: Original Sin II - Definitive Edition: Companion - Sir Lora the Squirrel
description: Sir Lora is a squirrel fleeing the Knights of Drey - an apocalyptic order of furry knights who believe in the coming of the Great Acorn. He’ll join you in Fort Joy (along with his undead cat mount).

title: Hunting Simulator 2: A Ranger's Life
description: In this new scripted campaign, join Dexter in his daily duties as a forest ranger.

title: Beat the Nightmare: Evil Dreams Simulator VR
description: One day, your life changed completely – going to sleep has become something you dread. You get a horrible nightmare every time. The only way to stop them is to find an exit out of each. 17 unique horror dreams and terrifying experiences are waiting for you. Dreams have no limits...

title: Game-Kun: Input Challenge
description: Game-Kun: Input Challenge is a reaction-based hiscore mini game. Test your reflexes and input skills with your gamepad. Unlock skins and other characters to enhance the fun! Can you reach the final level and compete for the ultimate hiscore?

title: Lo-Fi Lounge
description: A lounge for meeting others and vibing out to live Lofi and Retrowave.

title: Touhou Big Big Battle: Yuyuko's Food-hunting Adventure
description: Touhou Big Big Battle:Yuyuko's Food-Hunting Adventure: Adventure Mode Expansion

title: Partisans 1941: Back Into Battle
description: Fighting the invaders is like fighting a hydra: you cut off one head, and in its place two new ones immediately grow. But that’s no reason to give up! Return to the Eastern Front in this DLC featuring customizable scenarios, new maps and a new game mode!

title: Super Mario Bros. S: Road to Infinity
description: Run as far as you can in an infinitely-generating level! Collect coins and moons to buy powerups such as the iconic fire flower and ice flower and the custom blade star, and defeat both familiar and custom enemies to earn more time. As you run, you'll face increasingly dangerous foes and obstacles, so be prepared!

title: Traphouse Druglord
description: A drug dealer simulator. Deal with paying rent. Buying supplies. Police, rival gangs trying to rob you, while buying and making drugs to sell them and fund this plan to get to paradise.

title: 12 is Better than 6: The Apostles
description:
The DLC on the main story of "12 is Better than 6" is right around the corner!
Meet 3 new characters with their own story campaigns and different gameplay: Bill Watt, Indian Warrior and Slippery Pitt.

title: VR Black Hole Travel Hypothesis
description: In this VR Black Hole Travel Hypothesis game, you can have an immersive experience to travel through a black hole. What kind of unknown world did you reach after crossing? Start your adventure.

title: Airport Simulator 3: Day & Night
description: The airport is a place that never sleeps. With departures, arrivals and the continuous hustle and bustle of passengers, there is rarely an opportunity for a break.

title: Asteroid Five
description: Asteroid Five is a first person space exploration game where you investigate the inner caves of an asteroid passing by your planet. Aboard your ship, dive into the deeps of the asteroid, collecting information and samples of the many beautiful minerals and lifeforms who call this place home. Perhaps, somewhere you can even discover remains of an ancient intelligent species long forgotten.

title: Leman
description: A bloodthirsty, high fantasy, turn-based combat, open-world RPG! Light on story, this game is about deadly tactical combat and developing a legendary adventuring party!

title: Run! Grandpa! Run!
description: Just another boring day in the hospital? Not on your watch! Take on the role of Grandpa, grab your best slippers and embark on an epic race for freedom in a rocket-powered wheelchair.

title: League of Angels: Heaven's Fury
description: League of Angels: Heaven's Fury is a revolutionary 3D online action RPG that takes place in a fantastical world loosely based on Western mythology.

title: Chickenman
description: Be Chickenman and punch those sheep! Old fashioned arcady fun!

title: Clanfolk
description: Clanfolk is a medieval colony sim set in the Scottish Highlands. Harness your environment to survive - fish, gather, hunt, and farm as you prepare for the harsh winter. Build an inn, trade with other clans, have children and marry them off - live life and prosper across the generations.

title: Christmas Movie Bingo
description: Prepare to take your Christmas movie night to the next level of fun with Chrismas Movie Bingo. See if you can spot enough Chrismas film tropes to get 5-in-a-row!

title: Academy of Magic: Lair of the Beast
description: Join the young magician Dennis and his freinds in this magical match-3 game, to save a kidnapped student from a monstrous beast.

title: Stolen Eggs
description: Stolen Eggs is a Top Down 2D game. In the person of a mercenary, you need to save an endangered species, and return the last eggs to their parents. Go around the planets and collect eggs, just be careful, your ship does not always want to wait for the end of the collection.

title: Amnon's Beginning
description: A battle that commends for the mind, will the mind be successful or unsuccessful in maintaining it's stability? Build your settlement and fight off the invader of this spiritual realm with real-time strategy.

title: Naughty Memories: Asian Beauty
description: Enjoy the classic card match gameplay with high quality, realistic, sexy girls gone wild! This new series of Naughty Memories features a new theme with the hottest Asians.

title: Ungeon
description: Fight your way through a cursed dungeon filled to the brim with undead enemies in hopes of finding your lost father, or at least your way out. Ungeon is a randomly generated dungeon crawler with a large focus on combat and exploration.

title: Find the Cubs
description: In Find the Cubs you need to find your 5 cubs! They are hidden around the maps. The calm music helps you find the cubs.

title: Narcissu: Zero
description: This is a story about two kids growing up. About the wall between those leaving, and those left behind. It is about the origins of the Seventh Floor hospice. And finally, the origins of "the rules".

title: It's Not About the End
description: It's Not About the End is a short story inspired by David Wehle's game Home is Where One Starts. While recalling good memories of your childhood, explore the map in search of parts for the car that was left by a loved one for you.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki I KAI - Thors Military Academy 1204
description:
The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki role-playing game series is highly acclaimed by gamers all over the world for its elaborate character portrayals and epic storyline. The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki and The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II have sold over 1 million copies in total.
The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki I: Kai: Thors Military Academy 1204 is a remastered version of the series' iconic first installment, including all-new features!
The game also features the popular high-speed Skip Mode from the PlayStation4 version. With the touch of a button, you can jump between events and fields at twice the normal speed, and battles at four times the normal speed!

Tension is raising in the militaristic Erebonian Empire due to the conflict between the Nobel and Reformist Factions.
A dramatic busy student life awaits for members in special Class VII—established by the renowned Thors Military Academy—and Rean who is chosen as the new member!

title: Eliminate Drips
description: A brainstorming game relax you.

title: Unlock the Cat
description: You need to move all the stones which prevent the little kitten.

title: Polaris Sector: Lumens
description: The Lumens expansion pack will bring brand new features to the overall game, like new race-specific sciences, ships role assignment and updated planets properties, for an enhanced gameplay experience!

title: Feudalia
description: Feudalia is a deck building and resource card game. Discover how to be a feudal lord and manage the new territories of the kingdom with the help of your vassals. A fun card game that will make you the master of three fiefdoms, make them grow by taking advantage of your card skills.

title: Seditionis: Tower Defense
description: Seditionis - Tower Defense is a sci-fi based infinite TD game with 190+ upgrades to make your gameplay, units, and towers more powerful. 4 tiers of towers in each line, with 20 upgrade levels each. An introductory story gives you a sense of what you're fighting for. After all, this galaxy needs you.

title: Yolka
description: A Game inspired in the saga souls, with an open world to explore and some animals to hunt.

title: Tankocracy
description: Tankocracy is a tank tactical Top-Down shooter inspired by games like Desert Strike and Battletech on Mega Drive. You'll lead your mercenary company to the success by completing hardcore contracts.

title: Ascendum
description: Help 2 twin vessels on their journey through the afterlife! Overcome platforming and mind-bending puzzle challenges, and defeat scary enemies and bosses while controlling both characters at the same time or working together with another player in local Co-op.

title: Gods of the Twilight
description: Cyberpunk Ragnarök in visual novel form! Gods of the Twilight is a multi-season episodic visual novel that puts you in the shoes of two reincarnated gods facing a pending apocalypse. Decide how to handle the supernatural and human organizations that each have their own plans for you, while ancient truths about you and your companions start to resurface.

title: Librarian
description: The Librarian will take you on an epic adventure!

title: A Story of Merchant
description: A Story of Merchant is a 2D side-scrolling, Action-RPG, Set in an The old Town of Ayotha.

title: Pathfinder 08
description: Pathfinder 08 is a fun and challenging adventure. It is a platform game with a focus on exploration and retro inspiration with some RPG elements.

title: Corsairs Legacy
description: Corsairs Legacy is an open-world RPG pirate game in which you will immerse yourself in a perilous adventure. Solve the conflict in Barbados, being in the heart of intrigue, open up to new adventures and become a thunderstorm of the archipelago!

title: Bullet Wave
