description: Bullet Wave is a driving first-person shooter straight out of the 90s. Go to the space station to fight against hordes of zombies, combat drones and infernal evil spirits.

title: Aeon's End: The Nameless
description: The Nameless expansion includes 2 new nemeses to defeat, 1 new breach mage, as well as new gems, relics, and spells for the market.

title: Light Pursuer
description: The map will be displayed only when there is light, otherwise it will be dark and the player can only go to the place with light. The player can push the lighthouse to illuminate other parts of the map, so as to explore different parts of the map.

title: Battle Arena VR
description: Battle Arena VR is a multiplayer arena shooter, where you are automatically matched with opponents. Challenge yourself, challenge everyone in a deathmatch Battle Arena!

title: Button Lock
description: Navigate through a series of intricate—or possibly incredibly simple—mazes. But beware, as you are only given a certain number of moves to work with. You must make the most of your surroundings and discover unconventional pathways in order to proceed in this head-scratching puzzle game.

title: Life of Trophy
description: This work explores the current achievement culture in a humorous way.A variety of game modes, including role-playing, shooting, etc., and can freely choose the order of play, achieve multiple game endings, and experience various platform achievement systems.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Night Road: Usurpers and Outcasts
description: "Usurpers and Outcasts" unlocks the options to play as Tremere and Caitiff.

title: Rogueslide
description: Swiping puzzle meets dungeon-crawler in Rogueslide, a casual strategy game for desktop and mobile.

title: In Marte: The First Moon
description: In the game on Mars, Dom wakes up in a ship without knowing very well where he is, nor why he is there, much less where his body ended up. Help Dom find answers and have fun in this mind-blowing adventure.

title: Theogony: Crystal Water Blue
description: A monster taming game crossed with tactical grid based combat and open exploration.

title: Henry Stickmin: Completing the Mission
description: Completing the Mission is 3x bigger than Fleeing the Complex and features 16 Endings and 164 Fails!

title: The Witch Doctor
description: Lua is a Witch Doctor, a mutated magician that helps those in need, though they only repay her with disdain and prejudice. As one of the last of her kind, Lua finds out a fellow magician has evil plans to ressurrect the Gigantos, she takes it upon herself to stop the rogue magician.

title: Revolution Diabolique
description: Unlock diabolical magic in the time of Napoleon and Robespierre! Can you direct the course of the Revolution, or will you lose your head?

title: Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?
description: Players take on the role of gumshoe and explore the globe tracking down crafty criminals through guided tours of various locales and beautifully painted 360-degree panoramas. The player must use their knowledge to find Carmen Sandiego or any of her innumerable henchmen, all with the help of a searchable database within the game that contains: video clips; essays on each area's economics, politics and culture; maps; and photographs.

title: Furries & Scalies: Super Scary Halloween Spooky Times Part II
description: Manage a Halloween store. Maybe destroy Christmas. It's all up for grabs in this light Halloween Store Simulator.

title: Starmind
description: Kill it. Take its gun. Rinse and repeat. WARNING: You will die. A lot. Probably. This 2D Retro shooter is about as hard as it can get, but repetition and good luck will cut though everything like warm cheese. This game grows with the community, and more bosses will challenge you in the future.

title: Epejsodion Dodgeball Attack
description: Time to hit the parquet! Epejsodion Dodgeball is a sports game, where YOU can lead over 100 powerful teams to victory! Play an extensive singleplayer campaign, hone your skills, then beat your friends!

title: Soldier Warfare
description: Action shooter game with tactical combat and realistic gameplay experence.

title: Franky the Bumwalker: Reborn
description: Franky the Bumwalker: Reborn is an adventure game featuring quirky hero traveling in unique and fun world.

title: Radio Commander: Squad Management
description: Get closer to your men and make the Vietnam War even more personal. Learn your subordinates' stories and backgrounds from an illustrated glossary. Keep your men alive so they gain experience, perks and awards, that influence your platoons' stats. Promote, enlist and discharge.

title: Time Travel Shanty
description: Jump back and forth through time to explore maze-like ruins, dodge the attacks of undead guardians, loot their treasures and defeat tough bosses in this top-down, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer.

title: Golden Boy
description: Golden Boy is a 2D platformer packed with monsters and everyone's favorite gold. You need to help the boy collect all the gold in the levels, as well as get rid of annoying bubbles and bats. Sleight of hand and more!

title: Heavy Metal Babes
description: Heavy Metal Babes is a turn-based RPG strategy game featuring classic mechanics infused with steamy H-Scenes and an engaging action-packed gameplay. Build your team of hot XEN units, command them into battle and defeat your opponents!

title: Spirit of Europe: Origins
description: An edutainment jRPG experience, spanning from ancient Greece to the 12th century European Renaissance, brimming with historically-accurate characters and events, experienced through two realms: of spirits, thoughts and emotions, and the material world.

title: Centurion Rex
description: Command legions of dinosaur-riding roman riflemen in this historically accurate RTS.

title: WC
description: Hospital. Today, a lot of visitors. Among them there is a small boy with a bladder problem. Suddenly, he longed to the toilet. The main thing is not to be mistaken the door.

title: Zerone
description: Zerone is a PC-based high-quality VR game, and it is a Hyper FPS game that competes with the enemy units of the mechanic series.

title: Snow Fighters
description:
This is the Nintendo Switch version of “Snow Fighters” on sale on Steam.

It features a simple yet profound system that creates Yukidama and beats the opponent.
Aim for victory by operating all 6 characters with different stats and special moves!
New stages, new characters, and story modes will be added to the Nintendo Switch version!

title: Sphere Invasion
description: Sphere Invasion is Sci-Fi Tower Defence. Build your own road and defend it with 7 unique towers.

title: Poison Noir: Desire, Time & Gangsters
description: Animated Visual Novel in which you follow Jake through his romantic and student life evolution, making decisions that will impact how the story ends. This game has content unsuitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

title: 80's Night
description: Endless road, neon lights, palm trees. The game immerses you in the atmosphere of the 80's. Welcome to 80's Night! 80's Night is a car simulator game in which you drive along the endless road and avoid other cars.

title: Sea Dogs: To Each His Own - The Final Lesson
description: This pack of six new adventures tells a story of captain de Maure's first months in the Caribbean. New World has new rules and those who want to conquer it must learn it's final lesson.

title: Welcome to Graystone
description: Welcome to Graystone! Once believed to be the human race's next home, you are left alone after an asteroid hits the planet. Survive in an open-world environment, unfit for humans. Few resources remain, and must be rationed to survive. Will you band together, or fight to the survive?

title: Eisenbahn X: Berliner S-Bahn
description: The DB class 481/482 is an elektric railcar designed for conductor rail operation used by the S-Bahn Berlin. It's the latest design for the S-Bahn Berlin and currently the version that is used most.

title: Wirewalk
description: In the not so distant future, with the advancement of virtual reality and the internet of things, a powerful computer virus capable of infecting any digital system is causing chaos throughout the city. Control Rada, a regular programmer who loves baseball, roller skating and going to the bar. Uninvited, she builds a software called The Wirewalker, capable of hacking any infected digital device at the Wired.

title: Master Boy
description: "Master Boy" is a happy-paced cartoon casual role-playing game with Chinese cuisine as the theme. Players can accept tasks in charming urban areas, help friends defend farm and beach, exterminate invaders and collect ingredients to get rewards and improve their own attributes. Just enjoy it.

title: Age of ILCoin VR: Retribution
description: Age of ILCoin VR: Retribution is a virtual reality game set in a futuristic sci-fi action setting where the ultimate treasure is ILCoins (ILCs). You will become “The Miner” and your mission will be to earn and protect your coins from the space aliens pirates.

title: Hamster Logic 3D
description: Think hard and use your hamster logic to solve the geometric puzzles in this fun and fluffy game!

title: Knell of St. Godhrkar
description: In this game, you can watch as 7 protagonists come to a crossroad, facing their own destiny. You will witness their own choices and the blood-splattering consequence they have on one another. There is no way out except to plunge them into the abyss...

title: Karma: The Dark World
description: This is a first-person story-driven psychological horror game. Delve into this dark and strange world with an investigation officer from Roam to find traces of lost memories and fulfill your destiny.

title: Ravished Realms
description: You've been invited! Follow your classmates in this Visual Novel as they show you around the VR MMORP everyone's been talking about! The only problem? Nina may not be able to handle how attractive her party is!

title: Fire Survival
description: This game is a combination of first person, roguelite random elements and adventure decryption elements of survival games. You play as a normal person who is traped in a randomly generated fire hazard. To survive the hazard, you need to be resourceful. Use items found in the random world.

title: Ancient Gods
description: Ancient Gods is a fusion of gacha and deck-building rogue-lite where you collect your character, fight, and experience exciting events. Any character can use all the cards, combine them with the character's passive for ultimate power on your exploration.

title: OnlyGame: Athlete Girls
description: Relax class puzzle game to keep you in a good mood with sexy girls.

title: Succubus Hotel
description: Due to a poker game, the powerful succubus Carmilla is close to losing her precious hotel. Now, you need to Follow her life trying to Collect Fragments of Desire from humans, at the same time she teaches Corina, a young Neko maid, how to be slut. Can you do that before the 31st day?

title: Premier Manager 02/03
description: Indulge in pan-European fantasy football by taking control of any club from the four English divisions, or simultaneously from the top two divisions of the continent’s premier leagues (Spain, Italy, France and Germany).

title: HighQ Quiz
description: A simple quiz game with multiple ways to play. Simple and fun

title: FirstQueen1 Next
description: Battlefield with Many Enemies and Allies. Your soldiers will fight or retreat in battle using their own discretion. You watch over the actions of your troops and can either move characters that are in danger to safety or send a strong character to help defeat enemies and lead your army to victory.

title: Sea Dogs: To Each His Own - Flying the Jolly Roger
description: In this expansion you will learn what it truly means to be a pirate! Make friends with the most wanted criminals of the Caribbean, plunder cities, make a name for yourself, face a people's avanger and pay an ultimate price for all your crimes!

title: Lockdown VR: Kidnapped
description: Backpacking was all fun and enjoyable, until you and your friends hitchhiked a ride to your next destination. Will this be your final destination? Alone or with up to 6 players, explore, gather clues, and escape before its too late!

title: Starry Knight
description: Walk in Van Gogh’s paintings. Fight with the struggle that he went through in his life. Unveil the destiny of the starry, starry knight.Starry Knight is a 2D boss rush game focusing on unique boss design and hardcore action combat.

title: Ancient Souls: Starship Renata
description: Race against the time and obstacles. Hunt enemy ships. Make ground missions and vaporize your enemies with your battle droid. Improve your crew members to reach success. Rise in rank and unlock new Corvette and Frigate class ships. Buy new items and unlock new quests.

title: Mezmeratu
description: A Platform-Hell adventure but with some ROGUE stuff! Discover a new world from the creator of Baobabs Mausoleum, full of surrealistic horror villages, stinky talking characters, impossible rogue platforms and... and a giant fish kidnapped inside an owl's beak. Welcome to Prosciutto Misa!

title: BAL Solid
description: A Relaxing Ball Physic Puzzle Game

title: Detective Notes: Lighthouse Mystery Solitaire
description: Solve a baffling case! Experience the story together with the characters!

title: The Mistral Report
description: An espionage-themed turn-based RPG in which an agent must track down a rival agent hunting down their employees by infiltrating the hideouts of their rival's connections.

title: Disney Classic Games Collection
description:
The Expanded Collection - Play through multiple different versions of the beloved Aladdin, The Lion King, and The Jungle Book games that have been created over the years, including both console and handheld versions. This incredible combination makes this the best edition yet of Disney Classic Games
BOTH 16-Bit Console Aladdin Games included for the first time since their original release. By popular demand, two completely different and equally adored Aladdin games are finally available and enhanced for modern consoles. Which Aladdin game is YOUR favorite?

Disney Classic Games Collection is the latest and greatest compilation of classic Disney games based on some of the most beloved Disney movies of all time: Aladdin, The Lion King, and now, The Jungle Book!

Now you can play ALL of the critically acclaimed 16-Bit console versions of “Aladdin”, along with classic games based on Disney’s “The Jungle Book”! These all-new, fan-requested, and beloved games complete this collection, making this the only way to experience all 16-bit console versions of Aladdin and The Jungle Book.

Play as some of your favorite Disney characters, including Aladdin, Simba, and Mowgli, all while experiencing some of the best graphics the 16-Bit era had to offer. Play through multiple versions of each included game and enjoy tons of new features, enhancements, game modes, easy game saves, and display options.

Disney Classic Games Collection: The Jungle Book, Aladdin, and The Lion King include:

- Disney's Aladdin: SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Sega Mega Drive
- Disney's Aladdin - Final Cut: Sega Mega Drive
- Disney's Aladdin - Demo Version: Sega Mega Drive
- Disney's Aladdin - Japanese Version: Sega Mega Drive
- Disney The Lion King: SNES, Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega Mega Drive
- Disney The Lion King - Japanese Version: Sega Mega Drive
- Disney The Jungle Book: SNES, Game Boy, Sega Mega Drive

title: Gamble Tower
description: Embark on a high-stakes journey in our roguelite deckbuilder! A place where every decision is a gamble, risk and reward intertwine to shape your odds. Delve into a dark fantasy world brought to life through mesmerizing 2D hand-painted art, where wacky characters and unpredictable challenges await.

title: Mission Sunlight
description: Mission Sunlight is an educational adventure game that presents paintings by Vincent Van Gogh reconstructed in full real-time 3D.

title: Curse Crackers: For Whom the Belle Toils
description: Curse Crackers is a fast-paced acrobatic platformer where you bounce, vault, and fight your way through a whimsical world with the help of your loyal companion. Eat snacks, collect items, and travel the world to stop Bonnie and her band of troublemakers!

title: 3D Realms Anthology
description:
Come get the deal of the decade with the 3D Realms Anthology.

With 32 classic titles - which is almost every Apogee and 3D Realms game ever released - and a re-rockestrated soundtrack by Interceptor Entertainment's Andrew Hulshult (Rise of the Triad, Duke Nukem 3D: Reloaded, Brutal Doom), the 3D Realms Anthology is your chance to kick ass in the past for an absolutely killer price.

Get your copy of the 3D Realms Anthology before December 31st, 2015. The Anthology will be discontinued in 2016 and will never again be available in this form. This is your last chance to grab a piece of gaming history and at a strongly reduced price for the rest of the year!

title: DodgeBlock
description:
Experience the terror of rocks falling on a poor mail-man's head, while just trying to do his job.
DodgeBlock is a color text based game in which the player tries to dodge falling Blocks by moving left and right. Usually, the whole game is controlled from the arrow keys. In Normal Mode, collect Bonus Points to get +50 score. Wanna play with a friend? Invite your friend to play on WSAD with Two Player Mode! The half-cooperative dual play version of DodgeBlock. Sadly DodgeBlock is programmed in C# .net framework, so it only works on Microsoft Windows and Android.

title: Misty Hollow
description: Misty Hollow is a monster-themed visual novel that focuses on love, friendship, and mental health.

title: Double Romance
description: Somehow you've ended up in an alternate universe where Santa is an actual postal worker and where bad tofu gets put in jail. It seems you've arrived just in time to take part in a dating game show hosted by a two-inch tall cream puff. You're the main contestant, and your potential dates appear to be human, but they're a little weird. It's your chance to question, court, and maybe even insult your way to true love and find out who is your best match!

title: Monster Hunter Rise + Sunbreak
description: Experience Monster Hunter Rise and its massive expansion Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak in one convenient set!

title: Actraiser Renaissance
description: Heaven, earth and mankind - create and destroy everything according to your will! Experience the revival of the 90's classic hit Actraiser. Actraiser Renaissance combines 2D platforming action (Realm Acts) with a City-building simulation (Realm Management) in the ultimate battle between good and evil! Help humanity flourish by playing as the Lord of Light and their loyal angel in a world beset by evil.

title: Touken Ranbu Warriors
description: Touken Ranbu Warriors is an action console game for Nintendo Switch and PC via DMM Game Player.

title: 1000 Deaths
description: 1000 Deaths is a 3D adventure platformer about interpersonal conflicts and the effects of the media. Play fast-paced episodes and discover wildly different endings with each play through. Switch perspectives from a pool of eclectic characters, making decisions that you'll take with you to the grave.

title: Bruv
description: Bruv is a work-in-progress parkour based first person shooter, but you're a tea cup.

title: Danny Fisher Kills the Government
description: Danny Fisher Kills the Government is a satirical political video game, taking the player through the journey of Danny Fisher, as he and a party of local New Yorkers foster community, tussle with the NYPD, girl-bosses, CEOs, and Mayor de Blasio himself.

title: Dot's Home
description:
Dot's Home is a single player game about Dorothea (Dot) Hawkins, a young Black woman in her late 20’s living with her grandmother Mavis Hawkins in Detroit, Michigan. Following a cryptic conversation with her grandmother, Dot receives a mysterious key. This key allows Dot to open a door within her house and travel to another space in time within her own family history.

In order to return home, Dot finds that she must interact with and influence her family members to make important life decisions in order to receive a key back to her present, but Dot soon finds out that her journey to the past is steadily affecting her current reality…as well as the potential future.

title: Emergency Monster Team
description: Nadel is a Berserker Paramedic who is headed back to work after the events of the "Pipe Man" took place in the monster city of Dendsville. The city is on high alert, so the hospital director has asked her to work inside for the evening. She’s tasked with helping the staff and patients.

title: Sugar's Delight
description:
When Ichigo’s parents realize their daughter’s dream is to own and run a bakery they do everything they can to force her away from such a career and toward a more prestigious calling. However, in a fit of determination and frustration, Ichigo moves out and on her own with the desire to prove just how serious she is about her sweet passion.

After a brief amount of time, Ichigo stumbles upon Sugar’s Delight; a small bakery owned by the somewhat oblivious, but mature and incredibly kind “Chocoa”. In no time at all, Ichigo is working her dream job and learning everything there is to know about running a bakery, and things hardly seem like they could get any better…

That is, until Ichigo begins obtaining more than just lessons about how to bake the most delicious of strawberry cakes. Chocoa eventually begins making advances on the naïve Ichigo, and the only aspect of the newest ingredient in the young woman’s life that she’s apprehensive about is how much she doesn’t mind the older girl’s touch!

title: Slow Living With Princess
description: Slow Living With Princesss is an RPG adventure game. Gideon Ragnason has been discharged from the Hero's party because he was not "strong enough". Since then, he has retired from the front lines of the battle and changed his name to Red. Now he opens an apothecary in the frontier called Zoltan and hopes to have a happy slow living life style.

title: Lovecraft's Untold Stories 2
description: Lovecraft's Untold Stories 2 is the continuation of the action RPG with rogue-like elements based on the HP Lovecraft Mythos. Brand new dark comic graphic style, an advanced crafting system to create your equipment, 6 playable characters, and, for the first time, an online cooperative mode.

title: Powernaut 2
description: Powernaut 2 - A tough retro style platformer! Using a variety of weapons and special powers, you must fight through an unending series of levels! Each one is randomly generated so you'll never have the same experience twice!

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Dungeons & Dragons is a fan-made beat 'em up based on the animated series of the same name.

title: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
description: The Bookwalker is a narrative adventure where you play as Etienne Quist, a writer-turned-thief with the ability to dive into books. Use your powers to traverse reality and book worlds, and track and retrieve famous items like Thor's Hammer and the Excalibur in exchange for your creative freedom.

title: RLLL: Tower of Choices
description: RLLL: Tower of Choices blends party-based RPG, deck-building, and roguelite elements. Roll dice to move, make choices that matter, and build your perfect party through class advancement and companion recruitment. Discover powerful synergies between artifacts and skills with each new run.

title: Super Chicken Jumper
description: A spy-chicken tries to save the world from doom in this runner/shooter game that has a little bit of everything with a touch of chicken and anime girls on top. Run for your life in 6 different worlds and shoot your way through tons of enemies until you become a legend.

title: Putzgrila: Mestre dos Esportes
description:
Putzgrila is a sports trivia game created by journalist Milton Neves, developed by Banana Kelly Softwares, and published by Brasoft. It features more than 1.500 questions about motor racing, basketball, soccer, tennis, and volleyball.

The goal is to become a master of sports but be careful not to screw up because the Rooster will always be watching you and will not forgive any serious fouls. Got a mess in the midfield? You can count on the help of the fans, or maybe the officials can also give you a hand.

title: Fangs
description: Fangs is a free-to-play 4v4 Action MOBA currently in Early Access. Developed by Hidden Leaf Games, an international studio led by veteran developers from League of Legends, PUBG, VALORANT, Teamfight Tactics, and more.

title: Lisa the Vegaful
description: Lisa the Vegaful is a fangame of Lisa the Painful/Joyful set in eastern Olathe before the events of Joyful. Jerry Cracker, a gang member working for the beautiful warlord Vega Van Damn.

title: Lisa: The Bashful
description: Lisa: The Bashful is a short game inspired by Lisa: The Painful.

title: Sleepless Night
description: Your nightmare haunts you every night, but... are they really nightmares? You better survive them!

title: Das Überleben: Dem Großen Sprung
description:
Skydiving is dangerous, especially when the flight path is full of obstacles. Survival lets you put your skydiving skills to the test.

Das Überleben is a multiplayer skydiving game, with 8-bit retro graphics. The story is that you've gone skydiving, but your plans have gone horribly wrong!

This means you have to skydive through lots of obstacles, trying to reach your landing point. Your plans have gone so wrong, that you may be skydiving through a mine, a molten volcano, or even Star Wars' Death Star!

Controls are via keyboard, mouse or gamepad, and if you have enough controllers, can handle up to seven players! There are lots of options, which is pretty cool: difficulty settings, spin settings (which can be very disorientating!), multiplayer fighting and more. The sound is limited to rushing wind and a little ambient noise, like rain on the tree level. for such a simple game, it's quite engrossing and hypnotic.

Das Überleben is also quite hard! The levels seem to be randomly generated so you can't learn them, and you really have to concentrate to stop yourself from being splattered into a wall. However, the random levels give you more longevity along with the difficulty settings and the insane spinning effect! Collected rings increase your speed as you dive.

You can invite up to six other players to pop by on a split screen, pushing them away to be the solo survivor!

Das Überleben is an atmospheric and exciting retro looking game, great for solo and multi-player games alike.

title: Blossom Tales 2: The Minotaur Prince
description:
The Minotaur King has returned...and it's all your fault! Lily's back for a new "classic" action-adventure set hundreds of years after The Sleeping King!

Grandpa’s latest tale takes you on a journey through haunted forests, pirate shores, and other mysterious lands across a vast open-world! Charming towns, terrible enemies, tricky puzzles, and powerful weapons await you.

Enjoy a “story within a story” as Grandpa narrates exciting moments throughout Lily’s incredible adventure.

Will you help Lily defeat the Minotaur King and save her brother?

title: Lisa: Is Fearless
description: It's a short parody fangame of Lisa: The Painful.

title: Ena: Dream BBQ
description: Experience surreal environments and inexplicable characters as ENA in a new wild world.

title: Mosaic Hearts
description:
EVERY enemy is a (potential) new best friend!
Fight each boss, gain them as an ally, explore, and platform your way through each level. Build a strong group that can take down the final boss, Noel Weisburg.

title: Night Out
description: Night Out is a cooperative online multiplayer action puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. With both a online mode and solo mode, this game will deliver smiles and laughs...

title: Donkey Kong Country: The Trilogy
description: Donkey Kong Country: The Trilogy is a fan game made by André Productions. The game is a reimagining of the original Donkey Kong Country trilogy, with the same art style made popular by Rare. It has 40 newly designed stages and a new game mechanics not present in the original trilogy, like the rocket from Donkey Kong Country Returns.

title: Netherworld: Beyond Time I Stand
description:
An exciting new action and adventure game, NetherWorld Beyond Time I Stand involves complex quests, dangerous battles and occasionally baffling liaisons. Encounter numerous objects that contain special attributes and capabilities that are scattered throughout the game.

Control up to four characters and use their unique abilities to fight a wide assortment of creatures through 10 visually stunning environments. Amanda, also called the Vessel, can swap forms and use other characters’ abilities; Instinct is a power warrior and a master of close combat; Shadow can move easily through the underworld undetected; and Corruption is a long-range expert and very strong against ranged attacks.

Make your way through the underworld where lies are currency and deception is a way of life while losing yourself in this compelling, richly detailed and atmospheric gaming experience.

title: Punch the Stool John
description: You are John. You hate stools. You need to punch the stool John. PUNCH. THE. STOOL.

title: Orange Salvifique
description: "Orange Salvifique" is a very particular French interactive film. It is also a creation with a real artistic and intellectual work. In this game, you will follow the journeys of a man with a strange temperament, made more or less crazy by a failed marriage. You will discover his story through the eyes of several characters surrounding him.

title: City of Broken Dreamers: Book One
description: City of Broken Dreamers is a mature, adults-only cyberpunk visual novel. In the game, you will find a choice-based, visually erotic and exciting adventure.

title: Carpoon
description: What happens when you fuse a harpoon gun to a tow truck? Twin-stick car harpooning arcade party action! Harpoon and reel cars in, then tow them into the recycling crusher before time runs out and while watching out for other hazards.

title: Feign
description: Feign is a role-playing game with maximum 12 players that takes place in a small town where innocents, imposters and neutrals together. You use your role at night to win and send a person from the village in the morning.

title: Arran: The Book of Heroes
description: Arran: The Book of Heroes is an action TopDown Hack & Slash cooperative multiplayer game, set in a fantasy world where mighty heroes rise and fight hordes of enemies to restore peace in a war ravaged land.

title: Total Rendition
description: A first-person immersive sim/action role-playing game set in the dark underbelly of the Dutch seaside resort of Noordwijk aan Zee. There is a high degree of interactivity, giving players the opportunity to devise a variety of ingenious solutions to any problem encountered.

title: Super Otamatone
description: Basically you shoot red bois, that's it.

title: The Adventures of Bryan Scott
description: 2D point & click adventure, that combines classic elements from games like "Broken Sword" and "Deponia".

title: Thetan Arena
description: Thetan Arena is an e-sport game based on Blockchain technology. You can gather your friends, form a team, battle with others and earn money with just your skills. Thetan Arena's gameplay is designed to revolve around the combination of your personal skills and teamwork. Challenge yourself with various game modes: MOBA & Battle Royale, coming with monthly updates and attractive rewards.

title: Tall Poppy
description: Tall Poppy is a fun-house horror experience where you must find your wife's purse and a way off the church property before the prankster ghost gets you!!

title: Quant
description: Quant is a colorful adventure game, that will teach you Quantum Physics! Follow Atom, in the quest for independence. Guided by Professor Svobodan Randov, he will uncover his Quantum powers, and free himself from the oppressing world!

title: The King of Fighters XV: Deluxe Edition
description:
The King of Fighters XV, is the fifteenth installment of The King of Fighters series. Transcend beyond your limits with KOF XV! Classic popular characters, heroes and villains revived from the dead, new challengers, and more!

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Base game
- KOF XV DLC Characters "Team 1"
- KOF XV DLC Characters "Team 2"
- KOF XV DLC Costume "Garou: MotW Terry"
- Digital Edition Exclusive Bonus
- KOF XV DLC Costume "Classic Leona"

title: Kate: Collateral Damage
description: You are Kate, a deadly assassin on a quest for revenge against the Yakuza crime boss that lethally poisoned you. Battle your way through the Tokyo criminal underground in this time-attack, action roguelike inspired by the Netflix film!

title: Chorus: Day One Edition
description:
Take control of Nara, once the Circle's deadliest warrior, now their most wanted fugitive, on a quest to destroy the dark cult that created her. Unlock devastating weapons and mind-bending abilities in Chorus, a true evolution of the space-combat shooter. Along with Forsaken, her sentient starfighter, explore ancient temples, engage in exhilarating zero-g combat, and venture beyond our waking reality.

Chorus: Day One Edition includes a copy of the base game and the Elder Armor Skin Set. Resplendent in gold and purple livery, reserved only for the most exalted members of the Circle, the Elder Armor harks back to Nara's military past. This cosmetic pack can be applied to Forsaken as well as all three of the starting weapons; the Gatling Gun, Missile Launcher and Laser Cannon.

title: Gear.Club Unlimited 2: Ultimate Edition
description: Drive legendary vehicles in a huge environment with rich & diverse landscapes with remastered graphics for an enhanced experience! Manage your garage and make it your space! Admire your collection of racing cars acquired along your races. Gear Club Unlimited 2 offers more than 50 licensed vehicles from some of the world’s most prestigious manufacturers.

title: Megaman Sprite Christmas
description: A mini sequel to Megaman Sprite Game, in this “RPG Game”, Megaman journeys to the North Pole, and discovers the true awful meaning of christmas!

title: ArrowBall
description: ArrowBall is a fast-paced Arrow-Sports game where you use explosive arrows and acrobatics to outmaneuver your opponents and control the ball. Engage in 1v1 or 2v2 local multiplayer battles across a variety of unique Stages. Run, jump, slow time, build up your Super Bar, and unleash your Super...

title: Burnin' Rubber
description:
The myth, the legend,.. It is here! The very first Burnin' Rubber!
See where it all started and how it evolved from one of our first racing games to the series it is now. Are you ready to experience the first Burnin' Rubber ever?

title: Burnin' Rubber 2
description:
Burnin' Rubber 2 is the sequel to the first game and is the second installment in the Burnin' Rubber series which was released on October 7, 2008.

In Burnin' Rubber 2, the players race their way into five different types of maps and fifteen levels to unlock new races and new cars.

Players will have to collect enough points from collectibles around the map and/or score by beating the race in a low amount of time, or winning the race with the car in good condition.

An upcoming standalone version is supposed to release in the future.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club: Purist Mod
description: A fanmade mod that turns Doki Doki Literature Club into a traditional VN/dating-sim

title: Forgotten Chain
description:
ForgottenChain is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) set in a player-driven mysterious fantasy universe, the action takes place within three rival kingdoms (Xaetha, Taria, Drakary). The project offers players an immersive in-game environment with four playable character classes (Knight, Assassin, Warlock, Mage) and countless spells, abilities, and environments.

Get a champion, choose a kingdom to fight for, and set out into the mysterious world with your weapon, your mount, and your pet to prove your worth in the action-packed combat system by defeating monsters, bosses, and other players, or explore the world as a peaceful forager of goods and rares, establishing a reputation as a skilled refiner, miner, fisher, and craftsman.

In-game NFTs are obtained via rare monster drops and in-game events. ForgottenChain's NFTs aren't like the conventional "collectible card" NFTs that are so popular in crypto nowadays. Instead, they're useful and functioning NFTs that can be put into the Game Framework and turned into unique in-game objects. These NFTs can be purchased or sold in-game (auction houses, player marketplaces) as well as via third-party NFT exchanges outside of the game world.

title: Neurocracy
description:
Solve a murder in a near future world by diving into the Wikipedia of that world.

Have you ever lost yourself in a Wikipedia rabbit hole? Imagine doing that for the Wikipedia of the year 2049. This is Neurocracy, an interactive narrative experience that offers an anthology of compelling sci-fi stories inside and between the hyperlinked articles of an online encyclopedia. It is both a single-player alternate reality game and an epistolary hypertext novel, opening with a high-profile assassination that you must investigate and solve.

Playing out entirely on a website with no download required, Neurocracy invites you to go it alone or join forces with others to piece together what has happened, and what is happening, in the world of 2049. Using the narrative power of your imagination, chase implications and interpretations by reading between the lines and arranging a story from a deeper pool of potential stories. Find clues, draw connections, compare notes, and ultimately solve a murder.

title: Toree 2
description: Toree 2 is the sequel to Toree 3D. A bite-sized 3D Platformer sequel with more focus on the things people enjoyed in the first game like fast gameplay, flow focused levels and cute costumes (two this time).

title: Damocles Gaze
description: 12 minutes to gaze into your soul and go as deep as you can into its landscape - just how far will you go? What will you find? Damocles Gaze is a radically tight roguelite top-down shooter where every run takes 12 minutes. No matter how many times you die, no matter how good or bad you are, the run ends only after the 720 seconds went out.

title: Wonderful Everyday: Down the Rabbit-Hole
description:
What will you do when the last sky comes? The story follows a group of Tokyo high school students through a mystery revolving around a prophecy about the end of the world and they try to find their own "Wonderful Everyday".

Wonderful Everyday: Down the Rabbit-Hole is a visual novel with multiple routes which develops a story based on a few concepts: "the sky and the world", "the beginning and the end", "literature and science", "savior and hero", "brother and sister".

title: Road to Morrow
description: Road to Morrow is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game set in a near future Europe devastated by the effects of climate change. Explore this new normal through Iris, a girl whose memory was erased by an unknown event and must survive working for a company that controls everything. Travel around different countries created in a unique art style that bring together 2D and 3D graphics. Complete your tasks and reveal all the secrets of a world which is closer that you think.

title: Aspire: Ina's Tale
description: Aspire: Ina's Tale is a 2D, adventure puzzle game. Set out on a fantastical adventure as Ina and take a journey of self-discovery against the backdrop of dazzling, mystical landscapes of The Tower. Experience her fear turn to conviction as she unravels her purpose in this world and embarks on a one-way path to freedom.

title: In the Valley of Death
description: In the Valley of Death features a unique set of mechanics where the player controls Red and Blue, each character having their set of abilities, as they fight their way through colored enemies, where each enemy is vulnerable to a weapon with the same color they have, providing players with a unique challenge as they venture further into the game.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War - Season Six
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War - Season 6 reveals more than just Adler's counterattack against Stitch. Fight through Adler's broken memories in one of three new Multiplayer maps, and explore mysterious new World War 2 bunkers uncovered throughout Verdansk. Grab your gear and get ready for Season 6.

title: Underground Life
description: Underground Life is an open world game where the main objective is to survive in a post-apocalyptic world gather resources, create weapons and armour and interact with all kinds of characters.

title: GoldfishFlap
description:
"You Got Caught On the Fishing Line!"

A goldfish wandering along the river was caught on a fishing line!
You'll have to be a goldfish and help go home!

But Goldfish Are Still Hung On the Fishing Line.
Resisting the manpower of the fishing line, let's pass through various topography and go home!

My Family Is Waiting At Home!

It Will Be Hard But Worthwhile!

You can control flapping goldfish with your mouse! Adventure the sea!

There are now 3 kinds of area(more area will be updated!)
Avoid the jellyfish and other predator-fishes(even meteoric stones under the sea !

Sea is Dangerous Place So It Can Suffer You..!
But Don't Give Up You Can Do It!

title: Binary.
description: Binary. is a cybernetic stylish action game where you fight viruses with big swords and guns. You are a freelance cracker who must dive into the net to fight the defenses and take control of the net. Use stylish swordplay and gunfire to create combos and fight off viruses in spectacular fashion.

title: PolyBoost
description: Do you like a challenge? We offer you one! 100 handcrafted levels where you can prove your skills. Will you be the fastest? Test your skills against all other players with our global leaderboards.

title: Warpath Ace Shooter
description:
Agent: Your assistance is once again required in the fight against Raven's tyranny.

Your mission: To strike at the very heart of Raven. You will fight thrilling battles on both the ground and in the air. Equipped with an arsenal of powerful modern weapons, you will infiltrate deep behind enemy lines to ambush targets where they least expect it. You must become the embodiment of "death from afar": picking your spots, waiting for the right moment, then pulling the trigger. Only with your help will we be able to end Raven's plans for good.

Are you up for the challenge, agent? Then lock and load!

title: Dislyte
description: Dislyte is a stylish pop-fantasy RPG set in future cities with striking visuals, exuberant beats, and superheroic characters.

title: Guardian of the Demon Valley
description: This is an exciting shooting game.The game is set in a dark canyon, you’ll play a warrior who swears to defend the saint ice crystal that seals the devil with his life. would you be able to complete the mission of defending the sealing ice crystal against the horrible monsters’ continuous offensive?!

title: Mahokenshi - The Samurai Deckbuilder
description: Mahokenshi is a turn-based blend of adventure, deck-building and deep hex-grid strategy. Create your deck, out-smart your enemy, battle challenging demons and adventure through the Celestial Islands to protect your home from the forces of corruption.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Picross
description:
A picross fangame based on A Link to the Past, available for Windows and in the Universal Updater for the 3DS homebrew.

You start at Link's house, go to Hyrule Field where a fork leads you to the main dungeon (since the other ways are blocked by a boulder and a grass respectively), fight an enemy in the dungeon that gives you a sword to cut the grass, and so on. It has exploration, bosses, itens, hearts and a bucketload of picross puzzles.

title: Anomalice
description: AnoMalice is a 3D surreal First-person puzzle game and shooter hybrid inspired by the upcoming Puzzle platformer Teocida.

title: Taikou Risshiden V
description:
Taikou Risshiden V is the latest title of a Japanese video game series Taikou Risshiden (turn-based sandbox role-playing video games/turn-based strategy) produced by Koei. It was released on PC and PlayStation 2 in 2004 followed by a port to PlayStation Portable in 2009. The first title of the series was released on NEC PC-9801 in 1992 followed by ports to Super Famicom and Genesis/Mega Drive. It was later re-released on the Wii Virtual Console on September 1, 2009, ported from the Super Famicom version.

The name of the game roughly means "the Taikou's success story". The characters are taken from the Momoyama period in Japan. In the previous Taikou Risshiden IV, a character was selected from the choices of a samurai, a ninja or a merchant. In Taikou Risshiden V, new roles include a blademaster, a pirate, a doctor, a tea master, and a blacksmith, counting eight roles in total. The player meets various historical figures of the era in the game.

title: Mercury Abbey
description:
The game uses pixel sprites, with characters drawn in a classic American comicbook style. Fossil halls, greenhouses, hedge mazes, botanical gardens, underground cave systems...scenes appear one after another, presenting a visual feast. Unique lighting and shading technology creates an engaging atmosphere and a wonderfully immersive experience.
The game embraces the spirit of early suspense novels, interspersing classic cultural elements throughout the story. Adopting an overhead world view, the world is composed of anthropomorphic animal (furry) characters; the social structures, folklore, and ethnic relations of this world are all waiting to be discovered by players!

title: The Awakener: Risen
description: Set in a medieval fantasy world, Arise of Awakener is a third-person action-adventure game with a class system that gives players direct control in how they choose to fight. With three class choices - mages, archers, and warriors, the way players decide to fight the fantastical creatures which fill this world is entirely up to them. Battles are great spectacles in which players must use their abilities and weapons to overcome the trials and challenges they will face. Fight dragons, control flying airships, collect resources and explore the expansive world that Arise of Awakener offers

title: Black Sheep
description: Black Sheep is a 2D horizontal scrolling puzzle game, you will play a sophomore student in the flooded school ruins to explore the adventure, trace the shadow of the past, so that those buried in the bottom of the river of evil to see the light of day.

title: Project-Blemmyes
description: In this roguelite third-person shooter, control a consciousness inserted into a battle suit forced to defeat endless hordes of enemies as part of an experiment. The ultimate goal is to escape the experiment, but doing so will require determination, skill and countless deaths.

title: Pathless Woods
description: Pathless Woods is a sandbox-style game that features exploration, construction, and farming. Travel freely across this land and venture into its mystery. Build a homeland that only existed in your imagination while enjoying productive activities such as farming, logging, hunting and brewing.

title: The Robolovers
description: Do you believe in love and future full of troubled robots? Well, then this game is for you! You play as a LO43R, a robot prepared to do anything to have love back in his life. Naturally, she is trapped in a sleazy massage parlour. It's your job to fight the bad robots, use the help of not so bad ones and get her out of there.

title: Listen to the Wind
description: "Listen to the Wind" is a side-scrolling hack-and-slash game with counter attacks as the game's core mechanic. It takes pace during the Ming dynasty Jiajing era where you'll be battling Japanese pirates. It features unique martial art heroes and a story branching gameplay.

title: Vapor World: Over the Mind
description:
To escape the twisted world, the boy begins his journey.

Vapor World is an action-adventure game that unfolds the inner world.

title: Love of Renai Koutei of Love!
description: School president (emperor) Lukina wins at everything no matter what it is. However, there’s one exception: love. She proclaimed her love for her childhood friend Akito in front of the whole school, and now many other girls are after him as well!?

title: Star Melody: Yumemi Dreamer
description: Star Melody: Yumemi Dreamer is a rhythm video game / visual novel developed and published by Kogado Studio.

title: The Bend
description: Enter the depths of the ocean and discover a mystery in this tense, thrilling adventure.

title: HumanitZ
description: HumanitZ is an isometric, open-world sandbox survival game set in a world ended by a zombie outbreak. Survive alone or with friends by scavenging, crafting, building, and fighting to last as long as ‘humanly’ possible. You can’t change the past, but you can fight for the future of humanity.

title: Wizardry Chronicle
description: Wizardry Chronicle is a Japanese Wizardry spin-off. It is a role-playing game derivative of the original Wizardry games, with a menu town and a maze below to explore, monsters to defeat and items to be found. The game features five races, of which all but Humans are new: Sadeeq, Mirelli, Tairon and Wallbach. There are 15 different character classes, most of them familiar from other Wizardry games.

title: Lonley, Lustful, Arrogant, Hateful
description: A unique puzzle adventure with a cryptic story and intriguing drama. Solve puzzles and conquer challenges in a dystopic gameshow. Meet new friends along the way, get to know them and discover their motives. If everyone dies, it's game over and you'll have to start from the beginning. Can you keep everyone alive until the end? Are you after glory, love or vengeance?

title: Load Roll Die
description: Load your die in this dicebuilding roguelike all about creating and exploiting combos! Every face on your set of dice can be a unique weapon in your battle to the top. Duel enemies each with their own armament of dice and smash their faces, outplay their strategies, and deal deadly damage to take them out. Steal faces from enemies you beat to trade in at the store or incorporate into your winning strategy. The right combination of dice can let you tank damage, re-roll faces, create new dice from scratch and much more, but only if you play them right!

title: Somni
description: Identify and fight back against ghosts and cryptid terrors. Somni is VR and Desktop Compatible. Identify the threat at hand and perform the proper ritual to purify it either alone or with your friends. Fend off your paranormal nightmares by investigating events and performing rituals to banish the entity for good.

title: Serene Asylum
description: Serene Asylum is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game. Solve puzzles as you uncover the dark history of the insane asylum and try to escape before you are stuck in game forever. But don't be scared, it's just a game after all, right? Now... if you can read this, you need to wake up!

title: Eloquence
description: Can you save the villagers living on an active volcano? Make your way to the top while you're trying to learn and speak a language you don't understand.

title: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair
description: Bulb Boy defeated the evil that had overtaken the Bulbhouse and his beloved family. But it seems that this is only the beginning of his dark adventures! And this time, it all starts with an empty jam jar...

title: It's Dungeon Time!
description: It's Dungeon Time is a simple 2d puzzle casual game. Start out with the simple soldier or warrior class. Descend into the dungeon and survive against hoards of skeletons, zombies and other creatures.

title: Fisherman's House
description: You have been kidnapped, and you don't know why and where you are. All you know is that you have to escape from this place before the fisherman kills you. In this house, you will find some items and puzzles that will help you escape from this house. Will you survive or get killed by the fisherman?

title: Jumpy Dog
description:
Guide your dog home through dangerous pillars as the sun sets!

The first mobile game from Tomb Studios, Jumpy Dog is a blast from the past that is sure to reignite the addiction you never thought you'd want again.

title: No Fair Play
description:
No Fair Play is a multiplayer soccer anti-game based on physics with parkour gameplay.

An anti-game :
No Fair Play is a "Free Fight Football" game where you can beat your opponents using a nonstandard way. A member of the opposing team has a good dribbling skills ? Aim for the legs !
Punch, push, tackle, grab ... it's up to you to choose how you get the upper hand on your opponent.

Based on physics :
Ragdolls, ball control, player interactions … physics gives players more opportunities to have fun with unexpected situations.

title: Dungeon Encounters
description: Dungeon Encounters is a unique dungeon exploration RPG in which you lead an expedition to chart the depths of an otherworldly labyrinth. Plan and prepare to overcome numerous obstacles, solve puzzles, and defeat monsters. Strategize to survive!

title: De-Exit: Eternal Matters
description: Embark onto a surrealistic afterlife journey to discover the secrets of the broken and mysterious Plane of Memory in this atmospheric light puzzle-platformer with a hint of stealth. Explore a warm voxel world with an intense cinematic approach. Dive into this deep reflexive experience, meet its inhabitants and save the day!

title: Pokémon Royal Version
description:
Welcome to the Aristo Region, a quiet region in the Pokemon world. It just so happens that your father and mother are the king and queen of this region. Just as you have turned 10 years old it is time for the Royal Contest to begin. Here you will journey out with your brother, Victor, and Sister, Alice, across the region to complete the gym challenge, all to decide who will become heir to the throne.
Have you got what it takes to become the next ruler of the Aristo Region?

title: JoJo's Bizarre RPG: Phantom Blood
description: A fan-made RPG about JoJo's Bizarre Adventure by Hirohiko Araki. Play as Jonathan Joestar and experience the first major arc of the series in the style of a Final Fantasy-like RPG game.

title: JoJo's Bizarre RPG: Battle Tendency
description: The second part of the JoJo's Bizarre RPG series. This game is based on the second major arc of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure by Hirohiko Araki. Play as Joseph Joestar, the grandson of Jonathan Joestar, and uncover the mysteries behind the origins of the stone mask, its creators and the history of Hamon.

title: Lovely Sweet Dream
description:
Welcome to Lovely Sweet Dream! A game made for the Yume Nikki Dream Diary Jam 5! Inspired by Yume Nikki and LSD Dream Emulator.

A girl called Lulu is walking home from school one day when she finds an interesting looking charm at a flea market. The box describes that the charm will give the user wonderful dreams. Intrigued, Lulu takes the charm home and it introduces itself as LOVELY. With LOVELY's power, Lulu can explore its beautiful and happy dreams.

title: The Trials
description: Use three challenging skills including moving between worlds, teleporting and time manipulation to discover seven main areas in The Trials island and solve over 30 side puzzles to collect gemstone to unlock new areas on the island.

title: Somnography
description: An entry for dream diary jam 5, created by a team of four over the span of about one month.

title: eFootball 2022
description: eFootball 2022 is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami. Released in September 2021, it marks a significant shift in the Pro Evolution Soccer (PES) series. Konami rebranded the franchise to eFootball and transitioned to a free-to-play model and a new engine, Unreal Engine.

title: Fin Fin: On Teo, the Magic Planet
description:
Fin Fin is a virtual pet similar to Tamagotchi. The special feature of the simulation is speech recognition with a accompanying microphone. Of course it doesn't really understand what the player is saying but it reacts to the mode of speaking - a friendly tone makes it happy and loud or hectic speeches makes it sad. Sometimes it speaks back and a "conversation" occurs. Over time it learns to distinguish the player's voice from others.

Like other virtual pets the Fin Fin needs to eat and sleep. The game is set in a virtual world where the Fin Fin can meet other animals (the player can't interact with those). The pet either plays with them or is scared which affects its mood. A happy Fin Fin rewards the player by singing a song or performing stunts.

title: Abarenbo Tengu & Zombie Nation
description: This revival is a dual set of Abarenbo Tengu, a game that was released in 1990 on the Famicom System and Zombie Nation, which was released in the following year. Save the world and fight to maintain the peace in this exciting side-scrolling shooter, now with new modes and functions.

title: Hope Trigger
description: Hope Trigger is a perma-death Side-Scrolling RPG game. The game features fighting monsters, creating gears and using combo skills, magic to battle.

title: Cornmaze Craze
description: Cornmaze Craze is a casual multiplayer based game designed to be played with your close friends. Become the Pumpkin Poltergeist, a supercharged spirit bent on cleansing the maze of corn, or avoid the spirit in the bowels of the maze

title: Houchou Shoujo Gensoukyoku
description: Houchou Shoujo Gensoukyoku, commonly known as Yume Nikki Gensou among the western community, is a Metroidvania-style fangame made by Atelier Izumi (AKA Studio Izumi).

title: Flesh, Blood, & Concrete
description: An RPG Maker horror game about a normal apartment building.

title: Cute Invaders
description: Something great is coming! Something extremely Gigantic and Adorable!

title: Pollito & Xiang Xiang: Adventure in the Forest
description:
Pollito & Xiang Xiang: Adventure in the Forest is a family friendly adventure with RPG elements game, where you can control two characters (in single player or in online coop-multiplayer modes)

Your goal is to save the creatures of the planet while getting resources (paw coins) to fix your ship, improve your House and personalize your characters and mascots.

title: Galaxy Tales: Story of Rapunzel
description: Fight space pirates with Rapunzel, the Android with the best hair in the world! To protect the precious shelter where the Jimo race lives, the cute alien Rose and Android Rapunzel must go up to the ground floor.

title: Red Wings: American Aces
description: Red Wings: American Aces is a thrilling warplane arcade shooter with online and local multiplayer modes. Whiz and swish through vibrant comic book-style skies solo or with friends and win the day!

title: Xenocider
description: Blast through corrupted worlds in this HD remaster of a cult classic! Xenocider is a third-person rail shooter inspired by arcade classics and presented in nostalgic 32-bit style!

title: Rocket Jump
description: Rocket Jump is a great platform game that requires concentration and composure. Our goal is to get as high as possible, avoiding spikes and various obstacles. Think carefully about your next move, any mistake can cost you a lot of nerves and time.. The higher you are, the further you can fall.

title: Here Comes the Hero
description: 1 on 1 action roguelike game where you fight through a randomly generated path filled with villains and events until you defeat the final boss.

title: Fallen City Brawl
description: Brawl through the city in hard-hitting pixel art style inspired by arcade classics! Inspired by arcade beat ’em ups of the late ’80s and early ’90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

title: Drifting: Weight of Feathers
description: A third-person-action game with a special emphasis on aerial-combat. Players need to utilize grappling hook and acrobatics to fight enemies, solve puzzles to progress through each level.

title: Escape Ninja
description: apanese style maze FPS A simple action game where you aim for the goal while being chased by enemies! Use the map and hiding techniques to get to the goal!

title: Astlibra Revision
description: Astlibra Revision is a side scrolling 2D action RPG. It contains various reinforcement elements, exhilarating combat, rare equipment, battles with huge bosses, beautiful art, and long story. Estimated playtime: 40+ hours

title: Mr. Sleepy Man
description: In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

title: Atelier Sophie 2: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Dream
description: The latest entry in the series follows the beloved alchemist, Sophie Neuenmuller, shortly after her adventures in 2016’s Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book.

title: Displacer Beast
description:
There's something wrong with your new cat.

A ghost story about small creatures and the harm we do to each other.

Warning: This game contains written descriptions of gore, animal death, emotional abuse, and fleshy abominations.

title: Legeclo: Legend Clover
description: Legeclo: Legend Clover is a SRPG in which players summon the bishoujo heroes such as Jeanne d’Arc, Arthur, Siegfried and more, to confront monsters known as Abyss. The game features a diverse training system and tactical battle system. Players can also develop bondings with the heroes and enjoy their individual stories.

title: Piratopia
description: Set sail in the open seas! Plunder in PvE and PvP, trade goods for ship upgrades or equipments to hunt the Kraken, all in the same Server. Dominate by yourself or with maties.

title: Starlight Alliance
description: Starlight Alliance is an action RPG, featuring two playable characters – Cyris and Lea. If you like fast third-person shooter gameplay with plenty of character development, exploration, and puzzle-solving, Starlight Alliance is the game for you! Likewise, if you’re into shooting annoying drones that tell you to get back to work, we got you covered. Starlight Alliance has it all.

title: Shadow Corridor
description: Now on Steam, revamped with brand new content! Immerse yourself in the latest chapter of the popular, Japanese indie horror title, Kageroh: Shadow Corridor. Survive against the onslaught of horrors that lie in wait in eerie, traditional Japanese locales that change with every playthrough.

title: Lord of the Click II
description: Yes! Oh my gosh! Hell yeah! This long-promised day has finally come with the release of the game that kills not only your time but your calories as well! The return of the legendary Lord of the Click has happened so suddenly and with a number «II» on the end.

title: Medieval Tower Defense
description:
Imagine a world of knights where you must defend the resources of the inhabitants under your protection from the invasion of barbarian hordes. To do this, you will have to manage your budget by acquiring and using the best weapons of the time, catapults and cannons.

Medieval Tower Defense, with its exceptional graphics, will bring you hours of strategic fun....

title: Guardians of Greenheart
description: After ten thousand years of waiting, the Demon Lord Alrolloth and his bloodthirsty Orc warriors have returned to Greenheart. With a force of mighty Orc warriors and help from the Demons of Hell, the fall of the Great Forest Greenheart is only a matter of time.

title: Love Flute
description: Play the piano, play the flute, and enjoy a ghost story as you use the profits from your street performances to buy new instruments and furniture! Let's shoot for fame and fortune!

title: Game Theory At Christmas
description: In order to participate in the game competition, let's make a game with the theme of Game Theory. Originally thought so, but due to various complicated reasons. In the end it became a spoof game.

title: Escape From Planet Aelea
description: In this action-adventure game from DASA Studios, play as lone astronaut Jennifer Sousa as she evades deadly robots, solves puzzles to collects access keys, and uncover the secrets of outpost 3 to escape planet Aelea!

title: Gorge
description: Gorge is a first-person puzzle-platformer, where you use telekinesis and wall-running to solve challenging interconnected obstacle courses.

title: Scale Enchanter
description: Scale Enchanter is a musical scales building game. Test your scale building skills in this simple and minimalist puzzle game.

title: Língua
description: Follow Beto's adventure through the northeast of Brazil in this top-down adventure! Solve puzzles, battle to free animal spirits and finish quests to help a friend retrieve a valuable possession!

title: The Twins' Experiment
description: The Twins' Experiment is a platform adventure game. You play as Object 62473 who is called to discover his hidden brother in a dream world of his mind.

title: Mystery Swords
description: Mystery Swords is a survival game with RPG elements. Your village was attacked by evil orcs. To protect the inhabitants, you, as the best soldier, are sent to explore the forest, but the enemies were much closer than it seemed. Can you stop a whole horde of hostile orcs?

title: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive - Operation Riptide
description: Dive into Operation Riptide! New challenges await, with new maps, new game mode options, and the all-new Private Queues!

title: Super Grave Snatchers
description: Use pixelated necromancy to smash villages, scare townsfolk, and generally cause a ruckus.

title: Cologne 3D
description: Explore parts of Cologne like the historic Old Market in the old town and the Gottfried-Hagen-Street in Cologne-Kalk (the office of the developer!).

title: Angels Cove
description: You are called to a secluded house on a remote island to conduct a paranormal investigation. However, you find the island and the house abandoned. Or are they?

title: Weakpoint Delta
description: Asteroids go boom. Zoom around in your lil' ship and learn how to accurately hit weakpoints on asteroids to extract the precious crystals within allowing you to purchase upgrades.

title: Hyper Bullet
description: Hyper Bullet is a top-down action game replenished with agreeable vaporwave aesthetics, pure joy of combat and gunplay rhythm.

title: Farmers Market
description: Grow crops, watch market prices shift, and sell at the right moment to nourish the people in your village.

title: Yoli
description: A satisfying shooting game with 4 gameplay modes and simple controls! Upgrade your character and defend the Portal from the creatures of the void.

title: My Name Is Velcro
description: My Name Is Velcro is a hardcore platformer. You play as a piece of dirt named Velcro. The goal of the game is to grab the ceiling with the web and move on. There are several types of traps. You are also forbidden to touch any edges.

title: Deep Despair 2
description: Deep Despair 2 is an open world survival adventure action game with procedural generation and complete freedom of action: building, crafting, hunting, farming, livestock, brewing, cooking, traveling, fight, and more.

title: Victor
description: A third person gladiator fighting game, in which you defeat waves of enemies to claim victory

title: Doom Work
description: In this atypical game, your role is to prevent the working robots from finishing construction to save the forest!

title: Stella Pastoris
description: Shepherd the last remnants of the Malthusian monks marooned on Proxima Centauri B. As the colony AI, will you delve into forbidden means to save your people or allow them to go quietly into the night? Set up production chains to spend limited resources to save as many as you can.

title: Bat Boy
description:
A Sentai sports hero 8-bit action adventure!

Bat Boy and his fellow sports-star friends secretly battle against the evil invading forces of Lord Vicious, hell-bent on hosting sinister athletic events for his own amusement!

title: Knights of Grumthorr 2
description: Real-time strategy and tactics in a fantasy world of knights and magic! Command heroes, soldiers and mages to battle against the armies of darkness. Grumthorr needs you!

title: Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey
description: Escape the grasp of the Barbvarians! Plan B from Outer Space is a stellar adventure in the style of an interactive book and takes inspiration from classic science-fiction stories and Bavarian culture. Every decision will affect the outcome of your mission; to leave this strange planet unscathed!

title: Baking Bustle: Ashley's Dream
description: Baking Bustle: Ashley's Dream immerses you in an incredible culinary world! Recipes have no boundaries in this delicious game. Experience different cuisines and create your signature dishes! Expand your chain of eateries and build an empire.

title: Memory Lost
description: MemoryLost is an action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one clip in the weapon - change the bodies to survive!

title: Haunted Shores
description: Haunted Shores is a Single-player horror game where you are an investigative journalist of the paranormal, travelling to different locations confirming or debunking the tales of each. No guns, knifes or axes... just you against myth.

title: Save Yourself!
description: A burning skyscraper, a sinking ship, or a meteor shower – use your wits and everything that comes in handy, in order to save yourself from extremely perilous catastrophes. Save yourself!

title: Hidden Object Hunt Classic
description: Are you ready to test your eyes with Hidden Object Hunt Classic, your seek and find skills will be challenged like never before. Develops your secret seeker skill to find objects. This is a puzzle game similar to Hidden Object games, in which you have to find the objects while the clock is ticking.

title: Catsploration
description: In order to save your family, you must venture from home to find and return a dragon’s egg. Catsploration is a high fantasy adventure with narrative and 3D platforming elements.

title: Supraland: Six Inches Under
description: Supraland Six Inches Under has exploration, puzzles, and combat! A first-person-metroidvania taking place six inches under Supraland.

title: Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple
description: A cute, Raccoon-based, dungeon-crawling, gem-grabbing arcade game. Join Remy Raccoon on a perilous journey through over 100 levels filled with fiendish traps and malevolent creatures. Only the bravest adventurer will collect all the gems and progress to the next level. Your adventure awaits...

title: The Upturned
description: A frantic adventure. Welcome to the Upturned Inn: a grand hotel for the dead! You just want to find your room.

title: Robotry!
description: Wreak havoc in a physics-based world! Walk, jump, kick, grab and throw by directly controlling each leg. Go from a glitching toddler to a somersaulting acrobat in the story mode, or tackle your friends in multiplayer versus modes.

title: Grandma's Footsteps
description: A game for humans who enjoy suffering, injustice and cookies.

title: Three in a Rogue
description: Three in a Rogue is a tactical turn-based three in a row roguelike. Cascade combos to fight monsters and explore a randomly generated dungeon.

title: Fei
description: 《蜚》以一个名叫幸运的男孩视角，讲述了在一个被黑恶保护伞笼罩下的架空城市中发生的一系列边缘事件，涉及很多方面的问题……

title: The Chicken's Fall
description: Once Upon a time, A chicken that dreamed of flying, she tried 30 times... and fell. Fall, dodge obstacles and don't die.

title: Stories of Blossom
description: Reawaken your inner child and explore the colourful worlds of Stories of Blossom. A series of wholesome adventures, brought to life by the imagination of a young girl.

title: Memory Booster
description: Memory Booster – is a incremental puzzle game. Memorize tiles, upgrade stats to progress easier and train your brain!

title: Storage Chase
description: Help the furry creature stay alive and overcome all obstacles in this challenging and dynamic 2D platformer - Storage Chase!

title: Niki in the Ship
description: A first-person exploration game set on a planet where a god keeps you in prison. As Niki, you will travel around the planet with your ship, visiting beautiful places and trying to find a way to face the god itself.

title: 25 Layers of Pain
description: Are you tired of being happy? Does life keep giving you everything you want? Are you finally ready to turn that frown right-side-up? Play 25 Layers of Pain. The game for masochists.

title: Aqua Boy
description: Aqua Boy is a deep sea treasure hunter, but his latest mission has gone drastically wrong! Explore a quirky underwater world packed with secrets in this mini metroidvania.

title: The Eightfold Path
description: The path of a Buddhist monk is a path of enlighenment. Find your way through the mystical forest and encounter beautiful creatures, magical places, evil spirits and puzzling challenges which you will have to complete in order to be released from suffering.

title: Beyond the Darkness
description: Beyond The Darkness is a horror adventure game with puzzles where you help little girl Milly battle nightmares in the darkness to find her missing family. You will find yourself in bizarre worlds of memories, distorted by fears, and your only weapon will be the light of a small lamp...

title: Not Another Dungeon?!
description: The demonic Tower of Imalsrith has appeared on the battlefield of the Kingdom of Infantriell and the Empire of Fractile. Conquer it in this action-packed card game with rogue-lite elements!

title: Sandfall
description: The Sand War, a destructive conflict that took place over 30 years ago, still inflicts collateral damages on the continent. Our heroes must discover the the truth behind the war and bring peace once more to the continent while dealing with their own inner conflicts.

title: Evil Mansion
description: Evil Mansion is a first-person 3D Werewolf game with real-time voice chat. The game has a variety of occupations (such as security, doctors, detectives).and the vote system is not for vote out player, but for mark the position of the player with the most votes.

title: Hamster Playground
description: Prepare for cuteness overload, relentless training, and fierce rivalry as you and your hamsters take on challenges while traversing the maze and riding a skateboard! Be the first ones to cross the finish line to earn rewards and yummy treats!

title: Doomsday Defense
description: The end of the world is coming, face the endless attacking zombies, please live to the end...

title: 666 Masks
description: How to survive despair and fear? Stir up your emotions. Look at the world in a new way. Get out of the maze of the catacombs by completing interesting quests. Collect all Masks and become alive again...

title: PaintballX
description: PaintballX is an online mutliplayer FPS paintball game! Battle your friends in a casual paintball FPS!

title: Fox Goes Hunting
description: A combination Shooter and Action-Adventure game where the player is the hungry fox that needs to hunt food (Chickens, Rabbits, etc.). There are large predators (Bears, Wolves, etc.) that the fox must shoot using bullets that are earned as rewards.

title: Lawnmower Game: Battle
description: New part for Epic lawnmower game series. Now collect different weapons and destroy evil enemy ai lawnmowers in different arenas

title: Last Minute
description: Last Minute is a first person horrorgame.

title: Romans: Age of Caesar
description: Build Rome Together! A co-operative grand strategy MMO from a team of veteran city builders, Romans: Age of Caesar is the latest historical strategy game from Firefly Studios.

title: Leshy
description: Leshy is a hack'n'slash game based in the near future, in which the player takes the role of a forest guardian from the Slavic mythology. Fight ruthless humans that invade your home - the primeval forest. Face the enemy's world fueled by modern technology and evil motivations.

title: Detective AI
description: Become a detective and confront an assassin controlled by an artificial intelligence that evolves with each case you investigate.

title: Undarkened: Revival
description: Undarkened is a wizarding survival-adventure game where you must unravel the mystery of what, or who, corrupted your homeland. Explore a devastated world alone or with your friends, find out what happened, and try everything you can to save your home.

title: Treffen
description: Treffen is a game about boxing. Become the master of the sport of boxing, destroy your opponents, take revenge on your main enemy and take back your girlfriend.

title: The Last Will
description: "The Last Will" is a 3D point-and-click adventure game played from the perspective of a grieving father whose son just passed away.

title: Fighties 2
description: Fighties 2 is a fast paced 2D platform fighter. It is the second Fighties game.

title: Cards Matching Memory Game
description: Do you like memory games? Looking for a fun way for brain training and a way to improve your memory? Check out Cards Matching Memory Game.

title: The Facility Project
description: An epic horror adventure crafted with a strong focus on atmosphere and story. Explore the environments of an abandoned facility, solving its mystery. Action taking place in the year 2006, play as a private investigator tasked to obtain information about the strange activities that were rumored.

title: Legendary Tales: Stolen Life
description: “Legendary Tales: Stolen Life” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

title: Join Rush Attack
description: Run the crowd until you reach the castle at the end of the level. Crush your rivals in the final battle and capture the fortress!

title: Night Cascades
description: The city is on fire, and the Devil is to blame - or is it? Two women must solve an occult-themed mystery set in an alternate 1980s while unraveling the secrets of their past. Hunt for clues and interrogate suspects in this interactive yuri visual novel.

title: Jet Set Corps
description: You are a Jet Pack Marine of the famous Jet Set Corps. Rescue Colonists and Save Colonies and Earth from Aliens Attack! Get ready, mission starts NOW! Jet Set Corps is a tribute to the best times in arcade games history.

title: Diptych
description: The heroes meet on the battlefield of the First World War, in the case of the "Diptych", an anthropomorphic animal, we learn a terrible and touching story in a deceptively cute and unique style.

title: Book of Adventum
