description: An action-adventure FPS which combines the time-honored problem solving of adventure FPS games - shooting people in the face and getting through not-so-difficult puzzles - with metaphysical ponderings. You can craft and mod stuff as well.

title: Spidded
description: Spidded - An arcade platformer in which the player acts as a spider that moves with its web, dodging a fly swatter and balancing on an unstable web.

title: Without Pain
description: Without Pain - is a dynamic 2D shooter with surviving elements where you will have to fight against various types of monsters.

title: Detective Gman
description: Detective simulation. Top down open world exploration.

title: Human Madness
description: Human Madness is a multiplayer survivor game , you can customize your character and the weapons

title: The VanMan
description: this game is made by one person and will be uppdated irregulary

title: Mythic: Forest Warden
description: An action game where you play as a forest`s pagan god in the WW II times. Use god`s magic, brute force, sharp claws, and Nazi`s weapons to drive Germans away from your land.

title: Old Coin Pusher Friends
description: This is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Old japan that can be enjoyed by one or all. Cooperate with other players and aim for the jackpot. In addition, by collecting prizes, new content is released and coins are easily increased. Online multiplayer for up to five players possible.

title: Squared Up
description: Join Cubert, a 3rd dimensional shape, on his quest to escape the 2nd dimension. Navigate puzzles by morphing Cubert's form and interacting with the world to escape back to the 3rd dimension.

title: 10th Corpse
description: 10th Corpse is a Match 3 game with plenty of fun twists. Enjoy 100 twisted Match3 levels and solve a murder in Mansion Vinterfragen!

title: Esports History
description: Esports adventure-tycoon with RPG elements where you will have to go through the path from an ordinary teenager to an esports star. Win tournaments, improve your character, use your time and resource wisely to prove that you are the best.

title: Wyvia
description: Wyvia is an open world 3D action RPG with 8-bit sprites inspired by classic JRPGs of the era. Featuring a class system with over 10 classes to choose from, a robust cross-class skill system, tons of weapon types, many dungeons to explore, and bosses to fight! Also you can ride a Wyvern!

title: Inward
description: Discover, grow and name your own species of trees. Watch as the seed transforms from a sapling to a majestic tree. Water the tree with your mindfulness, habits and insights. Grow and discover yourself with the help of a stray dog called Samsara.

title: The Last Cadet
description: The Last Cadet is a deep sea action-driven metroidvania with elements of dread and isolation. Play one of two single player campaigns using twin-stick controls to escape a submarine sunk by an ancient monster. Also featuring two local co-op multiplayer modes at launch.

title: Spinner Invaders
description: Shoot your way through a thrilling action adventure of 120 waves in 4 different game modes while fighting against waves of enemies and 12 extreme bosses. Save the world from The General by yourself or with a friend locally and play 10 different Challenges.

title: Infinity Treasures
description: Labirinth of Infinity Treasures is a game that can be challenging and funny with each level. Brave forests, swamps, and venture to the depths of the planet to discover forgotten treasures.

title: Warlocks Entanglement
description: Warlocks Entanglement puts you into a destructible open world in a magical medieval setting. Explore and learn all this world has to offer and then open a gateway to the next world!.

title: Alec Adventure
description: Alec Adventure is a casual 2D pixel platformer. Shoot your crossbow as you travel through different environments fighting many different enemies. Find your way back home with items you find and don't forget to enjoy the view on the way!

title: Flesh Water
description: This is your last day as a worker for a pet feeding service, and depending on how the day goes, your life. Prepare the final meal for a client's odd pet that lives in an abandoned pool all while trying to make it out safely and avoid mistakes.

title: Bainok: City of Fighters
description: Combat men and monsters in this turn-based martial art rpg, while you try to live day by day in the dystopian metropolis of Cirqualo.

title: Gehinnom
description: Gehinnom is a multiplayer horror game for 1-4 players. (Demo is single-player only). Collect clues and complete quests to perform a ritual and banish the demon that hunts you. Everything in Gehinnom is randomly generated, so you will always be scared.

title: Bridge of Dawn
description: Bridge of Dawn is a free, open-sourced 3D arcade/racing style game for one or two players. Follow the story of Vulpes the Fox as he rushes to catch the sun and find out the secret to everlasting life in this lighthearted and fun game for all ages.

title: Short Hop Laser
description: Take the short hop laser concept from SSBM, and make it a 2d side scroller arcade game. Actually don't do that, because I already did that.

title: Hidden Flowers
description: Find the flowers that are hidden on the map

title: I Love Finding Pups
description: I Love Finding Pups is a classic Hidden Object game. Explore stunning locations through hidden object scenes and minigames while collecting all the adorable pups!

title: Wednesday Basketball
description: Live a year in a small town basketball association. Follow the stories of Fanny, Alex, Remy, Ajiba, Laura, Odile, Benjamin, Amir, Kariem and Meng as the season passes by. Some will join, some will leave. Relax and play some basketball.

title: Starry Moon Island
description: This is an old school game collection with ten different types of mini-games. The story tells of a series of wars that took place on the island.

title: Absurd Chess
description: Compete against up to 100 players in various, REALLY absurd chess modes never seen before! You will have to adapt to new rules and develop your own tactics that will allow you to dominate the board.

title: Jumping Pirates
description: Jumping Pirates are fun adventures where you have to get to the finish line alive but there are some problems with that ... Overcome obstacles, collect coins, avoid water and sharp objects! Complete all levels and defeat all enemies!

title: Box Survivors World
description: Box Survivors World is a multiplayer action survival game where players will have to do their best to become the greatest survivor.

title: HipWitch
description: HipWitch is a chill puzzle game that invites you to explore a beautiful nature reserve. Play as Prom, a young witch helping a cast of quirky characters. Use a variety of spells, and the power of 90s dial-up internet to solve the tasks ahead!

title: One Way to Exit 2
description: Move forward or backward in search of an exit, but remember: if you start moving, you will not be able to stop. Take bonuses, destroy obstacles and bosses, but in no case touch them or the walls, otherwise you will have to start from the beginning.

title: Pre Dusk
description: Discover the strange world of Pre Dusk with a child who knows nothing about his life and faces great difficulties in finding out the truth about his world.

title: Red Button
description: Get ready to take part in the world war! It depends only on your choice who you will be - a winner or a loser! It's time to press the red button!

title: Potata: Foxy Tale
description: Potata: Foxy Tale is a fairy tale themed platformer adventure game in a beautiful world of dark forests. Your goal is to restore the balance and assemble the fragments of the Woodland Spirit.

title: Battal Gazi: Stone of Yada
description: The Stone of Yada which gives enormous power to its possessors has broken into four pieces. Kill every enemy in front of you, capture Yada Guards, and bring these pieces together one by one to obtain that power.

title: Rocket Sword
description: Rocket Sword is a ridiculous, gratuitous slash-'em-up where you are the projectile: a rocket-propelled greatsword. Slice, stab, and pulverize everyone in your path with the most powerful weapon in the universe.

title: Abettor
description: Abettor is a top-down shooter where enemies constantly spawn all around you. In this game, not only does the world generate around you, but the enemies do as well. Kill as many enemies and achieve your highest score. How many can you kill in Abettor?

title: Road Builder
description: Road Builder is a logic puzzle game based on the system of creating roads and managing traffic flow. The player's task is to connect selected entry and exit roads by creating complex structures of intersections and junctions so that traffic collides with each other as little as possible.

title: Lucent Bounds
description: Lucent Bounds is a short and challenging 3D platformer. Make your way through an alien ocean planet by jumping, dashing, slamming, gliding, and swinging about. Avoid hazards, collect treasures, and challenge yourself in speed runs.

title: Horror Maze
description: A Tense, Terrifying series of mazes.

title: Jurassic Snap
description: Congratulations photographer , you have been selected for the mission on Gliese 486B . In order to study the creatures similar to the dinosaurs that live there, you will take pictures of them and we will study their behavior. So we will see if humans are able to cohabit.

title: Halloween Puzzle
description:
Immerse yourself in a dark and mysterious world as you explore the enchanting atmosphere of Halloween in this classic card matching game. With four distinct difficulty levels to choose from – Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert – get ready for a thrilling adventure.
Amongst the cards featuring ghosts, witches, cauldrons, and more, you'll need to exercise your memory and concentration to uncover the perfect matches. You can start with Easy for a pleasant introduction, but true mastery awaits you in the challenging Expert mode.
The Halloween ambiance will captivate you at every level, adding an extra layer of excitement to the game. With spooky themes and mind-bending pairings, this game will provide hours of fun for you and your friends. Flip the cards, make the matches, and unveil the secrets of this mystical world

title: Killer Gin: Battle Arcade
description: Harken back to the old school platformers! Heavily inspired by an Arcade Classic, use attacks, powers, and advanced tactics to eliminate enemies or your friends! Win by collecting 5 coins or being the last man standing! One thing is for sure, skills pay the bills!

title: Morbid Inhale
description: Hungry zombies want to devour you. Take the biggest gun and fight them back! Get experience, upgrade skills, use perks, bonuses, and kill them by any means. Shoot, blast, burn, rip and tear!

title: Hammerheart
description: Punishing, strategic and with a heavy focus on authenticity, Hammerheart is a hardcore roguelike set in the viking age that combines directional medieval combat with party customization and strategy mechanics.

title: Blood Impact
description: Fight for your escape from this mysterious lab. Use your blood powers to achieve your goal in this action adventure game! But don’t forget, blood is vital...

title: Lack of Water
description: Lack of water is a puzzle game. You need to direct the flow of water towards an empty glass.

title: Neeron: The Blade of Nature
description: Utilize the power of the Neeron, fight ingeniously against the invasion. Set off on a journey to protect the homeland!

title: Dash Realm
description: Dash Realm is a 2D multiplayer top down action shoot. Ideal for those boring breaks between two games. Compete against your friends in the arena and claim victory!

title: Storms 2
description: Set in an ancient world, Storms 2 combines action, progression, and loot, with generated worlds to explore. Character and loot choices change up the game as you try to find your way home.

title: Mystery at Morgoth
description: Who is behind the evil events that unfurled in Feldar Vale? Journey to the land of Morgoth to halt the dark force that terrorizes the people and learn who is behind the mysterious Cabal. An adventure for 4-6 characters of Level 1-6, loosely based on Dungeons & Dragons Open Game License (OGL 1e/2e).

title: Wander Hero
description: This is the fantasy of a two-dimensional traverser in a different world. You can take a leisurely and strategically deep adventure. You can also collect beautiful girls without hurting your wallet, and form your own harem... ahem, mercenary group.

title: Revel
description: Revel is a fun and original suit-based card game that will test your skills and instincts. Stepping out of the shadows of blackjack and poker, Revel will give you unprecedented ways to play such as buying cards and dynamic card values. Will you pin down its elusive optimal strategy?

title: Goat's Tale
description: Get ready for an amazing, challenging goat adventure where only the best can get to the top.

title: Mortal Rite
description: Mortal Rite is a third-person, action RPG that aims to breathe new life into the rogue-lite and dungeon crawler genres. In Mortal Rite you must face the blood spirit's trials as you ascend the tower in order to gain our access into the guild. The game can be played in single player mode or up to 6 player co-op!

title: Typer Hero
description: Typer Hero is a typing game with two different difficulty modes, however survive mode will only appear once you have completed the game.

title: Empire Takeover
description: This is a fun & amazing tower crush game! Crush enemy's towers, take over the empire!

title: Witchfall: Secrets of Emotica
description: Welcome to the world of Witchfall, a magical land filled with adventure! Play as five adorable critters: Koemi, Rez, Maya, Sloberg or Envel as they embark on a perilous journey to stop the evil Professor Flitz from stealing the mysterious Emotica Shards.

title: 1M84
description: An upcoming MMO RPG game with lots of fun and things to do! The things you can do are endless. With server updates planned every week!

title: Fragile Existence
description: Take command of the last surviving fleet of humankind in Fragile Existence, a sci-fi RTS with fully 3D planet surfaces and vast solar systems to explore. Dispatch expeditions to find resources, build settlements, construct vital parts and supplies, and evolve your technology to meet new threats.

title: Evolution: Moon Warfare
description: Low gravity sci-fi FPS team deathmatch game.

title: Gravity Mummy
description: "Gravity Mummy" is a platformer puzzle game. You play as a mummy guard who has different super powers to overcome the challenges: you can move heavy boxes, jump on the heads of bloodthirsty enemies, as well as move around the ceiling.

title: Evolution of War
description: The Evolution of War game shows the evolution of warfare in 5 ages, starting with the age of dinosaurs, crusades, medieval, 21st century (present time) and futuristic (fiction).The game's main objective is to destroy the enemy base.

title: Junkyard Fury
description: You appear in what seems to be an abandoned Junkyard, you don't quite know how you got there... But your not alone. Try to escape the Junkyard of killer cars, if you can.

title: Hidden Caves
description: Find the caves elements that are hidden on the map.

title: Ninja Express
description: ▲As a great ninja, after the combat mission is over, you need to protect your identity and collect necessary intelligence at the same time. For example, part-time as a courier. ▲You must quickly complete the client's entrustment, while avoiding the attention of the police.

title: Defect Process
description: Hack n' slash through increasingly dangerous arenas with a high action free-form combat system

title: The Story of Bill Bear
description: Help the little bear to find the way home. What dangers can be hidden in the night streets of a quiet suburb? Who is waiting for him at home, and who is waiting in the dark around the corner?

title: Dungeon Arsenal
description: Dungeon Arsenal is a fast-paced roguelite card game. Select a hero to go through series of random-generated floors where you can search for weapons and items, while fighting enemies or running to the next floor to save your life. The game have lots of unlockables, such as new skins for the heroes, card borders, new weapons and relics.

title: Platypus Adventures
description: An action packed, third person adventure about a Platypus uncovering a cosmic mystery! Explore an epic story based on Australian animals and landscapes.

title: Ravenous Devils
description: An horror cooking simulator where you manage an evil family business. Improve your shops buying new tools and serve your customers.

title: Commanding Nations
description: Commanding Nations brings back the fun gameplay of RTS. Build anywhere and produce as many units as you want, as long as you can collect the needed resources. Play with one of the 3 unique Nations and destroy your opponents.

title: Hearts of the Dungeon List
description: Conquer dungeons, find romance, upgrade the town, build your stats, or just take it easy in this fast-paced turn-based RPG.

title: Timewreck Tales
description: Fix the Timewreck in this story rich rogue-like RPG. Build up your team and collect time crystals as you battle, outwit, and discover different dimensions as Independent Time Specialists for Chronos Inc. Chronos Insurance does not cover brain warping or injuries from alternate versions of you.

title: League of Felt Tanks
description: "League of Felt Tanks" is a tank shooter game. We are developing for multiplayer, but now this single game for store review. We plan to create Battle with Friends mode and Team Battle mode, CO-OP mode! Please wait for update!

title: King's Helper
description: Have you ever wondered what the King's life is like? King's Helper is an extraordinary FPP game in which you have a chance to become his right hand. Travel back to the Middle Ages and assume the role of the King's helper.

title: Matching Cats
description: Match the cards of cute and funny kittens to find the correct path and pass level in this game that mixes memory and puzzle game!

title: Flyland Wars: 3 Model Trains
description: A sci-fi flying person vs. robot battle game. This flyland is a model train layout writ large! But it has been made to be terribly lethal You have to destroy every danger to the refugees! (Come back again, click the arrow button and play trains! Game within the game!)

title: Paradise Marsh
description: Wander through a perfect endless wetland! Catch tadpoles, enjoy peaceful sceneries and find lost poems while restoring fallen stars in the empty night sky.

title: Puzzle Art: Dogs
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with dogs.

title: Grand Attrition
description: Grand Attrition is a chaotic experimental strategy game where you can take control of everything in battles, from the existing terrain to enemy units. Survive attritions, detailed to the specifications of your choosing, and earn talent points to increase the chaos.

title: Last Defenders
description: The corruption must be purged! What do you get if you combine an cards, tanks & ... monastic order? LAST DEFENDERS.

title: Decide 4 God
description: Six of them wanted out. Six of them wanted in. Now, all twelve of them are trapped in a prison where a fate worse than death awaits them. Can they survive the wiles of Empathy Systems? What dark secrets lurk behind that institution? It is for the future when none may tread.

title: Space Reign
description: An indie space-sim and strategy game featuring ship and fleet combat mixed with management of a private space corporation. Claim sectors for your faction and raise its influence in the near-future, where resource exploiting corporations are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

title: Primal Threat
description: Blast cyborg dinosaurs and other dangerous creatures in this side-scrolling action/adventure! Explore an ancient labyrinth full of upgrades, weapons, and secrets to save the planet from a primal threat!

title: Steinstern: Spacewar
description:
The space shooter with infinite progression and procedural levels. Find the way through increasingly large levels and fight tougher and tougher enemies. Loot and level up to stand a chance!

Play alone or together in local couch coop!

title: Mage Rumble
description: Battle by yourself or with friends against the computer and other players in this turn-based combat game! Learn new spells after each round (if you can afford them) to add to your arsenal. Choose your game mode, customize your preferences and may the best mage win!

title: Chronicles of Sarval: Bridges of Koni
description: After the appearance of a mysterious wizard, the bridges of Koni were bewitched. The king summons Sarval's wizards to help him. You are Helm, a wizard willing to solve the problem. Based on graph theory, the player needs to find the path that only passes through each bridge once.

title: Iron Age
description: Iron Age is a real-time strategy game (RTS).

title: Superfluous Returnz
description: The adventures of Superfluous, a very useless superhero in a peaceful village in the deep French countryside ... Helped by his assistant Sophie, who tries to somehow temper the enthusiasm of his employer, he will try to apprehend the mysterious apple thief who is terrorizing the local orchards ...

title: Ship Simulator Realistic
description: Ship Simulator Realistic experience the real simulation. The game will be based on a free roam aspect to explore the Greece Scenery in a physics based game , realistic handling and many more features.

title: A Visit to Friends
description: A Visit to Friends is a collection of four dioramas, each with their own themes, characters, and puzzles to solve. Catch chickens, put in a day's work, and explore your own subconscious through heterodox methods. All this and more is in store when you take A Visit to Friends.

title: Rhythm Brawl
description: Rhythm Brawl is a versus-rhythm game about taking part in band battles with a story mode based on rivalries between talented musicians. It is easy to learn but hard to master.

title: The Dawning
description: The Dawning is a first-person puzzle mystery game. Play as Detective Madison as he searches 7 beautifully crafted areas for clues to catch a killer. Use stealth to sneak past deadly enemies. Solve complex puzzles to access new areas, progress the rich storyline, and obtain key items.

title: Polar Explorer Simulator
description: Live a few days of an "ordinary" polar explorer and overcome all the difficulties. You can play alone or as a team. The more polar friends you have with you, the easier it is. But there can be a strictly limited number of polar explorers at one polar station.

title: Recapture the Castle
description: Recapture the Castle is a third-person shooter game. The invaders have occupied the castle. Now you need to take up arms to destroy the invaders.

title: Gold Miner
description: The original gold mining web browser game from the early 2000s.

title: Izanami
description: Izanami is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Gutting Goblins!
description: A top-down point and click dungeon-slaughterhouse where you slay goblins, break stuff and collect gold for score. explore a lived-in dungeon with heavy metal to keep you playing for anywhere between fifteen minutes to an hour at a time.

title: The Hero of Bangaona
description: The Hero of Bangaona is a 2D Side-scrolling Action game where you play as the Hero of Bangaona kingdom whose mission is to capture the enemy bases in order to rescue the Princess who got kidnapped by the soldiers of the Weins Territory.

title: Nuclear Drifter
description: Nuclear drifter is a 2D open-world post-apocalyptic game. In the game we play the role of a farmer who is looking for a new water source for his sheep.

title: Poly Puzzle: Furries 2
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with furries.

title: Holiday Solitaire Easter
description: What has the Easter Bunny brought? Golden cards! Collect them all and complete 120 unique levels in the new Easter Solitaire!

title: Code Dread
description: Code Dread is a survival horror game for 1~4 players. You are on a mission to investigate an old abandoned hospital. Be prepared to fight against a ferocious monster lurking in the shadow!

title: Chill Corner
description: This is just an idle game for chillout and relaxing.

title: Dear Agony Aunt
description: Congratulations! You're on your way to becoming a professional agony aunt! All you have to do now is get through the trial period. Respond to messages using a retro 2006 email client. The replies you send will determine whether you are hired or fired at the end of the week. Good luck!

title: Zen Trails
description: Zen Trails is a relaxing, simple sand box in which you can do only one thing: draw lines. When you press play, the lines rotate to create beautiful designs. A zen-inducing spirograph-making experience to calm the soul while stimulating the mind.

title: 8 Links
description: 8 Links is a cool & smooth puzzle game where your goal is to link tiles. Make the longest chain, score more points and complete all the achievements

title: Tamale Loco: Rumble in the Desert
Phantom Blade: Executioners
description:
Phantom Blade: Executioners is a fast-paced action game set in the Phantom World.
It features a rich storyline of Kung-Fu adventures, where you dive into a conspiracy that threatens to topple the world, cut down Fung-Fu masters who have succumbed to insanity, and find out the mastermind following a series of seemingly independent incidents.

title: Emote Farming Simulator
description: Farm emotes, play scuffed games and react to video! See in-game simulated chatroom react to what you say and your gameplay. Say specific trigger words to make the in-game simulated chatroom react.

title: River City Saga: Three Kingdoms
description: In River City Saga: Three Kingdoms, the characters of the Kunio-kun series run-amok in the world of Sangokushi. The game, which follows the flow of the popular Downtown Special Kunio-kun's Historical Period Drama!, sees players cross countries and challenge the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Vengeance is Mine
description: Vengeance Is Mine’s, brutal melee mech combat is augmented with a time-manipulation mechanic that adds a fascinating twist to encounters. Thanks to the capabilities of the HYDRA mech suit, the player will have the ability to speed up time and blink towards unsuspecting enemies, or rewind time to readjust combos or evade death. HYDRA also comes packing an energy-based projectile weapon that allows you to take on foes at distance.

title: Red Goes Faster
description: In Red Goes Faster, players take control of an aspiring young racer named Leon Garcia. Leon is a racer who takes part in intergalactic races by day and explores his home planet of Keplar at night. Players spend their time between races hanging out with Leon's friends in a variety of establishments while finding themselves trying to untangle a complicated love triangle.

title: Wanted: Dead
description: Wanted: Dead promises "spectacular melee combat and exciting gunplay," and is set in a "dark and dangerous version of science-fiction Hong Kong where you will need sharpened skills to survive."

title: The Island: Into the Mist
description: The Island: Into The Mist is a mystery adventure visual novel where every decision counts.

title: The Last Worker
description: The Last Worker is a first person narrative adventure centered around our struggle in an increasingly automated world. Combining a hand crafted art style with uniquely immersive gameplay mechanics in an epic setting, The Last Worker delivers an emotional, thought provoking and comedic story packaged with rich characters performed by an all-star cast.

title: Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles
description: Meet Lumote, the squishiest bioluminescent creature, in this beautiful 3D puzzle platformer. Take control of the world’s inhabitants on a quest into the Great Depths to seize control from the Mastermote.

title: Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One - Deluxe Edition
description: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One Deluxe Edition includes a Season Pass with new quests: 'Saints and Sinners' DLC (available on release day), 'Mycroft's Pride' DLC (coming later), 'M for Mystery' DLC (coming later), 'Beyond A Joke' DLC (coming later).

title: UnMetal: UnDeluxe Edition
description:
UnMetal's a 2D stealth action-adventure that pays homage to the classics with a healthy dose of humor and satire. You play as Jesse Fox, who is definitely NOT an elite commando, under arrest for a crime he didn't commit, and must escape a covert military base.

The UnDeluxe Edition includes:
- The Game
- The Big Boom-Box Soundtrack

title: Rogue Lords: Blood Moon Edition
description:
The Blood Moon edition includes:
- The Game and the Supporter Pack
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack
- Moonlight set.

title: In Sound Mind: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: From the creators of the cult classic Nightmare House 2 comes In Sound Mind, a witty first-person psychological horror with frenetic puzzles and unique boss fights. In Sound Mind Digital Deluxe Edition includes the digital soundtrack by The Living Tombstone.

title: Gamedec: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
This bundle includes:
Gamedec digital copy
The Art of Gamedec – 80 pages of art and design concepts.
Digital Soundtrack - many minutes of the noir-themed original score.
Exclusive skin of Torkil Aymore - the protagonists known from the Gamedec books saga.

title: Bassmaster Fishing 2022: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Bassmaster Fishing 2022 Digital Deluxe Edition includes everything from the Standard Edition of the game, plus a heap more additional content!

With 6 stunning deluxe edition boat wraps, 5 special Deluxe Edition clothing items, and a mix of Deluxe Edition exclusive rods, reels, and lures with exclusive designs, you’ll be the envy of all your competitors on the water.

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer: Lotus Labyrinth R
description: Venture into dungeons with a huge party of your favorite Touhou characters! This is a dungeon-crawler RPG with an absurdly large party size! The dungeon-crawler RPG Genso Wanderer is now a game with an Oversized Party System that pushes the envelope of the roguelike genre! Now you can bring dozens of partners with you on your dungeon crawls, in addition to other quality of life improvements that make the game's systems and controls smoother than ever. Overwhelm your enemies with strength in numbers! Lead tons of your favorite Touhou characters at once and conquer the impregnable Lotus Labyrinth!

title: Ludo XXL
description: This classic game par excellence has brought young and old together for generations. The much-loved original, with its child-friendly rules and thrilling luck of the dice is now finally available for Nintendo Switch. It’s great fun for the whole family – full of both laughter and frustration!

title: Kyle is Famous: Complete Edition
description: Take Control of Kyle in this Text-Based Adventure. Make decisions for Kyle that will affect every part of his day. Take Kyle's hand through 117 unique endings, each determined by what Kyle has done and who he has interacted with. He needs you. Be kind. Kyle just woke up and Kyle needs to prepare to conduct an interview with a very, very important guest on his show. Collect items, make choices, and solve mysteries. Kyle can swallow the fridge and Kyle can travel time and steal from the locals and dump lard on his neighbor and many, many other things that KYLE SHOULD NOT DO. Take Kyle's hand. Direct him. Tell him what he ABSOLUTELY SHOULD NOT DO. Confidently help Kyle. He needs you. Kyle has 117 endings but only one of them is the good, well-prepared ending that you are going to guide Kyle to. Who knows what would happen if you weren't there for him? Would he destroy the city? Gossip about his neighbor? Fight crime? Revive a dead loved one?

title: ExZeus: The Complete Collection
description: Hostile alien forces have set their sights on Earth and will stop at nothing to wipe our civilization from existence. The invaders seek to use their advanced technology to annihilate humanity, but they weren’t expecting the people of Earth to counter with sophisticated technology of our own. Enter Project ExZeus, humanity’s last and best defense to repel the otherworldly menace and restore peace to our little blue planet using ultra high tech fighting robots! Take control of four different robots and blast those aliens back to where they came from in these action-focused high-flying 3D arcade style rail shooters! ExZeus In the year 2102 C.E. a massive, previously unknown asteroid entered Earth’s orbit and began unleashing waves of attacks on the planet, killing thousands of people every day and devastating human civilization. The lucky few who survived the initial onslaught managed to escape deep underground, narrowly preventing humanity’s extinction. The Governing Council ordered an immediate counter-attack using three experimental robots: Calista, Sophia, and Dynamis. With that, Operation ExZeus was born. Now, you must choose one of the three giant flying robots to take into battle against the invading forces of Diadora. Soar through the skies, blast away enemies, and reclaim Earth for its people! ExZeus 2 After a century of peace, Operation ExZeus and the defeat of Diadora are but a distant memory for the people of Earth. However, the peace was not to last. A new menace has emerged from deep space in the form of five mysterious pods, each one a weapon of mass…

title: Tekken 7: Lei Wulong
description: The super cop Lei Wulong has joined the fray! Keep your opponents guessing by switching seamlessly between his five stances as you dominate the battle!

title: Tekken 7: Kunimitsu
description: The young thief who inherited her mother's name, Kunimitsu II joins the fray! Knock your opponent off their guard with her lightning-fast moves, then finish them off with her blades wreathed in red and blue flames!

title: Tekken 7: Island Paradise
description: A spacious beachside stage that features both a poolside right out of a high-class resort and a beach with beautiful clear water! Play while enjoying the unique atmosphere of the beach, including bright, warm sunlight during the daytime and a beautiful sunset in the evening.

title: Tekken 7: Eliza
description: Get the mysterious Eliza vampire playable character, coming from TEKKEN Revolution, and master her unique fighting style to win the fight against your friends and rivals.

title: Tekken 7: Craig Marduk
description: Craig Marduk, ferocious beast and Vale Tudo fighter, has joined the fray! Tower over your opponent before pummeling them with powerful techniques!

title: Tekken 7: Ganryu
description: The long-awaited Ganryu joins the fray! Turn heads fighting in his showy outfit and show the world just how strong a sumo can be!

title: The Survivalists: Deluxe Edition
description: A living world full of surprises, secrets and danger awaits in The Survivalists, an adventure-filled survival sandbox set in The Escapists universe. Explore, build, craft and even train monkeys with up to three friends in a desperate bid to survive. Be prepared for your trek into the unknown and pack The Survivalists Deluxe Edition for the journey ahead.

title: Alder's Blood: Definitive Edition
description:
Alder's Blood is a tactical strategy game with stealth-based combat, RPG elements, crafting, resources gathering, and management, exploration, and a rich storyline. Set in a grim world, where mankind killed their God and is facing extinction.

DEFINITIVE UPDATE
- 3 new enemy types. Prepare to fight swarms of feral bats, witches of the wood, and elder vampires.

- 30 new weapons with unique abilities to add to your arsenal.
- Overwatch added to ease up your ambushes. Snipe any foes running into your range.
- Tug of war mechanics. Push a beast into a trap or pull it into the range of ally's overwatch.
- Rebalance of corruption system. Cursed weapons and items give you immense power but at a cost of slowly losing yourself.
- New questline: uncover dark secrets of House Blackwell.
- New hunter skin - hunt in style.

title: Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition
description: Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition contains Outer Wilds base game and Echoes of the Eye expansion.

title: Halloween Stories: Horror Movie - Collector's Edition
description: It’s Only a Movie... Right?

title: Sword Princess Amaltea: The Visual Novel
description: Princess Amaltea is sent out on this quest, and rescues Prince Ossian. They are both unwilling to play along in these traditional expectations of them, and after fleeing their own wedding they are now out on the open roads – on to new adventures in this gender flipped world!

title: Dreams of Adventure
description: Dreams Of Adventure brings you in a world of medival fantasy where you chose how to play and impact the world around you. Will you help a person in need? Want them to pay you for help? Perhaps... you end their life and take the bellongings...? The choice is yours!

title: Norr part II: Will Walker
description: Shot, run and slow time or you'll die!

title: Curving Over It with Evgeny Podoynikov
description: Overcome obstacles by throwing a ball, which is not as simple as it might seem.

title: Forbidden place
description: A zombie virus appeared in the spacecraft. Please collect the materials in the spacecraft and try to escape.

title: Legends of Murder Collection
description: When a murder is committed under mysterious and supernatural circumstances, the Inspector arrives on the scene, ready to interrogate witnesses, decipher riddles, and fend off attackers seeking their next victim. Ready your spyglass and sword as you take on these two murder mystery RPGs.

title: RunOut
description: “RunOut" is a 3-player action game in which you control unique robots to blow your opponents into a hole!Exhilaration of attackExhilaration due to the sound and direction released when an attack hits!

title: Hellworld!
description: A story-driven 2D platforming game in which you possess your enemies and use their abilities to solve puzzles and make your way through the land of Hellworld.

title: Abh
description: This is a psychological thriller game set in the 1990's, you wake up in a strange house and must search the house for a way out, if that is how your story will end. There will be some jumpscares.

title: Scp: Breakout
description: In SCP: Breakout, spawn as a lowly D-Class that has been granted their one chance to escape, team up with other players or go it alone as you take on the facility at its worst. In the midst of a catastrophic breach, will you survive?

title: Daikaiju Daikessen: Versus
description: Daikaiju Daikessen: Versus is a free to play arcade-style brawler inspired by the likes of classic Neo Geo’s King of the Monsters. The game will be regularly updated with new characters from various indie creators, along with new stages and game modes.

title: Adventures of Megara: Antigone and the Living Toys
description: Help Megara find Antigone and reveal the living toys’ secret

title: Jelly Brawl: Classic
description: Jelly Brawl: Classic is a physics based party game where you gotta flop, and pop your way to the top! Fight alone or against friends and experience the mayhem of the Classic mode as you struggle to be the last jelly standing!

title: Future Fortune
description: Future Fortune is an incremental/idle game featuring big numbers, a multi-layer prestige system, a milestone reward system, multiple upgrade shops, and much more!

title: March! March!
description: March! March! is a turn-based duel game with a puzzle-based combat system. Each turn your army gets a regiment that varies in formation and size. You only have a few seconds to decide where your soldiers fit best. Tell your units where to march! march! and they will do the rest.

title: BeachHead 2020
description: BEACHHEAD 2020 - IT'S NOT JUST A GAME, IT'S THE FUTURE OF REALITY. 20 years ago, BEACH HEAD 2000 changed the gaming paradigm by bringing a new gaming experience to life. 20 years later, the original game creators are ready to do it again. WELCOME TO BH2020 AND A NEW DIMENSION IN GAMING.

title: Apostle: Rebellion
description: A sci-fi, turn-based RPG. Humanity has reached a point where the majority of people opt to become cyborgs called Roids. However, social inequality is once again at a breaking point.

title: Attack of the Mechadonk: The Ultimate Donkey
description: Old school side scrolling shoot'em up. Blast through exciting different locations. Defeating waves of defenders until the final boss battle. Attack of the Mechadonk is a indie game developed for fun and learning for the creator.

title: Lovely Animal Stories
description: Lovely Animal Stories is a short game about cute animals. You have to complete 30 levels with simple tasks. Duration of the game: 20-30 minutes.

title: Retro Three Kingdoms
description: A game of oriental history made by a European War and war and war... Your time is precious.

title: Coloring Pixel: Fantasy Characters
description: Coloring Pixel - Fantasy Characters is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Coloring Pixel has never been this easy!

title: Lucky Tlhalerwa's Cybernetic Titan
description: First-Person Round Survival Shooter, Take Control Of IMS Sergeant John Kozack Working With Corporal Sebastian McGregor To Survive Attacks Of The Global Terrorism Confederation, Use Modern Day & WW2 Guns, Bombs, Attachments, Call In Controllable Support Aircrafts And Survive All Rounds To Evacuate.

title: Ningakki XXVI FPS
description: A first person shooter set in a dark future filled with death robots. The goal is to survive by killing all of the robots. This game is based on the FPS Microgame tutorial project from Unity, and is a work in progress.

title: Unity Invaders
description: Space Action,Casual game,Arcade

title: AsMagnet
description: A simple but profound 3D gimmick puzzle game.

title: Yamafuda! 2nd station
description: This is a game of hiking using cards. You choose a card for each station. If you make gears along the way, you can hike more comfortably. Let's enjoy many mountains!

title: Cosmosapiens
description: Cosmosapiens - Explore a galaxy. Discover strange new worlds with unexpected events and expand the of your reach Interact with diverse alien races. Fight and trade...

title: Behind Closed Doors: A Developer's Tale
description: In Behind Closed Doors, you plays as Ethan, who works for a small indie company, trying to support his pregnant wife. He gets an unexpected phone call during the middle of the night, and is teleports to another dimension, where he has to face a series of challenges to get back to the real world.

title: Soulstopia: Phi
description: Restless spirits robbed of their dreams and ambitions arrive in Soulstopia; a realm where a lonesome maiden awaits to deliver them salvation — Set the ill-fated free in style using various attacks and transform into a Demon when backed into a corner!

title: Flappy Person
description: Ever wondered how it is to be like a flappy person? Well now you can become one.

title: Funny puzzle
description: Funny puzzle game is an electronic form of classic puzzles, now you can collect puzzles on your computer! puzzles is not only a game of the mind, where you need logic, intelligence and ingenuity, but also a great way to calm your nerves.

title: Go Home, Mr. Fisk!
description: Go Home, Mr. Fisk! is a challenging (im)precision platformer, where a single mistake may bring you all the way back to the beginning. Mr. Fisk must make his way up a mountain to get back home to his lake, but climbing is a challenge for a salmon not used to moving on dry land.

title: Lowsy
description: Lowsy - a game whose main goal is to complete the level in such a way that each eyelid gets an eye. The eye has several parameters: color, speed, temperature, height, and you can change them with the help of objects.

title: Crom: Journey of Conquest
description: Crom: Journey of conquest is a real time strategy and adventure game build in a single package. It has a story, monsters, items, challenges, crafting, a unit editor and a large adventure map to play on.

title: Nightmare: The Origins
description: A horror and exploration game, investigate to find out the truth about your presence in these places. You are alone now and no one will hear you scream. Explore, find clues and escape your group must try to successfully discover the source of the evil

title: Memories of Loneliness
description: Memories Of Loneliness is a short story of psychological horror, where you have to find out what happened.

title: League Space
description: The space league has started! It's time to prove yourself and bring victory to your team. Decide who you want to be on your team and win the war against aliens from other galaxies to stop the invasion in your world to end.

title: How to Bathe Your Cat
description: It is well known that cats aren' t really fond of water, but, as pet owners, we know that sometimes a good bath is welcome. Use bombs and blocks to channel the water and clean your cat!

title: TitTok 2
description: TitTok - Minimalistic adventure 2D puzzle platformer with cats, explosions and spinning saws! Continuation of the first part.

title: Sola
description: Sola is a 3rd Person 3D Runner-Platformer with Exploration elements. Can you manage to escape into another world, or will you keep repeating the same dream over and over again?

title: Rectitude
description: Rectitude, is a Sci-Fi visual novel that centers around Timothy, a renowned professor who creates a groundbreaking technology.

title: Midinous
description: Midinous is a grid-based non-linear MIDI sequencer usable with any Digital Audio Workstation or hardware that accepts MIDI messages. Midinous can also generate its own simple sounds either for reference, or for normal use.

title: I'm a cowboy: Western Shooter
description: A hardcore top-down shooter set in the wild west. [/]Each shootout can be the last. You need a great reaction to defeat your enemies.

title: Never End, Neverland!
description: “Never End, Neverland!” is a 2D story-based adventure game, focused on dialogue and unique puzzle gameplay. Follow Amber, an 11-year old girl who wakes up one day in Neverland: a magical, dream-like place where your outer appearance is reflective of your own self-opinions.

title: Procedural Soccer
description: Work your way up from an unknown, low-league team up to the Championship league, or just play a quick game against another team. Explore your world, play different teams and find your favorite!

title: Golf For Fun in Ice
description: Golf for fun ice, is a 2D game based on golf, bringing players a hundred elaborate stages to test their skills.

title: Polyslime
description: An action survival game where you will craft weapons to survive waves of slime monsters.

title: Eyes of the Night
description: Eyes of the Night is a fast-paced, creepy game about finding treasure in a forest during the dark of night, while avoiding the deadly wolves who hunt you! Once you master the hard difficulty, can you survive the hardcore "deathrun" mode?

title: Hero or Foe
description: Hero or Foe could be a fast-paced online multiplayer Hide-and-Seek to fulfill your Hero/Kaijin (wannabe) fantasies with your friends!

title: Once Upon a Time in the Colony
description: 《殖民地往事》是一款生存模拟游戏，前往平行世界的新大陆。在条件恶劣的大陆上生存发展，耕种作物，书写自己的殖民地故事。

title: Close Quarters Supremacy: The Legis
description: A sci-fi third person action shooter, Close Quarters Supremacy The Legis, is a journey into the power struggle over advanced A.I.

title: 4 Witch Seasons & Convenant
description: 刚刚从孤儿院离开的少年遇到了自己亲生父亲的女儿，被要求前往她所在的城市的大学。少年进入了探索都市传说的社团，当在快乐的探索世界的大学生活之中度过的时候，城市之中释放出的吞噬一切的怪物出现在了他的面前，如同神明一样的神秘少女拯救。

title: String Rush
description: String Rush is a puzzle-platformer where you don't control your avatar in real time, but you have to enter the movement commands (input) inside a string and execute them all together.

title: Outergalactic Aliens Pinball
description: Outergalactic Aliens Pinball is a fast paced 8 flipper pinball game featuring 8 main missions, for more info check out our complete walkthrough guide! Get ready to battle the galaxy while listening to a twelve minute original soundtrack to keep the action rolling.

title: Higgs Boson: Timed Puzzle
description: Higgs Boson: Timed Puzzle is a minimalist and challenging puzzle game where the player must rotate pieces considering the time limit to assemble a particle accelerator.

title: Ballin'
description: Play as a ball, rolling, bouncing and flying your ball through the levels and try to beat each one as fast as you can!

title: Colours and Symbols
description: Colours and symbols is a single-player puzzle-solving game. Slide the coloured symbols around and match the sequence provided.

title: Planet Hotpot
description: Planet Hotpot is a VR shooter where you run around shooting aliens as an employee of a galactic megacorporation to recover corporate espionage left all over the world by your bungling coworker.

title: Lake Road
description: Lake Road is a simple addicting hyper-casual game that anyone can play.

title: Toadomination
description: Toadomination is a rogulite, bullethell, looter shooter game that takes you into an ancient confrontation that lasts more than a decade, in a battle between a toad and a viper. Equip yourself with the most powerful weapon, collect capital and meet face to face with the sworn enemy.

title: Cade Prime
description: Cade Prime is the DoD's most advanced android. Bad Dudes have placed him inside of the Mainframe. Can You help him solve challenging puzzles in order to escape ?

title: Unawake
description: Unawakens is a melee first person action adventure game in a surreal realm which combines ancient history and fantasy together. Live your journey beyond the battlefields of the Fallen Angels and the giant Unawakens. The Eternal War continues!

title: Calluna
description: Calluna is a small adventure game about the Norwegian composer and violinist Ole Bull. In Calluna, you can play as Ole Bull in four independent adventures as young, old, rich, and poor. Walk the streets of Bergen, Paris, and Cairo in first-person and explore a semi-open world filled with interactive items, townspeople, and collectibles. Solve quests based on historical events and follow Ole Bull’s dream of fame and glory.

title: Spirit Overflow
description: Spirit Overflow is the first online multiplayer e-sport for indoor cycling! Every game is an intense 3v3 territory battle that calls for skills, strategies, and sweat.

title: She Will Shoot
description: She Will Shoot - is a cool zombie killer from the third person in a variety of scenery. Choose an arena and use different types of weapons to clear it of zombies.

title: Winter Falling: Battle Tactics
description: Lead troops in tense tactical battles, just you and your brain against the dying world. Manage a mercenary company, scavenge supplies, build an army. Go on a quest! Burn down a village or two... Inspired by Warhammer, FTL and Total War.

title: Gomoku Let's Go
description: Gomoku: One of the most popular classic board games for all ages. Experience Zen style visuals, various levels of AI, seamless online multiplayer and Endgame challenges!

title: Anti Frank's Wrath
description: Anti Frank is unleashing his wrath on the universe! Play by yourself or with a few friends locally to take down hoards of zombies and stop Anti Frank! Play as one of four unique characters and buy new upgrades and weapons as you rid the universe of zombies.

title: The Last War
description: The Last War is an online multiplayer shooter where are you try to kill the opposite team with your friends, after you kill so many call And a kill streak and see what happens, customize your weapons and play a lot game modes.

title: Kick Bastards
description: Kick Bastards is a fast paced parkour game with a deep movement system! Kick your way through beautiful and varied levels where you must find your own route to overcome challenges and get a sick time.

title: Furtive
description: Prisoners of war, your team was captured but on the run on a large military controlled island. Explore, gather resources, build a shelter and survive the dangerous military presence on the look out for your team in this epic first person, multiplayer, open world, survival adventure.

title: Fleshport
description: In this horror-adventure game, you play as a child lost in a dystopian parallel dimension where human flesh is a commodity and outsiders are on the menu. You must flee from, hide from, and misdirect various threats as you search for a portal that will bring you back home.

title: Amazing Chicken Adventures
description: Embark on an adventure where gravity is your worst enemy & save the world one egg at a time! Featuring chicken-inappropriate tools and mandatory funny hats. Local split-screen co-op, 3D physics, explorable game world, puzzles, loot to collect. Oh, and a chainsaw.

title: Hackshot
description:
Hackshot is a twisted and extremely deep puzzle take on artillery games.
You are a hacker with the ability to craft unique projectiles, by mixing and matching different abilities. Use your imagination to hack in creative ways, and become a master hacker.

The game contains over 20 hours of shooting viruses and crashing the security, optional content and game modes, open-ended levels, over 7000 unique Cyberballs to craft. In addition, hackers will hack you back and there are no filler levels or condescending tutorials. Just pure challenging fun!

title: Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves
description: In the not so distant past, the Isle of Abbot underwent a mysterious evacuation event. Delve into the secrets of this unsettling place and elicit the girls' tragic fate. An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

title: Bubble People
description: Bubble People is a point-and-click game, click on things with your mouse and have some fun!

title: Searching for Objects in the Forest
description: Searching for objects in the forest is a classic game in the genre of "I'm looking for". During the game, you will have to get acquainted and search various places.

title: Dice vs Dice
description: Roll, Roll, Roll. This is all you have and all you can. Fight the High Lord and his armies with your dice. Believe the luck you have or calculate the chances.

title: The Judgement of Q
description: In an alternate reality, using a keyboard and a mouse, despite the danger of dissolving to nothing again, the player chose to transform potential into actuality, in a space of possibility he will try every key and every combination of keys until he forms an ultimate map of this new reality.

title: The Ghost Cage
description: In this short and light-hearted adventure game, you inadvertently rent a house with a ghost. Should you befriend the ghost, or drive it out of the house? Multiple endings available depending on your choices and the items you find!

title: Gladiator of sparta
description: A classic addictive/fun indie mini game for windows that you will play every time!. Do you ever wonder what is like to be in a realistic combat arena and how it feel? Play as Octavius , the greek warrior who is forced to fight in the gladiatorial arenas with many of the best soldiers in the empire..

title: Dkls
description: In DKLS you can be a person, but you can also be a car, a cactus, a microbe, a penguin or even a pencil. Feel the experience of dissociating from your own reality.

title: Triple Take
description: Triple Take is a fast 2D precision platformer where the stage evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasing difficult levels in vibrant colored worlds!

title: Legend of Labot: The Golden Pearl
description: An action-packed adventure through a breathtaking island of Moran where cute little creatures and powerful monsters live alongside humans. Slay monsters and bosses, collect pearls, unlock powerful abilities and ultimately seek the elusive golden pearl.

title: Unsafe Express
description: Unsafe Express is a cooperative first-person survival horror game for 1-4 players. Navigate through space stations, collect materials and outlast your enemies! Choose your objective based on complexity levels, then cast your vote. Gather items, exterminate hostiles, fulfill missions and repeat!

title: They Are Coming
description: They Are Coming is a hybrid game that combines roguelike, tower defense, and base building in a side-scrolling shooter format. It offers a straightforward gaming experience for pure enjoyment.

title: Wide Open
description: 'Wide Open' was born out of a love for old-school, top-down racing games. We've done our part to make it fresh and set it apart from the rest. With a fully deformable terrain, you can be sure that no lap will be like the last. There are many terrain types like asphalt, dirt, sand, mud, and more!

title: Ghost Terminator
description: Let's vanish some ghosts! Explore, shoot, run, throw grenades, have some fun and get a little scared. Your mission is to find and annihilate all the ghosts.

title: Am I the baddie?
description: Fetch some friends for fun, fast online multiplayer. One of you is the baddie! Everybody else is trying to find the baddie. The baddie is invisible. At least, most of the time...

title: Queen of Zarkov
description: 'Queen of Zarkov' is an 'indie-3rd-person-shooter' that combines elements of 'Escape from Tarkov' with zombies. Embark on missions and loot everything you can, while surviving against different types of zombies and other deadly threats. All your Equipment will be lost if you die, so try to survive!

title: Poly Racing
description: Poly Racing is a low poly casual racing game that for some reason is really fun to drift in. Pick and paint whatever car you like, and just have fun drifting and jumping around. And Poly Racing, early access or not, is going to be a community driven game.

title: Bravest Burden
description: You must protect the last light in a world of darkness. Bravest Burden is a cooperative, multiplayer RPG. In order to survive this brutal world, you will need to look out for each other during your treacherous adventures.

title: Alchemist's Mountain
description: Alchemist's Mountain is a dungeon solving, adventure platformer rendered in hi-bit pixel art. It tells a heartwarming story of courage and endearing characters, looking to find their place in a world of magic and science.

title: Against Ether
description: A fantasy RPG with music based fights where you will help a young girl to change the fate of the world!

title: Void of Space
description: Void of Space is an RPG, horror-survival game, a science fiction adventure. Explore the colonizer ship Genesis IV, abandoned in the atmosphere of an unknown alien planet. Craft items, find weapons and equipment to defend against the hostile life forms you encounter.

title: Crusade of Deitra
description: RPG 2D, Single Player

title: Running Water
description: You are a "Runner" known as subject #0076101, created out of water by a tyrannical A.I. that runs the facility. During testing an error occurs and you are released unexpectedly into the basement where you must run, jump, climb and fight for your freedom using the tools found along the way.

title: Clash of the Metal
description: Hyper Mecha Anime Manga Fighting Unleashed! Clash of the Metal introduces the mecha combat league in a glorious 2D anime styled arcade action fighting game..

title: Beneath the Mountain
description: In Beneath the Mountain, you play as the King of a new Dwarven civilization seeking to find their fortune beneath the mountain. You dig your way through the mountain, encountering many dangerous foes along the way, all while defending your kingdom from periodic Orc invasions.

title: Umbra: Journey Home
description: Umbra: Journey Home is a single-player, 3D puzzle game. Entering lights will cause you to lose control. Create shadows by moving objects in your environment to pass through. Adventure through a mysterious world to discover answers.

title: Noble's Life: Kingdom Reborn
description: Mix of realistic medieval noble simulator with a strategy game of historical depth. Manage your city and villages and make decisions in non-linear events. Command defenses in epic sieges and organize dangerous raids.

title: Force Reboot
description: Force Reboot is a fast-paced nonstop FPS with rogue-lite elements. Force Reboot is entirely focused on nonstop gameplay. You need to get past all of the rooms as fast as you can.

title: Traffic Chase
description: Road racing game. Beep at any traffic driver to start the race! Connect more drivers at any time! Earn money on road races, tune or buy a new car, participate in more racing events. Keep on racing!

title: Cat Capacity
description: A crazy cat lady simulator.

title: Midnight Blues
description: Smash, slash, and shoot your way to freedom through the bloody criminal underworld of a dark, future New York. Midnight Blues features fast-paced, unforgiving combat that will tug at your nerves until every man but you is dead.

title: Facteroids
description: Facteroids is a 3D factory building game about asteroid mining in space. Prospect, mine and manage your production lines in a variety of scenarios and procedurally generated worlds across the entire Solar system.

title: Lost Twins 2
description: A cute puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Engage in clever puzzles & overcome obstacles to help them re-unite & find their way back home

title: Delicious Fruitworld
description: Delicious Fruitworld is a classic jump 'n' run platformer where the goal is to complete each level with as many points as possible.Points are awarded for fruits distributed in the world and for a good time in which the level was passed. Share your score!

title: Code of the Savage
description: Inspired by the classics from the 80s and 90s - Code of the Savage is a western RPG with a heavy emphasis on exploration and NPC interaction. It features a large, seamless open world to explore. There is a focus on player freedom and the consequences that go along with that.

title: Dinogotchi
description: Dinogotchi is a tamagotchi-like game featuring cute dinosaurs. Take care, evolve, have fun and give lots of love to your little jurassic friends!

title: Below the Ocean
description: Dive deep "Below the Ocean" in search of legendary treasures while using your oxygen lifeline to swing passed obstacles! Run, Jump, Swing, Bubble-Jump, Bungee, Slingshot, Puzzle-Solve, Platform, Treasure-Hunt, BELOW THE OCEAN!

title: Tower to Heaven
description: Tower To Heaven is a simple, fun and pretty JRPG. Climb the tower, relax and battle bad guys and reap the reward.

title: Valor
description: Embark on a epic journey through a range of different environments and arenas. Upgrade, personalize and finetune your characters, overcome different challenges and bossfights to prove the single most important thing: your worth as a gladiator.

title: Fira
description: A lovely and emotional 3rd-person puzzle game centered on Kara: a young woman who deals with a painful past experience. Armed with her elemental skill, help her try to find her way accross a mysterious land and put an end to this pain.

title: SwapOut
description: A roguelike FPS game, focusing on gun customization and fast gameplay. Survive the zombie apocalypse, and possibly end it.

title: Necromancer's Gift
description: Necromancer's Gift is a Monster tamer sprinkled with roguelike elements like permadeath and procedurally-generated maps. Capture and face creatures in turn-based battles as you attempt to rescue your dog from a Necromancer that hates humans.

title: Heart & Soul
description: A romance otome visual novel set in Ancient Greece that follows the myth of Psyche as she falls in love with her mysterious husband. Navigate fickle gods and Psyche's looming tragic fate by making meaningful choices that affect the story and its ending.

title: Shinorubi
description: Shinorubi is a Bullet Hell Shoot'em up in the tradition of Danmaku games. A pure dose of adrenaline and frenetic arcade action. Choose your pilot and a spaceship, face powerful Bosses, and experience many cool Arrange Mods!

title: Turing Complete
description: In this challenging puzzle game, you build a computer from scratch and program it. It is a journey through the layers of abstractions of the computer. The game begins when you are abducted by aliens who are testing your intelligence, and from here a lighthearted sci-fi plot evolves.

title: Dance Like a Butterfly, Shot Like a Bee!
description: The steampunk and biological indie game!

title: Starship
description: An unofficial port of Star Fox 64 for PCs including enhancements.

title: Ninja: Rise of a Hero
description: The path of the ninja is hard! Can you save your beloved and become a hero?

title: Orph: The Lost Boy
description: Orph - The Lost Boy is a first-person horror game where you have to find out what happened with your son. Explore an old orphanage, uncover secrets long forgotten, solve puzzles and don't forget to watch your back.

title: Recall: Empty wishes
description: Recall: Empty wishes is a story-driven game based in Taiwan. The story centers around the desires and memories shared by a brother-sister pair.

title: Caves Of Mars
description: Caves of Mars is a new 2D sci-fi action adventure space shooter game set in the mysterious caves of the planet Mars. Your mission is to navigate your spacecraft through 100 procedurally generated levels, battle against and destroy enemies and alien lifeforms and collect as many gems as possible.

title: Randy and Teddy Adventure Road
description: A puzzle 2.5D platformer where Randy, main character, and Teddy, his pup go on an amazing adventure road! Go with them and travel to 5 different worlds where you'll meet pesky robots that will make this journey hard. Solve challenging puzzles and earn stars and achievements as you go!

title: Eternal Evil
description: A small town is being taken over by ghouls. Solve puzzles, carefully read notes and use various weapons against horrific and evolving enemies to uncover what is behind this gruesome event. Eternal Evil is an old-school survival-horror game.

title: Core Alpha
description: Core Alpha is an arcade first-person shooter, which is made in the best traditions of old-school shooters. Fight and defeat hordes of zombies, as well as destroy infected cores to fight the main enemy.

title: Yacht Dice
description: Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.

title: 100 Hidden Birds 2
description: Hidden object game in the cartoon city style. Animation and puzzles. Very large location. Ultra hard! Really very difficult!

title: Rd Mars
description: RD Mars is a top-down shooter where you play as an AI reconstruction of a once-great inventor, Felix Darwins. Explore the laboratory, and learn of his rise and downfall.

title: Puzzle Art: Cats
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with cats.

title: Grid Slayer
description: A unique tactical grid based card game with roguelite elements. Use elemental wizardry to manipulate your environment and defeat overwhelming odds. Test your wits and resolve to rise above the chaos.

title: Smashing time
description: VR destruction simulation, destroy everything in the museum, the oval office, a restaurant or a simple flat ! Wreak havoc and let the devil out !

title: Twelve Floors Below.
description: A claustrophobic horror game taking place in an elevator.

title: Professor of Magical Studies
description: Professor of Magical Studies is an interactive magical school novel by Stephen Granade, where your choices control the story. It’s entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Magical Inspector Momo
description: Magical inspector Momo uncovers the dirty secrets of adults! She must infiltrate without being discovered by anyone and without being caught in a trap!

title: Iris Covenant: Song of the Forgotten Heroes
description: Old School RPG.You accepted a request to save the world from a religious group called Levin Relief Society. Ancient mysteries and unknown dangers are waiting for you ahead the journey.

title: Dungescape!
description: Dungescape! is a casual, minimalist escape-room game in which players control Celeste, a young noblewoman who has been trapped in a series of mazes of ever-increasing size and complexity. More than 40 rooms await to challenge adventurers in this humble kickoff for solo-dev Autism Fanaticism Gaming!

title: Oh, Dungeon Master
description: Oh, Dungeon Master is a dungeon simulator, with elements of a roguelike game. Explore the intricate underground mazes and dense forests to exterminate monsters and find all the pictures!

title: My Inner Darkness is a Hot Anime Girl!
description: My Inner Darkness Is A Hot Anime Girl! is a 3D turn-based RPG game featuring surreal enemy designs and dream-like locations, packed into a gripping story about overcoming the thoughts and memories you would rather not have but can't stop thinking about. You know, the ones that keep you up at night.

title: Pussy 4
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Andarilho: Aliens
description: Survive among aliens!

title: Smelted Kin
description: Science fiction 2D shooter with platformer and metroidvania elements. Players will have to explore a huge research complex consisting of nonlinear levels, which is crowded with robots
